highlights.description: ヒナコは金庫に戻り、絵馬のヒントを元にダイヤルを操作するが、まだ3つのうち1つしか揃わない。直後、怪物に襲われ、ダガー（短刀）を使って戦闘する。

highlights.title: 神水とマユミのメモ（失踪した少女）発見
highlights.description: 戦闘と探索のループの中で、「神水（Divine Water）」の入った竹筒と、以前ポスターで見かけた失踪した少女『マユミ』の悲しいメモを発見。

highlights.title: 金庫ロックの最終ヒント（鶴と亀）発見
highlights.description: 他の絵馬ラックを調べ、パズルに必要な最後の2つのシンボル（鶴と亀）を見つける。これで金庫のロックを解除するための全情報が揃う。

highlights.title: 朱の参道金庫の解除
highlights.description: ヒナコは金庫前に戻り、パズルの組み合わせ（鶴、蛇、亀）を入力し、金庫（Shrine Vault）のロック解除に成功する。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶と感謝
highlights.description: 金庫の解除に成功した区切りで、Zetaは視聴者に対し、感謝の言葉を述べ、今回の配信を終了することを宣言する。

highlights.title: 視聴者からのスパチャとリアクション
highlights.description: 配信の終わりに寄せられたスパチャを読み上げる。99kチャンネル登録者数達成を祝うコメントに対して、まだ達成していないと可愛いらしいリアクションをする。

overview_en.summary: Zeta attempted exploration, combat, and challenging puzzles in the cursed town of "Ebisu-ga-oka" during her first playthrough of 'SILENT HILL f'. She experienced a sanity drop in a red corridor and encountered the fox-masked man, "Tokigami," before successfully unlocking the underground vault in the Scarlet Path using Ema (votive tablet) hints. The entire stream maintained a high level of tension and horror, intermixed with peaceful interaction with viewers, concluding at a natural breaking point.
overview_en.mood: High-tension horror throughout, challenging puzzles, continuous intense combat/survival action, and a peaceful farewell at the end

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Game Overview Introduction
highlights_en.description: Zeta greets the viewers. She explains that the game is R-rated, contains gore and violence, and that this is her first time playing the series. She consults with the chat regarding difficulty settings.

highlights_en.title: Difficulty Settings and Bunny Ear Costume Selection
highlights_en.description: Action difficulty is set to 'Story,' and puzzle difficulty is set to 'Hard.' She selects a cute pink school uniform costume with bunny ears and starts the game.

highlights_en.title: Opening Cutscene: Family Background
highlights_en.description: The protagonist Hinako and her older sister Junko appear. Hinako confides her troubles getting along with friends. Junko gives Hinako a red string 'Omamori' (charm), and they confirm their mutual feelings.

highlights_en.title: Start of Ebisu-ga-oka Exploration and Journal Check
highlights_en.description: The story shifts to the desolate rural town of 'Ebisu-ga-oka,' and the player begins controlling Hinako. The journal reveals the complex family environment and conflicts involving Hinako, her parents (Mother Kimie, Father Kanta), and her sister Junko.

highlights_en.title: Saving at the Shrine and Changing Settings
highlights_en.description: Arriving at the shrine (hokora), which serves as a save point, she saves her progress. She checks the graphic settings and turns off motion blur, which was enabled by default.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Missing Girl Poster and New Cutscene
highlights_en.description: While exploring the town, Hinako finds a poster for the missing girl, 'Mayumi Suzutani.' Afterward, she encounters her friend Sakuko, dressed in a school uniform, and they argue about 500 yen Hinako borrowed. Red vines erupt from the ground and begin attacking Sakuko, signaling the beginning of the serious horror segment.

highlights_en.title: First Escape: Fleeing the Fog Monster
highlights_en.description: In a bizarre space where red vines cover the walls and ground, Hinako begins her escape from the 'Fog Monster.' An action (evasion) tutorial appears, and she desperately searches the map for a safe route.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of 'Memo from Shuu' and Painkillers
highlights_en.description: Along the escape route, she finds painkillers (Red Capsules) placed on a wooden box and a memo from Shuu addressed 'To my partner.' The memo states that Hinako's headaches are caused by unconsciously grinding her teeth when she is stressed.

highlights_en.title: Local Doctor's Memo and Map Recheck
highlights_en.description: She reads the 'Local Doctor's Memo' found near the shrine. It describes local residents healing injuries through prayer, reaffirming the town's peculiarity. Feeling lost afterward, she meticulously checks the map.

highlights_en.title: Start of Eerie House Exploration
highlights_en.description: While exploring maze-like back alleys, she enters an old house, avoiding pursuit by a monster (Sick Villager). The objective 'Investigate the house' is updated.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Bloody Key and Grotesque Cutscene
highlights_en.description: Next to a futon in the house, she finds a bloody mass resembling a coin purse. Inside, she discovers a Bloody Key and a Hannya-like mask (grotesque face).

highlights_en.title: Chase in the House and Key Usage
highlights_en.description: Encountering the monster again inside the house, a chase begins. After struggling with a door that the Bloody Key doesn't fit, she uses the key on another locked door and escapes onto an exterior scaffolding.

highlights_en.title: Healing at the Shrine and Obtaining an 'Omamori'
highlights_en.description: Returning to the Hokora (shrine), she saves and recovers health and sanity. She tries the gacha system where she can draw an 'Omamori' (charm) in exchange for Faith (Here she obtains the 'Clam' Omamori).

highlights_en.title: Rinko Rescue and Combat Tutorial
highlights_en.description: A cutscene occurs where Rinko (a friend) is attacked by the Fog Monster. Hinako picks up a nearby metal pipe and engages in combat for the first time. She learns the tutorial for light and heavy attacks.

highlights_en.title: Weapon Durability and Sanity System Explanation
highlights_en.description: She confirms the weapon durability system, where the metal pipe breaks, and the Sanity system, where focusing with L2 decreases Sanity, and zero Sanity causes health loss.

highlights_en.title: Sakuko's End: A Sad Farewell
highlights_en.description: Hinako reunites with the monstrous Sakuko in front of Chizuruya General Store. Sakuko explains her dream was to become the daughter of the candy store owner, says 'Don't come back,' and collapses. Hinako vows to keep her promise.

highlights_en.title: Collapse of Reality and Transition to the Next Stage
highlights_en.description: After Sakuko disappears, a red fog envelops Hinako, and she finds herself in an old, altar-like location. The next objective is 'Find the exit.'

highlights_en.title: Altar Puzzle Completion and Spatial Shift
highlights_en.description: Solving the puzzle that involves offering items to the mysterious altar found in the Hokora, the space transforms into a corridor engulfed in red light.

highlights_en.title: Rapid Sanity Drop and Corridor of Illusions
highlights_en.description: As she proceeds down the corridor, Hinako is struck by a fierce headache, and her Sanity drastically decreases. She is plagued by phantom sounds mocking her as she tries to open doors and sees shadows plastered on the walls.

highlights_en.title: Encounter with the Mysterious Fox-Masked Man (Tokigami)
highlights_en.description: As Hinako struggles to proceed, a man wearing a fox mask and white attire appears. The man advises Hinako to calm down and opens the door for her instead.

highlights_en.title: Receiving the Lantern and Following the Fox Mask
highlights_en.description: Hinako receives a lantern from the man and steps into the 'Scarlet Path.' The man, named 'Tokigami,' guides Hinako forward.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Ema Hint (Vault Code)
highlights_en.description: After Tokigami disappears, Hinako finds a hint at a display of Ema (votive tablets) covering the wall. The description relates to symbols (Crane, Snake, Turtle) needed to unlock the vault combination lock.

highlights_en.title: Re-attempting Vault Lock and Starting Combat
highlights_en.description: Hinako returns to the vault and operates the dial based on the Ema hint, but only one of the three required symbols aligns. Immediately after, she is attacked by a monster and uses a dagger in combat.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Divine Water and Mayumi's Memo (Missing Girl)
highlights_en.description: During a cycle of combat and exploration, she finds a bamboo tube containing 'Divine Water' and a sorrowful memo written by 'Mayumi,' the missing girl previously seen on the poster.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Final Vault Lock Hints (Crane and Turtle)
highlights_en.description: Investigating other Ema racks, she finds the final two symbols needed for the puzzle (Crane and Turtle). Now she has all the information required to unlock the vault.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking the Scarlet Path Vault
highlights_en.description: Hinako returns to the vault, enters the puzzle combination (Crane, Snake, Turtle), and successfully unlocks the Shrine Vault.

highlights_en.title: Stream End Greeting and Gratitude
highlights_en.description: At the breaking point following the vault successful unlock, Zeta expresses her gratitude to the viewers and announces the end of the current stream.

highlights_en.title: Superchat Readings and Reactions from Viewers
highlights_en.description: She reads out the Superchats received at the end of the stream. In response to comments celebrating her reaching 99k subscribers, she gives a cute reaction stating that she hasn't reached it yet.

title: 【日本事故物件監視協会】夜のソロJSP（閲覧注意）【 雪花ラミィ /ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 雪花ラミィがホラー監視ゲーム『日本事故物件監視協会（JSP）』のソロ配信の後半戦。前回からの続きである「岐阜県 N旅館」をミス1個でクリアした後、4番目の物件「茨城県 S邸」の監視に挑む。茨城県の温泉旅館では、室内で複数の人影や、手が滑って井戸に落ちそうになる男性、さらにパンダの顔が画面いっぱいに現れるなど、不可解でコミカルな異常現象に遭遇し、絶叫しながらも業務を遂行する。苦戦しつつも見逃し1個でS邸の監視業務も完了させ、最終的に用意された全ての物件の監視業務を達成した。
overview.mood: 終始緊張感が高く、絶叫やパニックが多いが、後半はコミカルな異常現象に笑いも混じる

highlights.title: 配信開始と強がり宣言
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶と共に、ホラーゲームに慣れていると強がりつつ、ゲームの利用規約や警告文を読み上げる。

highlights.title: 恐怖を煽る業務開始前の警告演出
highlights.description: ゲーム開始前の画面で、「監視・発見・報告・見落とすな・来る」などの不気味なメッセージが連続で表示される。

highlights.title: 最初の監視業務開始（秋田県 A邸）
highlights.description: 最初の物件である秋田県A邸の監視業務を開始。CAM1（外便所）の薄暗い映像に緊張が走る。

highlights.title: CAM7 井戸にて人影を発見し報告
highlights.description: CAM7（井戸）にて、謎の物体の中に潜んでいる人影を発見し、報告する。

highlights.title: 業務中断通知と給与明細表示（最初の失敗）
highlights.description: 最初の監視業務が中断。異常を4個見逃し、報告数も足りず失敗に終わる。給与が14,850円と表示される。

highlights.title: 再挑戦でCAM2の家族写真の変化に気づく
highlights.description: 再挑戦でCAM2（居間1）のモニターに映る複数の家族写真が変化していることに気づき、恐怖を感じ始める。

highlights.title: 秋田県 A邸をパーフェクトクリア
highlights.description: 2回目の挑戦で、16個の異常を報告し、見逃しゼロで秋田県 A邸の監視業務を完了する。

highlights.title: 2番目の物件「奈良県 T神社」の監視開始
highlights.description: 次の物件「奈良県 T神社」での業務を開始。朽ちた神社の外観や参道のカメラ映像に切り替わる。

highlights.title: CAM4 仏間にて黒い人影の出現に驚き報告
highlights.description: CAM4（仏間）の奥の襖から黒い人影（おばあさん）が歩いてくるのを発見し、絶叫しながら報告する。

highlights.title: CAM1 参道にて謎の土山が出現
highlights.description: CAM1（参道）の階段の途中に、急に土山のような物体が出現し、報告する。

highlights.title: 奈良県 T神社をパーフェクトクリア

highlights.title: 3番目の物件「岐阜県 N旅館」の監視開始

highlights.description: 外観の映像で、背景にあった電柱が消える異常を発見し報告。

highlights.description: CAM2（待機場）でパンダの顔が画面いっぱいに現れるジャンプスケアに絶叫し報告。

highlights.description: 井戸の映像で人が井戸の中を覗き込む異常を発見し、報告する。

highlights.description: 4番目の物件「茨城県 S邸」の監視業務が完了。見逃し1個でクリア。これにより全ての事故物件の監視業務を完了した。

highlights.description: 全物件クリアにより開放された「特別手当」での茨城県 S邸の再監視を開始する。通常業務よりも異常の数が大幅に増えている。

overview_en.summary: Yukihana Lamy plays the latter half of her solo stream of the horror monitoring game "Japan Accident Property Monitoring Association (JSP)." Following the clearance of the previous property, "N Ryokan in Gifu Prefecture," with one mistake, she tackles the fourth property, "S Residence in Ibaraki Prefecture." At the hot spring inn in Ibaraki Prefecture, she encounters inexplicable and comical abnormalities, such as multiple figures inside the rooms, a man nearly slipping and falling into a well, and a giant panda face appearing on the screen. Despite screaming, she completes her duties. Struggling but succeeding with only one oversight, she finishes the monitoring work for the S Residence and ultimately achieves monitoring completion for all available properties.
overview_en.mood: High tension throughout, with lots of screaming and panic, but mixed with laughter in the latter half due to comical abnormal phenomena

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Brave Declaration
highlights_en.description: Greeting the start of the stream, she falsely boasts about being used to horror games while reading the game's terms of service and warning messages.

highlights_en.title: Warning Presentation Before Starting Work that Incites Fear
highlights_en.description: Spooky messages like "Monitor, Find, Report, Don't Miss, Coming" are continuously displayed on the screen before the game starts.

highlights_en.title: Start of the First Monitoring Duty (A Residence, Akita Prefecture)
highlights_en.description: Starts the monitoring duty for the first property, A Residence in Akita Prefecture. Tension rises due to the dimly lit footage from CAM1 (Outdoor Toilet).

highlights_en.title: Figure Discovered and Reported in CAM7 Well
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports a figure hidden inside a mysterious object in CAM7 (Well).

highlights_en.title: Duty Interruption Notice and Pay Slip Display (First Failure)
highlights_en.description: The first monitoring duty is interrupted. It ends in failure due to missing 4 abnormalities and insufficient reports. The salary is displayed as 14,850 yen.

highlights_en.title: Noticing Changes in Family Photos on CAM2 during Re-attempt
highlights_en.description: During the retry, she notices that multiple family photos displayed on the CAM2 (Living Room 1) monitor have changed and starts feeling fear.

highlights_en.title: Perfect Clear of A Residence, Akita Prefecture
highlights_en.description: Completes the monitoring duty for A Residence, Akita Prefecture, on the second attempt, reporting 16 abnormalities with zero oversights.

highlights_en.title: Start of Monitoring for the Second Property: "T Shrine in Nara Prefecture"
highlights_en.description: Starts duties at the next property, "T Shrine in Nara Prefecture." The camera switches to footage of the decaying shrine exterior and approach.

highlights_en.title: Startled Report of Black Figure Appearance in CAM4 Buddhist Room
highlights_en.description: Discovers a black figure (an old woman) walking out from behind the sliding doors in the back of CAM4 (Buddhist Room) and screams while reporting it.

highlights_en.title: Mysterious Mound of Earth Appears on CAM1 Approach
highlights_en.description: Reports a sudden appearance of an object resembling a mound of earth halfway up the stairs on CAM1 (Approach).

highlights_en.title: Perfect Clear of T Shrine, Nara Prefecture
highlights_en.description: Clears the monitoring duty for T Shrine, Nara Prefecture, reporting 16 abnormalities with zero oversights.

highlights_en.title: Start of Monitoring for the Third Property: "N Ryokan in Gifu Prefecture"
highlights_en.description: Selects the next property, "N Ryokan in Gifu Prefecture," and starts the duty. The footage switches to an even more desolate property.

highlights_en.title: Screaming Report of Figure with White Mask in CAM7 Fan
highlights_en.description: A black figure wearing a white mask suddenly appears from between the trees in CAM7 (Fan), causing Lamy to scream and report it.

highlights_en.title: Reporting Anomaly in Torii Gate Decoration on CAM2 Exterior
highlights_en.description: Confirms and reports that the decoration above the torii gate in CAM2 (Exterior) is broken.

highlights_en.title: Disappearance and Report of Komainu (Guardian Dogs)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the Komainu disappearing in the footage of CAM1 (Approach).

highlights_en.title: Reporting Change in Deity Decoration on CAM7 (Fan)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly in CAM7 (Fan) where the central stone decoration changes and something resembling a Shimenawa rope appears.

highlights_en.title: Cat Face Fills the Screen (Healing)
highlights_en.description: An anomaly occurs in CAM6 (Bell and Stone) where a cat's face suddenly appears, offering comfort rather than fear due to its cuteness.

highlights_en.title: Completion of Monitoring Duty for N Ryokan, Gifu Prefecture
highlights_en.description: Monitoring duty for the third property, "N Ryokan in Gifu Prefecture," is completed. Cleared with 16 reports and 1 oversight.

highlights_en.title: Start of Monitoring for the Fourth Property: "S Residence in Ibaraki Prefecture"
highlights_en.description: Starts duties at the fourth property, "S Residence in Ibaraki Prefecture" (Hot Spring Inn). The interior looks like an inn but is dilapidated.

highlights_en.title: Warning Message on CAM6 (Main Bath Entrance)
highlights_en.description: An abnormality detection message, like a warning to employees, is displayed in the footage of the Main Bath Entrance.

highlights_en.title: Anomaly of the Entrance Door Opening on CAM1 (Exterior)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where the exterior door is slightly ajar.

highlights_en.title: Handprint-like Anomaly on CAM2 (Lower Hallway)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports a black, handprint-like anomaly on the floor of the lower hallway.

highlights_en.title: Female Ghost Rushes Forward on CAM7 (Dressing Room)
highlights_en.description: Screams at a jump scare where a long-haired female ghost appears to fill the screen in the dressing room.

highlights_en.title: Group of Guests Appears in CAM5 (Grand Hall)
highlights_en.description: Screams and reports an anomaly where multiple figures resembling a group of guests with blurred faces appear in the Grand Hall.

highlights_en.title: Display Change on CAM6 (Main Bath Entrance)
highlights_en.description: Reports an anomaly where the display on CAM6 (Main Bath Entrance) changes to "Men's Main Bath."

highlights_en.title: Anomaly of Mop Disappearing in CAM7 (Dressing Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of a mop leaning against the wall disappearing in the dressing room footage.

highlights_en.title: Increase in Papers Pasted on Wall on CAM6 (Stairs)
highlights_en.description: Reports an anomaly where red talismans or papers increase across the entire wall in the staircase footage.

highlights_en.title: Shower Head Extends on CAM8 (Main Bath)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the showerhead extending in CAM8 (Main Bath).

highlights_en.title: Guest Room Becomes Wider on CAM4 (Guest Room)
highlights_en.description: Reports a "renovation-type" anomaly where the guest room footage changes, making the room appear wider.

highlights_en.title: Male Ghost Appears on CAM2 (Lower Hallway)
highlights_en.description: A male ghost suddenly appears in the lower hallway, prompting a report.

highlights_en.title: Anomaly of Utility Pole Disappearing on CAM1 (Exterior)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the utility pole in the background disappearing in the exterior footage.

highlights_en.title: Panda Rushes Forward on CAM2 (Waiting Area)
highlights_en.description: Screams and reports a jump scare where a giant panda face appears to fill the screen in CAM2 (Waiting Area).

highlights_en.title: Anomaly of Person Peering into Well on CAM5 (Well)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly in the well footage where a person is peering down into the well.

highlights_en.title: Bloodstain Appears on CAM9 (Near Tea Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where a palm-sized bloodstain appears on the carpet.

highlights_en.title: Eyes Peering from Shoji Screen Gap on CAM3 (Living Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where someone's eyes are peering through the gap in the shoji screen in CAM3 (Living Room).

highlights_en.title: Mannequin Falls Down on CAM2 (Waiting Area)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where the mannequin in CAM2 (Waiting Area) has fallen over.

highlights_en.title: Smoke Billows in CAM8 (Second Floor Room)
highlights_en.description: An anomaly occurs and is reported where the chair in CAM8 (Second Floor Room) is overturned, and smoke seems to billow from the corner of the screen.

highlights_en.title: Completion of Monitoring Duty for S Residence, Ibaraki, and Full Clearance Achievement
highlights_en.description: Monitoring duty for the fourth property, "S Residence in Ibaraki Prefecture," is completed. Cleared with 1 oversight. This completes monitoring duties for all accident properties.

highlights_en.title: Start of "Special Allowance" Monitoring for S Residence, Ibaraki Prefecture
highlights_en.description: Starts re-monitoring the S Residence in Ibaraki Prefecture under the "Special Allowance" mode, unlocked by clearing all properties. The number of abnormalities is significantly increased compared to regular duty.

highlights_en.title: Warning Mark on CAM6 (Stairs)
highlights_en.description: Reports a warning mark appearing on the staircase footage (CAM6), which had no issues during the regular duty, right after the start.

highlights_en.title: Long Object Appears in CAM3 (Living Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where a long, black object wriggles out from under the floor in the living room footage.

highlights_en.title: "Freedom" Text Changes on CAM7 (Hieroglyph Room)
highlights_en.description: Reports the word "自由" (Jiyuu/Freedom) written on the room wall changing to only "自" (Ji/Self).

highlights_en.title: Anomaly on Ceiling of CAM7 (Hieroglyph Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports a "renovation-type" anomaly where the torn ceiling wallpaper is now neat.

highlights_en.title: Figure with Knife Appears on CAM9 (In Front of Tea Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and screams while reporting a dangerous anomaly: a man standing in the hallway holding a knife.

highlights_en.title: Face Under Floor Disappears on CAM4 (Under Floor)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the Noh mask-like face under the floor disappearing.

highlights_en.title: Flowers Change in CAM3 (Living Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports an anomaly where the flowers placed on the floor change from fresh flowers to artificial flowers.

highlights_en.title: Anomaly of Person Present on CAM1 (Exterior)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of a person standing on the exterior balcony.

highlights_en.title: Panda Rushes Forward on CAM2 (Waiting Area) (2nd Time)
highlights_en.description: Encounters and reports the jump scare of the panda face filling the screen again on CAM2 (Waiting Area).

highlights_en.title: Mannequin Falls Down on CAM2 (Waiting Area)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the mannequin in CAM2 (Waiting Area) having fallen to the floor.

highlights_en.title: Man Peering into Well on CAM5 (Well) (2nd Time)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of a man peering into the well in the well footage.

highlights_en.title: Painting Changes on CAM8 (Second Floor Room)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the painting hanging on the wall of the second-floor room disappearing.

highlights_en.title: Female Ghost Disappears on CAM6 (Stairs)
highlights_en.description: Discovers and reports the anomaly of the female ghost standing on the stairs disappearing.

highlights_en.title: Full Property Clearance Achieved by Clearing S Residence Special Allowance
highlights_en.description: Cleared the Special Allowance monitoring duty, completing all property assignments. 21 reports, 1 oversight. Lamy reveals her joy and sense of accomplishment.

highlights_en.title: Stream End Greeting

overview_en.summary: The latter half of Roboco-san's regular singing stream, "Midnight RBmelody". After setting an emotional mood with Studio Ghibli songs and nostalgic classics, the final section ramped up the excitement with upbeat and catchy anime songs, such as the opening theme of 'Cardcaptor Sakura' and the theme from 'Urusei Yatsura'. The stream concluded with the moving ballad 'Kotonoha', but also included casual chat throughout, such as revealing the legendary behind-the-scenes story of a Valorant tournament she participated in (the 3 AFK incident). Overall, it was an energetic and fun stream until the very end.
overview_en.mood: Emotional and sometimes nostalgic atmosphere. The final section was exciting with lighthearted anime songs.

highlights_en.title: Opening & Song Selection Announcement
highlights_en.description: The stream starts. Announces that today's theme is "Midnight RBmelody" featuring many nostalgic anime songs.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Onegai! Cinderella"
highlights_en.description: Sings the first song, "Onegai! Cinderella." Starts with a bright idol song.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Propose"
highlights_en.description: Sings the second song, "Propose." Delivers a ballad with emotional vocals.

highlights_en.title: Behind-the-Scenes Valorant Event Story (Member Picks and Reason for Deadlock)
highlights_en.description: Mentions participation in the Valorant event at Tokyo Game Show (VALORANT Masters Japan). Talks about how strong the opponents were and shares behind-the-scenes stories about each member's character picks (Laplus: Smoker, Mue-chan: Sentinel, Lamy: Initiator, Noa: Duelist). Laughs and says she picked Deadlock half-jokingly because the other members had already chosen the characters they wanted to use.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Kirby★March"
highlights_en.description: Sings the third song, "Kirby★March." Creates excitement with a nostalgic anime song.

highlights_en.title: Behind-the-Scenes Valorant Event Story ② (Regret over using Deadlock)
highlights_en.description: Mentions again the regret of having fought with Deadlock at the Valorant event because the opponents were too strong. Talks about how teammate Suichan saved her during a pinch and her desire to have performed better with Deadlock.

highlights_en.title: Singing "secret base ~Kimi ga Kureta Mono~"
highlights_en.description: Sings the fourth song, "secret base ~Kimi ga Kureta Mono~," in an acoustic version. Expresses the poignant atmosphere of the end of summer.

highlights_en.title: Surprised by the speed of time
highlights_en.description: Realizes during the stream that September is ending and can't hide her surprise at how fast time flies. Laments that the year-end will arrive quickly.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Nandemonaiya"
highlights_en.description: Sings the fifth song, "Nandemonaiya." Delivers a moving song with vocals that resonate with the listeners' hearts.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Sparkle"
highlights_en.description: Sings the sixth song, "Sparkle." Creates an emotional climax, following a flow similar to a movie medley.

highlights_en.title: Thoughts after singing "Sparkle" and the speed of time
highlights_en.description: After finishing "Sparkle," they discuss "Your Name." Expresses surprise that roughly nine years have passed since the movie's release and talks about the rapid passage of time.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Princess Mononoke"
highlights_en.description: Sings the theme song from the Ghibli movie 'Princess Mononoke' as the seventh song. Showcases quiet yet powerful vocals.

highlights_en.title: Ghibli behind-the-scenes story (Ponyo voice recording)
highlights_en.description: After singing "Princess Mononoke," mentions she loved the behind-the-scenes story of the voice recording for Ghibli works, especially 'Ponyo on the Cliff by the Sea'. Says she felt touched when the voice actor's mother praised them.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Inochi no Namae"
highlights_en.description: Sings the eighth song, "Inochi no Namae" from 'Spirited Away'. Captivates listeners with a gentle, embracing voice.

highlights_en.title: Discussion about the jawline in 'The Tale of the Princess Kaguya'
highlights_en.description: Mentions 'The Tale of the Princess Kaguya'. Jokes that the sharpness of the jawline was so memorable that she only remembers that detail.

highlights_en.title: Emotional singing of "Teru's Song"
highlights_en.description: Sings the ninth song, "Teru's Song" from 'Tales from Earthsea'. Demonstrates high expressiveness with emotional vocals, sometimes sounding like she is holding back tears.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Kaze ni Naru"
highlights_en.description: Sings the tenth song, "Kaze ni Naru" from 'The Cat Returns'. Comforts listeners with a relaxed and gentle voice.

highlights_en.title: Expressing desire for Ghibli works to continue
highlights_en.description: Mentions 'Ponyo on the Cliff by the Sea' and expresses a strong desire to pass on Ghibli works to future generations of children.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Catch You Catch Me"
highlights_en.description: Sings the 11th song, the opening theme of 'Cardcaptor Sakura', "Catch You Catch Me." Brightens up the final segment with an upbeat song.

highlights_en.title: Singing "Lum's Love Song"
highlights_en.description: Performs the 12th song, the theme song from 'Urusei Yatsura'. Sings the upbeat anime song with a cute voice.

highlights_en.title: Final song "Kotonoha" performance
highlights_en.description: Sings the final song, the ballad "Kotonoha," in a subdued manner to conclude the stream. Infuses emotion into the lyrics, creating a moving finale.

highlights_en.title: Chat about Saturday night drowsiness
highlights_en.description: Discusses a relatable topic: getting sleepy on Saturday nights despite knowing you don't have to work the next day and wanting to stay up late.

highlights_en.title: Valorant Tournament Behind-the-Scenes (The miracle of 3 out of 4 players being AFK)
highlights_en.description: Shares an anecdote from a previous Valorant tournament. Reveals the legendary story of a match where the team's Duelist didn't instantly pick, resulting in 3 of the 4 players going AFK, but the opposing team, finding it amusing, all boycotted, resulting in a draw (+0 points).

highlights_en.title: Membership/Gift Reading and Ending
highlights_en.description: Expresses gratitude to membership subscribers and gift senders. Reviews the singing stream overall and announces the next ASMR stream, concluding the broadcast.

title: 【縦型雑談歌枠】歌ったり、お話したり🎵【ホロライブ DEV_IS 響咲リオナ】

overview.summary: 配信中盤から終盤にかけて、米津玄師、EGOIST、LiSA、いきものがかりなどの人気楽曲をピアノアレンジで披露する歌枠が中心となった。特に『Departures 〜あなたにおくるアイの歌〜』や『紅蓮華』といった感情のこもった曲を力強く歌い上げた。歌唱後には、音響機材のアップグレードやアコースティックライブへの意欲など、音楽活動への真剣な思いを語った。また、自身の内面的な悩みや「中二病」的な要素を笑いに変えつつ、リスナーへの深い感謝と「皆で笑って、皆で泣こう」というメッセージを伝え、感動的な雰囲気で締めくくった。

overview_en.summary: The stream primarily featured a singing segment, where popular songs by artists such as Kenshi Yonezu, EGOIST, LiSA, and Ikimonogakari were performed with piano arrangements, especially towards the middle and end. Emotionally charged songs like "Departures ~Anata ni Okuru Ai no Uta~" and "Gurenge" were sung powerfully. After singing, the streamer discussed their serious commitment to musical activities, mentioning intentions to upgrade audio equipment and potentially hold an acoustic live performance. They concluded in an emotional atmosphere by turning their personal anxieties and elements of "Chuunibyou" (eighth-grade syndrome) into humor, while expressing deep gratitude to the listeners and delivering the message: "Let's laugh together and cry together."

highlights_en.description: Enthusiastically singing LiSA's popular song 'Gurenge' with a piano arrangement, delivering a powerful and emotional performance.

highlights_en.title: Post-'Gurenge' Reflection and Feeling of Growth
highlights_en.description: Discussing minor mistakes made while singing, but noting that the piano arrangement allowed their voice to come out well and felt relaxing.

highlights_en.title: Self-Awareness of "Chuunibyou" and Enthusiasm for Singing Segments
highlights_en.description: Reflecting on their own statements, admitting they might have "Chuunibyou," but reaffirming their love for expressing themselves and interacting with listeners.

highlights_en.title: Fourth Song: Singing Ikimonogakari's 'YELL' (Support Song)
highlights_en.description: Performing 'YELL' with gentle piano accompaniment, dedicating the song as support for the listeners.

highlights_en.title: Gratitude to Viewers and Future Aspirations
highlights_en.description: Expressing gratitude to listeners through the singing segment and talking about enthusiasm for future activities and growth. Encouraging everyone to "laugh together and cry together."

highlights_en.title: Reading Super Chats and General Chat
highlights_en.description: Reading Super Chats, reiterating thanks, and engaging in general discussion leading up to the end of the stream.

highlights_en.title: Continuation of Super Chat Reading (from Anime Song Segment) and Old Wound Talk
highlights_en.description: Continuing to read Super Chats received during the singing segment. They humorously described their own "Chuunibyou"-like statements as "old wounds starting to speak."

highlights_en.title: Reading Super Chats from the Terraria Stream
highlights_en.description: Reading Super Chats received during a previous Terraria stream.

highlights_en.title: Ending: Completion of Super Chat Reading and Words of Gratitude
highlights_en.description: Finishing reading Super Chats from past streams, reiterating thanks for member gifts and merchandise purchases. Expressing the goal of working hard on vocal training tomorrow, and concluding the stream with words of appreciation for the viewers.

title: #5【Ace Attorney Investigations】Middle of Case 4! More young Edgey (SPOILERS!)【Pavolia Reine/holoID】

overview.summary: 『逆転検事 1』エピソード4「忘れられた肖像」のエピローグから、最終エピソード5「燃えさかる逆転」の導入部をプレイしました。御剣は、カリスト・ユウ（潮見ユウ）が偽のヤタガラスであると見破った過去を回想し、一柳ケイとの固い絆を確認します。エピソード4が解決した後、すぐに次の事件、エピソード5が始まります。御剣はオフィスで休息を取る暇もなく、ケイが持ってきた新聞記事から、怪盗ヤタガラスが「大使館」を狙っているという新たな予告状を知ります。舞台は中立地帯にある劇場「テアトル・ネウトラリス」へ。配信者はゲーム進行中に不覚にも口内を傷つけてしまい、急遽、健康を優先し、最終エピソードの開始時点で配信を終了しました。
overview.mood: 感動、決意、緊迫した新たな事件の始まり、体調不良による中断

highlights.title: 配信開始とオープニングトーク
highlights.description: 配信開始時の挨拶。チャットの不調が一時的に発生するものの回復。リスナーとの雑談や、プレイするゲーム（Ace Attorney Investigations Collection）の確認を行う。

highlights.title: エピソード4「忘れられた肖像」開始
highlights.description: 前回からのセーブデータでゲームを再開。御剣怜侍が10年前の事件、KG-8事件の真相を追うエピソード4の途中からスタート。

highlights.title: 裁判所控え室での登場人物と会話
highlights.description: 裁判所控え室にて、御剣怜侍、狩魔冥、ディック・バッド刑事、そして幼少期の一柳ケイ（Kay）が登場。御剣が部屋に充満する甘い匂いに気づく。

highlights.title: バッド刑事からKG-8事件の真相が語られる
highlights.description: バッド刑事が、KG-8事件の被害者とミス・ユウ（カリスト・ユウ）の姉妹、そして逮捕された秘書コリン・デヴォアに関する過去の出来事を回想する。

highlights.title: ヤタガラスが常に一歩先を行く3つの理由
highlights.description: バッド刑事が、怪盗ヤタガラスがなぜ常に警察より優位に立てるのか、彼らが持つ3つの特性について説明する。

highlights.title: 証拠品「ヤタガラスのカード」の詳細確認
highlights.description: ヤタガラスが世間に真実を公表する際に送る白いカードの証拠品が、オーガナイザーに記録される。

highlights.title: 御剣とバッド刑事の探究心
highlights.description: バッド刑事が、自分が生きているのはヤタガラスの謎を解くためだと語り、御剣もまた、その答えを見つけるために検事になったと応じる。

highlights.title: ファラデーのオーガナイザーと「ヤタガラスの鍵」
highlights.description: 裁判官から渡された証拠品の中に、ファラデーのオーガナイザーが含まれていることを確認。その中に隠されていた特殊な形状の「ヤタガラスの鍵」を発見。

highlights.title: ナイフが法廷に持ち込まれた謎
highlights.description: 証拠品の中にあったナイフが、厳重な警備を敷かれた法廷内に持ち込まれた方法について推理を進める。オーガナイザーにナイフに関する記述がないこと、ヤタガラスの鍵の形状の奇妙さがヒントとなる。

highlights.title: ヤタガラスの鍵のトリック解明
highlights.description: ヤタガラスの鍵の柄の部分が、ナイフの柄と一致することに御剣が気づき、鍵がナイフに変形するギミックを解明する。

highlights.title: 真のヤタガラスの正体に近づく推理
highlights.description: 御剣は、ファラデーがナイフの存在を知らなかったことを前提に、鍵の仕掛けを知る人物が真のヤタガラスであると推測する。

highlights.title: 失われた証拠品：監視カメラ映像
highlights.description: 証拠品リストを確認したところ、裁判で流されたはずの監視カメラの映像がなくなっていることに気づく。

highlights.title: 捜査再開：被告人控え室2
highlights.description: 御剣は監視カメラの映像を探すため、事件現場となった被告人控え室2へ再び向かう。

highlights.title: 狼の登場：国際捜査官ラン・ジー
highlights.description: 控え室2でバッド刑事と、国際捜査官のラン・ジー（狼）に遭遇。ランは挑発的な態度で、検事を軽視する言動をとる。

highlights.title: キー/ナイフの真実をバッドに突きつける
highlights.description: 御剣が変形するヤタガラスの鍵の証拠をバッド刑事に提示し、彼が鍵の真の機能を認識していなかったことを確認する。

highlights.title: バッド刑事の最初の証言
highlights.description: 御剣の求めに応じて、バッド刑事は銃声を聞いた時の状況（ロビー1でユウと話していた）を改めて証言する。

highlights.title: 銃声のトリックと風船の破片
highlights.description: 御剣が、潮見ユウがガムシューに渡した風船の破片を提示し、爆発音は銃声ではなく風船が割れた音だと指摘する。

highlights.title: 密室の音漏れ：音響設備の構造
highlights.description: 音漏れしにくい部屋の構造にもかかわらず銃声が聞こえた理由を探るため、バッド刑事の証言から部屋が防音仕様であることを突き止める。

highlights.title: 音漏れの真実：窓とテレビの音
highlights.description: 潮見ユウが故意に香水をこぼさせ、窓を開けさせたことで、ロビー2のテレビの音がロビー1まで聞こえていたことを解明する。

highlights.title: ビデオテープの発見
highlights.description: 御剣がテレビ台を調べ、行方不明だった監視カメラのビデオテープが、ビデオデッキの中に入ったままになっているのを発見する。

highlights.title: 映像の確認と犯行時間の捏造
highlights.description: 監視ビデオを確認し、ミスター・レルが殺人を犯したシーンを再生。犯人が映像を使って犯行時間を偽装しようとした意図を理解する。

highlights.title: 潮見ユウの逆転尋問とガムシューへの疑い
highlights.description: 法廷に戻った潮見ユウが、ガムシュー刑事のアリバイが崩れていることを根拠に、彼が真犯人だと主張する。

highlights.title: 御剣の反論準備
highlights.description: 御剣は潮見ユウの推理の矛盾点（ファラデーの手に誰が銃を握らせたか）を見つけ、対決の準備を整える。

highlights.title: 潮見ユウの嘲笑と御剣の反撃
highlights.description: 潮見ユウが、窓が開いていたことの証明を要求し、御剣は監視カメラの映像を使って、犯行時刻のトリックを証明し、反撃する。

highlights.title: 音漏れの原因の証明：窓と香水
highlights.description: 御剣は、潮見ユウが窓を開けさせた理由として、ロビー1でこぼした香水の匂いを消すためだったことを立証する。

highlights.title: 御剣、潮見ユウを殺人犯として告発
highlights.description: 御剣は、これまでの証拠に基づき、潮見ユウこそがファラデーとレルの二重殺人の真犯人であると告発する。

highlights.title: 潮見ユウの反論と証拠の穴の指摘
highlights.description: 潮見ユウは、御剣の推理にはまだ決定的な証拠がないと反論し、鍵が凶器になった経緯を尋ねる。

highlights.title: ヤタガラスの鍵のトリックと真の狙い
highlights.description: 御剣は、ファラデーの所持品の中にナイフが存在しなかったことを指摘し、鍵がナイフに変形するギミックを知っていた人物が真の犯人であると突きつける。

highlights.title: 潮見ユウの正体が判明：偽のヤタガラス、カリスト・ユウ
highlights.description: 潮見ユウは「ヤタガラス」が三本の足を持つと述べ、自らが怪盗ヤタガラスの一員（または後継者）であるカリスト・ユウであると正体を明かし、法廷は騒然となる。

highlights.title: 事件の全貌の告白と真の動機
highlights.description: カリスト・ユウは、レルの弁護士として彼を利用し、ヤタガラスの鍵を奪ってファラデーを殺害。口封じのためにレルも殺害したことを告白する。

highlights.title: カリスト・ユウの逮捕とケイの行動
highlights.description: カリスト・ユウが銃を取り出すが、バッド刑事と狩魔冥によって取り押さえられ逮捕される。混乱の中、幼いケイが法廷から姿を消す。

highlights.title: 事件解決とエピローグ：ケイとの再会
highlights.description: 数ヶ月後、御剣がスイートウォーター・ランドで成長したケイと再会。ケイは亡くなった父（真のヤタガラス）の秘密を知るための旅に出ていたことを明かす。

highlights.title: ガムシューへのお土産：スイスロール
highlights.description: ケイが御剣に、ガムシュー刑事へ渡すようにと「友好の証」であるコートハウス・スペシャル・スイスロール（スイスチーズではない）を託す。

highlights.title: エピローグの続き：御剣の誓い
highlights.description: 御剣はケイに、ユウが逃亡した際に彼女が命を救ってくれたこと、そしてヤタガラスの事件を清算する時が来たことを伝える。

highlights.title: エピソード4終了とセーブ
highlights.description: エピソード4「忘れられた肖像」が終了。配信者はゲームをセーブし、最終エピソード5へ進む準備をする。

highlights.title: エピソード5「燃えさかる逆転」オープニング
highlights.description: 最終エピソードのタイトルが表示される。オープニング映像は火事のシーンから始まり、二枚のヤタガラスのカードや、引き裂かれた二国の旗が映し出される。

highlights.title: 御剣のオフィスでの短い休息
highlights.description: 御剣が検事局のオフィスで紅茶を飲みながら、最近の立て続けの事件（大使館の殺人、テーマパークの誘拐殺人、そして自身のオフィスでの事件）を回想する。

highlights.title: ケイが新たな情報を持ち込む
highlights.description: ケイが興奮して御剣のオフィスに駆け込み、新聞記事を見せる。記事には「ヤタガラスが大使館に予告状を送った」という内容が書かれている。

highlights.title: streamer accident: 配信者が口内を負傷
highlights.description: 配信者がセリフを読み上げている最中に、誤って口内を噛んでしまい、出血する。チャットは体調を心配する。（この後、怪我のため配信を早めに終了することを決定）

highlights.title: 2枚のヤタガラスカードの謎
highlights.description: 御剣は、新聞に掲載されたヤタガラスのカードが、自身が手に入れたカードと色が異なる点に気づき、この事件が重要であると認識する。

highlights.title: 中立地帯の劇場へ向かう
highlights.description: 事件現場は、2つの国が共有する中立的な劇場「テアトル・ネウトラリス」。ケイはそこで「鋼のサムライ」のショーが開催されていることを伝える。

highlights.title: 配信終了（早退）
highlights.description: 配信者が口内を噛んだ怪我のため、体調を考慮し、最終ケースの序盤で配信を早めに終了することをリスナーに告げた。次回にケース5を改めてスタートする。

overview_en.summary: Played the epilogue of "Ace Attorney Investigations 1," Episode 4, "The Forgotten Turnabout," leading into the introduction of the final episode, Episode 5, "Turnabout Ablaze." Edgeworth reflects on uncovering Callisto Yew (Yew Shiver) as the fake Yatagarasu and confirms his strong bond with Kay Faraday. Immediately after Episode 4 concludes, the next case, Episode 5, begins. Edgeworth has no time to rest in his office before Kay brings him a newspaper article revealing a new calling card from the phantom thief Yatagarasu targeting the "Embassy." The scene shifts to the neutral theater, "Teatro Neutralis." Unfortunately, the streamer accidentally injured their mouth during gameplay reading lines, prioritizing health, and abruptly ended the stream right at the beginning of the final episode.
overview_en.mood: Emotional, Determination, Tense Start of a New Case, Interruption due to Poor Health

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Opening Talk
highlights_en.description: Greetings at the start of the stream. Temporary chat malfunction occurred but recovered. Casual conversation with listeners and confirmation of the game being played (Ace Attorney Investigations Collection).

highlights_en.title: Start of Episode 4, "The Forgotten Turnabout"
highlights_en.description: Resuming the game from the previous save data. Starting partway through Episode 4, where Miles Edgeworth pursues the truth behind the KG-8 Incident from 10 years ago.

highlights_en.title: Characters and Conversation in the Court Preparation Room
highlights_en.description: Miles Edgeworth, Franziska von Karma, Detective Dick Gumshoe, and the young Kay Faraday appear in the court preparation room. Edgeworth notices a sweet smell filling the room.

highlights_en.title: Detective Gumshoe Reveals the Truth of the KG-8 Incident
highlights_en.description: Detective Gumshoe recalls past events concerning the victim of the KG-8 Incident, Miss Yew (Callisto Yew)'s sister, and the arrested secretary, Colin Devora.

highlights_en.title: Three Reasons Why Yatagarasu is Always One Step Ahead
highlights_en.description: Detective Gumshoe explains the three characteristics that allow the phantom thief Yatagarasu to always maintain an advantage over the police.

highlights_en.title: Detailed Examination of the "Yatagarasu Card" Evidence
highlights_en.description: The white card used by Yatagarasu to publish the truth to the public is recorded as evidence in the organizer.

highlights_en.title: Edgeworth and Detective Gumshoe's Curiosity
highlights_en.description: Detective Gumshoe states that he lives to solve the mystery of Yatagarasu, and Edgeworth responds that he, too, became a prosecutor to find that answer.

highlights_en.title: Faraday's Organizer and the "Yatagarasu Key"
highlights_en.description: Confirmation that Faraday's organizer is among the evidence handed over by the judge. They discover the unusually shaped "Yatagarasu Key" hidden inside it.

highlights_en.title: The Mystery of How the Knife Was Brought into the Courtroom
highlights_en.description: Deduction regarding how the knife, which was among the evidence, was brought into the heavily guarded courtroom. The lack of mention of the knife in the organizer and the strange shape of the Yatagarasu Key provide clues.

highlights_en.title: Unraveling the Trick of the Yatagarasu Key
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth realizes that the handle of the Yatagarasu Key matches the handle of the knife, revealing the gimmick that allows the key to transform into a knife.

highlights_en.title: Deduction Closes in on the True Identity of Yatagarasu
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth hypothesizes that, assuming Faraday didn't know about the knife, the person who knew the key's mechanism must be the true Yatagarasu.

highlights_en.title: Lost Evidence: Security Camera Footage
highlights_en.description: Upon checking the evidence list, they realize that the security camera footage, which should have been shown in court, is missing.

highlights_en.title: Investigation Restarted: Defendant Lobby 2
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth heads back to Defendant Lobby 2, the scene of the crime, to look for the security camera footage.

highlights_en.title: Appearance of the Wolf: International Investigator Shih-na
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth encounters Detective Gumshoe and International Investigator Shih-na (The Wolf) in Lobby 2. Shih-na adopts a provocative attitude and speaks condescendingly toward the prosecutor.

highlights_en.title: Confronting Gumshoe with the Key/Knife Truth
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth presents the transforming Yatagarasu Key evidence to Detective Gumshoe, confirming that he was unaware of the key's true function.

highlights_en.title: Detective Gumshoe's Initial Testimony
highlights_en.description: At Edgeworth's request, Detective Gumshoe testifies again about the circumstances when he heard the gunshot (talking to Yew in Lobby 1).

highlights_en.title: The Gunshot Trick and Balloon Fragments
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth presents the balloon fragments Yew Shiver gave to Gumshoe, pointing out that the loud noise was the sound of a balloon popping, not a gunshot.

highlights_en.title: Sound Leakage in a Locked Room: Acoustic Structure
highlights_en.description: To determine why a gunshot was heard despite the room's structure resisting sound leaks, Gumshoe's testimony confirms the room is soundproofed.

highlights_en.title: The Truth of the Sound Leak: Window and TV Volume
highlights_en.description: It is revealed that Yew Shiver intentionally caused perfume to spill and had the window opened, allowing the sound of the TV in Lobby 2 to be heard in Lobby 1.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of the Videotape
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth examines the TV stand and discovers the missing security camera videotape still inside the VCR.

highlights_en.title: Confirming the Footage and Fabrication of the Time of the Crime
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth reviews the security video, playing the scene where Mr. Rehl commits murder. He understands the perpetrator's intent to use the footage to falsify the time of the crime.

highlights_en.title: Yew Shiver's Counter-Cross-Examination and Suspicion on Gumshoe
highlights_en.description: Returning to the courtroom, Yew Shiver argues that Detective Gumshoe is the true culprit, based on the collapse of his alibi.

highlights_en.title: Edgeworth Prepares His Rebuttal
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth finds a contradiction in Yew Shiver's deduction (who placed the gun in Faraday's hand) and prepares for the confrontation.

highlights_en.title: Yew Shiver's Mockery and Edgeworth's Counterattack
highlights_en.description: Yew Shiver demands proof that the window was open, and Edgeworth counters by using the security camera footage to prove the trick regarding the time of the crime.

highlights_en.title: Proof of the Sound Leak Cause: Window and Perfume
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth proves that Yew Shiver had the window opened to eliminate the smell of perfume she spilled in Lobby 1.

highlights_en.title: Edgeworth Accuses Yew Shiver as the Murderer
highlights_en.description: Based on the accumulated evidence, Edgeworth accuses Yew Shiver of being the true perpetrator of the double murder of Faraday and Rehl.

highlights_en.title: Yew Shiver's Rebuttal and Pointing Out Gaps in Evidence
highlights_en.description: Yew Shiver refutes Edgeworth's deduction, claiming that decisive evidence is still missing, and questions how the key became the murder weapon.

highlights_en.title: The Yatagarasu Key Trick and the True Objective
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth points out that the knife was not among Faraday's possessions and presses that the true culprit is the one who knew the key's transforming gimmick.

highlights_en.title: Yew Shiver's Identity Revealed: Callisto Yew, the Fake Yatagarasu
highlights_en.description: Yew Shiver states that "Yatagarasu" has three legs, revealing her true identity as Callisto Yew, a member (or successor) of the phantom thief Yatagarasu, causing an uproar in the courtroom.

highlights_en.title: Confession of the Entire Incident and the True Motive
highlights_en.description: Callisto Yew confesses to using Rehl as her lawyer, stealing the Yatagarasu Key, murdering Faraday, and then killing Rehl to silence him.

highlights_en.title: Arrest of Callisto Yew and Kay's Actions
highlights_en.description: Callisto Yew pulls out a gun, but she is subdued and arrested by Detective Gumshoe and Franziska von Karma. Amidst the confusion, the young Kay disappears from the courtroom.

highlights_en.title: Case Solved and Epilogue: Reunion with Kay
highlights_en.description: Months later, Edgeworth reunites with the grown-up Kay at Sweetwater Land. Kay reveals that she had been traveling to uncover the secrets of her deceased father (the true Yatagarasu).

highlights_en.title: Souvenir for Gumshoe: Swiss Roll
highlights_en.description: Kay entrusts Edgeworth with the "token of friendship," a Courthouse Special Swiss Roll (not Swiss cheese), to give to Detective Gumshoe.

highlights_en.title: Continuation of the Epilogue: Edgeworth's Vow
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth tells Kay that she saved his life when Yew was trying to escape, and that the time has come to settle the Yatagarasu case.

highlights_en.title: Episode 4 End and Save
highlights_en.description: Episode 4, "The Forgotten Turnabout," concludes. The streamer saves the game and prepares to move on to the final Episode 5.

highlights_en.title: Episode 5 "Turnabout Ablaze" Opening
highlights_en.description: The title of the final episode is displayed. The opening video starts with a fire scene, showing two Yatagarasu cards and the torn flags of two nations.

highlights_en.title: A Short Break in Edgeworth's Office
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth reflects on the recent string of cases (the embassy murder, the theme park kidnapping/murder, and the incident in his own office) while drinking tea in the prosecutor's office.

highlights_en.title: Kay Brings New Information
highlights_en.description: Kay rushes excitedly into Edgeworth's office and shows him a newspaper article. The article states that "Yatagarasu sent a calling card to the Embassy."

highlights_en.title: streamer accident: The Streamer Injures Their Mouth
highlights_en.description: While reading lines, the streamer accidentally bit the inside of their mouth and started bleeding. The chat expresses concern about their health. (Following this, the decision was made to end the stream early due to the injury.)

highlights_en.title: The Mystery of the Two Yatagarasu Cards
highlights_en.description: Edgeworth notices that the Yatagarasu card shown in the newspaper is a different color from the card he possesses, recognizing the importance of this new case.

highlights_en.title: Heading to the Neutral Zone Theater
highlights_en.description: The crime scene is the neutral theater, "Teatro Neutralis," shared by two nations. Kay mentions that the "Steel Samurai" show is being held there.

highlights_en.title: Stream End (Early Departure)
highlights_en.description: Due to the mouth injury from biting down, the streamer informed the listeners that, prioritizing health, the stream would end early during the introduction of the final case. Case 5 will be restarted next time.

title: Meet My Father! | Mr. Ravencroft Debut Q&A

overview.summary: Nerissa Ravencroftの父であるロード・マルファス（Mr. Ravencroft）のデビュー配信と質疑応答。地獄の王であるロード・マルファスは、その強面な見た目と威圧的な声に反して、意外にも娘思いで、ユーモアのある一面を見せる。後半では、彼の"おたく"としての側面（アニメやファンタジー小説の好み）や、料理、そして娘を射止めたい求婚者たちへの厳しい試練について語られる。終盤では、銃やバーボンに関する詳細な知識、そしてブリスケットのレシピを披露し、視聴者からの追加の質問に答えながら、娘Nerissaへの愛情とJailbirdsへの感謝を述べ、和やかに配信を締めくくった。
overview.mood: 終始和やかで、ユーモアに溢れた雰囲気

highlights.title: Mr. Ravencroft登場前のオープニングトーク
highlights.description: Nerissaが視聴者（Jailbirds）に挨拶し、今回の配信ゲストである父、ロード・マルファス氏のデビューを紹介。視聴者に対し、失礼のないよう最高の振る舞いを要求する。

highlights.title: ロード・マルファス（Mr. Ravencroft）登場と自己紹介
highlights.description: Nerissaの父、ロード・マルファスが"Lord Malphas, General of Hell's Legions, Slayer of Archangels, Conqueror of Realms"と威厳たっぷりに自己紹介。Nerissaは彼の自己紹介が長すぎるとツッコミを入れる。

highlights.title: Q&A形式の説明とロード・マルファスのお気に入りの呼ばれ方
highlights.description: 今回のQ&Aは事前に提出された60の質問から、Nerissaとロード・マルファスが選定。彼は「Lord Malphas」と呼ばれることを好むと明かす。

highlights.title: Q1: ママリッサとの出会いとプロポーズのエピソード
highlights.description: 最初の質問はロマンチックな話題。Nerissaの母Mamarissaとの出会いは共通のグループでの外出。プロポーズは電子レンジで温めたフォーチュンクッキーに指輪を仕込むという、凝った手法で行われた。

highlights.title: Q2: 人生で幸せを感じる一つのこと
highlights.description: ロード・マルファスは「バーボンと葉巻」と回答。友人と座って飲み、毎週の征服について語り合うのが好きだと明かす。

highlights.title: Q3: マルフス二世（Malphas II）への軍団の継承について
highlights.description: 息子であるMalphas IIに軍団を与えるつもりはないと明言。彼は自力で手に入れるべきであり、それがレヴンクロフト家の伝統だと語る。

highlights.title: Q4: お気に入りの武器とデザイン
highlights.description: 彼の好きな武器は両刃の斧。4フィートの大きさで、デーモン鍛造鋼で作られており、さらに魔術的なルーン（彼のホロの象徴である音符）で覆われている。

highlights.title: Q5: 世界中の人々から称賛されることへの気持ち
highlights.description: YouTubeと家族のアートを通じて世界中のファンから愛されていることについて、「謙虚な気持ちになる」と回答。特に娘のNerissaが愛されていることに喜びを感じている。

highlights.title: Q6: 子供時代の子供たちの様子と成長
highlights.description: 長女Aradiaは幼い頃はワイルドでクレイジーだったが、成長して落ち着いた。息子Malphas IIは内向的だったが、現在は成長していると語る。

highlights.title: Q7: 歴史上好きな時代について
highlights.description: 好きな時代は「プレ・カナン人のシュメール」時代。バアルとポーカーをし、略奪と飲酒を楽しみ、敵の捕虜をとるなど、「楽しいことがたくさんあった」と回顧する。

highlights.title: Q8: 子供たちに伝えた知恵/教訓
highlights.description: 「何かを極め、技術を習得し、そうすれば常に成功するだろう」という教えを伝えたと話す。また、Aradiaが天使と結婚したことについて言及し、彼女がうまくやっていることを認める。

highlights.title: Q9: レヴンクロフト家とサタン家の関係
highlights.description: ロード・マルファスは地獄の王の一人であり、サタンは皇帝のような存在。忠実な奉仕者として、指導者としての適性を維持するために、互いに権力闘争（模擬戦）を行う必要があると語る。

highlights.title: Q10: 好きなサンドイッチの具材
highlights.description: ベーコン、ソーセージ、卵サンドイッチが好きか問われ、彼は「パンなしのベーコン、ベーコン、ベーコン」が好きだと答える。アボカドはテクスチャや見た目が嫌い。

highlights.title: Q11: Aradia, Malpha, Nerissaの中で、誰が刑務所に入りそうか
highlights.description: Nerissaが「再び」刑務所に入りそうだと断言。Malphaは父のコネクションがなければ反逆罪で刑務所行きだが、Nerissaは自ら投獄されたため。視聴者の一人（Liz）に、Nerissaを「別の種類のシャックル」に入れようとしているのかと皮肉る。

highlights.title: Q12: 王としての日常の責任
highlights.description: 朝起きて軍団を訓練し、その後は大量の「事務処理」をこなす。一日の終わりには家族と過ごす。日常は退屈だが、誰かが反乱を起こすことを待っていると冗談を言う。

highlights.title: Q13: 大家族を持つ夢と孫について
highlights.description: 11人兄弟の大家族出身なので、自分の家族は小さく保っている。しかし、「天使のような孫ではない、もう少し孫が欲しい」とコメント。

highlights.title: Q14: 現在の人生の章のタイトル
highlights.description: 「落ち着く（Settling Down）」と回答。必要なものはすべて征服し、今は昔の良き時代について語り合ってリラックスしている段階だと述べる。

highlights.title: Q15: お気に入りの「親父ギャグ」
highlights.description: 「3人の天使がバーに入ると、悪魔は身をかがめる（Three angels walk into a bar, the demon ducks.）」。

highlights.title: Q16: Nerissaとの思い出深い父娘の瞬間
highlights.description: 父親としてダンスパーティーに行ったことや、Nerissaが歌を歌うのを聞くのが好きだと語る。特に、Nerissaが初めて背中が開いたドレスを着たときに、脊柱側弯症（Scoliosis）に気づき、治療を施して完璧な姿勢になったエピソードを明かす。

highlights.title: Q17: 古いオタク（Older Weeb）としての見解
highlights.description: 「Older Weeb」として、現代のオタク文化をどう捉えているか。アニメのシーズンが長く続きすぎる傾向にあり（3シーズンで完結すべき）、制作側の怠慢だと批判する。

highlights.title: Q18: 一番好きなレシピと肉へのこだわり
highlights.description: 好きなレシピについて聞かれ、ケール（Kale）の調理法を教えた後、「ゴミ箱に捨ててステーキを焼く」とジョークを飛ばす。真面目な答えとして、ブリスケットとベーコン巻きベーコンを挙げる。彼は肉食主義者（Meat Man）である。

highlights.title: Q19: ロマ帝国のことを考えるか
highlights.description: 「あなたはローマ帝国についてよく考えますか？」というミーム的な質問に対し、「毎日だ」と回答。ローマ軍団が自分の軍団を模倣したと主張し、残虐行為を回顧する。

highlights.title: Q20: Nerissaのオリジナル曲で一番のお気に入り
highlights.description: Nerissaのオリジナル曲の中で一番好きな曲は何か尋ねられ、「Say My Name」と回答。そのメロディーとNerissaのボーカルの表現力を称賛する。

highlights.title: Q21: なぜNerissaを刑務所から救出しなかったのか
highlights.description: Nerissaを監獄から救出しなかった理由について尋ねられ、「9000年のタイムアウトが必要だった。家の中の平和と静寂を楽しんでいた」と冗談を言う。彼女の力のコントロールを学ぶための試練だったと説明。

highlights.title: Q22: 好きな銃について
highlights.description: シューティングレンジに行くか、好きな銃は何か尋ねられる。好きな銃は「50口径のブローニング」または「トンプソン・サブマシンガン」。彼が所有する銃の中では「300 Blackout」を挙げる。

highlights.title: Q23: カルバーズ（Culver's）への執着と調味料戦争
highlights.description: NerissaほどCulver'sを熱望するか尋ねられ、そこそこと回答。ハンバーガーのトップバンズを外すか、マヨネーズをかけるかについてNerissaと激論を交わす。彼はマヨネーズを「サンドイッチのトッピング」だと断言。

highlights.title: Q24: Nerissaを射止める男性の資質
highlights.description: Nerissaが惚れる男性の資質について聞かれ、彼は「仕事を持つこと」と「面白く、スキルがあること」を挙げる。そして最も重要なのは、「地獄の軍団に立ち向かう勇気」だと語る。

highlights.title: Q25: レヴンクロフト家の雄叫び
highlights.description: 「レヴンクロフト家の雄叫び（War Cry）」を披露してほしいというリクエストに応え、威厳のある低い声で「Legions! Advance!」と叫び、Nerissaを笑わせる。

highlights.title: Q26: トップ3アニメシリーズ
highlights.description: 好きなアニメシリーズベスト3は『るろうに剣心』、『カウボーイビバップ』、そして『僕のヒーローアカデミア』(初期の3シーズンのみ)だと語る。彼はNARUTOの引き伸ばしやフィラーを強く批判する。

highlights.title: Q27: ステーキの焼き加減と調味料
highlights.description: ステーキの好みの焼き加減は「レアからミディアムレア」で、味付けは塩、胡椒、ガーリックのみが最高だと断言する。

highlights.title: Q28: 好きな本について
highlights.description: 好きな本について聞かれ、トールキン（『フーリンの子の物語』）、スター・ウォーズのスローン三部作、マイケル・ムアコックのエルリック・サーガを挙げる。彼は長編ファンタジーの未完結問題に不満を持つ。

highlights.title: Q29: Jailbirdsへの最後の言葉
highlights.description: リスナーへの最後の言葉として、「親切を弱さと誤解するな。私の試練を乗り越えれば、娘を射止める特権を与えるが、私から解放されることはない」と宣言し、愛娘への強い愛情と執着を見せる。

highlights.title: 配信終了と最後のユーモア
highlights.description: Nerissaの100万登録達成が近いことに触れ、Mr. Ravencroftが再度ユーモラスな脅しをかけながらリスナーにチャンネル登録を促し、配信を締めくくる。

highlights.title: マヤズミの可愛いクロニーの呪文
highlights.description: 視聴者からのスパチャで、Mr. Ravencroftが「マヤズミ・ザ・キュート・クロニー（Mayuzumi the Cute Kronie）」の呪文を詠唱させられる。彼の唸り声と可愛らしい言葉の組み合わせが笑いを誘う。

highlights.title: 銃に関するホットテイク：Sig Sauer P365は過大評価
highlights.description: 追加のスーパーチャットQ&Aにて、銃に関するホットテイクを求められ、Sig Sauer P365は過大評価（overhyped）されていると断言。視聴者もその「Based」な意見に反応する。

highlights.title: バーガーの調味料に関する見解（ケチャップ/BBQソース論争）
highlights.description: ケチャップは未調整のBBQソースであるという意見に対し、Mr. Ravencroftはハンバーガーにはケチャップとマスタードが「正しく」あるべきだと主張。BBQソースはバーガーには合わないと述べる。

highlights.title: Mr. Ravencroftのブリスケットレシピ公開
highlights.description: 最高のブリスケットを作るコツを尋ねられ、トリミングの重要性と、シンプルなドライラブ（塩、胡椒、ガーリック、カイエン）を使うこと、そしてヒッコリーとメスキートの木材でスモークすることが、肉の風味を引き立てると詳細に説明する。

highlights.title: 希少なバーボン「Pappy Van Winkle 15年」の話題
highlights.description: 自身がふさわしいか問われた高級バーボン「Pappy Van Winkle 15年」について、15年間熟成されており生産量が少ないため非常に希少で高価だと、バーボンに関する知識を披露する。

highlights.title: Nerissaの「妻のコレクション」と軍団トレーニングのアドバイス
highlights.description: Nerissaが冗談で「私の妻たち（Jailbirds）」について尋ねると、Mr. Ravencroftは「妻は一人で十分だ」と即答。その後、軍団への参加を目指す者には、200ポンド（約90kg）の重りを背負って日々の筋力トレーニング（キャリステニクス）を行うよう指導する。

highlights.title: Smith & Wesson M&Pを最初の銃として推奨
highlights.description: 初心者のための最初のピストル（銃）の推薦を求められ、Smith & Wesson M&Pシリーズが良いと回答。最も良い銃は「使いこなせる銃」だと強調する。

highlights.title: Nerissaと父による配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: Nerissaが感謝を述べ、Mr. Ravencroftは彼女がストリームの準備にどれだけ時間をかけているかを説明し、引き続き応援するよう視聴者に促す。最後に父娘でNerissaの定番の挨拶「Bye, Darlings!」を共に行い、配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: The debut stream and Q&A session featuring Nerissa Ravencroft's father, Lord Malphas (Mr. Ravencroft). Despite his intimidating appearance and commanding voice, Lord Malphas, a King of Hell, is surprisingly devoted to his daughter and shows a humorous side. In the latter half, he discusses his "otaku" side (preferences for anime and fantasy novels), cooking, and the strict trials he sets for suitors seeking to win his daughter's hand. Towards the end, he shares detailed knowledge about guns and bourbon, reveals his brisket recipe, answers additional viewer questions, expresses his love for Nerissa and gratitude towards the Jailbirds, concluding the stream peacefully.
overview_en.mood: A consistently warm and humorous atmosphere

highlights_en.title: Opening Talk Before Mr. Ravencroft's Appearance
highlights_en.description: Nerissa greets the viewers (Jailbirds) and introduces the debut of her father and stream guest, Lord Malphas. She demands the viewers behave impeccably to avoid offense.

highlights_en.title: Lord Malphas (Mr. Ravencroft) Appears and Introduces Himself
highlights_en.description: Nerissa's father, Lord Malphas, grandly introduces himself as "Lord Malphas, General of Hell's Legions, Slayer of Archangels, Conqueror of Realms." Nerissa interrupts, commenting that his introduction is too long.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of Q&A Format and Lord Malphas' Preferred Title
highlights_en.description: This Q&A was curated by Nerissa and Lord Malphas from 60 pre-submitted questions. He reveals that he prefers to be called "Lord Malphas."

highlights_en.title: Q1: The Story of Meeting Mamarissa and the Proposal
highlights_en.description: The first question is a romantic topic. He met Nerissa's mother, Mamarissa, during an outing with a mutual group. The elaborate proposal involved hiding a ring inside a microwave-heated fortune cookie.

highlights_en.title: Q2: The One Thing That Makes Him Happy in Life
highlights_en.description: Lord Malphas answers "bourbon and a cigar." He reveals he enjoys sitting and drinking with friends while discussing their weekly conquests.

highlights_en.title: Q3: On Inheriting the Legions to Malphas II
highlights_en.description: He states clearly that he will not simply give his legions to his son, Malphas II. He explains that his son must earn them himself, as is the tradition of the Ravencroft family.

highlights_en.title: Q4: Favorite Weapon and Design
highlights_en.description: His favorite weapon is a double-bladed axe. It is four feet long, made of demon-forged steel, and covered in magical runes (the musical notes that symbolize his holo).

highlights_en.title: Q5: Feelings on Being Praised by People Worldwide
highlights_en.description: Regarding the love he receives from fans worldwide via YouTube and family art, he answers that it makes him "feel humble." He is especially pleased that his daughter Nerissa is loved.

highlights_en.title: Q6: What His Children Were Like Growing Up
highlights_en.description: He says his eldest daughter, Aradia, was wild and crazy as a child but has settled down as an adult. His son, Malphas II, was introverted but is growing now.

highlights_en.title: Q7: Favorite Historical Era
highlights_en.description: His favorite era is the "Pre-Canaanite Sumer" period. He fondly recalls "many fun times," such as playing poker with Baal, enjoying pillaging and drinking, and taking enemy prisoners.

highlights_en.title: Q8: Wisdom/Lessons Imparted to His Children
highlights_en.description: He shared the lesson, "Master something, acquire a skill, and you will always succeed." He also mentions Aradia marrying an angel and acknowledges that she is doing well.

highlights_en.title: Q9: Relationship Between the Ravencroft and Satan Families
highlights_en.description: Lord Malphas is one of the Kings of Hell, while Satan is like an Emperor. He explains that as loyal servants, they must periodically engage in power struggles (mock battles) to maintain their fitness as leaders.

highlights_en.title: Q10: Favorite Sandwich Toppings/Ingredients
highlights_en.description: Asked if he likes bacon, sausage, and egg sandwiches, he replies he prefers "bacon, bacon, bacon—no bread." He dislikes avocado due to its texture and appearance.

highlights_en.title: Q11: Who Is Most Likely to End Up in Prison: Aradia, Malpha, or Nerissa?
highlights_en.description: He asserts that Nerissa is likely to end up in prison "again." While Malpha would be in jail for treason without his father's connections, Nerissa imprisoned herself. He teases one viewer (Liz) about putting Nerissa in "another kind of shackles."

highlights_en.title: Q12: Daily Responsibilities as a King
highlights_en.description: He wakes up in the morning to train his legions, followed by copious amounts of "paperwork." He spends time with his family at the end of the day. He jokes that daily life is boring, but he is waiting for someone to rebel.

highlights_en.title: Q13: Dream of Having a Large Family and Grandchildren
highlights_en.description: Since he came from a large family of 11 siblings, he keeps his own family small. However, he comments that he would "like a few more grandchildren, just not angel grandchildren."

highlights_en.title: Q14: Title of His Current Chapter in Life
highlights_en.description: He answers "Settling Down," stating that he has conquered everything he needs to and is now at the stage of relaxing and reminiscing about the good old days.

highlights_en.title: Q15: Favorite "Dad Joke"
highlights_en.description: "Three angels walk into a bar, the demon ducks."

highlights_en.title: Q16: Memorable Father-Daughter Moments with Nerissa
highlights_en.description: He mentions attending dance parties as a father and enjoying listening to Nerissa sing. He specifically recalls the time she first wore a backless dress, allowing him to notice her scoliosis, which he subsequently treated, resulting in her perfect posture.

highlights_en.title: Q17: Perspective as an Older Weeb
highlights_en.description: How does he view modern otaku culture as an "Older Weeb"? He criticizes the tendency for anime seasons to run too long (they should conclude after three seasons), calling it laziness on the part of the production staff.

highlights_en.title: Q18: Favorite Recipe and Dedication to Meat
highlights_en.description: Asked about his favorite recipe, he jokes about how to cook kale—"throw it in the trash and cook steak." His serious answers are brisket and bacon-wrapped bacon. He is a "Meat Man."

highlights_en.title: Q19: Does He Think About the Roman Empire?
highlights_en.description: Answering the meme question, "Do you often think about the Roman Empire?" he replies, "Every day." He claims the Roman Legions copied his legions and reminisces about their atrocities.

highlights_en.title: Q20: Favorite Nerissa Original Song
highlights_en.description: Asked for his favorite Nerissa original song, he answers "Say My Name," praising the melody and Nerissa's vocal expressiveness.

highlights_en.title: Q21: Why Didn't He Rescue Nerissa from Prison?
highlights_en.description: Asked why he didn't rescue Nerissa from prison, he jokes that she "needed a 9,000-year timeout" and that he "enjoyed the peace and quiet in the house." He explains it was a trial for her to learn to control her powers.

highlights_en.title: Q22: Favorite Gun
highlights_en.description: Asked if he goes to a shooting range or what his favorite gun is. His favorites are the ".50 caliber Browning" or the "Thompson Submachine Gun." Among the guns he owns, he names the ".300 Blackout."

highlights_en.title: Q23: Obsession with Culver's and the Condiment War
highlights_en.description: Asked if he craves Culver's as much as Nerissa, he answers moderately. He debates Nerissa fiercely about removing the top bun of a hamburger or putting mayonnaise on it. He asserts that mayonnaise is a "sandwich topping."

highlights_en.title: Q24: Qualities of a Man Who Could Win Nerissa's Hand
highlights_en.description: Asked about the qualities a man must possess to win Nerissa's heart, he lists "having a job," being "funny, and skilled." He states that the most crucial quality is "the courage to face the legions of Hell."

highlights_en.title: Q25: The Ravencroft Family War Cry
highlights_en.description: Responding to a request to perform the "Ravencroft Family War Cry," he yells "Legions! Advance!" in a deep, authoritative voice, making Nerissa laugh.

highlights_en.title: Q26: Top 3 Anime Series
highlights_en.description: He names his top three favorite anime series as *Rurouni Kenshin*, *Cowboy Bebop*, and *My Hero Academia* (only the first three seasons). He strongly criticizes the padding and filler in *Naruto*.

highlights_en.title: Q27: Steak Doneness and Seasoning
highlights_en.description: He asserts that his preferred steak doneness is "rare to medium-rare," and the best seasoning is strictly salt, pepper, and garlic.

highlights_en.title: Q28: Favorite Books
highlights_en.description: Asked about his favorite books, he lists Tolkien (*The Children of Húrin*), the Star Wars Thrawn Trilogy, and Michael Moorcock's Elric Saga. He expresses frustration with the problem of lengthy fantasy series remaining unfinished.

highlights_en.title: Q29: Final Words to the Jailbirds
highlights_en.description: As his final message to the listeners, he declares, "Do not mistake my kindness for weakness. If you pass my trials, I will grant you the privilege of winning my daughter's hand, but you will never be free of me," showing intense affection and possessiveness towards his beloved daughter.

highlights_en.title: Stream Conclusion and Final Humor
highlights_en.description: Touching upon Nerissa's approaching one million subscribers, Mr. Ravencroft encourages viewers to subscribe with another humorous threat before concluding the stream.

highlights_en.title: The Mayuzumi the Cute Kronie Incantation
highlights_en.description: A superchat request makes Mr. Ravencroft chant the incantation "Mayuzumi the Cute Kronie." The combination of his growling voice and the cute words elicits laughter.

highlights_en.title: Hot Take on Guns: The Sig Sauer P365 Is Overhyped
highlights_en.description: During an additional Super Chat Q&A, he is asked for a hot take on guns and asserts that the Sig Sauer P365 is overhyped. Viewers react positively to his "Based" opinion.

highlights_en.title: Condiment Viewpoint on Burgers (Ketchup/BBQ Sauce Debate)
highlights_en.description: Addressing the opinion that ketchup is unrefined BBQ sauce, Mr. Ravencroft argues that hamburgers should "properly" have ketchup and mustard. He states that BBQ sauce does not belong on a burger.

highlights_en.title: Mr. Ravencroft Shares His Brisket Recipe
highlights_en.description: Asked for tips on making the best brisket, he details the importance of trimming, using a simple dry rub (salt, pepper, garlic, and cayenne), and smoking it with hickory and mesquite wood to enhance the meat's flavor.

highlights_en.title: Discussion of the Rare Bourbon "Pappy Van Winkle 15 Year"
highlights_en.description: Asked if he is worthy of the premium bourbon "Pappy Van Winkle 15 Year," he showcases his bourbon knowledge, explaining that it is extremely rare and expensive due to being aged for 15 years and having low production volume.

highlights_en.title: Nerissa's "Wife Collection" and Training Advice for the Legions
highlights_en.description: When Nerissa jokingly asks about "my wives (Jailbirds)," Mr. Ravencroft immediately replies, "One wife is enough." He then instructs those aspiring to join the legions to perform daily calisthenics while carrying a 200 lb (~90 kg) load.

highlights_en.title: Recommending the Smith & Wesson M&P as a First Gun
highlights_en.description: Asked for a recommendation for a beginner's first pistol (gun), he suggests the Smith & Wesson M&P series. He emphasizes that the best gun is "the one you can master."

highlights_en.title: Nerissa and Her Father Say Goodbye
highlights_en.description: Nerissa expresses gratitude, and Mr. Ravencroft explains how much time she puts into preparing her streams, encouraging viewers to continue their support. The father and daughter conclude the stream by performing Nerissa's signature sign-off, "Bye, Darlings!" together.

name.ja: ネリッサ・レイヴンクロフト

title: 【AmiAmi】Final WAHmbassadorship Stream!!!!

overview.summary: ホロライブENの九十九佐命（Ina）によるAmiAmiワームバサダーとしての最後の配信。1年間の活動を振り返りファンに感謝を伝えつつ、自身のねんどろいどやfigmaの予約情報、そして今月のAmiAmiピックアップアイテムを紹介した。また、視聴者から寄せられた個性豊かなフィギュアコレクションの写真や、Ina自身が撮影したワンダーフェスティバル 2025 SummerのVlogを鑑賞し、フィギュア愛好家として熱量を共有した。終始和やかな雰囲気で、感動的なフィナーレを迎えた。
overview.mood: 感謝と喜びにあふれた和やかな雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始と最後のWahmbassador挨拶
highlights.description: BGMが一時消えるトラブルがあったものの、すぐに回復。AmiAmiのWahmbassadorとしての最後の配信であることを伝え、1年間が早く過ぎたことへの寂しさを表現した。

highlights.title: AmiAmiアンバサダー活動の振り返り
highlights.description: 1年間のアンバサダー活動を振り返り、ファンに感謝を伝える。AXでのアンケートでInaの配信を通じてAmiAmiを知った人が多いことを知り、貢献できたことに喜びを表した。

highlights.title: 新フィギュア情報：ねんどろいどとfigmaの予約開始
highlights.description: 自身のねんどろいどとfigmaが予約開始していることを告知。ねんどろいどには触手パーツ付きのDX版もある。figmaはAmiAmi公式アンバサダーとして紹介された。

highlights.title: 限定グッズとAmiAmi店舗ディスプレイ情報
highlights.description: Ina描き下ろしの新イラストを使用したアクリルキーホルダーやTシャツなどの限定グッズを紹介。また、秋葉原ラジオ会館店のディスプレイは10月末まで延長されることを告知した。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：ホロライブ＆モンハン系
highlights.description: 視聴者から寄せられたフィギュアコレクションの紹介が始まる。Monster Hunter Riseのデスクマットや、ホロライブのねんどろいどを含むコレクションが披露された。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：ミク＆シナモロールコラボ
highlights.description: ミクフィギュアとホロライブ、そしてシナモロールのコレクションが並ぶ写真を紹介。パンプキンミクのフィギュアをAmiAmiで格安で入手できたエピソードに触れた。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：Myth勢揃いのコレクション
highlights.description: ホロライブEN Mythメンバー全員のねんどろいどが並ぶ「Mythの祭壇」コレクションを紹介。キアラのねんどろいどでついに完成したとコメントがあった。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：大量のねんどろいどコレクション
highlights.description: 壁一面のペグボードやアクリル棚に大量のねんどろいど（特にホロライブVチューバー）が整然と並べられたコレクションを紹介。その見事なコレクションの成長に感嘆した。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：Hololiveゲーマーズなど
highlights.description: 1年前とのコレクションの比較写真を紹介。特にLook Upフィギュアが大量に並んでいる様子に注目。失くしてしまったミクのフィギュアについても触れた。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：スケールフィギュアと書籍
highlights.description: ライコリス・リコイルのウェディングフィギュアやエヴァンゲリオンなど、様々なスケールフィギュアのコレクションを紹介。ライトアップされたディスプレイケースを褒めた。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：MikuとInaの豪華コレクション
highlights.description: 初音ミクの豪華なスケールフィギュアとInaのグッズが展示されたコレクション。1年で棚が足りなくなったというコメントに共感した。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：ライトアップされたフィギュアケース
highlights.description: フィギュアケースに収納されたコレクションを紹介。プレオーダーが多数控えているため、ディスプレイケースや銀行口座への祈りを捧げるコメントに笑った。

highlights.title: 視聴者コレクション紹介：フィギュアの箱の保管問題
highlights.description: フィギュアケースに収納されたコレクションと、床に積み上げられた大量のフィギュアボックスの写真を紹介し、フィギュアコレクターの共通の悩みとして箱の保管問題に言及した。

highlights.title: ワンダーフェスティバル2025 Summer Vlog予告
highlights.description: フィギュアの大型イベント「ワンダーフェスティバル 2025 Summer」の告知に触れ、自身が撮影したイベント会場のVlogを流すことを予告した。

highlights.title: ワンダーフェスティバル2025 Summer AmiAmiブース訪問
highlights.description: Vlogを開始。会場である幕張メッセに到着し、AmiAmi 25周年記念ブースなど、大規模な企業ブースの様子を紹介した。

highlights.title: アニメ・ゲーム系フィギュア展示（ぼざろ、ホロライブなど）
highlights.description: Aniplexなどのブースで展示されていた人気アニメ（ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！、ライコリス・リコイル、86-エイティシックス-）やホロライブのフィギュア、モンハンなどの展示を多数紹介した。

highlights.title: エヴァ、カドカワ、マイテックスなどのブース紹介
highlights.description: エヴァンゲリオンの巨大なスタチューや、KADOKAWAのブースで展示されていたラフタリアやセイバーオルタのフィギュアなど、多様なフィギュアメーカーの展示物を紹介した。

highlights.title: Design COCO ホロライブゲーマーズ大型フィギュア展示
highlights.description: Design COCOブースで展示されていた戌神ころね、猫又おかゆ、白上フブキ、大神ミオの等身大に近い大型フィギュア群を紹介した。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：ねんどろいど 九十九佐命（Ina）紹介
highlights.description: 今月のAmiAmiピックアップアイテムとして、自身のねんどろいど（通常版とDX版）を、様々なアングルやポーズで紹介した。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：ねんどろいど 白上フブキ パレード服Ver.紹介
highlights.description: ホロライブの白上フブキのねんどろいど（パレード服Ver.）を紹介。眼鏡パーツやティーカップを持たせるポーズがキュートだとコメント。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：ねんどろいど 大空スバル紹介
highlights.description: ホロライブの大空スバルのねんどろいどを紹介。マリンルックの衣装と元気な表情、カードパーツが魅力的だと評した。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：figma ルイージ（Luize）紹介
highlights.description: figmaシリーズから、Vtuberのルイージ（Luize）の可動フィギュアを紹介。ポーズの自由度や、クールでかわいい見た目を絶賛した。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：POP UP PARADE 赤井はあと、星街すいせい紹介
highlights.description: Pop Up Paradeシリーズから、赤井はあと（セーラー服）、星街すいせい（ライブ衣装）のフィギュアを紹介。はあちゃまの元気なポーズや、すいちゃんのベースの細部に注目した。

highlights.title: 今月のピックアップ：宝鐘マリン 30th Outfit Ver.紹介
highlights.description: ホロライブの宝鐘マリンの1/6スケールフィギュアを紹介。王座に座った豪華な衣装と精巧な造形に感嘆した。

highlights.title: ワームバサダー活動終了の挨拶と感謝
highlights.description: 1年間のAmiAmiワームバサダーとしての活動を振り返り、ファン、AmiAmiのスタッフ、および協力してくれたすべての人に感謝を伝え、今後の活動継続を表明した。

tags: ワンダーフェスティバル

overview_en.summary: The final stream of Hololive EN's Ninomae Ina'nis (Ina) as the AmiAmi Wahmbassador. She looked back on her year of activities, expressed gratitude to her fans, and introduced reservation information for her own Nendoroid and figma, as well as AmiAmi's featured items for the month. She also viewed photos of unique figure collections submitted by viewers and watched a Vlog she filmed herself at Wonder Festival 2025 Summer, sharing the enthusiasm of a figure enthusiast. The atmosphere was amicable throughout, leading to an emotional finale.
overview_en.mood: A calm and peaceful atmosphere filled with gratitude and joy

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Final Wahmbassador Greeting
highlights_en.description: Although there was a brief technical issue where the background music disappeared, it was quickly resolved. She announced that this was her last stream as the AmiAmi Wahmbassador and expressed sadness that the year had passed so quickly.

highlights_en.title: Reflection on AmiAmi Ambassador Activities
highlights_en.description: She reflected on her one year as an ambassador and thanked the fans. She expressed joy that she was able to contribute, noting that many people learned about AmiAmi through her streams, according to a survey at AX.

highlights_en.title: New Figure Information: Nendoroid and figma Reservations Start
highlights_en.description: She announced that reservations for her own Nendoroid and figma have begun. The Nendoroid also has a DX version that includes tentacle parts. The figma was introduced in her capacity as an official AmiAmi ambassador.

highlights_en.title: Exclusive Merchandise and AmiAmi Store Display Information
highlights_en.description: She introduced exclusive merchandise, such as acrylic keychains and T-shirts, featuring a new illustration drawn by Ina. She also announced that the display at the Akihabara Radio Kaikan store would be extended until the end of October.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Hololive & Monster Hunter Series
highlights_en.description: The showcase of figure collections submitted by viewers begins. A collection including a Monster Hunter Rise desk mat and Hololive Nendoroids was presented.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Miku & Cinnamoroll Collaboration
highlights_en.description: She showed photos featuring Miku figures, Hololive items, and Cinnamoroll collections. She mentioned the episode of getting a Pumpkin Miku figure at a great price on AmiAmi.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Collection Featuring All Myth Members
highlights_en.description: She introduced the "Myth Altar" collection, featuring Nendoroids of all Hololive EN Myth members lined up. The submission noted that the collection was finally complete with Kiara's Nendoroid.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Massive Nendoroid Collection
highlights_en.description: She showcased a collection where numerous Nendoroids (especially Hololive Vtubers) were neatly arranged on a wall-to-wall pegboard and acrylic shelves. She admired the impressive growth of the collection.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Hololive Gamers and Others
highlights_en.description: She showed comparison photos of the collection from one year ago. She particularly noted the large number of Look Up figures lined up. She also mentioned a Miku figure that had been lost.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Scale Figures and Books
highlights_en.description: She introduced a collection of various scale figures, including Lycoris Recoil wedding figures and Evangelion figures. She praised the illuminated display case.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Luxurious Miku and Ina Collection
highlights_en.description: A collection featuring luxurious Hatsune Miku scale figures and Ina merchandise was displayed. She empathized with the comment that the shelf space became insufficient within a year.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Illuminated Figure Case
highlights_en.description: She introduced a collection stored in a figure case. She laughed at the viewer's comment praying for more display cases and for their bank account, due to the large number of pending pre-orders.

highlights_en.title: Viewer Collection Showcase: Figure Box Storage Problem
highlights_en.description: She showed photos of a collection stored in a figure case alongside a large stack of figure boxes piled on the floor, mentioning the common figure collector's struggle of storing the boxes.

highlights_en.title: Wonder Festival 2025 Summer Vlog Preview
highlights_en.description: She referred to the announcement of the major figure event, "Wonder Festival 2025 Summer," and previewed playing a Vlog she filmed at the event venue.

highlights_en.title: Visit to the Wonder Festival 2025 Summer AmiAmi Booth
highlights_en.description: The Vlog started. She showed her arrival at the Makuhari Messe venue and introduced the large corporate booths, including the AmiAmi 25th Anniversary booth.

highlights_en.title: Anime/Game Figure Displays (Bocchi the Rock, Hololive, etc.)
highlights_en.description: She introduced numerous exhibits, including figures from popular anime (Bocchi the Rock!, Lycoris Recoil, 86 EIGHTY-SIX), Hololive figures, and Monster Hunter items displayed at booths like Aniplex.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Booths: Evangelion, KADOKAWA, Myteth, etc.
highlights_en.description: She introduced exhibits from various figure manufacturers, such as a gigantic Evangelion statue and figures like Raphtalia and Saber Alter displayed at the KADOKAWA booth.

highlights_en.title: Design COCO Hololive Gamers Large Figure Display
highlights_en.description: She introduced the large, near life-sized figures of Inugami Korone, Nekomata Okayu, Shirakami Fubuki, and Ookami Mio displayed at the Design COCO booth.

highlights_en.title: This Month's Pick: Nendoroid Ninomae Ina'nis (Ina) Introduction
