The final game ended dramatically: despite losing significant points due to an opponent's Haneman, Roboco managed to clinch 2nd place due to the circumstances of the other players. After the match, she thanked viewers for their gifts, discussed her favorite Mahjong Soul character avatars, and concluded the stream by expressing her enthusiasm for the league match scheduled for the next day.
overview_en.mood: Although the matches became difficult, Roboco appeared consistently cheerful and serious about enjoying mahjong throughout.

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Confession of Feeling Unwell
highlights_en.description: The stream starts, and Roboco greets the viewers. She confessed to being stuck in the restroom during the opening, explaining the reason for the late start.

highlights_en.title: Pulling Mahjong Soul Outfit Gacha
highlights_en.description: During the stream, she tried the Mahjong Soul outfit gacha. She won the Halloween skin (Closed Land) for her favorite character, Aihara Mai, and immediately put it on.

highlights_en.title: Ranked Match (4-Player East Wind Battle) East 1 Start
highlights_en.description: Starts the Ranked Match (4-Player East Wind Battle). The opponents are "Mitsube," "Reichanko," "Reatsuki," and "Robocoan." She approaches the match with enthusiasm, using her new skin.

highlights_en.title: East 1 Round 1: Mitsube takes the lead with Mangan
highlights_en.description: East 1 Round 1, Mitsube wins Mangan with Riichi, Dora, and Ura-dora. Roboco immediately falls to 4th place.

highlights_en.title: East 2 Round 2: Roboco Self-Drawns Haneman
highlights_en.description: East 2 Round 2, Roboco self-draws Haneman (12,000 points) with Sanankou, Dora, Red Dora, and Ura-dora, moving up to 2nd place and taking the practical lead.

highlights_en.title: East 3 Round 3: Reatsuki wins with Riichi, Pinfu, and Dora
highlights_en.description: East 3 Round 3, Reatsuki wins by Ron off Roboco's tile. Winning 3,900 points with Riichi, Pinfu, and Dora, Roboco drops to 3rd place.

highlights_en.title: East 4 Round 4: Mitsube wins with Tanyao, half match ends
highlights_en.description: East 4 Round 4, Mitsube wins with Tanyao, Red Dora, and Dora, ending the half match. Mitsube finished 1st, and Roboco finished 2nd.

highlights_en.title: Ranked Match (4-Player South Battle) Start
highlights_en.description: Starts the next match, a 4-Player South Battle (East 1). Opponents are "Tsubasa Youka," "sin221," "Lion7," and "Robocoan."

highlights_en.title: East 1: Riichi attempted but deals into opponent's win
highlights_en.description: Roboco calls Riichi, but the player opposite (Tsubasa Youka) wins by Ron with Pinfu and Dora, resulting in a 1,000 point loss for Roboco.

highlights_en.title: East 2: After Riichi, opponent self-draws and dealer changes
highlights_en.description: East 2, Roboco calls Riichi, but Lion7 self-draws 2,700 points with Riichi, Tsumo, and Pinfu. The dealer changes, and Roboco drops to 4th place.

highlights_en.title: East 2 Round 1: Draw due to All Players Tenpai
highlights_en.description: East 2 Round 1, no one won, resulting in a draw. Since all players were Tenpai (ready hands), Roboco remains in 4th place with no change in points.

highlights_en.title: East 3: Lion7 wins Mangan
highlights_en.description: East 3, Lion7 wins by Ron with Riichi, Yakuhai, Dora, and Ura-dora for Mangan (5,200 points). Roboco loses the dealership and proceeds to the South Round.

highlights_en.title: South 1: Lion7 self-draws and takes the lead
highlights_en.description: South 1, Lion7 self-draws 2,700 points with Riichi, Tsumo, and Pinfu. Lion7 jumps into the lead, exceeding 30,000 points.

highlights_en.title: South 2: High-scoring self-draw after Riichi
highlights_en.description: South 2, Roboco self-draws 7,900 points with Riichi, Tsumo, and two Dora. She significantly recovers her points and moves up to 3rd place.

highlights_en.title: South 3: Half match ends
highlights_en.description: South 3 Round 1, Lion7 wins by Ron, ending the half match. In this match, Tsubasa Youka finished 1st, and Roboco finished 2nd.

highlights_en.title: South 3 Round 1: Half match ends
highlights_en.description: South 3 Round 1, Lion7 wins by Ron, ending the half match. In this match, Tsubasa Youka finished 1st, and Roboco finished 2nd.

highlights_en.title: 3rd Match (4-Player East Battle) Start
highlights_en.description: Starts a new match (Bronze Room, 4-Player East). Opponents are "Kanatsuten," "Moriougai," "idp," and "Robocoan."

highlights_en.title: East 1: Player opposite self-draws Mangan
highlights_en.description: East 1, the player opposite, "idp," self-draws 3,900 points with Riichi, Menzenchin Tsumoho, and Pinfu. This is an unlucky start.

highlights_en.title: East 1 Round 2: Opponent overwhelms with Baiman
highlights_en.description: East 1 Round 2, the player opposite, "idp," wins by Ron with Riichi, Yakuhai, Toitoihou, Honitsu, and Dora 3 for Baiman (24,000 points). Roboco immediately drops to 4th place, widening the score gap.

highlights_en.title: East 2 Round 1: Opponent further self-draws Mangan
highlights_en.description: East 2 Round 1, the player opposite, "idp," self-draws Mangan (12,000 points) with Sanshoku Doujun, Dora, and Ura-dora. The opponent's momentum is unstoppable.

highlights_en.title: East 2 Round 2: Opponent's Baiman ends the half match
highlights_en.description: East 2 Round 2, the player opposite, "idp," self-draws Baiman (24,000 points), and the dealer "Kanatsuten" is eliminated (tobi). Roboco finishes this half match in 3rd place.

highlights_en.title: 4th Match (4-Player East Battle) Start
highlights_en.description: Starts the 4th match, a 4-Player East Battle (Bronze Room). Opponents are "orangeyellow," "noinoi333," "Aarura," and "Robocoan" (dealer).

highlights_en.title: East 1 Round 1: Roboco deals into opponent's win
highlights_en.description: East 1 Round 1, Roboco deals into the opponent "noinoi333" (2,600 points). She gives up the lead.

highlights_en.title: East 2 Round 2: Mangan self-draw widens the score gap
highlights_en.description: East 2 Round 2, the opponent "Aarura" self-draws (5,200 points). Roboco is once again pushed into a tough situation.

highlights_en.title: East 4: Roboco is eliminated (tobi), half match ends
highlights_en.description: East 4 (Ourasu/Final Round), Roboco aims for a win while serving as dealer, but the opponent "Aarura" wins by Ron, resulting in Roboco being eliminated (tobi, scoring zero or less points) with 7,000 points and finishing 4th.

highlights_en.title: 5th Match (4-Player East Battle) Start, Drops to 4th place after Ron win
highlights_en.description: Starts a new half match (East Wind Battle). In East 2, KARO1121 wins by Ron with Riichi and Dora for Mangan, and Roboco drops to 4th place.

highlights_en.title: East 3 Round 1: Wins with Yakuhai, moves up to 3rd place
highlights_en.description: Roboco wins with Yakuhai (Haku/White Dragon), taking 1,000 points by Ron from the opponent who was the dealer (Desuyan). She recovers points and moves up to 3rd place.

highlights_en.title: East 4: Deals into Haneman, but finishes 2nd
highlights_en.description: In Ourasu (Final Round), she deals into Hisapontan's Haneman (12,000 points) Ron win, but due to the score situation of the other players, Roboco ultimately finishes this half match in 2nd place.

highlights_en.title: Mahjong Soul Skin Introduction and Chat
highlights_en.description: After the 4th match ends, she opens the Mahjong Soul character avatar (Janshi) screen and chats about her favorite characters and skins. In particular, she talks about the Aihara Mai Halloween skin she is currently using.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending Greeting
highlights_en.description: Announces the end of the practice stream, thanks viewers for their gifts, expresses her enthusiasm for the league match the next day, and concludes the stream.

title: 『コンプレックスが意外と役に立った時💕』 アキちょこナイトパレット第7回 ～ホロライブ深夜ラジオ～【ホロライブ/癒月ちょこ/アキロゼ】

overview.summary: ホロライブの癒月ちょこ（ちょこ先生）とアキロゼ（アキちゃん）による深夜ラジオ「アキちょこナイトパレット」第7回。今回のテーマはリスナーから募集した「コンプレックスが意外と役に立った時」に関するお便り紹介。冒頭で配信者自身の最近の出来事（ちょこ先生のクレカ紛失談やアキロゼのふわふわ声のコンプレックス）を交えつつ、リスナーからのコンプレックスにまつわるエピソードを読み上げた。コンプレックスがポジティブな結果に繋がった体験談が多く、終始笑いと共感に包まれた癒やしの時間となった。エンディングでは、ちょこ先生からの癒やしの一言も披露された。
overview.mood: 終始和やかで、笑いと癒やしに包まれた雰囲気

highlights.title: 番組開始と近況トーク
highlights.description: 番組開始の挨拶と、今週の気分を色で表現するトーク。ちょこ先生はクレジットカードを紛失しブラックな気分だったことを告白。

highlights.title: 今週のテーマ「コンプレックスが意外と役に立った時」発表
highlights.description: 今回のテーマを発表。続けて、ちょこ先生とアキロゼが自身のコンプレックスについて語り合う。

highlights.title: ちょこ先生のコンプレックスは「美しすぎる」こと？
highlights.description: ちょこ先生が「美しすぎる」ことがコンプレックスで話しかけられにくいと話し、アキロゼからツッコミを受ける。

highlights.title: アキロゼのコンプレックスは「声が幼い/圧がない」こと
highlights.description: アキロゼは声が幼い、または圧がないためにナメられやすいのがコンプレックスだと語る。

highlights.title: お便り：口唇の濃い色がコンプレックスだがコスプレで個性に
highlights.description: 発色の良い唇がコンプレックスだったが、コスプレ趣味で逆に強みとなり、現在ではリップなしでも綺麗に見せられると告白。

highlights.title: お便り：O脚がきっかけで深い関係に
highlights.description: O脚がコンプレックスだったが、バーで隣の女性とコンプレックスを打ち明け合い、一夜限りの深い関係に発展したエピソード。

highlights.title: お便り：負けず嫌いがホロカウ研究の力に
highlights.description: 負けず嫌いすぎる性格がコンプレックスだったが、そのおかげでホロカウ研究に没頭し大会で優勝できたという話。

highlights.title: お便り：歌の点数が低いが歌う姿で一目惚れされ交際中
highlights.description: カラオケの点数が低いのがコンプレックスだったが、異性に歌っている姿で一目惚れされて現在交際中だという幸せな体験談。

highlights.title: 次回テーマ発表とちょこ先生の癒やしセリフ
highlights.description: 来週のテーマ「あざとすぎる小悪魔な言動」を発表。その後、落ち込んでいるリスナーを慰める一口セリフをちょこ先生が披露。

highlights.title: エンディング
highlights.description: 次回放送日の告知と、おやすみの挨拶で番組を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: The 7th episode of the late-night radio show "Aki Choco Night Palette," featuring Hololive's Yuzuki Choco (Choco-sensei) and Aki Rosenthal (Aki-chan). The theme for this episode was listener submissions about "Times when a complex unexpectedly came in handy." The broadcast started with the hosts sharing recent events (Choco-sensei losing her credit card, Aki Rosenthal's complex about her soft voice), followed by reading listener anecdotes related to their complexes. Many stories involved complexes leading to positive outcomes, creating a time filled with laughter, empathy, and healing. Choco-sensei also provided a comforting phrase at the end.
overview_en.mood: A consistently warm atmosphere filled with laughter and healing

highlights_en.title: Program start and recent talks
highlights_en.description: Greetings for the program start and a segment where they express their mood of the week using colors. Choco-sensei confessed that she was feeling "black" because she lost her credit card.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of this week's theme: "Times when a complex unexpectedly came in handy"
highlights_en.description: The theme for this episode is announced. Following this, Choco-sensei and Aki Rosenthal discuss their own complexes.

highlights_en.title: Is Choco-sensei's complex that she is "too beautiful"?
highlights_en.description: Choco-sensei talks about her complex being that she is "too beautiful," making it hard for people to approach her, which draws a tsukkomi (retort) from Aki Rosenthal.

highlights_en.title: Aki Rosenthal's complex is having a "childish voice / lack of assertiveness"
highlights_en.description: Aki Rosenthal says her complex is that her voice is childish or lacks assertiveness, causing people to sometimes underestimate her.

highlights_en.title: Letter: Deep lip color was a complex, but became a unique trait in cosplay
highlights_en.description: The listener confessed that having highly pigmented lips was a complex, but it turned into a strength through their cosplay hobby, allowing them to look beautiful even without lipstick now.

highlights_en.title: Letter: Bowed legs led to a deeper relationship
highlights_en.description: An episode where a complex about bowed legs led to a deep, one-night relationship after sharing their respective complexes with a woman next to them at a bar.

highlights_en.title: Letter: Competitiveness fueled Holocow research
highlights_en.description: A story about how their overly competitive personality was a complex, but it allowed them to immerse themselves in Holocow research and win a competition.

highlights_en.title: Letter: Low singing score, but fell in love with their singing appearance and are now dating
highlights_en.description: A happy anecdote where their complex about low karaoke scores led to someone falling in love with them upon seeing them sing, and they are now dating.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of next theme and Choco-sensei's soothing line
highlights_en.description: The theme for next week, "Behavior that is too cunning and mischievous," is announced. Following this, Choco-sensei delivers a short line to comfort listeners who might be feeling down.

highlights_en.title: Ending
highlights_en.description: The program concludes with an announcement of the next broadcast date and good night greetings.

title: 【FUWAMOCO MORNING】episode 174 🐾 #FWMCMORNING

overview.summary: FUWAMOCOの朝の定期配信に、サプライズゲストとしてRaoraが参加した豪華な回。最近のホロライブの活動（Holoearth、コラボ）や、視聴者からの質問やメール、そしてRaoraとのトークテーマ（料理や映画鑑賞）について、終始賑やかに盛り上がった。最後はホロオクトーバーやマシュマロコラボの告知、そして視聴者への感謝で締めくくられた。
overview.mood: 非常に活発で、ゲストとの共演に盛り上がる楽しい雰囲気

highlights.title: FUWAMOCO MORNING スタート＆サプライズゲストRaora登場
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOが朝の挨拶を始めた直後、サプライズゲストとしてRaoraが登場し、視聴者とホストを驚かせる。

highlights.title: RaoraがFWMC MORNINGに出演した理由を説明
highlights.description: Raoraが視聴者に挨拶し、元気な一日の始まりを手助けするために登場したことを説明。FWMC MORNINGの配信曜日についても改めて告知。

highlights.title: Twitterトークテーマ：Perosightのファンアート紹介
highlights.description: リスナーが投稿した、ペロのデコレーション写真カードに関するツイートを紹介。Raoraはペロの可愛さに夢中だが、FUWAMOCOは「ナスティなもの」だと主張。

highlights.title: Among Us コラボレビュー：Chaos in Among Us
highlights.description: 先日行われたホロメン多数参加のAmong Usコラボを振り返る。MococoがFuwawaをキルしたエピソードや、インポスター役・エンジニア役の楽しさについて語る。

highlights.title: Holoearth Arrival Festivalの思い出
highlights.description: Holoearth Arrival Festivalについて語り、多くのホロメンと交流し、パークールのミニゲームを楽しんだ思い出を振り返る。

highlights.title: 新しいグッズ「Life is Bau Bau T-Shirt」発表
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOの新しい公式Tシャツ「Life is Bau Bau T-Shirt」がAmazonで販売されることを告知。Raoraは「No Jetpack」Tシャツのアイデアを提案。

highlights.title: Raoraのグッズアイデアとファンアート紹介
highlights.description: Raoraが自身のグッズとして「Big Cat means Big T-Shirt」を提案。また、Raoraの新しいビジュアルに関するファンアートを紹介。

highlights.title: トークテーマ：クッキングブーム
highlights.description: Raoraが健康志向のミールプレップ（作り置き）に凝っていると話し、高タンパク低カロリーな「スーパーチキンブリトー」や野菜について語り合う。

highlights.title: トークテーマ：ムービーパーティー（プリンセス・スイッチ）
highlights.description: Raoraが最近映画を観ていないと話す中、FUWAMOCOがChichiniが見たがっている「プリンセス・スイッチ」の映画鑑賞を提案。

highlights.title: Question of the Day：Holoctoberのプロンプト
highlights.description: 視聴者からの「Holoctoberで選ぶプロンプトは？」という質問に答え、Mococoは犬関連のプロンプトを希望。

highlights.title: Doggy of the Day：Fiora
highlights.description: Doggy of the Dayのコーナーで、Fuwawaの愛犬フィオラを紹介。フィオラの優雅なポーズが話題になる。

highlights.title: 配信の締めくくりとRaoraへの感謝
highlights.description: 様々な話題を振り返り、Raoraのサプライズ出演への感謝を伝え、視聴者やRaoraに別れを告げる。

highlights.title: Holoctoberプロンプトの続き：ピクニックと駄菓子
highlights.description: Holoctoberのプロンプトについてさらに話し合い、Raoraは「ピクニック」、Fuwawaは「駄菓子屋（日本の駄菓子）」、Mococoは「赤いサングラス」や「カボチャのスカート」など、様々なアイデアを提案する。

highlights.title: マシュマロコラボ（Marshmallow Q&A）の告知
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOとRaoraによる質問コーナー（マシュマロQ&A）が同日夜6時（PST）に実施されることを告知し、視聴者に質問を募集する。

highlights.title: エンディング：Raoraへの感謝と特別ウォルフィーへの呼びかけ
highlights.description: ゲストのRaoraに感謝を伝え、視聴者や特にメンバーシップのウォルフィーたちへBau Bauと挨拶し、配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: A special episode of FUWAMOCO's regular morning stream featuring surprise guest Raora. The stream was lively throughout, covering recent Hololive activities (Holoearth, collaborations), viewer questions and emails, and discussion topics with Raora (cooking and movie watching). It concluded with announcements for Holoctober and a Marshmallow Q&A collaboration, followed by thanks to the viewers.
overview_en.mood: Extremely lively and fun atmosphere, energized by the guest appearance

highlights_en.title: FUWAMOCO MORNING Starts & Surprise Guest Raora Appears
highlights_en.description: Immediately after FUWAMOCO began their morning greetings, surprise guest Raora appeared, astonishing both the viewers and the hosts.

highlights_en.title: Raora Explains Why She Appeared on FWMC MORNING
highlights_en.description: Raora greets the viewers and explains that she appeared to help everyone start their day energized. She also re-announced the streaming schedule for FWMC MORNING.

highlights_en.title: Twitter Talk Topic: Introducing Perosight Fan Art
highlights_en.description: They introduce a viewer's tweet featuring a decorated photo card of Pero. Raora is obsessed with Pero's cuteness, but FUWAMOCO insists it's 'nasty stuff.'

highlights_en.title: Among Us Collab Review: Chaos in Among Us
highlights_en.description: They look back on the recent Among Us collaboration featuring many Holomembers. They discuss the episode where Mococo killed Fuwawa and the enjoyment of playing Imposter and Engineer roles.

highlights_en.title: Memories of the Holoearth Arrival Festival
highlights_en.description: They talk about the Holoearth Arrival Festival, reminiscing about interacting with many Holomembers and enjoying the parkour mini-game.

highlights_en.title: New Merchandise Announcement: 'Life is Bau Bau T-Shirt'
highlights_en.description: They announce that FUWAMOCO's new official T-shirt, the 'Life is Bau Bau T-Shirt,' is available on Amazon. Raora suggests the idea for a 'No Jetpack' T-shirt.

highlights_en.title: Raora's Merch Idea and Fan Art Introduction
highlights_en.description: Raora suggests 'Big Cat means Big T-Shirt' as her own merchandise idea. They also introduce fan art related to Raora's new visual look.

highlights_en.title: Talk Topic: Cooking Boom
highlights_en.description: Raora talks about her current focus on health-conscious meal prepping, and they discuss high-protein, low-calorie 'super chicken burritos' and vegetables.

highlights_en.title: Talk Topic: Movie Party (The Princess Switch)
highlights_en.description: While Raora mentions she hasn't watched movies recently, FUWAMOCO suggests watching 'The Princess Switch,' which Chichini wants to see.

highlights_en.title: Question of the Day: Holoctober Prompts
highlights_en.description: They answer a viewer question asking, 'What prompt would you choose for Holoctober?' Mococo expresses interest in dog-related prompts.

highlights_en.title: Doggy of the Day: Fiora
highlights_en.description: In the Doggy of the Day segment, they introduce Fuwawa's beloved dog, Fiora. Fiora's elegant pose becomes a topic of discussion.

highlights_en.title: Stream Wrap-up and Thanks to Raora
highlights_en.description: They recap the various topics discussed, express gratitude for Raora's surprise appearance, and bid farewell to the viewers and Raora.

highlights_en.title: Holoctober Prompt Continuation: Picnic and Dagashi
highlights_en.description: They continue discussing Holoctober prompts. Raora suggests 'Picnic,' Fuwawa suggests 'Dagashiya (Japanese snacks),' and Mococo proposes various ideas like 'Red Sunglasses' and 'Pumpkin Skirt.'

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Marshmallow Collaboration (Marshmallow Q&A)
highlights_en.description: They announce that a Q&A session (Marshmallow Q&A) featuring FUWAMOCO and Raora will be held that night at 6 PM PST, and they solicit questions from viewers.

highlights_en.title: Ending: Thanks to Raora and Call-out to Special Woofies
highlights_en.description: They thank guest Raora, greet the viewers and especially the membership Woofies with 'Bau Bau,' and conclude the stream.

name.ja: モココ・アビスガード

title: 【 #朝こよ 】９月最後⁉の火曜日の朝も朝こよ～～～！☀ #252 【博衣こより/hololive】

overview.summary: 博衣こよりによる恒例の朝の雑談配信「朝こよ」第252回。9月最後の火曜日の放送として、近況やホロライブの最新ニュース、視聴者からの投稿コーナーなどが行われました。ホロライブEXPO 2024開催決定などの大きなお知らせへのリアクションや、リスナーからの悩みに真摯に答える「自信の持ち方」に関するアドバイス、好きなホロメンのファッション、最近ハマっている食べ物など、幅広いトピックでリスナーと交流を深めました。終盤はスパチャ読みと共に今後の配信告知を行い、和やかに締めくくられました。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気で、リスナーとの交流を楽しむ朝の雑談

highlights.title: 「朝こよ」スタート！最近の話題
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶。「朝こよ！」スタート。最近リスナーから「こよちゃん、大人になったね」と言われることが増えたことについてのトーク。

highlights.title: 誤変換から生まれた「おしゅし」
highlights.description: 配信中に生まれた誤変換「おしゅし（お寿司）」がリスナー間で流行っていることと、こよりの大人っぽさの正体について考察する。

highlights.title: ホロライブEXPO 2024開催決定！
highlights.description: 「朝こよ！ニュース」として、ホロライブEXPO 2024開催決定やホロライブDEV_ISの1st LIVEなど、ホロライブの最新公式情報を紹介し、前回参加の感動を語る。

highlights.title: こより流カレーメシの食べ方
highlights.description: 「今日のこよっとスポット」で、星街すいせいと日清カレーメシのコラボニュースを取り上げ、自身が実践しているカレーメシの「水少なめ濃厚派」の食べ方を熱弁する。

highlights.title: リスナー参加型！こよっとクイズ
highlights.description: 視聴者投稿コーナー「こよっとクイズ！」を実施。リスナーが考えるこよりの「大人っぽさ」を表現する擬音を当てる問題などに挑戦する。

highlights.title: こよりが初めて作った料理
highlights.description: リスナーからのお題「初めて料理した思い出」に回答。初めて作ったパンケーキの話や、普段料理をあまりしないこと、手順通りにやるタイプであることを明かす。

highlights.title: 夜型生活からの脱却を誓う
highlights.description: 最近、仕事で朝まで起きてしまうことが続いているという悩みを打ち明け、リスナーに睡眠に関する健康アドバイスを求める。

highlights.title: 9月にやり残したことと秋の味覚
highlights.description: リスナーのお便り「9月にやり残したこと」を紹介。こよりは結局サウナに行けなかったことを悔やみ、秋の味覚（サンマ、栗など）についてのトークに移る。

highlights.title: 好きなホロメンのファッションについて
highlights.description: リスナーからの質問に回答。桃鈴ねねや姫森ルーナなど、ホロメンそれぞれの個性的なファッションが好きだと語る。また、戌神ころねの3Dライブを見て感動した感想を述べる。

highlights.title: リスナーの悩みに答える：自信を持つ方法
highlights.description: 「自分に自信がない」というリスナーの悩みにアドバイス。好きなことを見つけて深く追求すること、褒め言葉を素直に受け入れることなど、自己肯定感を高めるための具体的な方法を提案する。

highlights.title: リスナーからの愛の告白タイムに照れる
highlights.description: 配信中にリスナーがこよりの好きなところを大量にコメントし始め、照れながらも感謝を伝える。褒められるのは好きだが、素直に受け取るのは照れると明かす。

highlights.title: 最近ハマっている食べ物：バウムクーヘン
highlights.description: 最近の個人的な話題として、バウムクーヘンにハマっていることを明かす。しっとり系よりもパサパサ系のバウムクーヘンが好きだと力説する。

highlights.title: スパチャ読みと今後の配信告知
highlights.description: スパチャ読みを行い、リスナーへの感謝を伝える。今後の配信予定として、企画配信やゲーム配信、公式グッズ情報などの告知を行う。

highlights.title: 配信エンディングと感謝のメッセージ
highlights.description: 9月最後の「朝こよ」を締めくくる挨拶。視聴者への感謝を述べ、次回の配信でまた会うことを約束して配信を終了する。

overview_en.summary: The 252nd installment of Hakui Koyori's regular morning chat stream, "AsaKoyo" (Morning Koyo). Broadcast on the last Tuesday of September, the stream covered current events, the latest Hololive news, and included a segment for viewer submissions. Koyori reacted to big announcements like the decision to hold Hololive EXPO 2024, provided earnest advice on "how to gain confidence" in response to viewer concerns, discussed her favorite Holomem fashion, and recent food obsessions, deepening her interaction with listeners across a wide range of topics. The stream concluded peacefully with Super Chat readings and announcements regarding future streams.
overview_en.mood: A peaceful morning chat, enjoying interaction with listeners throughout

highlights_en.title: "AsaKoyo" Starts! Recent Topics
highlights_en.description: Greetings at the start of the stream. "AsaKoyo!" begins. Discussion about how listeners have recently been commenting more often that "Koyo-chan has matured."

highlights_en.title: "Oshushi" Born from a Typo
highlights_en.description: Discussing how the typo "Oshushi" (meaning sushi, お寿司) that occurred during the stream has become popular among listeners, and theorizing about the true nature of Koyori's newfound maturity.

highlights_en.title: Hololive EXPO 2024 Announced!
highlights_en.description: As part of "AsaKoyo! News," Koyori introduces the latest official Hololive information, such as the announcement of Hololive EXPO 2024 and Hololive DEV_IS's 1st LIVE, sharing her excitement from attending the previous event.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Way of Eating Curry Meshi
highlights_en.description: In "Today's Koyo Spot," she discusses the news of Hoshimachi Suisei's collaboration with Nissin Curry Meshi and passionately explains her personal method of eating Curry Meshi: the "less water, rich flavor faction."

highlights_en.title: Listener Participation! Koyo Quiz
highlights_en.description: Holding the viewer submission segment "Koyo Quiz!" where she tackles questions, such as guessing the onomatopoeia listeners use to express Koyori's "maturity."

highlights_en.title: The First Dish Koyori Ever Cooked
highlights_en.description: Responding to the viewer topic "Memories of the first time you cooked." She talks about the first pancakes she made, reveals that she doesn't cook often, and mentions she is the type who strictly follows procedures.

highlights_en.title: Pledging to Escape the Night Owl Lifestyle
highlights_en.description: Confessing her worry about recently staying up until morning due to work and asking listeners for health advice regarding sleep.

highlights_en.title: Things Left Undone in September and Autumn Flavors
highlights_en.description: Introducing a listener's letter about "things left undone in September." Koyori regrets not being able to go to the sauna and transitions to talking about autumn flavors (like Pacific saury and chestnuts).

highlights_en.title: Discussing Favorite Holomem Fashion
highlights_en.description: Answering a question from a listener. She talks about liking the unique fashion styles of various Holomembers, such as Momosuzu Nene and Himemori Luna. She also shares her moving impressions after watching Inugami Korone's 3D Live.

highlights_en.title: Responding to Listener Worries: How to Gain Confidence
highlights_en.description: Giving advice to a listener who struggles with "lack of self-confidence." She proposes specific ways to boost self-esteem, such as finding something you love and pursuing it deeply, and honestly accepting compliments.

highlights_en.title: Getting Shy During the Listener Love Confession Time
highlights_en.description: During the stream, listeners started commenting extensively on what they love about Koyori. She expresses thanks while being shy, admitting that she likes being praised but gets embarrassed when accepting it honestly.

highlights_en.title: Recently Obsessed Food: Baumkuchen
highlights_en.description: Sharing personal news that she has recently become obsessed with Baumkuchen (layer cake). She strongly argues that she prefers the dry/crumbly type of Baumkuchen over the moist type.

highlights_en.title: Super Chat Reading and Future Stream Announcements
highlights_en.description: Reading Super Chats and expressing gratitude to the listeners. Announcing future stream plans, including special project streams, gaming streams, and official merchandise information.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending and Message of Thanks
highlights_en.description: The closing greetings for the final "AsaKoyo" of September. She expresses thanks to the viewers and promises to see them in the next stream before ending the broadcast.

title: 【No, I'm not a Human】開けて？？？？？？？？？？？？【白上フブキ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 白上フブキが監視型ホラーゲーム『No, I'm not a Human』のDay 9とDay 10をプレイ。連日過酷な選択を迫られる中、Day 9では隣人夫婦の来訪者判定と、それに伴う苦渋の決断、そして狂信的なカルト集団の登場により物語が加速する。Day 10ではついに自身を検査するフェーズが始まり、プレイヤー自身も人間であるかどうかの不安に直面する。最終的に、主人公は自分を人間だと証明しようとする来訪者（家族連れの男）を誤って殺害し、リスタート。その後、FEMA職員や武装した来訪者ハンターに遭遇し、非協力的な態度を取った結果、凄惨な「ジェノサイド・エンド」を迎え、配信は終了した。
overview.mood: 緊張感と疑心暗鬼が続くシリアスな雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲーム紹介
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶。「おはこんきーつね！」。前日深夜に配信予定だったが、食事をして寝てしまったため朝配信になった経緯を話す。ゲーム『No, I'm not a Human』は東京ゲームショウで体験版をプレイしたことがあると紹介。

highlights.title: Day 1：最初の訪問者（髭面の男性）の出現
highlights.description: ゲーム開始。主人公の部屋に隣人の髭面の男性が訪れ、ドア越しに太陽の異常と「来訪者」について話し、警戒を促す。

highlights.title: 緊急速報：太陽の異常と非常事態宣言
highlights.description: テレビの緊急速報。太陽からの強力なエネルギー放射と異常気温の上昇により、政府が非常事態宣言を発令。日中の屋外外出を控えるよう呼びかける。

highlights.title: 隣人との再度の会話と連絡先の入手
highlights.description: 隣人が日中は外に出てはいけないこと、家に他人を入れるべきではないことを再確認し、緊急連絡用の電話番号（875765）を教える。

highlights.title: 長髪の少女が助けを求める
highlights.description: ドアスコープを覗くと長髪の少女（隣人の娘？）が立ち、夜になると人がウロウロして怖いと訴える。彼女から父親のビールを飲んだ話を聞く。

highlights.title: 長身の男性（元酒場避難者）の訪問
highlights.description: 長身の男性が訪れ、酒場に避難していたが追い出されたと話す。彼は誰かを傷つけるつもりはないと語り、入室を求めてくる。最終的に入室を許可する。

highlights.title: 短髪の男性（家を追い出された人）の訪問
highlights.description: 短髪の男性が訪れ、昼間の暑さで屋外に出ない方が良いというテレビの情報を見ていたが、自分の家に訪問者が来て追い出されてしまったと話す。彼も入室を求めてくる。

highlights.title: ラスタマン風の男性の訪問と「ハッピーメモリー」
highlights.description: ドレッドヘアでアロハシャツを着た男性が訪れ、世の中の状況は厳しいが、生きる喜びを思い出せば楽になるかもと語る。彼も入室を求めてくる。

highlights.title: 窓の外のFEMA職員とDay 2 ニュース
highlights.description: 窓の外に化学防護服を着たFEMA職員らしき人影が複数確認される。夜が明け、テレビでDay 2のニュースが報じられる。殺人事件数が平均を上回り、来訪者に関する緊急情報が報じられる。

highlights.title: 来訪者を見分ける最初の徴候：白い歯
highlights.description: 来訪者を見分ける徴候として「真っ白な歯」が確認されたとニュースで報じられる。白い歯のホームレスの似顔絵が公開される。

highlights.title: メールで写真を送るシステムが判明
highlights.description: ラジオの周波数を合わせると、暗号化されたメッセージが復元され、写真をメールで送れば体を処理してくれるという情報（yesiamhuman@gmail.com）が判明する。

highlights.title: 長身の男性（入居済み）の検査と退室
highlights.description: 居間にいる長身の男性の検査を行う。歯が白すぎて人間ではないと判断し、銃を構えて追い出す。

highlights.title: 短髪の男性の検査と射殺
highlights.description: クローゼットから短髪の男性を発見。検査すると歯が白すぎる。彼が家を追われた経緯を聞いた後、来訪者であると判断し射殺する。

highlights.title: シスターの訪問と検査
highlights.description: 黒いローブを着たシスターが訪れる。彼女の歯がないことを確認し、来訪者と判断して追い出す。彼女は「この家が住みうる場所か確かめたい」と話す。

highlights.title: ラスタマン風の男性の検査と入室許可
highlights.description: ラスタマン風の男性が訪れる。彼の発言がポジティブなため人間らしいと判断し入室させる。

highlights.title: Day 3 ニュース：来訪者の新たな徴候「爪の間が泥」
highlights.description: Day 3のニュースで、来訪者の新たな徴候「爪の間が泥」が確認されたと報じられる。写真をメールで送ることで鑑定できる部位が目、歯、爪に限定される。

highlights.title: 長身の男性（入居済み）の爪の検査
highlights.description: 居間にいる長身の男性の爪が綺麗だったため、人間であると判断し、入室を許可したまま夜を明かす。

highlights.title: 寝室で夜を明かす
highlights.description: 危険が迫る中、寝室で一夜を過ごす。これで3日目の夜が終わる。

highlights.title: Day 4：武装兵士の出現と半裸の男の訪問
highlights.description: 窓の外に黒焦げの遺体と武装したFEMA職員が見える。ドアスコープに青白い半裸の男が現れ、「広い家だねえ」「気に入ったよ」と不気味な笑みを浮かべる。銃を持っていると伝えると「素晴らしい！」と反応し、中に誰かいることを指摘して立ち去る。

highlights.title: Day 4：スピリチュアルな女性の助言
highlights.description: 不気味な化粧をした女性が訪れ、主人公の運勢を占い、「この家に不快な陰の気を溜め込んだ」と指摘。髭面の男を追い出すべきだと助言し、輪廻の鎖を断ち切るために前世の繰り返しの受け入れを説く。

highlights.title: Day 5 ニュースと来訪者の新たな徴候
highlights.description: Day 5のニュース速報。来訪者の新たな徴候として「充血した赤い目」が報じられる。FEMAは危険性のある人物に対する隔離区域を設けたと発表。

highlights.title: Day 5：同居人2名を来訪者として射殺
highlights.description: 居間にいたラスタマン風の男の目を検査すると、充血した赤目を確認。銃を構えると男は「そう思わねえだろ！最高のネタだった！」と叫び、射殺。続いて髭面の男の歯が白すぎるため来訪者と断定し射殺。

highlights.title: Day 6：隣家の焼失とFEMAの同居人連行
highlights.description: Day 6。窓の外を見ると隣人の家が焼失しており、半裸の男が兵士の生首を持って立っている。その後、防護服を着たFEMA職員が訪れ、太陽の影響を研究するため同居人（髭面の男）を研究所へ連行する。

highlights.title: Day 6：隣人の娘の訪問と別れ
highlights.description: ドアスコープに青ざめた隣人の娘が現れる。彼女は夫（髭面の男）が死んだため、誰も助けてくれないと絶望している。同情し入室を許可するも、彼女は入室せず去っていく。

highlights.title: Day 6：猫を抱いた女性の訪問と入室拒否
highlights.description: 猫を抱いた女性が訪れる。彼女は猫を連れており、予言の老人から猫を連れた者を受け入れるよう言われたと話す。彼女の不気味な笑顔と人間だと証明する言葉（腕二つ、足二つ、頭一つ）から来訪者と判断し入室を拒否。

highlights.title: Day 7 ニュース：来訪者の新たな特徴「脇毛の欠如」
highlights.description: Day 7のニュース。来訪者には「脇毛がない」という特徴が追加される。また、来訪者を目撃した際の対応方法が報じられる。

highlights.title: Day 7：猫を抱いた女性の脇毛検査と射殺
highlights.description: 室内に入り込んできた猫を抱いた女性を脇毛の有無で検査。脇毛があるが、オーラ写真で人間でないと判断し射殺。彼女は「私を殺すの？」と泣きながら絶命。

highlights.title: Day 7：電話ルーレットで心の内を話す
highlights.description: ラジオで流れていた電話ルーレットの番号（891-533）に電話をかける。話し相手（孤独な男性）は、家族を失い、誰にも話せずにいた心の内を吐露する。互いに辛い状況にあることを知り、会話で救われる。

highlights.title: Day 8：医師の訪問とオーラ写真による検査
highlights.description: Day 8。白衣の老人が訪れ、病院であった恐ろしい出来事を話す。老人は自分の運命を占ってほしいと頼み、写真でオーラを撮影。写真に黒い斑点（来訪者の特徴）が映ったため、老人は来訪者と断定し射殺される。

highlights.title: Day 8：髭面の男の再来と最後の決断
highlights.description: Day 8の夜、ドアスコープから最初に射殺した半裸の男が再び現れる。「わかってるよな。だからこそ生きてられんだからな！」と入室を要求。プレイヤーは彼を撃ち、Day 8を終える。

highlights.title: Day 9：指令部からの秘密通信
highlights.description: Day 9開始。ラジオを操作すると、隔離区域の状況確認と爆発の報告、遺体処理班の要求、そして市を封鎖する指示など、軍事的な通信を傍受する。

highlights.title: Day 9：ひげの老人から「キノコ祭」に関する情報
highlights.description: 青い髭を生やした老人が窓の外に現れ、彼が「スマイルの書」の研究者であることを明かす。彼は「キノコ祭」が近づいていると警告し、スマイルの書から破り取った数ページを主人公に渡す。

highlights.title: Day 9：避難民の集団と虐殺の現場
highlights.description: 窓の外に多くの避難民らしき人影が見える。彼らは助けを求め扉を叩くが、誰も受け入れようとしない。遠景には武装したFEMA職員が立っており、ライフルで銃撃している様子が映し出される。

highlights.title: Day 9：テレビの緊急報道と来訪者の正体
highlights.description: テレビで緊急速報。避難所が襲撃され、未確認の人物が複数脱走したことが報じられる。来訪者は「正体不明の生物学的因子と接触した人間」であり、宇宙人や亡霊ではないという調査結果が発表される。

highlights.title: Day 9：隣人夫婦の来訪と検査
highlights.description: 髭面の男性が妻と共に訪れ、一時的な避難場所を求めて入室を請う。夫婦は疲弊しており、夫は妻を休ませたいと訴える。妻の目を検査すると、充血した赤目を確認し、来訪者と断定。

highlights.title: Day 9：来訪者夫婦の射殺
highlights.description: 妻が来訪者だと分かり射殺。夫（来訪者ではない）は混乱し、悲しむ。彼は外の世界に戻っても意味がないと考え、自ら銃を向けるよう求め、プレイヤーが彼も射殺する。

highlights.title: Day 9：狂信的なカルト集団の来訪
highlights.description: 黒いローブを着たカルト集団のメンバーが家に侵入し、主人公に休息が必要だと告げる。彼らは「静かに祈る」ためこの部屋にいると言い、自分たちの道を邪魔しないよう警告する。

highlights.title: Day 9：カルト集団メンバーの排除
highlights.description: カルトメンバーの耳を検査すると、異物（黒い糸のようなもの）が絡みついていることを発見。彼らは「外部の敵対勢力（FEMA）と戦う」という宗教的な使命を持っていることを示唆するが、主人公は彼らを撃退する。

highlights.title: Day 10：隣の家で人が住み始めた兆候
highlights.description: Day 10開始。窓の外には武装した来訪者ハンターらしき人物が徘徊しており、犬の群れが彼らの周りにいる。隣の廃墟となった家に誰か住み始めたらしいことが示唆される。

highlights.title: Day 10：武装した男の来訪と情報提供
highlights.description: 迷彩服を着てライフルを持った男が訪れる。彼は自分の地域を浄化しており、来訪者の歯を抜くことを明かす。彼はFEMAによって来訪者が増えていること、そしてジャガイモ味のポテトチップスがマインドコントロールの媒体であるという情報を打ち明ける。

highlights.title: Day 10：自分自身が来訪者であるかの検査
highlights.description: 主人公が鏡で自分の容姿を確認し、歯、目、手、脇毛、耳の項目をチェックする。全ての部位が異常なし（来訪者の特徴がない）と判明する。

highlights.title: Day 10：別の家族の来訪と受け入れ
highlights.description: Tシャツ姿の男が息子を連れて訪れる。彼らは嵐を避ける安全な場所を探している。男は家賃を払う余裕がないが、息子を休ませたいと懇願し、主人公は彼らを家に入れる。

highlights.title: Day 10：不気味な半裸の男の再来
highlights.description: Day 4で登場した半裸の男が再び窓の外に現れ、主人公に「変化を感じるか？」と問いかける。彼は自分がここを仕切っているのではなく、より強大な力に従っているだけだと語り、主人公に自分を開放するように圧力をかける。

highlights.title: Day 10：家族連れの男を射殺しゲームオーバー
highlights.description: 家族連れの男の耳を検査するが特に異常なし。しかし、何を信じるべきかわからず銃を構え男を射殺してしまう。男の言葉（僕はズット...）でゲームオーバー。主人公は自分の選択を悔やみ、Day 10を再スタートする。

highlights.title: Day 10（リスタート）：地下室の探索とキノコの確認
highlights.description: Day 10をやり直し、地下室を探る。キノコがまだ生えているのを確認するが、前回入手したキノコ（ポテトチップスのヒント）が腐敗していることを確認。

highlights.title: Day 10：狂気に満ちた村の光景と放火犯の出現
highlights.description: 窓の外の暗視カメラ映像。一団が全滅した村の死体の傍にFEMAの薬莢が散らばっていることが判明。狂信的な男（カルト集団のメンバー？）がガソリン缶と火炎瓶を持ち、村を焼き払おうとしている。

highlights.title: Day 10：FEMA職員との対立
highlights.description: 化学防護服を着たFEMA職員が再び現れ、主人公にさらなる人員を要求する。協力しない場合は全員連行すると脅すが、主人公は来訪者を差し出すことを拒否し、壁と話しているとあしらう。

highlights.title: Day 10：ライフルを持った男の再訪と運命の選択
highlights.description: ライフルを持った武装した男が訪れる（来訪者ハンター）。彼は主人公に身分証明（身体の検査）を要求するが、耳を見せるなどふざけた態度をとると、男は主人公を射殺する。

highlights.title: Day 10：ジェノサイド・エンドに到達
highlights.description: 主人公が殺されたことで「GENOCIDE END」が達成される。エンディング画像は顔を潰され血まみれになった主人公の姿が描かれ、主人公は恐るべき存在になったと語られる。

overview_en.summary: Shirakami Fubuki played Day 9 and Day 10 of the surveillance horror game 'No, I'm not a Human'. Facing difficult choices daily, Day 9 accelerated the story with the identification of a neighboring couple as Visitors, the difficult decision that followed, and the appearance of a fanatical cult. Day 10 finally introduced a phase where the protagonist must inspect themselves, leading the player to confront doubts about their own humanity. Ultimately, the protagonist mistakenly killed a visitor (a man with his family) who was trying to prove he was human, leading to a restart. After that, they encountered FEMA agents and armed Visitor hunters, and their non-cooperative attitude resulted in a gruesome 'Genocide End', concluding the stream.
overview_en.mood: Serious atmosphere marked by sustained tension and paranoia

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Game Introduction
highlights_en.description: Greeting at the start of the stream: "Ohakon-kitsune!". Fubuki explains that the stream was originally scheduled for late the previous night but became a morning stream because she ate and fell asleep. She mentions having played the demo of 'No, I'm not a Human' at the Tokyo Game Show.

highlights_en.title: Day 1: Appearance of the First Visitor (Bearded Man)
highlights_en.description: The game starts. A bearded neighbor visits the protagonist's room, talking through the door about the sun's abnormality and the "Visitors," urging caution.

highlights_en.title: Breaking News: Solar Anomaly and State of Emergency
highlights_en.description: Emergency breaking news on TV. The government declares a state of emergency due to powerful energy radiation from the sun and abnormally rising temperatures. They urge citizens to refrain from going outside during the day.

highlights_en.title: Second Conversation with the Neighbor and Obtaining Contact Info
highlights_en.description: The neighbor reiterates that they should not go outside during the day and should not let strangers into the house, providing an emergency contact number (875765).

highlights_en.title: Long-Haired Girl Asks for Help
highlights_en.description: Looking through the peephole, a long-haired girl (the neighbor's daughter?) stands there, complaining that people wander around at night and it's scary. She mentions drinking her father's beer.

highlights_en.title: Visit by a Tall Man (Former Bar Refugee)
highlights_en.description: A tall man visits, saying he was sheltering in a bar but was kicked out. He claims he doesn't intend to harm anyone and asks to be let in. The protagonist ultimately grants him entry.

highlights_en.title: Visit by a Short-Haired Man (Man Kicked Out of Home)
highlights_en.description: A short-haired man visits, saying he saw the TV warning not to go outside due to the daytime heat, but visitors came to his home and forced him out. He also asks to be let in.

highlights_en.title: Visit by a Rasta-like Man and "Happy Memory"
highlights_en.description: A man with dreadlocks and an Aloha shirt visits, saying that while the world is tough, remembering the joy of life might make things easier. He also asks to be let in.

highlights_en.title: FEMA Agents Outside the Window and Day 2 News
highlights_en.description: Several figures resembling FEMA agents in chemical protective suits are seen outside the window. Dawn breaks, and Day 2 news is reported on TV. Homicide rates are above average, and urgent information about Visitors is reported.

highlights_en.title: First Sign to Identify Visitors: White Teeth
highlights_en.description: News reports that "pure white teeth" have been identified as a sign to distinguish Visitors. A sketch of a homeless person with white teeth is shown.

highlights_en.title: System Revealed for Sending Photos via Email
highlights_en.description: When tuning the radio frequency, an encrypted message is deciphered, revealing information (yesiamhuman@gmail.com) that if you send photos via email, they will dispose of the body.

highlights_en.title: Inspection and Eviction of the Tall Man (Already Admitted)
highlights_en.description: The tall man already admitted to the living room is inspected. His teeth are too white, leading the protagonist to determine he is not human. He is evicted at gunpoint.

highlights_en.title: Inspection and Shooting of the Short-Haired Man
highlights_en.description: The short-haired man is found in the closet. Inspection shows his teeth are too white. After hearing his story about being kicked out of his home, he is determined to be a Visitor and is shot dead.

highlights_en.title: Visit and Inspection of the Sister
highlights_en.description: A sister in a black robe visits. Confirming she has no teeth, she is identified as a Visitor and driven away. She says she wants "to see if this house is a habitable place."

highlights_en.title: Inspection and Admission of the Rasta-like Man
highlights_en.description: The Rasta-like man visits. Because his statements are positive, he is judged likely human and allowed entry.

highlights_en.title: Day 3 News: New Visitor Sign "Dirt Under Fingernails"
highlights_en.description: Day 3 news reports that a new sign of Visitors, "dirt under the fingernails," has been confirmed. The body parts that can be assessed by sending photos are limited to the eyes, teeth, and nails.

highlights_en.title: Fingernail Inspection of the Tall Man (Already Admitted)
highlights_en.description: Since the tall man in the living room had clean nails, he is judged to be human and allowed to stay the night.

highlights_en.title: Spending the Night in the Bedroom
highlights_en.description: Spending the night in the bedroom while danger looms. This marks the end of Day 3.

highlights_en.title: Day 4: Appearance of Armed Soldiers and Visit by a Half-Naked Man
highlights_en.description: Charred bodies and armed FEMA agents are visible outside the window. A pale, half-naked man appears in the peephole, smiling eerily and saying, "Nice big house," and "I like it." When told the protagonist has a gun, he replies, "Wonderful!" He points out that someone is inside and then leaves.

highlights_en.title: Day 4: Advice from a Spiritual Woman
highlights_en.description: A woman wearing strange makeup visits, reads the protagonist's fortune, and points out that the house has accumulated "unpleasant negative energy." She advises kicking out the bearded man and preaches acceptance of past life repetition to break the chain of reincarnation.

highlights_en.title: Day 5 News and New Visitor Signs
highlights_en.description: Day 5 breaking news. "Bloodshot red eyes" are reported as a new sign of Visitors. FEMA announces the establishment of quarantine zones for dangerous individuals.

highlights_en.title: Day 5: Two Housemates Shot as Visitors
highlights_en.description: Inspecting the eyes of the Rasta-like man in the living room, bloodshot red eyes are confirmed. When the protagonist raises the gun, the man screams, "You don't think so! It was a great joke!" and is shot. Subsequently, the bearded man's teeth are too white, so he is also identified as a Visitor and shot dead.

highlights_en.title: Day 6: Neighbor's House Burned Down and FEMA Takes a Housemate
highlights_en.description: Day 6. Looking outside, the neighbor's house has burned down, and the half-naked man is standing there holding a soldier's severed head. Later, FEMA agents in protective suits arrive and take a housemate (the bearded man) to a lab for research on the sun's effects.

highlights_en.title: Day 6: Visit and Farewell of the Neighbor's Daughter
highlights_en.description: The pale neighbor's daughter appears in the peephole. She is desperate because her husband (the bearded man) is dead and no one is helping her. The protagonist sympathizes and allows her entry, but she leaves without entering.

highlights_en.title: Day 6: Visit by a Woman Holding a Cat and Refusal of Entry
highlights_en.description: A woman holding a cat visits. She says a prophet told her to welcome anyone accompanied by a cat. Based on her eerie smile and her proof of being human ("Two arms, two legs, one head"), she is judged to be a Visitor and denied entry.

highlights_en.title: Day 7 News: New Visitor Feature "Lack of Armpit Hair"
highlights_en.description: Day 7 news reports that a new characteristic of Visitors—"lack of armpit hair"—has been added. Guidelines for dealing with Visitors upon sighting are also reported.

highlights_en.title: Day 7: Armpit Hair Inspection and Shooting of the Woman with a Cat
highlights_en.description: The woman holding the cat, who managed to get inside, is inspected for armpit hair. Although she has armpit hair, she is judged non-human by an aura photo and shot dead. Crying, she dies, asking, "Are you going to kill me?"

highlights_en.title: Day 7: Sharing Inner Feelings via Telephone Roulette
highlights_en.description: The protagonist calls the telephone roulette number (891-533) that was broadcast on the radio. The person on the other end (a lonely man) reveals his inner feelings, having lost his family and having nobody to talk to. They find comfort in the conversation, recognizing they are both in tough situations.

highlights_en.title: Day 8: Visit by a Doctor and Inspection via Aura Photo
highlights_en.description: Day 8. An elderly man in a white coat visits, describing the terrifying events at the hospital. The old man asks the protagonist to read his fortune, taking an aura photo. Since black spots (a Visitor characteristic) appear in the photo, the old man is determined to be a Visitor and is shot dead.

highlights_en.title: Day 8: Return of the Bearded Man and the Final Decision
highlights_en.description: Day 8 night. The half-naked man, whom the protagonist shot first, reappears in the peephole. He demands entry, saying, "You know what's up. That's why you're still alive!" The player shoots him, ending Day 8.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Secret Communication from Command
highlights_en.description: Day 9 begins. Operating the radio, the protagonist intercepts military communications, including status checks of quarantine zones, reports of explosions, demands for body disposal teams, and instructions to seal off the city.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Information on the "Mushroom Festival" from a Bearded Old Man
highlights_en.description: An old man with a blue beard appears outside the window, revealing himself to be a researcher of the "Book of Smiles." He warns that the "Mushroom Festival" is approaching and hands the protagonist several torn pages from the book.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Group of Refugees and a Scene of Massacre
highlights_en.description: Many figures resembling refugees are visible outside the window. They knock on the door asking for help, but nobody lets them in. In the distance, armed FEMA agents are standing and are shown firing rifles.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Emergency TV Report and the True Identity of Visitors
highlights_en.description: Emergency breaking news on TV. It is reported that shelters were attacked and multiple unidentified individuals escaped. Investigation results announce that Visitors are "humans who came into contact with an unknown biological factor," not aliens or ghosts.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Visit and Inspection of the Neighboring Couple
highlights_en.description: A bearded man visits with his wife, pleading for temporary shelter and entry. The couple is exhausted, and the husband insists he wants his wife to rest. Inspecting the wife's eyes, bloodshot red eyes are confirmed, and she is determined to be a Visitor.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Shooting of the Visitor Couple
highlights_en.description: The wife is identified as a Visitor and shot dead. The husband (who is not a Visitor) is confused and distressed. Believing there is no point in returning to the outside world, he asks the protagonist to aim the gun at him, and the protagonist shoots him too.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Visit by a Fanatical Cult Group
highlights_en.description: Members of a cult group wearing black robes infiltrate the house, telling the protagonist that they need rest. They state they are in the room "to pray quietly" and warn the protagonist not to interfere with their path.

highlights_en.title: Day 9: Elimination of Cult Group Members
highlights_en.description: Inspecting the cult members' ears, the protagonist finds foreign objects (like black threads) entangled inside. They suggest they have a religious mission to "fight external hostile forces (FEMA)," but the protagonist repels them.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Signs that People Have Started Living Next Door
highlights_en.description: Day 10 begins. Armed Visitor hunters are seen wandering outside the window, with packs of dogs surrounding them. It is suggested that someone has started living in the neighboring ruined house.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Visit by an Armed Man and Information Provision
highlights_en.description: A man in camouflage with a rifle visits. He reveals he is purifying his area and pulling out the teeth of Visitors. He shares information that FEMA is increasing the number of Visitors, and that potato-flavored potato chips are a medium for mind control.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Self-Inspection for Being a Visitor
highlights_en.description: The protagonist checks their own appearance in the mirror, examining their teeth, eyes, hands, armpit hair, and ears. All body parts are found to be normal (lacking Visitor characteristics).

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Visit by Another Family and Acceptance
highlights_en.description: A man in a T-shirt visits with his son. They are looking for a safe place to avoid the storm. The man begs to let his son rest, despite having no money for rent, and the protagonist lets them into the house.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Return of the Eerie Half-Naked Man
highlights_en.description: The half-naked man who appeared on Day 4 reappears outside the window, asking the protagonist, "Do you feel the change?" He states that he is not in charge but merely following a greater force, pressuring the protagonist to open up to him.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Shooting the Family Man and Game Over
highlights_en.description: The protagonist inspects the ear of the family man but finds no abnormality. However, unsure what to believe, the protagonist raises the gun and shoots the man. The man's final words (I was always...) trigger the Game Over screen. The protagonist regrets the choice and restarts Day 10.

highlights_en.title: Day 10 (Restart): Basement Exploration and Mushroom Check
highlights_en.description: Restarting Day 10, the protagonist explores the basement. They confirm that mushrooms are still growing, but the previously acquired mushroom (the hint about potato chips) has rotted.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Scene of a Mad Village and Appearance of an Arsonist
highlights_en.description: Night vision camera footage outside the window shows FEMA shell casings scattered near the bodies of a group annihilated in a village. A fanatical man (a cult member?) appears with a gasoline can and molotov cocktails, attempting to burn down the village.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Confrontation with a FEMA Agent
highlights_en.description: A FEMA agent in a chemical protective suit reappears, demanding more personnel from the protagonist. He threatens to take everyone if the protagonist doesn't cooperate, but the protagonist refuses to hand over any Visitors and dismisses the agent as talking to a wall.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Return of the Man with a Rifle and a Fateful Choice
highlights_en.description: The armed man with a rifle (Visitor Hunter) visits again. He demands the protagonist show proof of identity (a physical inspection), but when the protagonist acts flippantly, showing only their ear, the man shoots the protagonist.

highlights_en.title: Day 10: Reaching the Genocide End
highlights_en.description: The protagonist's death leads to the "GENOCIDE END." The ending image depicts the protagonist, bloody and with a crushed face, and states that the protagonist has become a formidable entity.

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【MARSHMALLOW Q&A OFF-COLLAB with RAORA】just a cat and two dogs eating your questions 🐾 【FUWAMOCO】

overview.summary: FUWAMOCOとゲストのRaoraによるマシュマロQ&Aコラボ配信は、ホロライブJPメンバーとのコラボ希望、ユニークな食べ物のアイデア、ガチゃの哲学など、幅広い話題で盛り上がりました。後半では、Raoraが今後の活動についてヒントを出し、FUWAMOCOのオリジナル曲やグッズを紹介。終始アットホームな雰囲気の中、次回オフコラボの約束や、キウイチャレンジの顛末などで笑いを誘い、賑やかに締めくくられました。
overview.mood: 終始愉快で、アットホームな雰囲気

highlights.title: Raoraをゲストに迎えた初のオフコラボ配信開始
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOがゲストのRaoraと共にストリームを開始。Raoraはオフコラボで2人の間に挟まれて寝たため「気持ちよくて眠い」とコメント。

highlights.title: Raora流ファンアートへのアドバイス
highlights.description: ファンアートに関する質問に対し、Raoraは技術より作品に込められた気持ちやクリエイティブな表現が重要だとアドバイス。

highlights.title: 「赤」の色に関する質問とその答え
highlights.description: 視聴者から届いた哲学的な質問「赤とは何色？」に対し、モココが「血」だと即答し、FUWAMOCOが爆笑する。

highlights.title: パスタ vs 日本の麺料理ランキング
highlights.description: ラーメン、うどん、そば、パスタの中で何が好きかというRaoraへの質問。Raoraは太いうどんを好むが、シンプルであればパスタも良いとコメント。ウドン > そば/ラーメン > パスタの順位付けを披露し、麺類対決が勃発。

highlights.title: 月の表面に「BAU BAU」を刻むファンアート
highlights.description: ファンがゼロから新しいものを創ることにどう思うかという質問から、Fuwaが「月の表面にBAU BAUとカービングする」という壮大なアイデアを提案。

highlights.title: FUWAMOCOの仕事観「休憩はなし」
highlights.description: 仕事のアウトプットに限界はあるか、いつ家に帰るかという質問に、「終わりはない。限界が来たらそこで終わり」と2人ともワーカホリックな一面を覗かせる。

highlights.title: モココの虫嫌いエピソード
highlights.description: 普段の会話内容の質問から、FuwaとMococoが早朝に遭遇した大きな虫（セミの抜け殻と蝶々）を巡る可愛らしい喧嘩のエピソードをRaoraが語る。

highlights.title: FUWAMOCOに着てほしい服は「エレガントなスポーツウェア」
highlights.description: RaoraがFUWAMOCOに着てほしい服の質問に対し、エレガントなドレスやスポーツウェアを提案。特にモココにはフリル付きのスカートが良いと提案。

highlights.title: Dog Houseでの就寝場所のルール
highlights.description: ゲストが泊まる際の寝具について質問。Raoraは布団で寝るのが好きだと答え、FUWAMOCOは3人で一つのベッドで寝ることもあると明かす。

highlights.title: ビジュアルノベルコラボは「Visual Skippa」
highlights.description: FuwaMocoはビジュアルノベルが好きだが、Raoraがスキップが好きだという前提で、もしコラボするならどうなるかという質問。Raoraはスキップありの短編なら良いと答える。

highlights.title: ホロライブENでの共通目標は「トップを目指す」
highlights.description: 今後、ホロライブENのメンバーとして追いかける目標について、3人揃って「トップ（月）を目指す」という大きな夢を語る。

highlights.title: キュウリとトマトの交換チャレンジ
highlights.description: Raoraはキュウリが嫌い、FUWAMOCOはトマトが嫌いという事実から、お互いの嫌いなものを交換して食べる取引案が浮上。Fuwaはトマトの食感が苦手だとコメント。

highlights.title: FUWAMOCOがシンプルなピザを好む理由
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOがピザを嫌いな理由をRaoraに説明してほしいという質問に対し、具材が多すぎる複雑なピザが苦手で、モッツァレラとトマトソースのようなシンプルなものが好きだと解説。

highlights.title: FUWAMOCOのシンプルなピザへの愛とSaizeriya体験
highlights.description: 前の質問から続き、FUWAMOCOが具材の多いピザを苦手とする理由を再説明。Raoraは来日後、日本のイタリアンチェーンSaizeriyaを気に入り、3人でSaizeriyaに行く約束をする。

highlights.title: Raora特製の手打ちパスタは試すか？
highlights.description: パスタが苦手なFUWAMOCOに対し、もしRaoraが自家製で本格的なパスタを作ったら試すかという質問に、2人は即答で「Yes」と回答。特にRaoraが自家製ソースやミートボールについて言及し、盛り上がる。

highlights.title: Raoraから見たFUWAMOCOとの姉妹関係
highlights.description: 視聴者からの質問で、RaoraがMococoを「スモール・シスター」、Fuwaを「ビッグ・シスター」、自身を「ミドル・シスター」として見ていると説明。

highlights.title: FuwaMocoとRaoraがオンセン旅行を計画
highlights.description: 3人でのオンセン（温泉）旅行の計画があるかという質問に対し、皆で盛り上がり、冬に温泉に浸かりたいという希望を語る。

highlights.title: MMO/RPGゲームの好みについて
highlights.description: MMOゲームとシングルプレイヤー/オフラインマルチプレイヤーゲームのどちらが好きかという質問。RaoraはMMO（Ragnarok Online, World of Warcraftなど）を好むが、時間がかかるため今はほとんどプレイしていないと語る。

highlights.title: Raoraのイラストレーターとしての原点
highlights.description: Raoraの絵の才能について、幼少期にプリキュアやポケモンに影響を受けて自分だけのコミックやキャラクターを描き始めたエピソードを披露。

highlights.title: 3人で歌いたいホロライブソングの話題
highlights.description: 3人で一緒に歌いたいホロライブの曲について話す。Fuwaが「Suspect」を提案し、Raoraのアイドルの愛称（Raodol）にちなんだ曲を歌うアイデアも出る。

highlights.title: Raora、日本語での自己紹介に挑戦
highlights.description: Raoraが日本語が上手くなったかという質問に、恥ずかしがりながらも日本語で自己紹介に挑戦。「私は大きな猫です（Big Cat）」とユーモラスに語る。

highlights.title: ホロライブでの活動で学んだこと
highlights.description: この1年間でホロライブの活動を通じて何を学んだかという質問に対し、FuwaMocoとRaoraは情熱を持って物事に取り組むことの重要性を語る。

highlights.title: ホロJPとのコラボ希望：Botan SenpaiとFPS？
highlights.description: ホロライブJPメンバーとのコラボ希望の話題。3人はBotan Senpai、Okakoro（Okayu SenpaiとKorone Senpai）の名前を挙げ、特にBotanとはFPSをやりたいと盛り上がる。FuwaがApexが得意であることをアピール。

highlights.title: Calzone Pon de Ringsの斬新なアイデア
highlights.description: リスナーからの質問で、イタリア料理のカルツォーネと日本のポン・デ・リングを合わせた「Calzone Pon de Rings」というユニークな食べ物のアイデアが浮上し、3人は戸惑いつつも議論する。

highlights.title: RaoraはPizaman（ピザまん）より肉まん派
highlights.description: Raoraが日本の肉まん（Nikuman）が好きだという話題から、ピザまん（Pizaman）はどうかと聞かれ、皮とピザソースの相性が悪く、伝統的な肉まんの方が好きだと答える。

highlights.title: Gacha QueenはRaora？Mococo？
highlights.description: 真のガチゃクイーンはMococoとRaoraどちらかという質問に対し、RaoraはMococoこそがGacha Queenだと主張。Mococoはセット買いはするが、ガチャポンでドキドキ感を味わうのは好きだと説明。

highlights.title: FuwaMocoの500円玉貯金とRaoraのKiwi皮食
highlights.description: Mococoが500円玉貯金でGachaを引くのを楽しみにしていると語る。また、Kiara MamaがRaoraの奇妙な食習慣（キウイの皮を食べること）を暴露し、笑いが起きる。

highlights.title: Hololiveで最も記憶に残る瞬間：Mythの3Dお披露目
highlights.description: Hololiveに参加して以来の最もお気に入りの思い出について尋ねられ、FuwaMocoは初のコンサートを挙げ、RaoraはMythの3Dデビューを思い出深い瞬間として語る。

highlights.title: Raoraの英語学習法：イマージョンとシャドーイング
highlights.description: 日本語の生徒から英語学習法について尋ねられ、Raoraは英語のアニメや動画を集中して視聴し、セリフを復唱するイマージョン（シャドーイング）が効果的だとアドバイスする。

highlights.title: 「これ無しでは生きられないもの」：ゲームとポケモン
highlights.description: 「これ無しでは生きられないもの」という質問に対し、MococoはFuwaWawaだと答えるが、アイテムに限定するよう求められるとRaoraはゲームのコレクション、特にポケモンを挙げる。

highlights.title: 尻尾が一番長いのは誰？
highlights.description: メンバーの中で誰の尻尾が一番長いかという質問に対し、FuwaとRaoraがRaoraの尻尾だと主張する。

highlights.title: ラフィアンとチャッティーニはどちらが美味しいか？
highlights.description: リスナーがFUWAMOCOのキャラクターであるラフィアンとチャッティーニの「食べられるか、どちらが美味しいか」という恐ろしい質問をするが、最終的に両方とも食べ物ではないという結論に達する。

highlights.title: 「絶対領域」（ZR）についての文化的質問
highlights.description: 『スク水（スクール水着）とサイハイソックスの間の「絶対領域」（ZR）に境界線はあるか？』というオタク的な質問に対し、その定義や概念について語り合う。

highlights.title: ソースに関するアンオーソドックスな意見
highlights.description: ソースについての質問に対し、FuwaMocoはソースをつけずに食材本来の味を楽しむことを好むと主張。カレーライスについても議論が勃発する。

highlights.title: Q&A終了、次回コラボの約束
highlights.description: マシュマロQ&Aが終了。RaoraとFUWAMOCOは、次回のオフコラボでのパスタパーティーやSaizeriya訪問を約束し、ファンに感謝を伝える。

highlights.title: Raoraから今後の活動に関するヒント
highlights.description: RaoraはRuffiansとChattiniesに向けて、今後何かエキサイティングなことが起こるかもしれないと匂わせる発言をするが、詳細は秘密のままである。

highlights.title: FUWAMOCOのオリジナル曲MV紹介
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOが、自身のオリジナルソング「Lifetime Showtime」のミュージックビデオについて言及し、まだ見ていない視聴者へ視聴を促す。

highlights.title: 「Life is BAU BAU」Tシャツのプロモーション
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOが、現在Amazonで販売中の「Life is BAU BAU」Tシャツの可愛らしさについて語り、購入を勧める。

highlights.title: キウイチャレンジの顛末を確認
highlights.description: FuwaMocoが、配信冒頭で話題になったキウイの皮を食べた後のRaoraの体調について冗談めかして確認。Raoraは「大丈夫」と答え、笑いを誘う。

highlights.title: 配信終了：Bau Bau Raoの最終チャント
highlights.description: FUWAMOCOとRaoraがファンに別れを告げ、最後に全員で「BAU BAU RAO」を唱和して配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: The Marshmallow Q&A collaboration stream featuring FUWAMOCO and guest Raora covered a wide range of topics, including hopes for collaborations with Hololive JP members, unique food ideas, and the philosophy of gacha. In the latter half, Raora dropped hints about her future activities, and FUWAMOCO introduced their original song and merchandise. The stream maintained a warm, cozy atmosphere throughout, concluding cheerfully with promises for the next in-person collaboration and laughter over the outcome of the kiwi challenge.
overview_en.mood: Joyful and cozy atmosphere throughout

highlights_en.title: First In-Person Collaboration Stream Begins with Raora as Guest
highlights_en.description: FUWAMOCO starts the stream with guest Raora. Raora comments that she feels 'comfortable and sleepy' because she slept squished between the two during the off-collab.

highlights_en.title: Raora’s Advice on Fan Art
highlights_en.description: Responding to a question about fan art, Raora advises that the feeling conveyed in the work and creative expression are more important than technical skill.

highlights_en.title: Question About the Color 'Red' and the Answer
highlights_en.description: Responding to a philosophical question from a viewer, 'What color is red?', Mococo immediately answers 'Blood,' causing FUWAMOCO to burst into laughter.

highlights_en.title: Pasta vs. Japanese Noodle Dish Ranking
highlights_en.description: A question for Raora about her preference among ramen, udon, soba, and pasta. Raora prefers thick udon but says simple pasta is also good. She reveals her ranking: Udon > Soba/Ramen > Pasta, sparking a noodle debate.

highlights_en.title: Fan Art Idea: Carving 'BAU BAU' on the Moon's Surface
highlights_en.description: Following a question about what they think of fans creating new things from scratch, Fuwa proposes the grand idea of 'carving BAU BAU into the surface of the moon.'

highlights_en.title: FUWAMOCO's Work Ethic: 'No Breaks'
highlights_en.description: When asked if there's a limit to their work output or when they go home, both reveal their workaholic side, stating, 'There is no end. When we hit the limit, that’s when it ends.'

highlights_en.title: Mococo’s Bug Phobia Episode
highlights_en.description: Responding to a question about their typical conversations, Raora recounts a cute early morning argument between Fuwa and Mococo over large bugs (a cicada shell and a butterfly) they encountered.

highlights_en.title: Recommended Outfit for FUWAMOCO: 'Elegant Sportswear'
highlights_en.description: Answering a question about what clothes she wants FUWAMOCO to wear, Raora suggests elegant dresses or sportswear. She specifically suggests a frilly skirt for Mococo.

highlights_en.title: Sleeping Arrangement Rules at the Dog House
highlights_en.description: A question about sleeping arrangements when guests stay over. Raora says she likes sleeping on a futon, while FUWAMOCO reveals they sometimes sleep three people in one bed.

highlights_en.title: Visual Novel Collaboration: 'Visual Skippa'
highlights_en.description: The twins love visual novels, but Raora likes skipping text. A viewer asks how a collaboration would work. Raora replies that a short story with skipping allowed would be fine.

highlights_en.title: Shared Goal in Hololive EN: 'Aiming for the Top'
highlights_en.description: When asked about their collective goals as Hololive EN members moving forward, all three express the grand ambition of 'aiming for the top (the moon).'

highlights_en.title: Cucumber and Tomato Swap Challenge
highlights_en.description: Based on the fact that Raora dislikes cucumbers and FUWAMOCO dislikes tomatoes, a deal is proposed to swap and eat each other’s disliked foods. Fuwa comments that she dislikes the texture of tomatoes.

highlights_en.title: Why FUWAMOCO Prefers Simple Pizza
highlights_en.description: In response to a request for Raora to explain why FUWAMOCO dislikes pizza, they clarify that they dislike overly complicated pizzas with too many toppings, preferring simple ones like mozzarella and tomato sauce.

highlights_en.title: FUWAMOCO's Love for Simple Pizza and the Saizeriya Experience
highlights_en.description: Following up on the previous question, FUWAMOCO reiterates their dislike for heavily topped pizzas. Raora mentions she loves the Japanese Italian chain Saizeriya after arriving in Japan, and the three promise to go together.

highlights_en.title: Would They Try Raora's Homemade Pasta?
highlights_en.description: When asked if they would try homemade, authentic pasta if Raora made it, despite their general dislike of pasta, the twins immediately answer 'Yes.' The discussion gets lively as Raora mentions homemade sauce and meatballs.

highlights_en.title: Raora's View on Her Sibling Relationship with FUWAMOCO
highlights_en.description: Responding to a viewer question, Raora explains that she views Mococo as the 'Small Sister,' Fuwa as the 'Big Sister,' and herself as the 'Middle Sister.'

highlights_en.title: FuwaMoco and Raora Plan an Onsen Trip
highlights_en.description: When asked if they plan a trip to an Onsen (hot spring) together, they all get excited and express their desire to soak in a hot spring in the winter.

highlights_en.title: Preferences Regarding MMO/RPG Games
highlights_en.description: A question about whether they prefer MMOs or single-player/offline multiplayer games. Raora says she likes MMOs (like Ragnarok Online, World of Warcraft) but rarely plays now because they are too time-consuming.

highlights_en.title: Raora's Origins as an Illustrator
highlights_en.description: Regarding Raora's drawing talent, she shares an episode from her childhood where she was influenced by Precure and Pokémon and began drawing her own comics and characters.

highlights_en.title: Discussion of Hololive Songs They Want to Sing Together
highlights_en.description: They discuss Hololive songs they want to sing together. Fuwa suggests 'Suspect,' and an idea comes up to sing a song related to Raora's idol nickname (Raodol).

highlights_en.title: Raora Attempts Self-Introduction in Japanese
highlights_en.description: When asked if her Japanese has improved, Raora shyly attempts a self-introduction in Japanese, jokingly stating, 'I am a Big Cat.'

highlights_en.title: Lessons Learned from Hololive Activities
highlights_en.description: Asked what they have learned over the past year of Hololive activities, FuwaMoco and Raora emphasize the importance of approaching things with passion.

highlights_en.title: Hololive JP Collaboration Hopes: Botan Senpai and FPS?
highlights_en.description: The topic turns to desired collaborations with Hololive JP members. They mention Botan Senpai and Okakoro (Okayu Senpai and Korone Senpai), and they are excited about playing FPS, especially with Botan. Fuwa boasts about being good at Apex.

highlights_en.title: The Innovative Idea of Calzone Pon de Rings
highlights_en.description: A listener proposes a unique food idea: 'Calzone Pon de Rings,' a fusion of the Italian calzone and the Japanese Pon de Ring donut. The three discuss the idea with confusion.

highlights_en.title: Raora Prefers Nikuman over Pizaman
highlights_en.description: Following a discussion about Raora liking Japanese Nikuman (meat buns), she is asked about Pizaman (pizza buns). She replies that she dislikes the combination of the bun skin and pizza sauce and prefers traditional Nikuman.

highlights_en.title: Who is the Gacha Queen: Raora or Mococo?
highlights_en.description: In response to a question about who the true Gacha Queen is—Mococo or Raora—Raora insists Mococo is the Gacha Queen. Mococo explains that while she buys sets, she enjoys the thrilling feeling of using gachapon machines.

highlights_en.title: FuwaMoco's 500 Yen Savings and Raora's Kiwi Skin Eating Habit
highlights_en.description: Mococo mentions she looks forward to using her 500 yen coin savings to pull gacha. Also, Kiara Mama exposes Raora's strange eating habit (eating kiwi skin), resulting in laughter.

highlights_en.title: Most Memorable Hololive Moment: Myth's 3D Debut
highlights_en.description: Asked about their favorite memories since joining Hololive, FuwaMoco names their first concert, while Raora highlights Myth’s 3D debut as a deeply memorable moment.

highlights_en.title: Raora's English Learning Method: Immersion and Shadowing
highlights_en.description: Asked by a Japanese student for English learning advice, Raora recommends immersion (shadowing), focusing on watching English anime and videos and repeating the dialogue.

highlights_en.title: Things They Can't Live Without: Games and Pokémon
highlights_en.description: When asked what they cannot live without, Mococo initially answers 'FuwaWawa,' but when asked to limit it to an item, Raora names her game collection, particularly Pokémon.

highlights_en.title: Whose Tail is the Longest?
highlights_en.description: When asked whose tail among the members is the longest, Fuwa and Raora both assert that Raora's tail is the longest.

highlights_en.title: Which Tattiness and Ruffian Tastes Better?
highlights_en.description: A listener asks the terrifying question of whether FUWAMOCO’s characters, Ruffian and Chattinies, are edible and which tastes better, but they ultimately conclude that neither is food.

highlights_en.title: Cultural Question About 'Absolute Territory' (ZR)
highlights_en.description: In response to an otaku-related question: 'Is there a boundary line for the 'Absolute Territory' (ZR) between a sukumizu (school swimsuit) and thigh-high socks?', they discuss the definition and concept.

highlights_en.title: Unorthodox Opinion Regarding Sauces
highlights_en.description: In response to a question about sauces, FuwaMoco asserts that they prefer to enjoy the original taste of the ingredients without sauce. A discussion about curry rice erupts as well.

highlights_en.title: Q&A Concludes, Promise for Next Collaboration
highlights_en.description: The Marshmallow Q&A concludes. Raora and FUWAMOCO promise a pasta party or a visit to Saizeriya during their next in-person collaboration and thank their fans.

highlights_en.title: Hints from Raora Regarding Future Activities
highlights_en.description: Raora hints to the Ruffians and Chattinies that something exciting might happen in the future, but the details remain a secret.

highlights_en.title: Introduction of FUWAMOCO's Original Song MV
highlights_en.description: FUWAMOCO mentions the music video for their original song 'Lifetime Showtime' and encourages viewers who haven't seen it yet to watch it.

highlights_en.title: Promotion of the 'Life is BAU BAU' T-Shirt
highlights_en.description: FUWAMOCO talks about how cute the 'Life is BAU BAU' T-shirt, currently available on Amazon, is and encourages purchasing it.

highlights_en.title: Checking the Outcome of the Kiwi Challenge
highlights_en.description: FuwaMoco jokingly checks on Raora's condition after she ate the kiwi skin, a topic discussed at the beginning of the stream. Raora answers 'I'm okay,' eliciting laughter.

highlights_en.title: Stream Conclusion: Final BAU BAU RAO Chant
highlights_en.description: FUWAMOCO and Raora bid farewell to the fans, concluding the stream by chanting 'BAU BAU RAO' together.

name.ja: モココ・アビスガード

title: 【声遊楽プロジェクト】共同研究第一弾！リラックススポットに…GO!!【博衣こより/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: ホロライブの博衣こよりとD-LABの「声遊楽プロジェクト」共同研究第一弾として、リラックススポットである箱根湯本「天成園」での体験を収録。日頃多忙なこよりさんをリラックスさせ、声のサンプルを採取することが目的。自分の声当てクイズに正解したご褒美として豪華な客室露天風呂付きの部屋を堪能し、足湯や美味しい食事を通じて心身ともにリラックスした状態での声のデータを集めました。
overview.mood: 実験的でありながらも終始和やかでリラックスした雰囲気

highlights.title: D-LABとの共同研究プロジェクト始動！
highlights.description: ホロライブの博衣こよりとD-LABによる声の共同研究プロジェクトが始動。テーマは「声における私らしさ」と、スタッフによる裏テーマ「博衣こよりを休ませる」ことが発表される。

highlights.title: 共同研究の舞台：箱根湯本「天成園」紹介
highlights.description: 研究の舞台として箱根湯本にある温泉宿「天成園」が紹介される。敷地内には全長17mの天空大露天風呂や玉簾の滝、神社があり、リラックスに最適なロケーション。

highlights.title: 声の実験：自分の声当てクイズに挑戦
highlights.description: 研究の取り組みの一環として、自分の声を録音し、高さや速さが変わった9つのパターンから「本当の自分の声」を当てるクイズに挑戦する。正解すれば露天風呂付きの豪華客室がご褒美に。

highlights.title: 録音と正解の発表！
highlights.description: こよりが自身の挨拶を録音した後、9つのサンプルを聞き比べる。録音した声をイヤホンで聞いているため有利だと予想し、見事正解して豪華客室露天風呂付きの部屋を獲得する。

highlights.title: 露天風呂付き客室で再度挨拶を録音
highlights.description: ご褒美の客室に移動した後、スタッフから「リラックスした声」のサンプルを取るため、再度挨拶の録音を依頼される。

highlights.title: 布団ヘダイブ＆足湯を楽しむ
highlights.description: 広々とした部屋でふかふかのお布団にダイブし、その後、客室に備え付けられている源泉かけ流しの足湯を堪能。血行促進やリラックス効果を実感する。

highlights.title: 豪華な昼食（うな重・山女魚の刺身）を堪能
highlights.description: 研究後のご褒美として、豪華なうな重、珍しい山女魚の刺身、地元日本酒（玉簾の滝）など、豪華な昼食をいただく。あまりの美味しさに感極まる。

highlights.title: リラックスした声のデータ取得完了
highlights.description: 温泉と食事で満たされた後、改めて挨拶を録音。自身でもリラックスした声になっていることを感じ、研究データ取得が完了したことに満足する。

highlights.title: おまけ：玉簾神社でおみくじ＆階段登り
highlights.description: おまけ映像として、天成園敷地内の玉簾神社で運試しのおみくじを引き「小吉」を引く。その後、本殿まで続く105段の階段を登る様子が収録される。

overview_en.summary: This video records the experiences at Tenseien in Hakone Yumoto, a relaxing spot, as the first collaborative research project between hololive's Hakui Koyori and D-LAB's "Voice Play Project." The goal was to relax the usually busy Koyori and collect voice samples. After correctly answering a quiz about her own voice, she enjoyed a luxurious room with an open-air bath, collecting voice data while physically and mentally relaxed through foot baths and delicious meals.
overview_en.mood: Experimental, yet consistently calm and relaxed atmosphere

highlights_en.title: Collaborative Research Project with D-LAB Begins!
highlights_en.description: A collaborative voice research project between hololive's Hakui Koyori and D-LAB begins. The theme is announced as "My Voice Identity," with the staff's hidden theme being "Letting Hakui Koyori Rest."

highlights_en.title: Introduction to the Setting of the Research: Hakone Yumoto's "Tenseien"
highlights_en.description: Tenseien, an onsen (hot spring) inn in Hakone Yumoto, is introduced as the research location. The grounds include a 17m-long massive open-air bath, Tamadare Falls, and a shrine, making it a perfect location for relaxation.

highlights_en.title: Voice Experiment: Challenging the "Guess Your Own Voice" Quiz
highlights_en.description: As part of the research efforts, Koyori records her voice and attempts a quiz to identify her "true voice" among 9 variations of pitch and speed. The reward for a correct answer is a luxurious room with an open-air bath.

highlights_en.title: Recording and Announcement of the Correct Answer!
highlights_en.description: After Koyori records her greeting, she compares the 9 samples. She predicts she has an advantage because she is listening to her recorded voice via earphones, and she successfully guesses correctly, winning the luxurious room with an open-air bath.

highlights_en.title: Recording the Greeting Again in the Room with an Open-Air Bath
highlights_en.description: After moving to the reward room, the staff requests Koyori to record her greeting again to obtain a sample of her "relaxed voice."

highlights_en.title: Diving into the Futon & Enjoying the Foot Bath
highlights_en.description: Koyori dives into the soft futon in the spacious room, and then enjoys the free-flowing hot spring foot bath provided in the room, feeling the effects of improved circulation and relaxation.

highlights_en.title: Enjoying a Luxurious Lunch (Unaju & Amago Sashimi)
highlights_en.description: As a reward after the research, Koyori enjoys a luxurious lunch including premium Unaju (Eel over rice), rare Amago (Cherry Salmon) sashimi, and local Japanese sake (Tamadare Falls). She is deeply moved by the deliciousness.

highlights_en.title: Relaxed Voice Data Acquisition Complete
highlights_en.description: After being satisfied by the hot springs and the meal, Koyori records her greeting again. She feels that her voice is indeed relaxed and is satisfied that the research data acquisition is complete.

highlights_en.title: Bonus: Fortune Slip at Tamadare Shrine & Stair Climb
highlights_en.description: As bonus footage, Koyori tries her luck with an omikuji (fortune slip) at Tamadare Shrine on the Tenseien grounds, drawing a "Shokichi" (Minor Luck). She is then filmed climbing the 105 steps leading to the main shrine.

title: 【 nosh 】おいしい宅配弁当をうめうめして食レポに挑戦！！【音乃瀬奏】#hololiveDEV_IS #ReGLOSS

overview.summary: ホロライブDEV_IS所属の音乃瀬奏が、冷凍宅配弁当サービス「nosh（ナッシュ）」とのタイアップで、提供された6種類の冷凍弁当を試食し、食レポとランキング付けを行った配信です。様々なジャンルのメニューを試食し、それぞれの味や食感を詳細にレビュー。特に鰻のひつまぶしやプルコギ、ハンバーグが高評価を得ました。最後には全6品のランキングを発表し、視聴者限定のクーポン情報も紹介されました。終始和やかな雰囲気で、奏の美味しいものへのこだわりと豊かなリアクションが楽しめる内容となっています。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気で、食レポとサービスの紹介がメイン

highlights.title: 配信開始とnoshとのタイアップ紹介
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、音乃瀬奏が冷凍宅配弁当サービス「nosh（ナッシュ）」とのタイアップ配信であることを紹介。提供された6種類のお弁当を食レポすることを報告しました。

highlights.title: noshの概要と販売実績について
highlights.description: noshが糖質・塩分に配慮した健康的な冷凍弁当のサブスクサービスであることを紹介。2025年7月時点で累計販売食数が1.3億食を突破しているという驚異的な実績を伝えました。

highlights.title: noshの栄養基準について
highlights.description: noshが生活習慣病予防のため、糖質30g以下、塩分2.5g以下の栄養基準を設けていることを説明。奏は普段栄養を意識しないため、具体的な基準値を聞いて驚きを隠せませんでした。

highlights.title: noshの5つのこだわりと魅力
highlights.description: 「料理が美味しい」「準備が楽」「長期間食べても飽きない」「継続しやすい価格設定」「わかりやすいサービス」というnoshの5つのこだわりを紹介。特に「準備が楽」（レンジで約5分、分別して捨てるだけ）な点に魅力を感じていると語りました。

highlights.title: メニューオプションと購入特典の紹介
highlights.description: ボリュームメニューやプレミアムメニューなど、豊富なメニューオプションを紹介。また、初回購入で最大5,000円OFFになるクーポンや、累計購入数に応じて割引になる「nosh club」について案内しました。

highlights.title: 今回試食する6種類のメニュー紹介
highlights.description: 今回試食する「うなぎのひつまぶし」「鶏だしの華中華ゆ」「たっぷり野菜の旨辛プルコギ」「回鍋肉」「オニオングリルハンバーグ」「鶏肉の照り焼き」の6種類を紹介しました。

highlights.title: 「うなぎのひつまぶし」実食レビュー
highlights.description: 一つ目のメニュー「うなぎのひつまぶし」を実食。うなぎのタレの甘じょっぱさと香ばしさ、そして副菜のサツマイモの甘さがバランス良く美味しいと絶賛しました。

highlights.title: 「オニオングリルハンバーグ」実食レビュー
highlights.description: 二つ目のメニュー「オニオングリルハンバーグ」を実食。ハンバーグは間違いない美味しさで、添えられた付け合わせのジャガイモの甘さが際立っていると評価しました。

highlights.title: 「たっぷり野菜の旨辛プルコギ」の食レポ：コチュジャンソースの甘辛さ
highlights.description: 3品目として「たっぷり野菜の旨辛プルコギ」を選択。ソースは甘辛いコチュジャンベースで、牛肉の旨味と甘みが感じられると評価。辛さは控えめ。

highlights.title: 「回鍋肉」の食レポ：エビのモチモチ食感と中華特有の風味
highlights.description: 4品目の「回鍋肉」を実食。エビがモチモチした食感で、ソースに中華料理特有の苦味があるが、全体としては美味しいと評価しました。

highlights.title: 「鶏だしの特製中華粥」食レポ：優しい味わい
highlights.description: 5品目の「鶏だしの特製中華粥」を実食。貝の風味も感じられ、冷めてしまったのが惜しいほど優しい味で、体調不良時などに最適だとコメント。

highlights.title: 「鶏肉の照り焼き」食レポ：ネギの風味が効いたジューシーな肉
highlights.description: 最後のメニュー「鶏肉の照り焼き」を実食。甘い照り焼きソースと鶏肉の柔らかさが特徴。焼き鳥のネギマのようなネギの風味が強く、非常に美味しいと高評価。

highlights.title: nosh弁当6品ランキング発表
highlights.description: 全6品の食レポを終え、奏の個人的なランキングを発表。1位「うなぎのひつまぶし」、2位「たっぷり野菜の旨辛プルコギ」、3位「オニオングリルハンバーグ」が選ばれました。

highlights.title: 視聴者限定特典紹介と配信終了
highlights.description: 改めて視聴者限定クーポン（初回購入最大5,000円OFF）の詳細を紹介。視聴者へのお礼を述べて配信を締めくくりました。

overview_en.summary: This stream featured Otonose Kanade, belonging to hololive DEV_IS, reviewing and ranking six types of frozen meals provided through a collaboration with the frozen meal delivery service, 'nosh.' She tasted various menu genres, detailing the flavor and texture of each. The Unagi Hitsumabushi, Bulgogi, and Hamburg steak received particularly high praise. At the end, she announced the ranking of all six items and introduced a viewer-exclusive coupon. The entire broadcast maintained a cheerful atmosphere, showcasing Kanade's dedication to delicious food and her rich reactions.
overview_en.mood: A consistently cheerful atmosphere, mainly focused on food review and service introduction.

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Introduction of the nosh Collaboration
highlights_en.description: The stream began with Otonose Kanade introducing the collaboration with the frozen meal delivery service 'nosh.' She announced that she would be reviewing the six types of lunch boxes provided.

highlights_en.title: Overview of nosh and Sales Achievements
highlights_en.description: She introduced nosh as a subscription service for healthy frozen meals that are mindful of sugar and salt content. She shared the impressive achievement that the cumulative number of meals sold surpassed 130 million as of July 2025.

highlights_en.title: About nosh's Nutritional Standards
highlights_en.description: She explained that nosh sets nutritional standards (30g or less of carbs, 2.5g or less of salt) to help prevent lifestyle diseases. Kanade, who usually doesn't pay attention to nutrition, was visibly surprised upon hearing the specific values.

highlights_en.title: nosh's Five Commitments and Appeals
highlights_en.description: She introduced nosh's five commitments: 'Delicious Food,' 'Easy Preparation,' 'No Boredom Even When Eaten Long-Term,' 'Affordable Pricing for Continuation,' and 'User-Friendly Service.' She noted that she was particularly attracted to the 'Easy Preparation' aspect (only about 5 minutes in the microwave, then separating and disposing).

highlights_en.title: Introduction of Menu Options and Purchase Benefits
highlights_en.description: She introduced the wide range of menu options, including Volume Menu and Premium Menu items. She also announced a coupon offering up to ¥5,000 off the first purchase, as well as the 'nosh club,' which provides discounts based on the cumulative number of purchases.

highlights_en.title: Introduction of the 6 Menus to be Tasted
highlights_en.description: She introduced the six types of meals to be tasted: 'Unagi Hitsumabushi (Grilled Eel over Rice),' 'Chicken Dashi Chinese Porridge,' 'Spicy and Flavorful Bulgogi with Plenty of Vegetables,' 'Twice-Cooked Pork (Hoi-Ko-Ro),' 'Onion Grilled Hamburg Steak,' and 'Chicken Teriyaki.'

highlights_en.title: Tasting Review: Unagi Hitsumabushi
highlights_en.description: She tasted the first menu item, 'Unagi Hitsumabushi.' She highly praised the balanced deliciousness of the eel sauce’s sweet and savory flavor, its aroma, and the sweetness of the sweet potato side dish.

highlights_en.title: Tasting Review: Onion Grilled Hamburg Steak
highlights_en.description: She tasted the second menu item, 'Onion Grilled Hamburg Steak.' She rated the hamburger as reliably delicious and highlighted the notable sweetness of the accompanying potatoes.

highlights_en.title: Food Review of 'Spicy and Flavorful Bulgogi with Plenty of Vegetables': The Sweet and Spicy Gochujang Sauce
highlights_en.description: She chose 'Spicy and Flavorful Bulgogi with Plenty of Vegetables' as the third item. She assessed the sauce as sweet and spicy, gochujang-based, and noted the umami and sweetness of the beef. The spiciness was mild.

highlights_en.title: Food Review of 'Hoi-Ko-Ro' (Twice-Cooked Pork): The Chewy Texture of Shrimp and the Unique Chinese Flavor
highlights_en.description: She tasted the fourth item, 'Hoi-Ko-Ro.' She noted the chewy texture of the shrimp and assessed the sauce as having a slight bitterness unique to Chinese cuisine, but overall rated it as delicious.

highlights_en.title: Food Review of 'Special Chicken Dashi Chinese Porridge': Gentle Flavor
highlights_en.description: She tasted the fifth item, 'Special Chicken Dashi Chinese Porridge.' She commented that it had a hint of shellfish flavor and a gentle taste—so good that she regretted letting it cool down—and suggested it was perfect for when feeling unwell.

highlights_en.title: Food Review of 'Chicken Teriyaki': Juicy Meat with a Strong Scallion Flavor
highlights_en.description: She tasted the final menu item, 'Chicken Teriyaki.' It featured sweet teriyaki sauce and tender chicken. She highly rated it as extremely delicious due to the strong flavor of scallions, similar to yakitori negima.

highlights_en.title: nosh Bento 6-Item Ranking Announcement
highlights_en.description: After completing the review of all six items, Kanade announced her personal ranking. 1st place went to 'Unagi Hitsumabushi,' 2nd place to 'Spicy and Flavorful Bulgogi with Plenty of Vegetables,' and 3rd place to 'Onion Grilled Hamburg Steak.'

highlights_en.title: Viewer Exclusive Benefit Introduction and Stream Conclusion
