overview_en.summary: This is the continuation of the free preview segment (Day 1) of Tokino Sora's 8th Anniversary Party, "Starry Bl∞min'". It includes the waiting screen before the performance, the live opening video, and the performances of the first three songs of the main live show ("Heroine Taru Mono!", "Yumehanabi," and "Aventure♡"). Tokino Sora delivered splendid dancing and singing amidst massive cheering, capturing the palpable energy of the audience now permitted to voice their support. Call-and-response sessions with the fans during song breaks further heightened the excitement. The free stream concluded after the final MC segment, transitioning to the paid broadcast.
overview_en.mood: Enthusiastic and exhilarating live atmosphere

highlights_en.title: Stream Start / Waiting Screen
highlights_en.description: The stream starts, and the waiting screen (credits for bento box donors) is displayed until the performance begins. Tokino Sora's music plays as BGM.

highlights_en.title: Event Key Visual and Important Notices
highlights_en.description: The key visual for Tokino Sora 8th Anniversary Party "Starry Bl∞min'" is displayed, along with important notices regarding SNS posting and other matters.

highlights_en.title: Start of Flower Stand Donor Credits Display
highlights_en.description: The screen changes, and the names of participants who donated flower stands (Frasuta) are displayed as credits.

highlights_en.title: Song Change and Credit Repetition
highlights_en.description: The BGM track changes, and the credits for the donors continue to roll. (Includes songs like "Aventure♡").

highlights_en.title: Re-display of Event Notices
highlights_en.description: The event key visual and important notices are displayed again. The credit display and BGM switching continue afterward.

highlights_en.title: Song Change and Credit Repetition
highlights_en.description: The BGM track changes, and credits for bento box and flower stand donors continue. (Includes songs like "Routine").

highlights_en.title: Song Change and Credit Repetition (4th time)
highlights_en.description: The BGM switches to yet another song, and the credits repeat as the start time approaches. (Includes songs like "Yumezora☆Fanfare").

highlights_en.title: Song Change and Credit Repetition (5th time)
highlights_en.description: The BGM switches to another song, building excitement towards the start of the opening. (Includes songs like "Bridal Dream").

highlights_en.title: Curtain Up, Just Before Live Start
highlights_en.description: The waiting screen ends, sound effects indicating the start of the live show play, and the venue's atmosphere intensifies.

highlights_en.title: Tokino Sora Appears, Opening Starts
highlights_en.description: The live opening movie begins to play, Tokino Sora appears, and the entire venue erupts in excitement.

highlights_en.title: Excitement in the Live Venue (From Waiting Screen to Moments Before Live Start)
highlights_en.description: The video switches to a view inside the venue, showing the audience's penlights colored blue, highlighting the rising anticipation for the live show.

highlights_en.title: Start of 8th Anniversary Event Opening Video
highlights_en.description: A colorful and futuristic opening video plays, featuring the date 2025.10.1 (WED), Tokino Sora's activity timeline, and an introduction to DJ ANKIMO.

highlights_en.title: Countdown Right Before the Live
highlights_en.description: A countdown is displayed on the stage monitors, and the venue's energy reaches its peak.

highlights_en.title: 1st Song: Heroine Taru Mono! Performance Starts
highlights_en.description: The main part of the live show begins. Tokino Sora appears and performs the HoneyWorks song "Heroine Taru Mono!" The audience's penlights align in blue, and enthusiastic calls resonate throughout the venue.

highlights_en.title: 2nd Song: Yumehanabi Performance Starts
highlights_en.description: The musical style shifts, the stage lighting adopts a passionate, red-themed atmosphere, and she performs her original song "Yumehanabi."

highlights_en.title: 3rd Song: Aventure♡ Performance Starts
highlights_en.description: The musical style shifts again. She performs the poppy and cheerful "Aventure♡." The color of the audience's penlights changes colorfully, fueling the excitement.

highlights_en.title: MC: Gratitude for the Long-Awaited Vocally Permitted Live and Joy over the Cheers
highlights_en.description: Tokino Sora addresses the audience in an MC segment, expressing joy and gratitude for the massive cheers at the live show, where vocal support was permitted again after a long time.

highlights_en.title: Execution of the Traditional Call and Response
highlights_en.description: The customary call and response is performed, separating the audience by gender, region, and finally, "everyone," enhancing unity in the venue.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Free Stream End and Transition to Paid Stream
highlights_en.description: Tokino Sora announces that the YouTube free stream segment is concluding, expresses gratitude to those who purchased live tickets, and introduces the next song.

highlights_en.title: Live Video Ends and Live Ticket Purchase Information Screen
highlights_en.description: The live footage ends, the key visual for Tokino Sora 8th Anniversary Party "Starry Bl∞min'" is displayed, and information on purchasing live tickets appears.

title: 【 SILENT HILL f 】サイレントヒル最新作！クリアまで！※ストーリーのネタバレあります#5【#綺々羅々ヴィヴィ #hololiveDEV_IS #FLOWGLOW】

overview.summary: 本配信で『SILENT HILL f』の初見プレイが完結し、プレイヤーはヒナコの狂気の物語の結末（エンディング「呪いは雛の如く舞い戻る」）を見届けた。クレジット中、配信者はヒナコが起こした事件の真相や、家族との関係、薬物依存など、衝撃的なストーリー設定について深く考察する。クリア後、マルチエンディングの存在が明らかになり、配信者は他のエンディングへの意欲を見せつつ、今回の配信を締めくくった。
overview.mood: 終盤は緊張感のある展開と考察、クリア後は達成感とマルチエンディングへの期待

highlights.title: オープニングとマイク調整
highlights.description: 配信開始時の挨拶と、マイクの音量調整に関するコメント欄とのやり取り。

highlights.title: 前回のストーリー振り返りと考察
highlights.description: 主人公ヒナコがもう一人の自分を殺してバケモノになった経緯や、姉の行動など、前回までのストーリーの重要な要素を振り返り、今後の展開を予想する。

highlights.title: ゲーム画面表示と探索再開
highlights.description: 画面が真っ暗になるトラブルを乗り越え、ゲーム画面が表示され探索を再開。異形に侵食された町を進む。

highlights.title: ゾンビと人形との戦闘
highlights.description: 探索中に敵（ゾンビのようなものと、人形）に遭遇し戦闘。人形を倒すと霧が晴れることを確認する。

highlights.title: 尋ね人「深水雛子」の張り紙とセリフ
highlights.description: 深水雛子の行方不明を知らせる張り紙を発見。「これは私の選択……」というヒナコのセリフが流れる。

highlights.title: 祠でアイテム奉納とセーブ
highlights.description: マップ上の祠でアイテムを功徳に変換し、ゲームの進行をセーブする。

highlights.title: 複数（2体）の敵との戦闘
highlights.description: 2体の敵に同時に襲われ、集中ゲージを使いつつ立ち回る。

highlights.title: 「世界が私を祝福してる」
highlights.description: ヒナコが「世界が私を祝福してる……両親にも 会いに行こう」と発言し、深水家へ向かう。

highlights.title: 巨大なバケモノ（ボス）との遭遇
highlights.description: 深水家近くで、巨大な木やドラム缶のようなものを纏ったバケモノに遭遇し戦闘開始。

highlights.title: 巨大バケモノとの激しい戦闘
highlights.description: 弱点である背中を狙って攻撃し、集中ゲージを駆使して強敵を撃破する。

highlights.title: ムービー：両親と嫁バケモノ
highlights.description: バケモノ撃破後、ヒナコの両親と、ウェディングドレスのような姿の巨大バケモノ（嫁入り姿？）が登場するショッキングなムービー。

highlights.title: 水辺の鳥居で目を覚ますヒナコ
highlights.description: ムービー後、ヒナコが異形の地、水辺の鳥居で目を覚ます。背中のバケモノの腕が消えている。

highlights.title: 人形とメッセージ「深水雛子を助けてお願い」
highlights.description: ヒナコが目覚めた場所の壁に「深水雛子を助けてお願い」という文字と、小さな人形が残されている。

highlights.title: 祠でアイテム交換と能力強化
highlights.description: 祠で新しい武器「バール」を発見し、武器を交換。アイテムを奉納し、耐久力の最大値を強化する。

highlights.title: 鳥居を越えた先の戦闘とヒナコのセリフ
highlights.description: 鳥居の奥で、青い炎に囲まれた空間に突入し、人型の敵と戦闘。敵が「通さないつもりか？上等だ！」と話しかける。

highlights.title: 過去の戦いの場所とヒナコの決意
highlights.description: 扉を開けると、姉の桜子と戦った場所に出る。ヒナコが「まだ邪魔をするか」「気が済むまで……血の海に沈めてやる！」と叫ぶ。

highlights.title: 新種のバケモノとの戦闘
highlights.description: 頭に花のようなものがついた巨大なバケモノと、複数の小型の敵が出現し、乱戦になる。

highlights.title: 狐の石像が鍵を咥えている場所の探索
highlights.description: 戦闘後、狐の石像が鍵を咥えている場所を探索。アイテム（包丁）を入手し、武器を交換する。

highlights.title: 姉との対面とヒナコの過去（ムービー）
highlights.description: 和装の姉らしい人物とヒナコが対面。ヒナコが「私の気持ちなんてわからない！」と叫び、薬を服用。姉が薬を阻止しようとすると、ヒナコが「修を奪ったアンタを……許さない！」と姉を攻撃する。

highlights.title: 巨大なボス「白無垢」との初遭遇
highlights.description: 白い包帯のような姿の巨大なボス「白無垢」が出現。ヒナコのバットでは攻撃が効かないように見える。

highlights.title: 白無垢との戦闘：赤い糸の攻撃
highlights.description: 白無垢は赤い糸のようなものを地面から出して広範囲を攻撃。ヒナコは回避と攻撃のタイミングを見計らう。

highlights.title: 白無垢撃破とヒナコの狂気（ムービー）
highlights.description: 白無垢を撃破。ヒナコが正気を取り戻したかのように「もうこんな所は嫌だ」と叫んだ後、バットで周囲の狐の石像を破壊し、「ぶち壊してやる！」と狂気に満ちた表情を見せる。

highlights.title: 「私達の邪魔をするな！」と襲い来るバケモノ
highlights.description: ヒナコの周りのバケモノたちが「これは何の真似だ！」「私達の邪魔をするな！」と叫びながらヒナコに襲いかかってくる。

highlights.title: 警察の無線と事件の真相
highlights.description: ゲーム内に警察の無線音声が流れ、ヒナコが起こしたとみられる事件の詳細（男性2名襲撃、カプセル薬服用）が明らかになる。

highlights.title: カプセル薬だらけの廊下と白無垢との最終戦
highlights.description: ヒナコの記憶が戻るが、薬物中毒の過去がフラッシュバック。大量の赤いカプセルが敷き詰められた廊下で、白無垢と最後の戦闘に突入。

highlights.title: エンディング：スタッフロール開始とストーリー考察
highlights.description: ゲームがクリアとなりスタッフロールが流れる。配信者は、ヒナコが起こした事件の背景（薬物依存や結婚式での異常行動）について改めて考察を深める。

highlights.title: 初回クリアエンディングの達成条件確認
highlights.description: エンディング一覧画面に移行。「呪いは雛の如く舞い戻る」の達成条件（「赤いカプセル」を一度も飲まなかった）が判明し、マルチエンディングの存在を確認。

highlights.title: ゲームクリア報告と感想、次回への意欲
highlights.description: 初回クリアを視聴者に報告。マルチエンディングの存在に驚き、今後の他ルートへの挑戦意欲を語る。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: 視聴者への感謝を述べ、喉の調子を考慮し配信を終了する。

overview_en.summary: The initial playthrough of 'SILENT HILL f' concluded in this stream, where the player witnessed the end of Hinako's tale of madness (Ending: "The Curse Returns Like a Doll"). During the credits, the streamer deeply analyzed the shocking story elements, including the truth behind the incident Hinako caused, her family relationship, and her drug addiction. After clearing the game, the existence of multiple endings was revealed, and the streamer closed the stream, expressing eagerness to pursue the other routes.
overview_en.mood: Tension and deep analysis in the final stages, followed by a sense of achievement and anticipation for the multi-endings after clearing the game

highlights_en.title: Opening and Microphone Adjustment
highlights_en.description: Greeting at the start of the stream and interaction with the comments section regarding microphone volume adjustment.

highlights_en.title: Review and Analysis of the Previous Story
highlights_en.description: Reviewing key elements of the story up to this point, such as how the protagonist Hinako killed her other self and became a monster, and her sister's actions, and predicting future developments.

highlights_en.title: Game Screen Displayed and Exploration Resumes
highlights_en.description: Overcoming a black screen issue, the game screen is displayed, and exploration resumes. Proceeding through the town invaded by anomalies.

highlights_en.title: Battle Against Zombies and Dolls
highlights_en.description: Encountering enemies (zombies and dolls) during exploration and engaging in combat. Confirming that the fog clears when the dolls are defeated.

highlights_en.title: Missing Person Poster of "Hinako Fukamizu" and Dialogue
highlights_en.description: Finding a poster announcing the disappearance of Hinako Fukamizu. Hinako's dialogue plays: "This is my choice..."

highlights_en.title: Item Offering and Saving at the Shrine
highlights_en.description: Converting items into merit at the shrine on the map and saving the game progress.

highlights_en.title: Combat Against Multiple (Two) Enemies
highlights_en.description: Attacked simultaneously by two enemies, navigating the fight while utilizing the focus gauge.

highlights_en.title: "The World is Blessing Me"
highlights_en.description: Hinako says, "The world is blessing me... Let's go see my parents too," and heads toward the Fukamizu residence.

highlights_en.title: Encounter with a Giant Monster (Boss)
highlights_en.description: Near the Fukamizu residence, encountering a monster covered in giant trees and drum cans, and starting combat.

highlights_en.title: Intense Battle with the Giant Monster
highlights_en.description: Targeting the weakness on its back and using the focus gauge effectively to defeat the powerful enemy.

highlights_en.title: Movie: Parents and the Bride Monster
highlights_en.description: A shocking movie plays after defeating the monster, showing Hinako's parents and a giant monster resembling a figure in a wedding dress (a bride?).

highlights_en.title: Hinako Wakes Up at the Torii Gate by the Water
highlights_en.description: After the movie, Hinako wakes up in an anomalous place, a torii gate by the water. The monster's arm on her back has disappeared.

highlights_en.title: Doll and Message: "Please Help Hinako Fukamizu"
highlights_en.description: The words "Please help Hinako Fukamizu" and a small doll are left on the wall where Hinako woke up.

highlights_en.title: Item Exchange and Ability Enhancement at the Shrine
highlights_en.description: Discovering a new weapon, a "crowbar," at the shrine and exchanging weapons. Offering items to enhance maximum durability.

highlights_en.title: Combat Beyond the Torii Gate and Hinako's Dialogue
highlights_en.description: Entering a space surrounded by blue flames past the torii gate and engaging in combat with a humanoid enemy. The enemy asks, "Do you intend to stop me? Fine by me!"

highlights_en.title: Location of Past Battle and Hinako's Resolve
highlights_en.description: Opening a door leads to the location where she fought her sister, Sakurako. Hinako yells, "Are you still getting in the way?" and "I'll drown you in a sea of blood until I'm satisfied!"

highlights_en.title: Combat Against a New Type of Monster
highlights_en.description: A huge monster with a flower-like growth on its head appears, along with multiple small enemies, leading to a chaotic battle.

highlights_en.title: Exploring the Location where a Fox Statue Holds a Key
highlights_en.description: After combat, exploring the location where a fox statue holds a key. Obtaining an item (kitchen knife) and swapping weapons.

highlights_en.title: Confrontation with Sister and Hinako's Past (Movie)
highlights_en.description: Hinako confronts a figure who seems to be her sister, dressed in traditional Japanese attire. Hinako yells, "You don't understand how I feel!" and takes medicine. When the sister tries to stop the medicine, Hinako attacks her, shouting, "I won't forgive you for taking Shu away from me!"

highlights_en.title: First Encounter with the Giant Boss "Shiromuku"
highlights_en.description: The giant boss "Shiromuku" (White Kimono/Wedding Garment), resembling white bandages, appears. Hinako's bat seems ineffective against it.

highlights_en.title: Battle with Shiromuku: Red Thread Attack
highlights_en.description: Shiromuku launches wide-range attacks using red thread-like elements emerging from the ground. Hinako seeks opportunities for evasion and attack.

highlights_en.title: Defeating Shiromuku and Hinako's Madness (Movie)
highlights_en.description: Shiromuku is defeated. Hinako shouts, "I hate this place!" as if regaining sanity, then uses her bat to destroy the surrounding fox statues, revealing a look of madness and yelling, "I'll smash everything!"

highlights_en.title: Monsters Attack, Shouting "Don't Get in Our Way!"
highlights_en.description: Monsters surrounding Hinako attack her, shouting, "What is the meaning of this?" and "Don't get in our way!"

highlights_en.title: Police Radio and the Truth Behind the Incident
highlights_en.description: Police radio audio plays in the game, revealing details of the incident believed to be caused by Hinako (attack on two males, ingestion of capsule medicine).

highlights_en.title: Hallway Covered in Capsule Medicine and the Final Battle with Shiromuku
highlights_en.description: Hinako's memory returns, flashing back to her past drug addiction. The final battle with Shiromuku begins in a hallway covered with a large quantity of red capsules.

highlights_en.title: Ending: Staff Roll Begins and Story Analysis
highlights_en.description: The game is cleared and the staff roll begins. The streamer deepens the analysis regarding the background of the incident Hinako caused (drug addiction and abnormal behavior at the wedding).

highlights_en.title: Confirmation of First Clear Ending Achievement Condition
highlights_en.description: Moving to the ending list screen. The achievement condition for "The Curse Returns Like a Doll" (never drinking the "Red Capsule") is revealed, confirming the existence of multiple endings.

highlights_en.title: Game Clear Report, Impressions, and Eagerness for the Next Time
highlights_en.description: Reporting the first clear to viewers. Expressing surprise at the existence of multi-endings and enthusiasm for challenging other routes in the future.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending Greeting
highlights_en.description: Thanking the viewers and ending the stream, considering the condition of the throat.

title: 【#戌神ころね生誕祭2025】戌神ころね分かり手王選手権！！！告知もあるよ🐶✨【戌神ころね/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 戌神ころね生誕祭企画「戌神ころね分かり手王選手権」の後半戦。豪華ゲストを迎え、ころねに関するコアなクイズとイラスト問題で大盛り上がりを見せた。特に最後のクイズでは、ころねの配信エンド画面にまつわる問題が出題され、珍回答が続出。最終的に、天音かなたが僅差で『分かり手王』の座を勝ち取った。また、途中にはころねの誕生日記念グッズの紹介が挟まれ、終始賑やかで楽しい雰囲気で進行し、笑いに包まれながら大会は幕を閉じた。
overview.mood: 賑やかで楽しい雰囲気、爆笑

highlights.title: 戌神ころね分かり手王選手権！豪華ゲスト登場
highlights.description: 戌神ころねの生誕祭企画として、猫又おかゆ、天音かなた、宝鐘マリン、大神ミオ、さくらみこの豪華ゲストを招き、「戌神ころね分かり手王選手権」が開催される。

highlights.title: ゲストの回答ボードいじり (かなた/マリン)
highlights.description: かなたの回答ボード「世界一だって!?」、マリンの回答ボード「いじめられてます!!!」の装飾で盛り上がる。

highlights.title: ゲストの回答ボードいじり (ミオ/みこ)
highlights.description: ミオの回答ボード「もぐもぐ」、みこの回答ボード「絆」のイラストや文字で盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 第1問: ころねの犬種は何でしょう？
highlights.description: ころねの犬種を当てるクイズが出題。正解は「キャバリアキングチャールズスパニエル」。おかゆとミオが正解。

highlights.title: 第2問: 好きなスターウォーズのキャラクターは？
highlights.description: ころねが一番好きなスターウォーズのキャラクターを当てるクイズ。正解は「ボバ・フェット」。ころねとおかゆが正解。

highlights.title: 第3問: 一番好きなゲーム機は？
highlights.description: ころねが一番好きなゲーム機を当てるクイズ。ゲストの回答が「セガサターン」に集中する中、正解は「ドリームキャスト」。おかゆが正解。

highlights.title: 第4問: 好きな映画のシチュエーションは？
highlights.description: ころねが好きな映画の中のシチュエーションを当てるクイズ。正解は「生きたまま痛いことをする」。みこが正解。

highlights.title: 第5問: ころねすきーを絵で描いてください
highlights.description: 「ころねすきー」のイラストを描くお絵描き問題。ゲストの個性的なイラストが公開される。

highlights.title: 第5問正解発表とイラスト判定
highlights.description: ころねすきー(通常ver.)の正解イラストが公開され、ゲストのイラストと比較される。おかゆの絵が一番似ていると評価される。

highlights.title: 第6問: こいつの名前は？（指示しませ〜）
highlights.description: ころねの配信で登場した棒人間の名前を当てるクイズが出題。ゲストは様々な珍回答を出す。

highlights.title: Q6：ゲストの珍回答披露
highlights.description: Miko「ウキウキ指示王」、Mio「指示肉まん」、Marine「ゴシゴシ指示厨」、Kanata「シジエモン」など、面白い珍回答が連発し爆笑を誘う。

highlights.title: 第7問: 洗濯バサミを挟んだ最大数
highlights.description: 猫又おかゆ考案のクイズ。「ころさんが配信中、顔面に洗濯バサミを挟んだ数は最大いくつでしょう？」が出題される。ゲストは数字で回答を出す。

highlights.title: エンドカード（スキップEND）の映像公開
highlights.description: 最後のクイズ（Q8のヒント）として、ころねが配信中に使用していたエンドカードの映像が公開される。ころねすきーのスキップする様子が流れる。

highlights.title: 誕生日記念グッズ紹介
highlights.description: ころねの誕生日記念グッズ（抱き枕カバー、タンブラー、スライドミラー、前髪クリップ、ボイス、クリアファイル）が発表される。

highlights.title: Q7正解発表：最大9個でかなた＆マリン正解
highlights.description: Q7の正解発表。最大で9個の洗濯バサミを顔面に挟んでいたことが判明。かなたとマリンが正解し、1ポイント獲得。

highlights.title: 第8問/最終問題: スキップENDの後に何が起こる？
highlights.description: エンドカードの映像で流れた出来事の結末を当てるイラスト問題。ゲストは『生まれた』『分裂』『合体』などの珍回答を披露。正解は「分裂する」。

highlights.title: 天音かなたが分かり手王に決定！
highlights.description: 最終問題の結果、天音かなたが3ポイントで優勝。ころねすきーを抱いたオスカー像がトロフィーとして贈られる。

highlights.title: おかゆに特別プレゼント：2D版ころねすきーの赤ちゃん
highlights.description: 司会を務めた猫又おかゆに、ころねすきーの2D赤ちゃんのイラストがプレゼントされる。

highlights.title: オリジナル楽曲『MafiosA』MVの告知
highlights.description: ころねのオリジナル楽曲『MafiosA』のアニメMVが公開されたことが告知される。

overview_en.summary: The second half of Inugami Korone's Birthday Celebration project, "Inugami Korone Understander King Championship." Featuring luxurious guests, the event was a great success with core quizzes and drawing challenges about Korone. Especially in the final quiz, questions related to Korone's stream end screen were asked, resulting in many unusual answers. Ultimately, Amane Kanata won the title of 'Understander King' by a narrow margin. Korone's birthday merchandise was also introduced midway through, and the tournament proceeded in a lively and fun atmosphere from start to finish, concluding amidst laughter.
overview_en.mood: Lively and fun atmosphere, burst of laughter

highlights_en.title: Inugami Korone Understander King Championship! Luxurious Guests Appear
highlights_en.description: As part of Inugami Korone's birthday celebration project, the 'Inugami Korone Understander King Championship' is held, inviting luxurious guests: Nekomata Okayu, Amane Kanata, Houshou Marine, Ookami Mio, and Sakura Miko.

highlights_en.title: Teasing the Guests' Answer Boards (Kanata/Marine)
highlights_en.description: The decorations on Kanata's answer board, 'World's Best!?', and Marine's board, 'I'm being bullied!!!', create excitement.

highlights_en.title: Teasing the Guests' Answer Boards (Mio/Miko)
highlights_en.description: Mio's answer board 'Mogumogu' (Munching) and Miko's board 'Kizuna' (Bond) generate excitement with their drawings and text.

highlights_en.title: Question 1: What breed of dog is Korone?
highlights_en.description: A quiz is given to guess Korone's dog breed. The correct answer is 'Cavalier King Charles Spaniel.' Okayu and Mio answer correctly.

highlights_en.title: Question 2: What is her favorite Star Wars character?
highlights_en.description: A quiz to guess Korone's favorite Star Wars character. The correct answer is 'Boba Fett.' Korone and Okayu answer correctly.

highlights_en.title: Question 3: What is her favorite game console?
highlights_en.description: A quiz to guess Korone's favorite game console. While guests' answers centered on 'Sega Saturn,' the correct answer is 'Dreamcast.' Okayu answers correctly.

highlights_en.title: Question 4: What is her favorite movie situation?
highlights_en.description: A quiz to guess Korone's favorite situation in a movie. The correct answer is 'Doing painful things while alive.' Miko answers correctly.

highlights_en.title: Question 5: Please draw Koronesuki
highlights_en.description: A drawing challenge to illustrate 'Koronesuki.' The guests' unique illustrations are revealed.

highlights_en.title: Q5 Correct Answer Announcement and Illustration Judgment
highlights_en.description: The correct illustration of Koronesuki (standard ver.) is revealed and compared with the guests' drawings. Okayu's drawing is judged to be the most similar.

highlights_en.title: Question 6: What is this guy's name? ('Please give instructions~')
highlights_en.description: A quiz is given to guess the name of the stick figure that appeared in Korone's stream. The guests give various unusual answers.

highlights_en.title: Q6: Reveal of Guests' Unusual Answers
highlights_en.description: A series of hilarious and unusual answers are revealed, causing laughter: Miko 'Ukiuki Instruction King,' Mio 'Instruction Nikuman,' Marine 'Goshigoshi Instruction Critic,' Kanata 'Shijiemon,' and others.

highlights_en.title: Question 7: Maximum number of clothespins attached
highlights_en.description: A quiz devised by Nekomata Okayu: 'What is the maximum number of clothespins Korone has clipped to her face during a stream?' is asked. Guests submit numerical answers.

highlights_en.title: End Card (Skip END) Video Release
highlights_en.description: The video of the end card Korone used during her streams is revealed as a hint for the final quiz (Q8). It shows Koronesuki skipping.

highlights_en.title: Birthday Commemorative Merchandise Introduction
highlights_en.description: Korone's birthday commemorative merchandise (dakimakura cover, tumbler, slide mirror, bangs clip, voice pack, clear file) is announced.

highlights_en.title: Q7 Correct Answer Announcement: Kanata & Marine Correct with 9 Maximum
highlights_en.description: The correct answer to Q7 is announced. It is revealed that she clipped a maximum of 9 clothespins to her face. Kanata and Marine answered correctly and earned 1 point.

highlights_en.title: Question 8/Final Question: What happens after the Skip END?
highlights_en.description: A drawing challenge to guess the conclusion of the event shown in the end card video. Guests offer unusual answers like 'It was born,' 'Split,' or 'Merged.' The correct answer is 'It splits/divides.'

highlights_en.title: Amane Kanata is determined to be the Understander King!
highlights_en.description: As a result of the final question, Amane Kanata wins with 3 points. An Oscar statue holding Koronesuki is presented as the trophy.

highlights_en.title: Special Gift for Okayu: 2D version Koronesuki baby
highlights_en.description: Nekomata Okayu, who served as the host, is presented with a 2D baby Koronesuki illustration.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Original Song 'MafiosA' MV
highlights_en.description: It is announced that the anime music video for Korone's original song 'MafiosA' has been released.

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【凶寓 / Dread Flats】ししらみは3日住めば150万円もらえる物件に泊まるようです【獅白ぼたん・雪花ラミィ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: ホロライブの獅白ぼたんと雪花ラミィによるホラーゲーム『凶寓』の実況後半。巨大な化け物と化したお婆さんとのステルスパートが本格化。プレイヤーの動きに反応しワープするお婆さんの巡回ルートを把握し、コンセントやラジオを使って誘導し、隠密行動（ステルス）で部屋の探索を進める。中盤、ハサミを手に入れた直後にお婆さんに捕獲され、再び夢落ちするが、今度は3日目がスタート。住人たちの日記やスケッチから、このマンションで起こった悲劇的な人体変形と「ロボトミー手術」の事実が明らかになる。最終的に必要な鍵を見つけ脱出を試みるが、お婆さんが車に同乗しているという結末を迎え、主人公はアパートに二度と行かないと決意してゲームは終了する。
overview.mood: 終始笑いと悲鳴が入り混じる、ホラーとコメディの雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲームの概要確認
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、雪花ラミィと獅白ぼたんが挨拶。ゲームタイトル「凶寓（きょうぐう）」の読み方を確認し、3日住めば150万円もらえるというゲーム設定についてトークし盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 配信音声トラブル発生と復旧
highlights.description: ゲームを開始する前に音声が聞こえにくいというコメントが入り、原因がDiscordの音声共有設定にあることが判明し、修正を行う。

highlights.title: 芳江マンションに到着
highlights.description: ゲームがスタートし、主人公（探検チャンネルの配信者）が過去に集団失踪事件が起きた芳江マンションを訪れる導入テキストを読み上げる。

highlights.title: 郵便受けと麻雀室の探索
highlights.description: 荒れたマンション内を探索開始。郵便受けには204号室の鍵が入っていたのを確認。1階の麻雀室の様子も確認する。

highlights.title: 警備室の鍵の発見
highlights.description: 麻雀室に続く警備室の扉が鍵がかかっており、周囲の棚の引き出しから鍵を発見する。

highlights.title: 204号室に入室、ファンからの手紙
highlights.description: 鍵を使って204号室に入ると、部屋は荒れており、ファンからの手紙を発見。「おばあさんがベッドの下にいる」という不穏なメッセージが書かれていた。

highlights.title: 悪夢とビデオカメラの設置
highlights.description: 夜になり眠りにつくが、すぐに目が覚めてしまい、調査を再開。手に入れたビデオカメラを起動する。

highlights.title: 過去のビデオ映像に映り込んだ存在
highlights.description: 警備室で見つけた過去のビデオの映像を確認。麻雀卓を囲む人物たちの背後に、人影が映り込んでいるのを発見。

highlights.title: 天井からビー玉の音が響く
highlights.description: 探索中、天井からビー玉の転がる音が聞こえ始め、恐怖感が増す。音は階上から聞こえているようだ。

highlights.title: カメラのバッテリー切れと恐怖体験
highlights.description: トイレに行く途中、ドアが勝手に閉まる現象が発生。カメラのバッテリーが切れ、映像が途切れる。

highlights.title: 異常な光景とビー玉の音の継続
highlights.description: バッテリーを充電して再度探索へ。廊下が無限に続くかのようなループ状態に陥り、ビー玉の音が継続して聞こえてくる。

highlights.title: 異常な光景とビー玉の音の継続
highlights.description: 廊下でビー玉の音が継続して響き、さっき見た悪夢と似た光景が続く。警備室へ移動し、ブレーカーを上げるが大きなノイズが鳴り響く。

highlights.title: 玄関から外へ脱出を試みる
highlights.description: 「大したことはないだろう。もう帰ろう」というメッセージが表示され、玄関のドアを開けようとすると画面が暗転する。

highlights.title: 車での移動中、お婆さんと遭遇
highlights.description: 暗転後、車で森の中を走る場面に切り替わる。窓に張り付くお婆さんの顔が映り込み、恐怖の悲鳴を上げる。

highlights.title: 最初のエンディング（バッドエンド）
highlights.description: エンディング1が表示され、主人公（探検チャンネルの配信者）がお婆さんを車に乗せて「3人で帰宅」したことが示唆される。

highlights.title: 悪夢からの覚醒と2日目の開始
highlights.description: 悪夢だったのかというメッセージと共に、再び204号室で目覚める。カメラのバッテリー切れを確認し、充電するため部屋に戻る。

highlights.title: 別の住人（記者）の日記を発見
highlights.description: 寝る前にカメラをセットし、日記を発見。住人（ワンさん）の精神状態が悪化していることや、心霊現象について科学的な説明を求めて記者が接触してきたことが書かれている。

highlights.title: お婆さんのバイタリティに驚愕
highlights.description: 再開後、廊下の足音がお婆さん（NPC）のものだと気づく。彼女のスタミナと頻繁な登場に獅白ぼたんが驚きを表現する。

highlights.title: 再びビー玉の音と雨の夜
highlights.description: 2日目の夜明けまで寝ようとするが、外の雨の音と天井からのビー玉の音が再び始まり、目が覚める。

highlights.title: ビー玉が転がっていた部屋に侵入
highlights.description: ビー玉の音が聞こえた部屋を探索。床にビー玉が落ちており、ネズミの仕業かもしれないというメッセージが表示される。ネズミのせいでビー玉が落ちていたという解釈に二人は納得しようとする。

highlights.title: 305号室の住人による手紙を発見
highlights.description: 引き出しの中の手紙に、住人の精神状態の悪化や、ローバがお婆さんのせいで連れ去られたという記述を発見。お婆さんがカメラ越しに監視しているという記述に背筋を凍らせる。

highlights.title: 305号室の血まみれの部屋と鍵の発見
highlights.description: 手紙に書かれていた305号室に入ると、部屋は血まみれの状態。さらに探索し、引き出しから鍵を発見する。

highlights.title: トイレの穴からお婆さんの顔
highlights.description: 腹痛を訴えトイレへ向かうと、便器の穴からカメラを入れて覗いた瞬間に、お婆さんの顔が映り込み悲鳴を上げる。

highlights.title: 壁に書かれた血文字「ビー玉は返すよ」
highlights.description: 204号室の壁に血文字「弾珠還你、放過我们一家（ビー玉は返すよ、私たちを放して）」を発見。ビー玉を返せば解放されることを示唆。

highlights.title: 異世界ワープと化け物のお婆さん
highlights.description: トイレの穴にカメラを落とすと、画面がノイズと共に赤く変わり、異世界のような空間へワープ。巨大な化け物と遭遇し、悲鳴を上げる。

highlights.title: 異世界でのステルスと逃走
highlights.description: 赤い異世界のような空間で、巨大な化け物（お婆さん）に気付かれないように忍び足で移動し、隠れる。音に反応する化け物に対し、ラジオの音を使って誘導を試みる。

highlights.title: 化け物の正体は元住人？
highlights.description: 化け物が麻雀卓の下にいる間に手記を発見。化け物は視力がないが、一時的にやり過ごせるらしいというヒントを得る。

highlights.title: ワープするお婆さんとの攻防
highlights.description: ステルスパートを続ける中、ドアを開けたらお婆さんが目の前に現れる現象に遭遇。お婆さんが部屋を瞬間移動（ワープ）している可能性に気づく。

highlights.title: コンセントを抜いてお婆さんの動きを変える
highlights.description: お婆さんがテレビを見ている隙にコンセントを抜くと、お婆さんがテレビから離れ、巡回ルートが変わることを発見。

highlights.title: ハサミの入手と2度目の捕獲イベント
highlights.description: お婆さんの巡回ルートを利用して、隠れながらアイテムのハサミを発見し取得。直後、大きなノイズと共に化け物に捕まり、2度目の夢落ちとなる。

highlights.title: 子供部屋での日記の発見と奇妙な絵
highlights.description: 夢落ち後、3日目がスタート。子供部屋で日記を発見。子供が拾ったビー玉をきっかけに事件が始まった可能性を示唆。

highlights.title: 自ら行うロボトミー手術の記録を発見
highlights.description: さらなる日記を発見。住人が怪物に襲われる恐怖から逃れるため、自ら「手術」を最後の手段として実行しようとしていたことが判明。

highlights.title: 細長い化け物が並ぶ廊下でのチェイス
highlights.description: 鍵を入手後、体が細長く変形した複数の化け物が並ぶ薄暗い廊下へ。鍵がかかったドアを見つけた直後、化け物に追われダッシュで逃走する。

highlights.title: 101号室の鍵発見と屋外への脱出
highlights.description: 3日目の部屋に戻り、部屋を探索し直し101号室の鍵を発見。脱出経路である外部へ続くドアを開けて外に出る。

highlights.title: 最終エンド：夢落ちからの決意
highlights.description: 屋外の車に乗り込んだところで暗転し、お婆さんが車に乗っているという映像と共にエンディング2へ。主人公は今回の経験を風邪のせいだと結論付け、アパートには二度と行かないと決意してゲーム終了。

overview_en.summary: The latter half of the horror game 'Kyouguu (Dread Flats)' playthrough by Hololive's Shishiro Botan and Yukihana Lamy. The stealth segment against the grandmother, who has transformed into a gigantic monster, intensifies. They track the patrol route of the teleporting grandmother, who reacts to player movement, use electrical outlets and radios to distract her, and advance through the apartment using stealth. Mid-game, immediately after obtaining scissors, the player is captured by the grandmother, resulting in another dream sequence, but this time Day 3 begins. Diaries and sketches from residents reveal the tragic human deformation and the fact of "lobotomy" that occurred in the apartment. Finally, the protagonist finds the necessary key and attempts to escape, but the game concludes with the grandmother joining them in the car, and the protagonist resolving never to return to the apartment.
overview_en.mood: An atmosphere of horror and comedy, constantly mixed with laughter and screams

highlights_en.title: Stream start and game overview check
highlights_en.description: The stream starts with greetings from Yukihana Lamy and Shishiro Botan. They confirm the reading of the game title "Kyouguu (Dread Flats)" and discuss the game setting where staying for three days earns ¥1.5 million.

highlights_en.title: Stream audio trouble occurs and is fixed
highlights_en.description: Before starting the game, comments indicated that the audio was difficult to hear. The cause was found to be the Discord audio sharing settings, and it was fixed.

highlights_en.title: Arrival at Yoshie Apartment
highlights_en.description: The game starts, and the protagonist (a streamer from an exploration channel) reads the introductory text about visiting the Yoshie Apartment, where a mass disappearance occurred in the past.

highlights_en.title: Exploring the mailbox and the Mahjong room
highlights_en.description: Exploration of the dilapidated apartment begins. They confirm that the key to Room 204 was in the mailbox. They also check the condition of the Mahjong room on the first floor.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of the Security Room key
highlights_en.description: The door to the security room adjacent to the Mahjong room was locked, and they found the key in a surrounding shelf drawer.

highlights_en.title: Entering Room 204, Letter from a fan
highlights_en.description: Using the key, they enter Room 204. The room is messy, and they find a letter from a fan containing an unsettling message: "Grandma is under the bed."

highlights_en.title: Nightmare and Video Camera Setup
highlights_en.description: Night falls and the protagonist goes to sleep, but wakes up quickly and resumes the investigation. They activate the video camera they obtained.

highlights_en.title: Presence captured in old video footage
highlights_en.description: They review the old video footage found in the security room, discovering a human shadow lurking behind the people sitting around the mahjong table.

highlights_en.title: Sound of marbles echoing from the ceiling
highlights_en.description: During exploration, the sound of rolling marbles begins to echo from the ceiling, increasing the sense of fear. The sound seems to be coming from upstairs.

highlights_en.title: Camera battery dies and a scary experience
highlights_en.description: On the way to the toilet, a phenomenon occurs where the door closes by itself. The camera battery dies, and the footage cuts out.

highlights_en.title: Abnormal sight and continued marble sounds
highlights_en.description: After charging the battery, they resume exploration. They fall into a looping state where the hallway seems endless, and the sound of marbles continues to be heard.

highlights_en.title: Abnormal sight and continued marble sounds
highlights_en.description: The sound of marbles continues echoing in the hallway, and scenes similar to the nightmare they just had continue. They move to the security room and flip the breaker, causing loud static noise.

highlights_en.title: Attempting to escape outside via the entrance
highlights_en.description: A message appears saying, "It's nothing serious. Let's go home now." As they try to open the front door, the screen fades to black.

highlights_en.title: Encounter with the grandmother while driving
highlights_en.description: After the blackout, the scene switches to driving through the forest. The grandmother's face presses against the window, eliciting terrified screams.

highlights_en.title: First Ending (Bad End)
highlights_en.description: Ending 1 is displayed, suggesting that the protagonist (the exploration channel streamer) took the grandmother into the car and "went home as three."

highlights_en.title: Awakening from the nightmare and the start of Day 2
highlights_en.description: The protagonist wakes up again in Room 204, accompanied by a message asking if it was a nightmare. They check the camera battery is dead and return to the room to charge it.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of another resident's (reporter's) diary
highlights_en.description: They set the camera before sleeping and find a diary. It details the deteriorating mental state of a resident (Mr. Wang) and how a reporter contacted them seeking a scientific explanation for the paranormal phenomena.

highlights_en.title: Astonishment at the grandmother's vitality
highlights_en.description: After resuming, they realize the footsteps in the hallway belong to the grandmother (NPC). Shishiro Botan expresses surprise at her stamina and frequent appearances.

highlights_en.title: Marble sounds and a rainy night again
highlights_en.description: They try to sleep until the dawn of Day 2, but the sound of rain outside and the marbles from the ceiling start again, waking them up.

highlights_en.title: Entering the room where the marbles rolled
highlights_en.description: They explore the room where the sound of marbles was heard. Marbles are scattered on the floor, and a message suggests rats might be the cause. Both streamers try to accept the interpretation that the rats knocked the marbles down.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of a letter by the resident of Room 305
highlights_en.description: A letter in a drawer describes the resident's worsening mental state and how a person named Luo Ba was taken away by the grandmother. The description that the grandmother is watching through the camera chills them.

highlights_en.title: Room 305's bloody interior and key discovery
highlights_en.description: They enter Room 305, mentioned in the letter, and find the room covered in blood. Further exploration reveals a key inside a drawer.

highlights_en.title: Grandmother's face in the toilet hole
highlights_en.description: Complaining of stomach ache, the protagonist heads to the toilet. The moment they peer into the toilet bowl hole with the camera, the grandmother's face appears, causing screams.

highlights_en.title: Blood writing on the wall: "I'll return the marbles"
highlights_en.description: In Room 204, they discover blood writing on the wall: "弾珠還你、放過我们一家 (I'll return the marbles, let our family go)." This suggests returning the marbles might lead to liberation.

highlights_en.title: Otherworldly warp and the monstrous grandmother
highlights_en.description: Dropping the camera into the toilet hole causes the screen to turn red with static, warping them to an otherworldly space. They encounter a gigantic monster and scream.

highlights_en.title: Stealth and evasion in the otherworld
highlights_en.description: In the red, otherworldly space, they move stealthily to avoid being noticed by the gigantic monster (the grandmother) and hide. They attempt to use the radio sound to distract the monster, which reacts to noise.

highlights_en.title: Is the monster a former resident?
highlights_en.description: While the monster is under the mahjong table, they find a manuscript. They get a hint that the monster is blind but can be temporarily bypassed.

highlights_en.title: Struggle against the teleporting grandmother
highlights_en.description: During the stealth segment, they open a door only for the grandmother to appear right in front of them. They realize the grandmother might be instantly moving (warping) between rooms.

highlights_en.title: Changing the grandmother's movements by unplugging the outlet
highlights_en.description: They discover that unplugging the electrical outlet while the grandmother is watching TV causes her to move away from the TV, changing her patrol route.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining scissors and the second capture event
highlights_en.description: Using the grandmother's patrol route, they hide, find the scissors item, and acquire them. Immediately afterward, accompanied by loud static, they are captured by the monster, resulting in the second dream sequence.

highlights_en.title: Diary discovery and strange drawings in the children's room
highlights_en.description: After the dream sequence, Day 3 starts. They find a diary in the children's room, suggesting the incident might have started with the marbles the child picked up.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of records detailing self-performed lobotomy
highlights_en.description: They find further diaries. It is revealed that residents were attempting to perform "surgery" on themselves as a last resort to escape the terror of being attacked by monsters.

highlights_en.title: Chase in the hallway lined with elongated monsters
highlights_en.description: After obtaining the key, they enter a dark hallway lined with multiple monsters whose bodies are stretched and deformed. Immediately upon finding a locked door, they are chased by the monsters and flee by dashing.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of the Room 101 key and escape outside
highlights_en.description: Returning to the Day 3 room, they re-explore and find the key to Room 101. They open the exit door leading outside and escape.

highlights_en.title: Final End: Resolution after the dream sequence
highlights_en.description: The screen blacks out after getting into the car outside, followed by Ending 2, showing the grandmother is in the car. The protagonist concludes the experience was due to a cold and resolves never to go to the apartment again, ending the game.

title: 【Original anime MV】マフィオーザ / 戌神ころね (official)

overview.summary: 戌神ころねのオリジナル楽曲「マフィオーザ」のアニメMV。舞台はレトロで退廃的な都市。主人公（戌神ころねをモデルとしたキャラクター）と相棒らしき人物が、マフィア的な組織に立ち向かうハードボイルドなサスペンスアクションが描かれる。不確かな平和と絶望、そして裏切りと抗争を経て、二人が「かけがえのない居場所」を見つけるまでのドラマティックなストーリーが、力強くジャジーなサウンドに乗せて展開する。
overview.mood: ハードボイルド、ドラマティック、スタイリッシュなアクション

highlights.title: MV開始とキャラクター紹介
highlights.description: 戌神ころねのオリジナルMVが開始。主演の「INUGAMI KORONE」と登場人物「MR. RICEBALL」のタイトルが表示され、物語の導入となる映像が流れる。

highlights.title: 理性を欠いたサバイブ
highlights.description: 血にまみれた部屋や、追われるキャラクターの描写。不確かな平和と不安に怯え、理性を欠いたサバイバルを続ける主人公の葛藤が描かれる。

highlights.title: 現状打破への試みと希望
highlights.description: 鉄格子の檻の中で目を覚ます主人公。現状を打破し、ユートピアを求める強い眼差しが映される。個性の延長線上にあるというメッセージが挿入される。

highlights.title: 暗闇での対立と緊張感
highlights.description: 怪しげな集会や、フードを被ったキャラクターが対峙するシーン。感情を洗浄し、世間から出来損ないとして扱われる状況が描かれる。

highlights.title: 束の間の休息とクリティカルな状況
highlights.description: 警察のサイレンが鳴り響く中、薄暗い路地を逃走。その後、束の間の休息と、主人公たちがベランダでタバコを吸いながら過ごす様子が描かれる。

highlights.title: 廃墟の街での出会い
highlights.description: 大量の廃車が積み重なる荒野で、杖を持った金髪の少女と、主人公たちが対峙する。平和を求めて連勝した後の状況に立ち尽くす。

highlights.title: 激しい銃撃戦と狂ったエネルギー
highlights.description: 突然の爆発と銃撃戦の開始。敵対するマフィア集団との激しい戦闘シーンが展開され、狂った情熱で冷え切った体温を上げるという歌詞が続く。

highlights.title: 裏切りと忘却の結末
highlights.description: 血まみれの室内で、敵に銃を向けるキャラクターのクローズアップ。皆が特別な存在だった結果を忘れたこと、自分と違う箇所を否定して突っ張ねることを描写。

highlights.title: 再度の挑戦と運命のトリガー
highlights.description: 主人公たちが再び銃を携えて背中合わせに立つ。悲愴な状況から立ち直り、運命を捻じ曲げるトリガーを引くことを決意する。

highlights.title: 衝撃の対峙シーン
highlights.description: 真っ暗な室内で、相棒が主人公に銃口を突きつける衝撃的なシーン。極限の緊張感の中で、「Don't panic」という言葉が繰り返される。

highlights.title: マフィア組織との決着と祝福
highlights.description: マフィア風の男たちが銃を向ける中、主人公は微笑み、銃口からバラの花びらが舞う演出。「マフィオーザ 祝福の歌」として、キャラクターたちが猫耳姿で現れ、ダンスを踊る。

highlights.title: ようやく見つけたかけがえのない居場所
highlights.description: 空に舞う帽子と花びら。主人公は笑顔を見せ、仲間たちと共にいること、ようやく見つけたかけがえのない居場所を噛みしめる。

overview_en.summary: An animated music video (MV) for Inugami Korone's original song "Mafiosa." The setting is a retro and decadent city. It depicts a hard-boiled suspense action where the protagonist (a character modeled after Inugami Korone) and a presumed partner confront a mafia-like organization. The dramatic story of the two characters finding their "irreplaceable place" after enduring uncertain peace, despair, betrayal, and conflict unfolds accompanied by a powerful, jazzy sound.
overview_en.mood: Hard-boiled, dramatic, stylish action

highlights_en.title: MV Start and Character Introduction
highlights_en.description: Inugami Korone's original MV begins. The titles of the main star, "INUGAMI KORONE," and the character "MR. RICEBALL" are displayed, showing the introductory footage for the story.

highlights_en.title: Survival Lacking Reason
highlights_en.description: Depiction of a blood-stained room and the character being chased. It shows the protagonist's struggle to continue surviving without reason, living in fear amidst uncertain peace and anxiety.

highlights_en.title: Attempt to Break the Status Quo and Hope
highlights_en.description: The protagonist wakes up inside a barred cage. A strong gaze seeking to break the current situation and find utopia is shown. A message is inserted stating that this quest is an extension of their individuality.

highlights_en.title: Confrontation and Tension in the Darkness
highlights_en.description: Scenes of suspicious gatherings and hooded characters confronting each other. It depicts a situation where emotions are cleansed and they are treated as failures by society.

highlights_en.title: Momentary Rest and Critical Situation
highlights_en.description: Fleeing down a dim alleyway as police sirens blare. This is followed by a momentary rest, showing the protagonists spending time on a balcony, smoking.

highlights_en.title: Encounter in the Ruined City
highlights_en.description: The protagonists confront a blonde girl holding a cane in a wasteland piled high with scrapped cars. They stand motionless in the aftermath of seeking peace and achieving a winning streak.

highlights_en.title: Intense Gunfight and Mad Energy
highlights_en.description: A sudden explosion and the start of a gunfight. An intense battle scene unfolds against rival mafia groups, followed by lyrics about raising cold body temperatures with mad passion.

highlights_en.title: The Outcome of Betrayal and Oblivion
highlights_en.description: A close-up of a character pointing a gun at an enemy in a blood-stained room. It depicts the forgetting of the result that everyone was a special existence, and the denial and rejection of parts that are different from oneself.

highlights_en.title: Second Challenge and the Trigger of Fate
highlights_en.description: The protagonists stand back-to-back, armed with guns again. They recover from a tragic situation, determined to pull the trigger that twists destiny.

highlights_en.title: Shocking Confrontation Scene
highlights_en.description: A shocking scene in a pitch-dark room where the partner points a gun at the protagonist. The phrase "Don't panic" is repeated amidst extreme tension.

highlights_en.title: Showdown with the Mafia Organization and Blessing
highlights_en.description: As mafia-like men point guns, the protagonist smiles, and rose petals flutter from the barrel. As the "Mafiosa Song of Blessing," characters appear wearing cat ears and start dancing.

highlights_en.title: The Irreplaceable Place Finally Found
highlights_en.description: A hat and petals fluttering in the sky. The protagonist smiles, savoring being with their comrades and the irreplaceable place they finally found.

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【CloverPit】生き残るために！！！利用できるものはなんでも利用してやるｩｳｳ！！！【白上フブキ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: ホロライブの白上フブキが、スロットゲームとデッキ構築ローグライクが融合したホラーゲーム『Clover Pit』を実況プレイ。本作は、悪魔との契約により命を賭けたスロット勝負を強いられる内容。フブキは過去のデータを引き継ぎつつ、所持金と「死の期限」をやりくりしながら、7シンボルの永続的な強化と効率的なコイン獲得に注力。ゲーム後半では、連鎖効果のあるチャームや強力なシンボル倍率アップにより、数千万φを超える超大勝利を連発し、最終的に7000万φ以上の大金を集める。目標金額の4400万φには惜しくも届かずゲームオーバーとなったが、ギャンブルの駆け引きを楽しみ、爽快感あふれるプレイを展開した。最終的に2度目の挑戦も序盤で資金難に陥り、「死の期限」を迎えて幕を閉じた。
overview.mood: 終始ハイテンションで、ギャンブルの駆け引きに興奮する様子が伺える。

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲーム紹介
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、視聴者への挨拶の後、今回プレイするホラー要素のあるスロットゲーム『Clover Pit』の紹介を行う。体験版から正式リリースになったことを喜ぶ。

highlights.title: 過去のプレイデータ引き継ぎを確認
highlights.description: ゲーム開始前に、前回のデモ版プレイでアンロックしたアイテム（チャーム）を確認。コレクション数が46/160となっていることを確認する。

highlights.title: 最初のラウンド開始と「偽のコイン」の購入
highlights.description: 第1ラウンドを開始し、所持金を7スピンに投資。運気上昇の可能性がある「偽のコイン」を購入する。

highlights.title: 電話イベントと「ジャックポットの価値が2倍」の選択
highlights.description: 最初のラウンド終了後、電話がかかってきて運気を上げるアイテムの選択肢が提示される。ギャンブル性が高い「ジャックポットの価値が2倍」になるオプションを選ぶ。

highlights.title: 「逆さハムサ」を購入し、第2ラウンドで大勝利
highlights.description: ランダム発動でチャームの出現頻度が2倍になる「逆さハムサ」を購入。第2ラウンドでクローバーシンボルが揃い、大勝利を収める。

highlights.title: 「死の期限」のルール説明と高額な借金
highlights.description: ボーナスを得るためにATMに借金をするが、負けると借金が膨らむシステムの確認。また、次のラウンドの賭け金が上がっていくルールの確認。

highlights.title: 「ハブ太郎」の効果発動と驚異の連鎖
highlights.description: 第3ラウンドで「ハブ太郎」が発動し、連鎖的に大量のコインを獲得。特に7のシンボルが揃い、賭け金が3倍になるオプションの効果も相まって、一気に所持金が増加する。

highlights.title: チャームスロット拡張と「物件証明書」獲得
highlights.description: 「電話」イベントでチャームスロットのスペースが永久に1つ増える「物件証明書」を入手。今後のチャーム選択の幅が広がる。

highlights.title: 「死体」と「スカル」のチャームアンロック
highlights.description: 引き出しから「死体」と「スカル」という新しいチャームを入手。死体はスロットマシンに適用すると借金が5%増えるが捨てられないというリスキーなアイテム。

highlights.title: 「7つの大罪の石」と「占い師」を獲得
highlights.description: 7つ揃うと黄金の7に変わる「7つの大罪の石」と、モディファイア確率が25%アップする「占い師」をアンロック。チャームの選択肢がさらに充実する。

highlights.title: ダイヤの連鎖でジャックポット発動！大勝利
highlights.description: 残りスピン0の土壇場でダイヤシンボルが揃い、「ハブ太郎」の効果でジャックポット（+100）を含む合計400φを獲得。一気に所持金を増やす。

highlights.title: ラッキーチャーム枠拡張「物件証明書」獲得
highlights.description: リロール後、「物件証明書」（チャームスペース+2）が再度登場し購入。チャーム枠を広げ、戦略の幅を広げる。

highlights.title: 新規チャーム「ダンボールの家」アンロック

highlights.title: 7揃い達成！40,320φの超大勝利！

highlights.title: 新チャーム「貪欲な王様」をアンロック

highlights.title: 連続発動で26,220φを追加獲得

highlights.title: 7の連鎖が止まらず177,868φ追加

highlights.title: ラウンド終了直前に100万φ超えの超大勝利

highlights.title: 「永久に7が出現しやすくなる（+1）」のオプションを獲得

highlights.title: 100万φ超えの大当たりで連続勝利

highlights.title: 「小太り猫」のチャームをアンロック

highlights.title: 「ギャンブラー特性」で無料補充を獲得

highlights.title: 7のチャージを発動し、大連鎖を開始

highlights.title: 1000万φ超えの超超大勝利
highlights.description: 7の黄金化と連鎖が重なり、10,517,850φの特大のコインを獲得し、興奮するフブキ。

highlights.title: 再び大連鎖で800万φ超えの獲得

highlights.title: 最終ラウンドで1000万φ超えの追い上げ

highlights.title: 目標未達成でゲームオーバー

highlights.description: 新たな死の期限（#2）でのプレイを開始。所持金がリセットされたため、序盤からコイン獲得に苦戦する。

highlights.title: 最初のラウンド終了で即ゲームオーバー

highlights.description: 死亡時に2ラウンドを追加で得られる復活チャーム「アンク」をアンロック。

highlights.description: 立て直せずに再度ゲームオーバーとなり、新しい死の期限（#2）の Round 1 で敗北する。

highlights.title: 最終死亡と振り返り
highlights.description: 死亡画面が表示され、今回のミニランのプレイ時間と獲得コイン（191 φ）を確認。今日の配信は運が悪かったとして終了することを宣言し、視聴者へ感謝を述べる。

overview_en.summary: Hololive's Shirakami Fubuki played the horror game 'Clover Pit,' a fusion of slot machine and deck-building roguelike. In this game, players are forced into life-or-death slot matches due to a contract with a demon. Fubuki focused on permanent enhancement of the '7' symbol and efficient coin acquisition, managing her funds and the "deadline of death" while carrying over previous data. In the latter half of the game, she achieved massive wins exceeding tens of millions of φ repeatedly, thanks to chaining charms and powerful symbol multiplier boosts, accumulating over 70 million φ in total. Although she narrowly missed the target amount of 44 million φ and triggered a game over, she enjoyed the thrill of gambling and delivered an exhilarating performance. Her second attempt ended quickly due to lack of funds and reaching the "deadline of death" early on.
overview_en.mood: Extremely high energy throughout, showing excitement over the gambling strategy.

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Game Introduction
highlights_en.description: The stream begins, followed by greetings to the viewers and an introduction to the horror slot game 'Clover Pit' being played. She expresses joy that the game has moved from a trial version to a full release.

highlights_en.title: Checking Previous Play Data Transfer
highlights_en.description: Before starting the game, she checks the items (Charms) unlocked in the previous demo play. She confirms the collection count is 46/160.

highlights_en.title: Starting the First Round and Purchasing a "Fake Coin"
highlights_en.description: She starts Round 1 and invests her funds into 7 spins. She purchases a "Fake Coin," which might increase her luck.

highlights_en.title: Phone Event and Choosing "Jackpot Value Doubled"
highlights_en.description: After the first round, a phone call offers a choice of luck-boosting items. She chooses the high-risk, high-reward option: "Jackpot Value Doubled."

highlights_en.title: Buying "Inverted Hamsa" and Achieving a Big Win in Round 2
highlights_en.description: She purchases "Inverted Hamsa," which doubles the charm appearance rate randomly. In Round 2, the clover symbols align, resulting in a big win.

highlights_en.title: Explaining the "Deadline of Death" Rule and High Debt
highlights_en.description: She confirms the system where borrowing money from the ATM for bonuses causes debt to increase if she loses. She also checks the rule that the stake for the next round increases.

highlights_en.title: "Habutarou" Effect Activation and Amazing Chain
highlights_en.description: In Round 3, "Habutarou" activates, leading to a cascade of massive coin gains. Combined with the effect of the '7' symbols aligning and the option doubling the stake, her funds rapidly increase.

highlights_en.title: Charm Slot Expansion and Obtaining the "Property Deed"
highlights_en.description: She obtains the "Property Deed" during a 'phone' event, permanently adding one charm slot space. This expands the range of future charm choices.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking the "Corpse" and "Skull" Charms
highlights_en.description: She obtains new charms, "Corpse" and "Skull," from the drawer. Corpse is a risky item that increases debt by 5% when applied to the slot machine but cannot be discarded.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins" and "Fortune Teller"
highlights_en.description: She unlocks "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins," which turns into a Golden 7 when seven are collected, and "Fortune Teller," which increases modifier probability by 25%. This further enhances her charm selection.

highlights_en.title: Diamond Chain Triggers Jackpot! Huge Win
highlights_en.description: Just before running out of spins (0 remaining), the diamond symbols align, granting 400φ in total, including the Jackpot (+100) effect from "Habutarou." This significantly boosts her funds.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining "Property Deed" to Expand Lucky Charm Slots
highlights_en.description: After rerolling, the "Property Deed" (Charm Space +2) appears again and is purchased. She expands the charm slots, broadening her strategy options.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking New Charm "Cardboard House"
highlights_en.description: Following the acquisition of the "Property Deed," she unlocks the "Cardboard House" (creates one space for a Lucky Charm, requires no space).

highlights_en.title: Purchasing "Maneki-Neko" (Lucky Cat) to Boost Interest
highlights_en.description: She purchases "Maneki-Neko," which grants the equivalent of the interest (14φ) if three or more patterns align in one spin, boosting her wealth generation.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins," Preparing for a Huge Win
highlights_en.description: She purchases the "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins" to permanently enhance the '7' symbols, increasing the chance of a massive hit.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing Cardboard House Again, Further Expanding Charm Slots
highlights_en.description: As she lacks charm space, she purchases a second "Cardboard House" to secure more slots.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing Ticket Enhancement Charm "Angry Capitalist"
highlights_en.description: She purchases the "Angry Capitalist," which increases the probability of the Ticket modifier being applied to any symbol, boosting ticket collection efficiency.

highlights_en.title: Stable Coin Acquisition Thanks to Maneki-Neko Charm
highlights_en.description: Maneki-Neko activates, aligning a large number of cherry symbols and granting 65φ. She confirms the coin acquisition effect of the charm.

highlights_en.title: Lemon Enhanced by Poppo-Tarou Activation
highlights_en.description: The alignment of lemons triggers a lemon enhancement modifier, leading to a chain reaction of coin gains, totaling 16φ.

highlights_en.title: 7 Symbol Turns Gold! 140φ Acquired in a Chain
highlights_en.description: The alignment of '7' triggers the "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins," turning the 7 symbol into a Golden 7 (permanent enhancement). She acquires 140φ in total.

highlights_en.title: Betting Everything on 7 Value Tripled! Gambling Begins
highlights_en.description: She chooses "All In" in the phone event. She selects the buff that triples the value of '7', aiming for a massive win in the next round.

highlights_en.title: Massive 7 Chain Explodes for a 5,040φ Big Win
highlights_en.description: The combined effect of the tripled '7' value and the bonus from symbol alignment results in a huge coin gain of 5,040φ in a single spin.

highlights_en.title: Unstoppable 7 Chain! Additional 2,128φ Acquired
highlights_en.description: The '7' modifiers and chains continue, accumulating another 2,128φ in coins.

highlights_en.title: All 7s Align! Super Big Win of 40,320φ!
highlights_en.description: The '7' symbol aligns across all slots, resulting in a gain of 40,320φ, including the jackpot. Fubuki is thrilled by this biggest win yet.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking New Charm "Greedy King"
highlights_en.description: Riding the wave of victory, she unlocks the "Greedy King" (increases modifier application probability).

highlights_en.title: Immediate 30% Debt Repayment via Briefcase
highlights_en.description: During a charm Gacha reroll, the "Lost Briefcase" (immediate acquisition of 30% of debt) appears and is purchased. She instantly repays a portion of her debt, stabilizing her finances.

highlights_en.title: Cherries Chain! 8,214φ Acquired
highlights_en.description: A chain reaction of cherry symbols results in a large amount of coin acquisition, increasing her funds.

highlights_en.title: Another Huge 7 Chain! 34,710φ Big Win
highlights_en.description: Many '7' symbols align, combined with modifier effects, immediately granting 34,710φ.

highlights_en.title: Aftermath of the Huge Win: Chain Continues, 3,940φ Added
highlights_en.description: Luck continues in the spin following the massive gain, acquiring more coins.

highlights_en.title: Unstoppable! 7 Chain Acquires 12,406φ
highlights_en.description: The chain of high-value symbols continues relentlessly, consistently yielding significant profit.

highlights_en.title: 37,613φ Just Before Spin Ends! Overwhelming Round Clear
highlights_en.description: Just before the spin count runs out, a massive alignment of '7's occurs, combined with modifier effects, leading to an astonishing coin gain and clearing the round.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing "Hourglass" for 3 Rounds Duration
highlights_en.description: She purchases charms like "Hourglass" (extends the deadline of death by 3 rounds) and "Clover Pet," focusing on long-term operations.

highlights_en.title: Storing "Toy Train" Due to Charm Limit
highlights_en.description: Having reached the limit for held charms, she temporarily stores "Toy Train" in the drawer to adjust her charm choices.

highlights_en.title: Avoiding "7 Value Tripled" by Rerolling
highlights_en.description: In the phone event, she chooses to reroll instead of selecting the "Value of 7 is tripled" option. However, the same option appears again.

highlights_en.title: Interest Management and Conserving Maneki-Neko
highlights_en.description: She deposits coins into the ATM and conserves the Maneki-Neko charm, preparing for the next round.

highlights_en.title: Maneki-Neko Activation Leads to 26,120φ Big Win
highlights_en.description: In Round 9, Maneki-Neko activates, resulting in a chain reaction of cherry symbols and acquiring 26,120φ.

highlights_en.title: Consecutive Activation Adds 26,220φ
highlights_en.description: Maneki-Neko chains again, acquiring an additional 26,220φ, establishing a solid foundation.

highlights_en.title: Clearing the Round Assisted by Maneki-Neko
highlights_en.description: Maneki-Neko activates again on the final spin, acquiring 26,060φ. She clears the round with a total of 104,595φ.

highlights_en.title: Discarding "Toy Train" and Equipping "Angry Capitalist"
highlights_en.description: She discards an unnecessary charm and equips the "Angry Capitalist," which increases the modifier application probability for tickets.

highlights_en.title: Super Big Win of 276,680φ from 7 Chain
highlights_en.description: In Round 10, the '7' symbol modifier and chain effect combine, immediately granting 276,680φ.

highlights_en.title: Unstoppable 7 Chain Adds 177,868φ
highlights_en.description: The continuous '7' chain yields an additional 177,868φ in coins. The momentum is relentless.

highlights_en.title: Super Big Win Exceeding 1 Million φ Just Before Round End
highlights_en.description: A massive chain reaction occurs just before the round ends, acquiring 1,050,658φ in total, clearing the round with an overwhelming coin surplus.

highlights_en.title: Acquiring Option for "Permanent Increased 7 Appearance (+1)"
highlights_en.description: In the phone event, she selects the option that permanently increases the appearance rate of '7'. The '7' symbol multiplier rises to 20.0%.

highlights_en.title: Full Screen 7 Alignment Acquires 778,120φ
highlights_en.description: The '7' symbol aligns across the entire screen, resulting in a super big win of 778,120φ.

highlights_en.title: Consecutive Wins with Payouts Over 1 Million φ

highlights_en.title: Purchasing "Pentagram" to Aim for Symbol Multiplier Increase

highlights_en.description: In the phone event, she selects the Gambler Trait, acquiring free replenishment for each Deadline of Death.

highlights_en.title: Activating 7 Charge and Initiating Massive Chain
highlights_en.description: She activates the charge for the "Stone of Seven Deadly Sins" using the red button, turning the '7' symbol into a Golden 7.

highlights_en.title: Ultra Super Big Win Exceeding 10 Million φ
highlights_en.description: The goldenization of '7' and the chain reaction combine, resulting in a colossal coin acquisition of 10,517,850φ. Fubuki is ecstatic.

highlights_en.title: Another Massive Chain Acquires Over 8 Million φ
highlights_en.description: The momentum continues, resulting in an ultra big win of 8,545,992φ.

highlights_en.title: Pushing for Over 10 Million φ in the Final Round
highlights_en.description: A massive chain reaction occurs again on the final spin, acquiring 10,885,056φ, closing in on the target amount.

highlights_en.title: Checking Play Data
