overview_en.summary: The second half of the sauna-themed ASMR collaboration stream between Hololive members Hakui Koyori and Houshou Marine. The competition to see who had the faster heart rate continued, escalating the punishment games for the loser. After rhythmic lullabies, intense whipping ASMR, and breast-kneading ASMR, they finally demanded a 'Suffocation ASMR' using thigh clamping, claiming viewer satisfaction was low. Throughout, the stream was extreme and unique, cleverly utilizing ASMR sounds and character settings while maintaining a comedic touch.
overview_en.mood: Comical and extreme ASMR, consistently friendly and filled with laughter.

highlights_en.title: Pre-Stream Announcement Loop
highlights_en.description: Announcement slides regarding streaming schedules, merchandise, and membership benefits loop continuously.

highlights_en.title: Koyori ASMR: Responding to a Call
highlights_en.description: Koyori greets in a whisper. An ASMR skit where the listener calls her name and Koyori responds.

highlights_en.title: Marine ASMR: Host (Jack) Appears
highlights_en.description: Marine appears with a thick, grandmotherly voice, introducing herself as 'Jack' in a skit. Koyori reacts cutely, but Marine interrupts, saying, 'Please don't browser back.'

highlights_en.title: Marine Appeals That She Is Number One
highlights_en.description: Marine emphasizes that she is the number one host. Koyori agrees but reveals that La+ Darknesss is also watching simultaneously in the background.

highlights_en.title: Caring ASMR for Marine (Ear blowing)
highlights_en.description: Marine asks Koyori for 'ear blowing,' and Koyori gently breathes onto her ear. Marine is moved, saying, 'I feel alive again.'

highlights_en.title: Marine's Identity (Number One Host) Revealed
highlights_en.description: Marine's character is revealed to be 'Captain Marine, aged 78.' Koyori plays the role of her caretaker in old age.

highlights_en.title: Caring ASMR by Koyori (Patting Sound)
highlights_en.description: To soothe Marine's rheumatism pain, Koyori makes gentle patting sounds. Marine thanks her, saying, 'I feel alive again.'

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Sauna ASMR
highlights_en.description: Marine complains she is sweating profusely, and Koyori suggests, 'I'll do something hotter for you.' Hinting at the start of Sauna ASMR.

highlights_en.title: Earpick (Hard Sound) ASMR
highlights_en.description: Koyori makes the sound of gently (?) scraping Marine's ear with a hard earpick. She asks Marine whether she prefers the hard one or a cotton swab.

highlights_en.title: Earpick (Cotton Swab Sound) ASMR
highlights_en.description: Koyori makes the sound of cleaning ears with a cotton swab. Marine is enchanted by the comfort.

highlights_en.title: Comparing Heart Rates: Duel Rules Explained
highlights_en.description: Koyori proposes a contest with Marine using heart rate ASMR. The loser must perform a gentle act as a penalty for the winner.

highlights_en.title: Gentle Earpick ASMR (Revisited)
highlights_en.description: Koyori makes gentle earpick sounds with a cotton swab. Marine makes suggestive comments like 'The hole is too narrow to fit,' embarrassing Koyori.

highlights_en.title: Heartbeat Speed Contest (Round 1 Start)
highlights_en.description: Marine and Koyori's heartbeats (drum sounds) begin. They compete to see whose is faster.

highlights_en.title: Marine's Victory and Reward ASMR (Patting Sound)
highlights_en.description: Marine wins the heartbeat duel. As a penalty, Koyori gives Marine a reward by gently stroking her ear (patting sound).

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Counterattack ASMR
highlights_en.description: As revenge, Koyori alternately whispers and performs earpicking near Marine's ear.

highlights_en.title: Towel ASMR for Wiping Sweat
highlights_en.description: Setting the scene that Marine is sweating, Koyori performs ASMR of wiping sweat (towel sounds).

highlights_en.title: Duel: The Niceness Race (Round 2)
highlights_en.description: A contest to see who can be gentler to the other. Koyori does a cheek massage, and Marine does head petting ASMR. Koyori wins.

highlights_en.title: Whispering ASMR (Fast Talk)
highlights_en.description: Marine and Koyori whisper to each other alternately.

highlights_en.title: Fluffy ASMR (Blanket)
highlights_en.description: Koyori gently wraps Marine in a blanket ASMR. Marine is enchanted by the comfort.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Lullaby ASMR
highlights_en.description: Koyori complains she's getting sleepy and sings a lullaby ASMR. Marine joins in with harmonies.

highlights_en.title: Marine's Sleep Induction ASMR
highlights_en.description: Gentle whispering ASMR to help Marine fall asleep. Halfway through, Marine changes into her grandmother voice.

highlights_en.title: Marine's 'Totonoi' ASMR (Strong Wind Sound)
highlights_en.description: Marine wakes up from sleep and experiences the sudden 'Totonoi' (state of deep relaxation, often achieved in a sauna) using strong wind (hair dryer sound) ASMR.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Defeat and Reward ASMR
highlights_en.description: Marine's victory. Koyori performs a 'reward massage' for Marine as a penalty.

highlights_en.title: Ice ASMR
highlights_en.description: ASMR of stirring ice and chewing ice.

highlights_en.title: Heartbeat Duel (Round 2)
highlights_en.description: Heartbeat ASMR rematch. Competing to see if Marine's heartbeat or Koyori's heartbeat is faster.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Victory and Reward ASMR (Boobs)
highlights_en.description: Koyori wins the heartbeat duel. As a penalty, Marine is ordered to 'show her boobs' and performs breast ASMR.

highlights_en.title: Marine's Whipping ASMR
highlights_en.description: Marine makes the sound of whipping ASMR. Koyori endures it while saying 'It hurts.'

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Kindness ASMR (Revisited)
highlights_en.description: Koyori soothes Marine with gentle patting sounds. Marine resists, saying, 'Don't kill me...'

highlights_en.title: Whipping ASMR (Round 3)
highlights_en.description: Marine performs whipping ASMR again. Marine is excited by Koyori's gasping.

highlights_en.title: Heartbeat Duel (Round 3)
highlights_en.description: Heartbeat Duel Round 3.

highlights_en.title: Marine's Victory and Reward ASMR (Pantsu)
highlights_en.description: Marine wins Round 3. Koyori is forced to perform ASMR of taking off her panties.

highlights_en.title: Taking Off Panties ASMR
highlights_en.description: Koyori simulates taking off her panties ASMR using fabric rubbing sounds. Marine rejoices.

highlights_en.title: Ice ASMR (Round 3)
highlights_en.description: The return of Ice ASMR.

highlights_en.title: Heartbeat Duel (Round 4)
highlights_en.description: Heartbeat Duel Round 4.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Victory and Reward ASMR (Breast Rubbing)
highlights_en.description: Koyori wins Round 4. As a penalty, Marine is ordered to perform 'breast rubbing ASMR.'

highlights_en.title: Breast ASMR
highlights_en.description: Marine simulates the sound of kneading ASMR. Koyori treats it as a 'breast massage' gently.

highlights_en.title: Heartbeat Duel Round 5 Preparation/Start
highlights_en.description: The Heartbeat Duel resumes. Both Marine and Koyori perform heartbeat ASMR, competing to see whose BPM is higher.

highlights_en.title: BPM Singing ASMR for the Defeated Marine
highlights_en.description: Marine is defeated. As a penalty, Koyori performs ASMR of an improvised lullaby sung to the rhythm of the heartbeat BPM.

highlights_en.title: Grandpa Marine's Lung Capacity (Breath) Training
highlights_en.description: Marine returns to her 'Captain Marine, aged 78' character and conducts breathing (exhale) ASMR training for health maintenance.

highlights_en.title: Koyori's Healing Ear Blowing ASMR
highlights_en.description: Koyori gently breathes onto Marine ASMR. Marine reacts, saying, 'I am satisfied.'

highlights_en.title: Koyori Deceived by Marine's Breath
highlights_en.description: Koyori expresses frustration that the viewers were deceived, not realizing it was Marine's breath.

highlights_en.title: Scratching ASMR (Aggressive Earpick Sound)
highlights_en.description: To relieve her frustration, Koyori attempts to tease Marine with aggressive scratching sounds ('kari kari' sound) ASMR.

highlights_en.title: Marine's Counterattack Against Aggressive ASMR
highlights_en.description: Marine counters Koyori with friction sounds (towel sounds). Both sounds are intense, but the viewers seem satisfied with either sound.

highlights_en.title: Viewers Satisfied with Either Bondage (ASMR)
highlights_en.description: Koyori expresses dissatisfaction with viewer comments stating, 'I get excited by either ASMR.' This makes the meaning of winning or losing vanish.

highlights_en.title: Final Penalty Game: Thigh Clamping to Kill ASMR
highlights_en.description: Since the outcome became ambiguous, Koyori demands an extreme penalty game: clamping Marine with her thighs to kill her.

highlights_en.title: Thigh Clamping ASMR Execution and Marine's Death
highlights_en.description: Koyori executes the thigh clamping ASMR. Marine acts out suffocation and death, leading the stream to a chaotic ending.

highlights_en.title: End of Stream Greeting
highlights_en.description: The heartbeat stops, Koyori confirms Marine's death, and gives the closing greetings for the stream.

title: Let's Race to Victory! Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds SEA Grand Prix Tournament

overview.summary: ホロライブIDのAyunda Risuが「Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds SEA Grand Prix Tournament」に参加した際のゲーム実況配信です。東南アジアのコンテンツクリエイター12名が集まり、全10レースの白熱したレースが展開されました。Risuは序盤から好調を維持し、多くのレースで上位入賞を果たしました。特に、中盤のレースでは1位を獲るなど実力を発揮しましたが、終盤の猛追により最終的に総合2位（100ポイント）で大会を終えました。レース終了後、彼女は健闘を称え、視聴者や大会運営、共演者への感謝を述べ、興奮と充実感に満ちた大会参加の模様を届けました。配信の最後には、ゲームの紹介や今後の配信予定について補足的な説明を行いました。
overview.mood: 競争的で熱狂的な雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始と大会概要の説明
highlights.description: オープニング映像が終わり、Ayunda Risuが挨拶。Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds SEA Grand Prix Tournamentに参加することを説明し、自身が唯一のVTuber参加者であること、非常に緊張していることを伝える。

highlights.title: マシンカスタマイズの設定解説
highlights.description: 自身のマシン「Lip Spyder」のカスタマイズ画面を紹介。ハンドリングを重視したパラメータ設定や、Master Plateのパーツ選択について詳しく説明する。

highlights.title: キャラクター選択と大会ルールの確認
highlights.description: 使用キャラクターはBLAZE。大会は全10マッチで行われることを確認する。また、チャットスタンプでハツネミクのデカールがあることにも触れる。

highlights.title: レース1：Radical Highway開始
highlights.description: 最初のレースがスタート。序盤は後方からのスタートとなる。

highlights.title: レース1で1位フィニッシュ！
highlights.description: 激しいアイテム攻防とドリフトブーストを駆使し、順位を上げてトップでゴール。興奮を抑えきれない様子を見せる。

highlights.title: レース2：Mystic Jungle開始
highlights.description: 次のマップはランダム選択で「Mystic Jungle」に決定。ジャングルの中のテクニカルなコースでレースが始まる。

highlights.title: レース2で3位フィニッシュ
highlights.description: コース内の水面やトリッキーな仕掛けを乗り越え、安定した走行で3位に入賞し、ポイントを獲得。

highlights.title: レース2終了時点での総合順位
highlights.description: 総合順位でAyunda Risuが2位に浮上。トップのAfq Chiiとのポイント差が詰まり、さらに緊張感が高まる。

highlights.title: レース3：Ocean View開始
highlights.description: 次のレースは「Ocean View」のマップでスタート。青空の下、高速道路のようなコースが特徴。

highlights.title: レース3で2位フィニッシュ
highlights.description: 1位のAfq Chiiとの激しいトップ争いを繰り広げ、惜しくも2位でゴールする。レース後に思わず笑い声が漏れる。

highlights.title: レース3終了時点での総合順位
highlights.description: 総合順位はAfq Chiiが46ポイントで1位、Ayunda Risuが36ポイントで2位をキープしていることを確認。

highlights.title: レース4：Water Palace開始
highlights.description: 次のマップは「Water Palace」に決定。氷と水が組み合わされた滑りやすいコースで、レースがスタート。

highlights.title: レース4：Water Palace（中盤）
highlights.description: レース4中盤。Risuは序盤11位から8位まで順位を上げる。

highlights.title: レース4：2周目、一時1位に浮上
highlights.description: レース4、2周目に入り、アイテムやブーストを駆使して一時的に1位に浮上するが、アイテム攻撃で順位を落とし5位に。

highlights.title: レース4：ファイナルラップと追い上げ
highlights.description: ファイナルラップでRisuは順位を上げ、4位で最終セクションへ。最後まで上位を狙う。

highlights.title: レース4：3位フィニッシュ！総合3位維持
highlights.description: レース4終了。Risuは3位でフィニッシュし、10ポイントを獲得。総合順位は3位をキープ。

highlights.title: レース5へ：Afq Chiiの脅威
highlights.description: 次のレース5のコース選択中。RisuはライバルAfq Chiiが圧倒的なスコアでリードしていることに言及し、警戒する。

highlights.title: レース5：E-Stadium開始
highlights.description: レース5スタート。都市型のネオンが輝く高速コース「E-Stadium」。

highlights.title: レース5：1周目でトップ獲得
highlights.description: 序盤はアイテム攻撃を受けるが、リカバリーに成功し、1周目終盤でRisuが1位に躍り出る。

highlights.title: レース5：2位フィニッシュ！総合2位へ浮上
highlights.description: 激しい最終ラップの末、Risuは2位フィニッシュし、ポイントを獲得。総合順位は2位へ浮上。

highlights.title: 総合順位更新：Risu 2位維持 (56pt)
highlights.description: レース5終了後、Risuの総合順位は2位（56pt）。1位のAfq Chii（76pt）と20ポイント差。

highlights.title: レース6へ：Colorful Mallを選択
highlights.description: レース6のコースがランダムで「Colorful Mall」（ショッピングモール内のコース）に決定。

highlights.title: レース6：Colorful Mall開始
highlights.description: レース6スタート。序盤は中盤の順位を維持。

highlights.title: レース6：2周目の失速と追い上げ
highlights.description: 2周目、再びアイテム攻撃で最下位付近まで順位を落とすが、必死に順位を回復させる。

highlights.title: レース6：9位フィニッシュ（僅かなポイント獲得）
highlights.description: レース6終了。Risuは9位でフィニッシュ。総合2位を維持するが、ポイント差は広がる。

highlights.title: レース7へ：Radical Highwayを選択
highlights.description: レース7のコースが「Radical Highway」に決定。気持ちを切り替え、次のレースに挑む。

highlights.title: レース7：Radical Highway開始
highlights.description: レース7スタート。序盤は中盤を走行し、ドリフトブーストを試みる。

highlights.title: レース7：終盤のアイテム戦で順位ダウン
highlights.description: ファイナルラップで4位まで順位を上げるが、最終セクションでアイテム攻撃を受け順位を落とす。

highlights.title: レース7：5位フィニッシュ
highlights.description: Risuは5位でフィニッシュし、ポイントを獲得。

highlights.title: 総合順位：Risu 2位維持 (78pt, 3位と同点)
highlights.description: レース7終了後、Risuは総合2位を維持（78pt）。3位のZbing Z.と同点で緊迫した状況となる。

highlights.title: レース8へ：Rainbow Gardenを選択
highlights.description: レース8のコースが「Rainbow Garden」（花畑のカラフルなコース）に決定。最後の巻き返しを狙う。

highlights.title: レース8：Rainbow Garden開始
highlights.description: レース8スタート。序盤からブーストをうまく使い、順位を上げていく。

highlights.title: レース8：1位フィニッシュ！
highlights.description: ファイナルラップでトップを維持し、そのまま1位でフィニッシュ。大きなポイントを獲得。

highlights.title: 大会最終結果：Risuが総合2位を獲得！
highlights.description: 全10レース終了後、最終結果発表。Risuは総合2位（100pt）を獲得し、Afq Chii（111pt）に惜しくも及ばなかったものの、健闘を称える。

highlights.title: Risuの大会総括と感謝
highlights.description: Risuが視聴者に向けて、大会参加が非常に楽しい経験であったことを感謝の言葉とともに伝える。

highlights.title: Risuの使用マシンとカスタマイズ解説
highlights.description: 改めて自身が使用したキャラクター（Blaze）とマシンのカスタマイズ設定（ハンドリング重視）について解説。上級者向けパーツの性能比較も行う。

highlights.title: 視聴者参加型レースイベントの告知
highlights.description: 月曜日に視聴者参加型のSonic Racingゲーム配信を計画していることを発表。ゲームのSteamコードがもらえる可能性についても触れる。

highlights.title: エンディングの挨拶と閉会
highlights.description: 視聴者や大会関係者、共演者への感謝を述べ、興奮冷めやらぬ中で配信を終了する。

highlights.title: レース5：2位フィニッシュ！総合2位へ浮上
highlights.description: 激しい最終ラップの末、Risuは2位フィニッシュし、ポイントを獲得。総合順位は2位へ浮上。

highlights.title: ゲームのクロスプレイ機能とコラボキャラクター紹介
highlights.description: ゲームがクロスプラットフォーム対応であること、また、イチバンカスガ（龍が如く）やジョーカー（ペルソナ5）、初音ミク、スティーブ（Minecraft）など、多くのコラボキャラクターがいることに言及し紹介する。

highlights.title: ゲーム内フェスティバルイベントの解説
highlights.description: ゲーム内で開催中のフェスティバルイベント（Tap Boost, Ring Grab, Freestyleなど）のルールについてインドネシア語で補足説明を行う。イベントが30分ごとに切り替わることに触れる。

highlights.title: 大会終了後の感謝と最終的な挨拶
highlights.description: 改めて大会が終了したことを宣言し、総合2位という結果に感謝と驚きを表明。視聴者、SEGA、Sonic Racing CrossWorldsへの感謝を述べ、配信を締めくくる。

highlights.title: エンディングアニメーションと終了
highlights.description: 配信終了のピクセルアートアニメーションが開始される。「NONSTOP NUT November」の告知も表示される。

overview_en.summary: This is a gameplay stream featuring Hololive ID's Ayunda Risu participating in the "Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds SEA Grand Prix Tournament." Twelve content creators from Southeast Asia gathered for 10 intense races. Risu maintained strong performance from the start, placing high in many races. She demonstrated her skill, particularly by taking first place in a mid-tournament race, but ultimately finished the tournament in 2nd place overall (100 points) due to intense competition late in the event. After the races concluded, she praised the efforts of the competitors, expressed gratitude to her viewers, the organizers, and fellow participants, conveying the excitement and fulfillment of her involvement. At the end of the stream, she provided additional information about the game and her future streaming schedule.
overview_en.mood: Competitive and enthusiastic atmosphere

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Tournament Overview Explanation
highlights_en.description: The opening video ends, and Ayunda Risu greets the viewers. She explains her participation in the Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds SEA Grand Prix Tournament, noting that she is the only VTuber participant and is very nervous.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of Machine Customization Settings
highlights_en.description: Risu introduces the customization screen for her machine, "Lip Spyder." She elaborates on the parameter settings, which prioritize handling, and the selection of Master Plate parts.

highlights_en.title: Character Selection and Tournament Rules Confirmation
highlights_en.description: The character used is BLAZE. She confirms the tournament will consist of 10 matches in total. She also mentions the existence of a Hatsune Miku decal available via chat stamp.

highlights_en.title: Race 1: Radical Highway Begins
highlights_en.description: The first race starts. Risu begins from the back of the pack.

highlights_en.title: Finishing 1st in Race 1!
highlights_en.description: Utilizing intense item battles and drift boosts, she climbs the ranks and finishes in the lead. She appears unable to contain her excitement.

highlights_en.title: Race 2: Mystic Jungle Begins
highlights_en.description: The next map is randomly selected as "Mystic Jungle." The race starts on the technical course within the jungle.

highlights_en.title: Finishing 3rd in Race 2
highlights_en.description: Navigating the water surfaces and tricky gimmicks on the course, she finishes 3rd with stable driving and earns points.

highlights_en.title: Overall Standings After Race 2
highlights_en.description: Ayunda Risu moves up to 2nd place in the overall standings. The point difference with the leader, Afq Chii, narrows, increasing the tension.

highlights_en.title: Race 3: Ocean View Begins
highlights_en.description: The next race starts on the "Ocean View" map. The course is characterized by a highway-like track under a blue sky.

highlights_en.title: Finishing 2nd in Race 3
highlights_en.description: She engages in an intense battle for the lead with Afq Chii, who is in 1st, and narrowly finishes 2nd. She chuckles after the race.

highlights_en.title: Overall Standings After Race 3
highlights_en.description: Confirmation that Afq Chii holds 1st place with 46 points, and Ayunda Risu maintains 2nd place with 36 points.

highlights_en.title: Race 4: Water Palace Begins
highlights_en.description: The next map is determined to be "Water Palace." The race starts on the slippery course combining ice and water.

highlights_en.title: Race 4: Water Palace (Mid-Race)
highlights_en.description: Mid-race in Race 4. Risu moves up from 11th place early on to 8th place.

highlights_en.title: Race 4: Lap 2, Briefly Takes 1st Place
highlights_en.description: Entering Lap 2 of Race 4, Risu briefly takes 1st place using items and boosts but drops to 5th after an item attack.

highlights_en.title: Race 4: Final Lap and Catch-up
highlights_en.description: In the final lap, Risu gains positions, reaching 4th place as she enters the final section. She aims for a top spot until the end.

highlights_en.title: Race 4: Finishing 3rd! Maintains 3rd Overall
highlights_en.description: Race 4 ends. Risu finishes 3rd, earning 10 points. She maintains 3rd place in the overall standings.

highlights_en.title: Heading to Race 5: The Threat of Afq Chii
highlights_en.description: During the course selection for Race 5. Risu notes that her rival, Afq Chii, is leading with an overwhelming score, expressing caution.

highlights_en.title: Race 5: E-Stadium Begins
highlights_en.description: Race 5 starts. The fast-paced, urban course "E-Stadium" shines with neon lights.

highlights_en.title: Race 5: Secures the Lead on Lap 1
highlights_en.description: Although hit by item attacks early on, she successfully recovers, and Risu jumps into 1st place near the end of the first lap.

highlights_en.title: Race 5: Finishing 2nd! Climbs to 2nd Overall
highlights_en.description: After an intense final lap, Risu finishes 2nd and earns points. She rises to 2nd place in the overall standings.

highlights_en.title: Standings Update: Risu Maintains 2nd (56pt)
highlights_en.description: After Race 5, Risu remains 2nd overall (56pt), 20 points behind the leader, Afq Chii (76pt).

highlights_en.title: Heading to Race 6: Colorful Mall Selected
highlights_en.description: The course for Race 6 is randomly selected as "Colorful Mall" (a course set inside a shopping mall).

highlights_en.title: Race 6: Colorful Mall Begins
highlights_en.description: Race 6 starts. Risu maintains a mid-pack position early on.

highlights_en.title: Race 6: Slowdown and Catch-up in Lap 2
highlights_en.description: In the second lap, she is hit by item attacks again, dropping near last place, but desperately attempts to regain positions.

highlights_en.title: Race 6: Finishing 9th (Minor Point Gain)
highlights_en.description: Race 6 concludes. Risu finishes 9th. She maintains 2nd overall, but the point gap widens.

highlights_en.title: Heading to Race 7: Radical Highway Selected
highlights_en.description: The course for Race 7 is set as "Radical Highway." Risu resets her mindset and prepares for the next race.

highlights_en.title: Race 7: Radical Highway Begins
highlights_en.description: Race 7 starts. Risu drives in the middle of the pack early on and attempts drift boosts.

highlights_en.title: Race 7: Position Drops Due to Item Battle in Climax
highlights_en.description: Risu climbs to 4th place in the final lap but loses position after being hit by an item attack in the final section.

highlights_en.title: Race 7: Finishing 5th
highlights_en.description: Risu finishes 5th and earns points.

highlights_en.title: Overall Standings: Risu Maintains 2nd (78pt, Tied with 3rd)
highlights_en.description: After Race 7, Risu maintains 2nd place overall (78pt). The situation is tense, as she is tied with Zbing Z. for 3rd place.

highlights_en.title: Heading to Race 8: Rainbow Garden Selected
highlights_en.description: The course for Race 8 is decided as "Rainbow Garden" (a colorful course set in a flower field). Risu aims for a final comeback.

highlights_en.title: Race 8: Rainbow Garden Begins
highlights_en.description: Race 8 starts. Risu skillfully uses boosts from the beginning to gain positions.

highlights_en.title: Race 8: Finishing 1st!
highlights_en.description: Risu maintains the lead throughout the final lap and finishes 1st, earning significant points.

highlights_en.title: Final Tournament Results: Risu Takes 2nd Place Overall!
highlights_en.description: After all 10 races conclude, the final results are announced. Risu secures 2nd place overall (100pt). Although narrowly beaten by Afq Chii (111pt), Risu is commended for her strong performance.

highlights_en.title: Risu's Tournament Summary and Gratitude
highlights_en.description: Risu tells her viewers, with words of thanks, that participating in the tournament was a highly enjoyable experience.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of Risu's Machine and Customization
highlights_en.description: Risu explains the character she used (Blaze) and her machine's customization settings (prioritizing handling). She also compares the performance of parts intended for advanced users.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Viewer Participation Race Event
highlights_en.description: Risu announces plans for a viewer-participation Sonic Racing stream on Monday, mentioning the possibility of viewers receiving Steam codes for the game.

highlights_en.title: Ending Greetings and Conclusion
highlights_en.description: Risu expresses thanks to viewers, tournament staff, and fellow participants, ending the stream while still high on adrenaline.

highlights_en.title: Race 5: Finishing 2nd! Climbs to 2nd Overall
highlights_en.description: After an intense final lap, Risu finishes 2nd and earns points. She rises to 2nd place in the overall standings.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Game's Crossplay Function and Collaboration Characters
highlights_en.description: Risu mentions and introduces the game's cross-platform compatibility, as well as the numerous collaboration characters, including Ichiban Kasuga (Yakuza), Joker (Persona 5), Hatsune Miku, and Steve (Minecraft).

highlights_en.title: Explanation of In-Game Festival Events
highlights_en.description: Risu provides additional explanations in Indonesian about the rules for the ongoing in-game festival events (such as Tap Boost, Ring Grab, and Freestyle), noting that the events rotate every 30 minutes.

highlights_en.title: Post-Tournament Gratitude and Final Greetings
highlights_en.description: Risu officially declares the end of the tournament and expresses gratitude and surprise at achieving 2nd place overall. She thanks the viewers, SEGA, and Sonic Racing CrossWorlds before concluding the stream.

highlights_en.title: Ending Animation and Conclusion
highlights_en.description: The stream's closing pixel art animation begins. An announcement for "NONSTOP NUT November" is also displayed.

title: 【 HITMAN 】エージェントねねち、出勤！【 桃鈴ねね / hololive 】

overview.summary: 桃鈴ねねが暗殺ゲーム『HITMAN 3』のローグライクモード「フリーランサー」の訓練ミッションと、本格的なフリーランサー契約を成功させた後、キャンペーンモードの「ショーストッパー」（パリのファッションショー）ミッションに挑戦。ターゲットはヴィクター・ノビコフとダリア・マルゴリスの2名。強引な行動でミッション失敗を繰り返すが、衛兵の衣装に変装し、外壁のぶら下がり移動を活用するステルス戦術を確立。ヴィクターを偶然排除し、ダリア・マルゴリスを軍刀で暗殺することに成功した。その後、衛兵姿で正面ゲートから無事脱出し、ミッションを完了させた。ねねちは暗殺者としての才能を見出しつつ、達成感と共に配信を締めくくる。
overview.mood: 計画的暗殺と、潜入失敗によるコミカルな死亡を繰り返す、緊張と緩和の入り混じった展開

highlights.title: 配信開始と「HITMAN 3 フリーランサー」紹介
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶と共に、星街すいせいと鷹嶺ルイに勧められたという『HITMAN 3』の新しいローグライクモード「フリーランサー」をプレイすることを発表。ゲームのルール概要について動画で学ぶ。

highlights.title: フリーランサーモードのルール確認
highlights.description: フリーランサーモードのチュートリアル映像を視聴。犯罪シンジケートリーダーを倒すこと、装備を失うリスクがあること、難易度が上がっていくことなど、基本的なルールを把握する。

highlights.title: ICAトレーニング施設（初級）開始とグラフィック設定調整
highlights.description: ICAトレーニング施設（プロローグ）の「ガイド付きトレーニング」を開始。画面の色味が薄いのを見て、オプションでHDR設定をオフにし、画質を調整する。

highlights.title: 最初の変装とミッション失敗（非致死で逮捕）
highlights.description: 警備員に扮したメカニックを非致死で気絶させ、制服を奪う。ターゲットであるカルヴィン・リッターを発見し、力づくで気絶させようとするが周囲に目撃され、警備員に囲まれ銃殺される。

highlights.title: 再挑戦と船員への変装
highlights.description: ミッションをリスタート。メカニックを気絶させて制服を奪い、死体を冷凍庫に隠す。さらに船員に扮した人物を気絶させて制服を奪い、ターゲットのいる上層デッキへの侵入を試みる。

highlights.title: ターゲットを個室へ追い込む
highlights.description: 船員服で上層デッキに到達し、バーカウンターに紛れてターゲットを観察する。ターゲットがプライベートオフィスに移動し、護衛を下がらせたのを確認する。

highlights.title: ターゲット排除と暗殺完了（非致死）
highlights.description: ターゲットのオフィスに忍び込み、レンチでカルヴィン・リッターを気絶させる。彼のボディガードも気絶させて死体を隠し、暗殺を成功させる。 ICAトレーニングの目標を達成する。

highlights.title: 装備を充実させつつ、まさかの強硬手段
highlights.description: 装備が充実したため、強行突破を試みる。アサルトライフルとショットガンを装備し、ターゲットを隠れて観察中に銃撃戦に突入。ターゲットを排除するが、警備員に集中砲火を浴びて再び死亡する。

highlights.title: 最後の再挑戦：銃撃戦でターゲット排除
highlights.description: 最後のチャンスとして、警備員を排除して手に入れた銃（アサルトライフル）でターゲットに突っ込み、ターゲットのカルヴィン・リッターを射殺し、ミッションを完了する。

highlights.title: 最終テストへの挑戦権獲得
highlights.description: ICAトレーニングの上級ミッションクリア。ダイアナから「最終テスト」を楽しみしていると告げられ、本モードへの準備完了を宣言する。

highlights.title: 激しい銃撃戦の末、再びミッション失敗
highlights.description: 前のセーブデータからやり直すも、ターゲット周辺の警備員に発見され、猛烈な銃撃戦の末に射殺されミッション失敗。ステルスの難しさを痛感する。

highlights.title: 暗殺には「待て」が重要だと悟る
highlights.description: マップ上の敵配置を慎重に確認。ターゲットが多数の人に囲まれている状況を避け、孤立するチャンスを待つ戦略に切り替える。忍耐の重要性を説きながら待機。

highlights.title: ターゲットを隔離し射殺
highlights.description: ターゲット（Kalvin Ritter）が護衛を伴いオフィスに入室。Neneはドアをロックピックで開け、背後からターゲットと護衛の2人を拳銃で排除し、ミッションを完了させる。

highlights.title: 激しい追跡をかわして脱出成功
highlights.description: 暗殺成功後、多数の警備員に追われながらも、隠れていた脱出ポイントの車に飛び込み、訓練ミッションを完了させる。

highlights.title: 最終試験「ICA施設：所属地不明」開始
highlights.description: ICAトレーニングの最終試験として、キューバの軍事施設が舞台となるミッション「Jasper Knightを排除」を開始。整備士の会話を盗み聞きし、ターゲット排除のヒントを得る。

highlights.title: メカニックの変装を確保し、格納庫へ潜入
highlights.description: 警備室前のトラックの陰に隠れ、コインでメカニックをおびき寄せて気絶させ、装備を奪う。変装して格納庫エリアへ潜入。

highlights.title: ジェット機の射出シートを細工
highlights.description: 整備士に扮したNeneは、ミッションストーリー「安全第一」を進行させ、格納庫内の戦闘機の射出シートに細工を施す。

highlights.title: ターゲットをジェット機へ誘導し事故死させる
highlights.description: ターゲット（Jasper Knight）を安全点検のためジェット機のコックピットへ誘導し、細工した射出シートのレバーを引かせる。ターゲットは爆発と共に射出され、事故死として処理される。訓練ミッションクリア。

highlights.title: フリーランサー契約開始とターゲットの情報確認
highlights.description: ICA最終試験をクリアし、本格的なフリーランサーの国際犯罪シンジケート「Yardbirds」の排除ミッションを開始。ターゲットはDorian Lang、Guillaume Maison、Doris Leeの3人。

highlights.title: スナイパー暗殺に挑戦：最初の失敗
highlights.description: ヒメルシュタインの屋敷を見下ろす丘からスナイパーライフルでターゲット3人を狙う。Guillaume MaisonとDoris Leeの排除には成功するが、Dorian Langが逃走車両に乗り込みミッション失敗。

highlights.title: スナイパー暗殺成功：3人同時排除
highlights.description: 再挑戦し、ターゲットが屋外に集まるタイミングを狙い、素早い連続射撃で3人全員の排除に成功。難易度の高いスナイパーチャレンジを達成し、高評価を得る。

highlights.title: キャンペーンミッション「ショー・ストッパー」開始
highlights.description: 武器庫を見て回り、フリーランサー以外のミッションへ挑戦することを決定。キャンペーンモードの最初のミッション「ショー・ストッパー」（パリのファッションショー）を開始。ターゲットはヴィクター・ノビコフとダリア・マルゴリス。

highlights.title: 武器を取り出し大失敗、初手で即死
highlights.description: 難易度カジュアルでミッションをスタートするが、人混みの中で武器（銃）を取り出そうとした瞬間、周囲に気づかれ銃撃戦となり即座に死亡。

highlights.title: クルーの衣装を奪い、バックステージへ潜入
highlights.description: リトライし、バックステージ裏のトイレでクルー（スタッフ）を気絶させ衣装を奪う。このエリアで有名モデル「ヘルムート・クルーガー」の噂を聞き、ミッションストーリーのヒントを得る。

highlights.title: 階段上の衛兵に発見され戦闘、失敗
highlights.description: クルーの衣装で2階へ続くメイン階段を登ろうとするが、衛兵に不法侵入と見なされ戦闘状態となり死亡。

highlights.title: 外壁伝いに移動するも、警備員に発見され失敗
highlights.description: 建物の外壁伝いに移動し、バルコニーの淵にぶら下がるが、警備員に見咎められ、戦闘状態となり死亡。

highlights.title: 偶然ヴィクター・ノビコフを排除する
highlights.description: リトライ後、衛兵の衣装を奪うために気絶させた人物が、実はターゲットの一人であるヴィクター・ノビコフであったことが判明し、目標達成ボーナスを得る。

highlights.title: ウェイターに変装し、ボディチェックを通過
highlights.description: ヴィクター・ノビコフを排除したため、ダリア・マルゴリスの暗殺に集中。ウェイターの衣装を奪ってメインエントランスのボディチェックを突破する。

highlights.title: 護衛との格闘戦に敗北し失敗
highlights.description: ダリア・マルゴリスがいるテラスへ潜入を試みるが、彼女の護衛と格闘戦になり、逆に気絶させられ失敗。

highlights.title: 衛兵の衣装で外壁を移動し、ダリアの部屋へ
highlights.description: 衛兵（ノビコフの衣装）に変装し、建物の外壁を伝ってダリア・マルゴリスのいる高層階へ向かう。外壁移動で追跡状態から逃れる。

highlights.title: ダリア・マルゴリスを軍刀で暗殺成功
highlights.description: ダリア・マルゴリスのプライベートルームに潜入し、護衛の隙を突いて軍刀を奪い、ダリアを暗殺。ミッション完了直前の状態となる。

highlights.title: 脱出ポイントへ向かいミッション完了
highlights.description: ダリア暗殺後、衛兵姿で建物の外壁を伝って下階へ移動し、人混みを走り抜けて正面ゲートから脱出。ミッション完了となる。

highlights.title: ミッション評価：「だらしないアマチュア」と「MAX-NENE-MAY」
highlights.description: ミッション完了画面で、ミッション評価「だらしないアマチュア」が表示され、ねねちは「こんなにスマートだったのに！」とツッコミを入れる。称号「MAX-NENE-MAY」を獲得。

highlights.title: ミッションクリア後のムービー（グローバルエリートの秘密）
highlights.description: ターゲット排除後のムービーが流れる。エージェント47が黒服の男たちと接触し、暗殺がグローバルエリートの秘密に関わっていることを示唆する会話が展開される。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶と感想
highlights.description: ミッションを無事完了し、「エージェントねねち、才能あるね！」と達成感を語る。夜遅い時間の視聴への感謝を伝え、配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: After successfully completing the training missions for the roguelike mode "Freelancer" in the assassination game 'HITMAN 3', and a full Freelancer contract, Momosuzu Nene attempts the campaign mode mission "The Showstopper" (Paris Fashion Show). The targets are Victor Novikov and Dalia Margolis. Despite repeated mission failures due to aggressive actions, she establishes a stealth strategy by utilizing the guard uniform disguise and traversing along ledges on the exterior walls. She accidentally eliminates Victor and successfully assassinates Dalia Margolis with a saber. She then safely escapes through the main gate while disguised as a guard, completing the mission. Nenechi concludes the stream with a sense of accomplishment, having discovered her talent as an assassin.
overview_en.mood: A mix of tension and relaxation, featuring carefully planned assassinations interspersed with comical deaths resulting from failed infiltrations

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Introduction to "HITMAN 3 Freelancer"
highlights_en.description: After greeting the viewers, Nene announces she will play 'HITMAN 3's new roguelike mode, "Freelancer," which was recommended to her by Hoshimachi Suisei and Takane Lui. She learns the general rules of the game via video.

highlights_en.title: Confirming the Rules of Freelancer Mode
highlights_en.description: Watches the Freelancer mode tutorial video. She understands the basic rules, such as eliminating crime syndicate leaders, the risk of losing gear, and increasing difficulty.

highlights_en.title: Starting the ICA Training Facility (Beginner) and Adjusting Graphic Settings
highlights_en.description: Starts the "Guided Training" in the ICA Training Facility (Prologue). Noticing the muted colors on the screen, she turns off HDR settings in the options and adjusts the picture quality.

highlights_en.title: First Disguise and Mission Failure (Arrested without Lethal Force)
highlights_en.description: Non-lethally knocks out a mechanic disguised as a security guard and takes his uniform. She finds the target, Kalvin Ritter, and attempts to knock him out by force, but is witnessed by others, surrounded by guards, and shot dead.

highlights_en.title: Retrying and Disguising as a Crewman
highlights_en.description: Restarts the mission. Knocks out the mechanic, takes the uniform, and hides the body in a freezer. She then knocks out another person disguised as a crewman, steals that uniform, and attempts to infiltrate the upper deck where the target is located.

highlights_en.title: Luring the Target into a Private Room
highlights_en.description: Reaches the upper deck in the crew uniform and observes the target near the bar counter. She confirms that the target moves to a private office and dismisses his bodyguard.

highlights_en.title: Target Elimination and Assassination Complete (Non-Lethal)
highlights_en.description: Sneaks into the target's office and knocks out Kalvin Ritter with a wrench. She also knocks out his bodyguard and hides both bodies, successfully completing the assassination. She achieves the objective of the ICA training.

highlights_en.title: Gearing Up, Yet Surprisingly Resorting to Force
highlights_en.description: Since her gear is stocked up, she attempts a forced entry. Armed with an assault rifle and a shotgun, she gets into a firefight while observing the target from cover. She eliminates the target but is showered by concentrated fire from the guards and dies again.

highlights_en.title: Final Reattempt: Eliminating the Target in a Firefight
highlights_en.description: For her final chance, she rushes the target using a gun (assault rifle) acquired by eliminating a guard, shoots Kalvin Ritter dead, and completes the mission.

highlights_en.title: Earning the Right to Attempt the Final Test
highlights_en.description: Clears the advanced ICA training mission. Diana tells her she looks forward to the "Final Test," and Nene declares herself ready for the main mode.

highlights_en.title: Mission Failed Again After an Intense Firefight
highlights_en.description: Retries from the previous save data, but is spotted by guards near the target and is killed in a ferocious gun battle, resulting in mission failure. She realizes the difficulty of stealth.

highlights_en.title: Realizing "Patience" is Crucial for Assassination
highlights_en.description: Carefully checks enemy placement on the map. She switches strategy to avoid situations where the target is surrounded by many people, waiting for a chance for isolation. She waits while emphasizing the importance of patience.

highlights_en.title: Isolating and Shooting the Target
highlights_en.description: The target (Kalvin Ritter) enters an office accompanied by a bodyguard. Nene lockpicks the door, eliminates both the target and the bodyguard from behind with a pistol, and completes the mission.

highlights_en.title: Successfully Evading Intense Pursuit and Escaping
highlights_en.description: After a successful assassination, she is pursued by numerous guards but manages to jump into the escape point vehicle that was hidden, completing the training mission.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Final Test: "ICA Facility: Unknown Location"
highlights_en.description: Begins the mission "Eliminate Jasper Knight," set in a Cuban military facility, as the ICA Training Final Test. She overhears a mechanic's conversation and gains a hint for eliminating the target.

highlights_en.title: Securing the Mechanic Disguise and Infiltrating the Hangar
highlights_en.description: Hides behind a truck near the guard room, lures a mechanic with a coin, knocks him out, and steals his gear. Disguised, she infiltrates the hangar area.

highlights_en.title: Tampering with the Jet's Ejection Seat
highlights_en.description: Nene, disguised as a mechanic, progresses the Mission Story "Safety First" and tampers with the ejection seat of the fighter jet inside the hangar.

highlights_en.title: Luring the Target to the Jet and Causing Accidental Death
highlights_en.description: She guides the target (Jasper Knight) to the jet cockpit for a safety check and makes him pull the lever for the sabotaged ejection seat. The target is ejected in an explosion and counted as an accidental death. Training mission complete.

highlights_en.title: Freelancer Contract Starts and Target Information Confirmation
highlights_en.description: Having cleared the ICA Final Test, she begins a full-fledged Freelancer mission to eliminate the international crime syndicate "Yardbirds." The targets are Dorian Lang, Guillaume Maison, and Doris Lee (3 people).

highlights_en.title: Attempting Sniper Assassination: First Failure
highlights_en.description: Aims for the three targets with a sniper rifle from a hill overlooking the Himmelveil Manor. She successfully eliminates Guillaume Maison and Doris Lee, but Dorian Lang escapes in a vehicle, resulting in mission failure.

highlights_en.title: Successful Sniper Assassination: Simultaneous Elimination of Three
highlights_en.description: Retries, waits for the moment the targets gather outside, and successfully eliminates all three with quick successive shots. She completes the high-difficulty sniper challenge and receives a high rating.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Campaign Mission "The Showstopper"
highlights_en.description: Looks around the armory and decides to attempt a non-Freelancer mission. She starts the first campaign mode mission, "The Showstopper" (Paris Fashion Show). The targets are Victor Novikov and Dalia Margolis.

highlights_en.title: Massive Failure Upon Drawing Weapon, Instant Death on First Move
highlights_en.description: Starts the mission on Casual difficulty, but the moment she tries to draw a weapon (gun) in the crowd, she is spotted, a gunfight ensues, and she immediately dies.

highlights_en.title: Stealing a Crew Uniform and Infiltrating Backstage
highlights_en.description: Retries, knocks out a crew member (staff) in the restroom behind the backstage area, and steals the uniform. In this area, she overhears rumors about the famous model "Helmut Kruger," gaining a hint for the Mission Story.

highlights_en.title: Spotted by a Guard on the Stairs, Combat, Failure
highlights_en.description: Attempts to climb the main stairs leading to the second floor in the crew uniform, but is deemed trespassing by a guard, resulting in combat and death.

highlights_en.title: Moving Along the Exterior Wall, Spotted by a Guard and Failed
highlights_en.description: Moves along the exterior wall of the building and hangs onto a balcony ledge, but is spotted by a security guard, resulting in combat and death.

highlights_en.title: Accidentally Eliminating Victor Novikov
highlights_en.description: Upon retrying, the person she knocked out to steal a guard uniform is revealed to be Victor Novikov, one of the targets, earning an objective completion bonus.

highlights_en.title: Disguising as a Waiter and Passing the Body Check
highlights_en.description: Since Victor Novikov was eliminated, she focuses on assassinating Dalia Margolis. She steals a waiter's uniform and breaks through the body check at the main entrance.

highlights_en.title: Defeated in Hand-to-Hand Combat with a Bodyguard and Failed
highlights_en.description: Attempts to infiltrate the terrace where Dalia Margolis is located, but gets into hand-to-hand combat with her bodyguard and is knocked out, resulting in failure.

highlights_en.title: Moving Along the Exterior Wall in a Guard Uniform to Dalia's Room
highlights_en.description: Disguised as a guard (Novikov's outfit), she traverses the exterior wall of the building toward the upper floor where Dalia Margolis is located. She uses the wall traversal to evade pursuit.

highlights_en.title: Successful Assassination of Dalia Margolis with a Saber
highlights_en.description: Infiltrates Dalia Margolis's private room, seizes a saber during a lapse in the guard's attention, and assassinates Dalia. The mission is now moments from completion.

highlights_en.title: Heading to the Escape Point and Mission Complete
highlights_en.description: After assassinating Dalia, she moves down the exterior wall in her guard uniform, runs through the crowd, and escapes through the main gate. Mission complete.

highlights_en.title: Mission Rating: "Sloppy Amateur" and "MAX-NENE-MAY"
highlights_en.description: On the mission completion screen, the rating "Sloppy Amateur" appears, prompting Nenechi to retort, "But I was so smart about it!" She acquires the title "MAX-NENE-MAY."

highlights_en.title: Post-Mission Clear Movie (Secrets of the Global Elite)
highlights_en.description: A cutscene plays after the targets are eliminated. Agent 47 contacts men in black suits, and a conversation unfolds suggesting the assassination is connected to the secrets of the global elite.

highlights_en.title: Stream Conclusion Greetings and Thoughts
highlights_en.description: Having safely completed the mission, she expresses a sense of achievement, saying, "Agent Nenechi, you've got talent!" She thanks the viewers for watching late at night and concludes the stream.

overview_en.summary: A spontaneous singing stream by AZKi. She captivated listeners with her high vocal ability and expressiveness, performing covers of emotional anime songs, J-POP, and Vocaloid tracks. Highlights included performing Ai Higuchi's 'Akuma no Ko' (The Child of Evil), ZUTOMAYO's 'Tadashiku Narenai' (Can't Be Right), and Yorushika's 'Shayou' (Setting Sun). In the latter half, she sang her original song 'Aoi Yume' (Blue Dream), and concluded the stream strongly with an encore performance of Chihiro Onitsuka's 'Gekkou' (Moonlight). She also announced her live concert 'Departure' and discussed the graduation of hololive EN's Tsukumo Sana. The stream ended with her thanking the viewers before moving to Super Chat reading.

title: 【#白上フブキ生誕祭2025】今年も無事に誕生日を迎えますｯｯ！！ちょっとした告知あります。【白上フブキ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 白上フブキのホロライブ8周年記念誕生日配信。国内外のファンによる大規模な応援広告への感謝を伝え、黒上フブキのカバー楽曲、Fubuki Kingdom小説投稿、3Dモデル表情アップデートの3つの「プチ告知」を発表しました。配信後半では、翌日の3Dライブゲストのシルエット予想やホロライブ10周年への意気込みを語り、最後に自身の楽曲「Dear My Fave,」を歌い上げ、感動的に締めくくりました。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気で、ファンからの多大な愛情に感謝しつつ、新情報への期待感が高まる配信

highlights.title: 配信開始と誕生日のお祝い
highlights.description: 白上フブキが誕生日衣装と眼鏡で登場し、ファンに挨拶。ホロライブでの活動が8年目に突入したことを報告し、感謝を述べました。

highlights.title: ファンからの海外/国内の応援広告に感謝
highlights.description: タイムズスクエアや広島など、国内外のファンが制作した誕生日のお祝い広告について言及し、感謝の気持ちを伝えました。

highlights.title: 配信内での「プチ告知」ラインナップ発表
highlights.description: 今回の配信で発表する3つの告知内容「プチ告知」「プチお知らせ」「プチお披露目」のラインナップが紹介されました。

highlights.title: 誕生日カウントダウン終了＆お祝い
highlights.description: 日付が変わり、正式に誕生日を迎えた瞬間をファンと共に祝い、大量のコンフェッティエフェクトと共に喜びを爆発させました。

highlights.title: プチ告知：黒上フブキ カバー楽曲「逢魔が時の帰り方」公開決定
highlights.description: 一つ目の告知として、黒上フブキによるカバー楽曲「逢魔が時の帰り方」が10月5日20時にプレミア公開されることが発表されました。

highlights.title: プチお知らせ：Fubuki Kingdom小説投稿開始
highlights.description: 二つ目の告知として、Fubuki Kingdomの世界観を掘り下げる小説がYouTubeコミュニティにて投稿されることが決定しました。ライブの補足的な物語も含まれます。

highlights.title: プチお披露目：3Dモデルの表情アップデート
highlights.description: 3Dモデルの表情がより豊かに、特にコミカルな表情や微妙な表情ができるようにアップデートされたことが発表されました。

highlights.title: 3Dライブ「冥界ハロウィンナイト」告知とゲスト紹介
highlights.description: 10月5日21時から開催される誕生日3Dライブ「冥界ハロウィンナイト」のキービジュアルと共に、ゲスト陣（大空スバル、大神ミオ、猫又おかゆ、戌神ころね、鷹嶺ルイ、風真いろは、ハコス・ベールズ、風真いろは）が紹介されました。

highlights.title: 3Dライブゲストのシルエット予想
highlights.description: ゲストのシルエットが一部公開されたことで、ファンと一緒に誰なのかを予想し、その尖った耳からエルフかもしれないと冗談を言いました。

highlights.title: YAGOO/谷郷氏との交流エピソード
highlights.description: 視聴者のコメントからYAGOO社長の話題になり、先日会った際、彼がホロライブの10周年に向けた夢を熱く語ってくれたエピソードを披露しました。

highlights.title: 誕生日記念ジャンケン大会
highlights.description: ファンに向けて突然ジャンケンを仕掛け、「パー」を出し、「負けました」とオチをつけて会場の笑いを誘いました。その後も一人ジャンケンを続けました。

highlights.title: 楽曲披露：「Dear My Fave,」
highlights.description: 誕生日配信の最後に、自身の楽曲である「Dear My Fave,」を歌唱しました。途中、マイクの位置調整で配信画面から姿が消えるハプニングもありました。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶と感謝
highlights.description: 「Dear My Fave,」を歌い終え、誕生日カウントダウン配信に来てくれたファンに改めて感謝を伝え、明日のカバー曲投稿と3Dライブへの参加を呼びかけました。

overview_en.summary: Shirakami Fubuki's Hololive 8th Anniversary Birthday Stream. She expressed gratitude for the large-scale fan support advertisements both domestically and internationally and announced three "mini-updates": a Kurokami Fubuki cover song, the launch of Fubuki Kingdom novel serialization, and a 3D model expression update. In the latter half of the stream, she discussed predictions for the next day's 3D live guests' silhouettes and her aspirations for Hololive's 10th anniversary, concluding emotionally by singing her original song, "Dear My Fave,".
overview_en.mood: A consistently friendly atmosphere where gratitude for immense fan love was shared, while anticipation for new information grew

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Birthday Greetings
highlights_en.description: Shirakami Fubuki appeared in her birthday outfit and glasses, greeting her fans. She reported that her activities in Hololive have entered their 8th year and expressed her gratitude.

highlights_en.title: Gratitude for Domestic and International Fan Support Advertisements
highlights_en.description: She mentioned the birthday celebration advertisements created by fans both domestically and internationally, including those in Times Square and Hiroshima, and expressed her thanks.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of the "Mini-Update" Lineup during the Stream
highlights_en.description: The lineup of three announcements ("Mini-Update," "Mini-Notice," and "Mini-Reveal") to be disclosed during the stream was introduced.

highlights_en.title: Birthday Countdown Ends & Celebration
highlights_en.description: The moment the date changed and she officially celebrated her birthday, she rejoiced with her fans, releasing a burst of happiness accompanied by mass confetti effects.

highlights_en.title: Mini-Update: Kurokami Fubuki Cover Song "Omagatoki no Kaerikata" Release Decided
highlights_en.description: The first announcement revealed that Kurokami Fubuki's cover song, "Omagatoki no Kaerikata," would premiere on October 5th at 20:00 JST.

highlights_en.title: Mini-Notice: Fubuki Kingdom Novel Serialization Starts
highlights_en.description: The second announcement revealed that a novel delving into the world of Fubuki Kingdom will be serialized on the YouTube Community tab. It will include supplementary stories related to the live event.

highlights_en.title: Mini-Reveal: 3D Model Expression Update
highlights_en.description: It was announced that the 3D model's expressions have been updated to be richer, allowing for more comical and nuanced facial movements.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of 3D Live "Meikai Halloween Night" and Guest Introduction
highlights_en.description: The key visual for the birthday 3D Live "Meikai Halloween Night," held from 21:00 JST on October 5th, was revealed along with the guests: Oozora Subaru, Ookami Mio, Nekomata Okayu, Inugami Korone, Takane Lui, Kazama Iroha, Hakos Baelz, and Kazama Iroha.

highlights_en.title: Guessing the 3D Live Guest Silhouettes
highlights_en.description: As parts of the guests' silhouettes were revealed, she guessed who they might be along with the fans, joking that the pointed ears suggested they might be elves.

highlights_en.title: Anecdote of Interaction with YAGOO (Tanigo)
highlights_en.description: A viewer comment brought up the topic of CEO YAGOO. She shared an anecdote about recently meeting him, where he passionately spoke about his dreams for Hololive's 10th anniversary.

highlights_en.title: Birthday Commemorative Rock-Paper-Scissors Tournament
highlights_en.description: She spontaneously challenged the fans to a game of rock-paper-scissors, throwing "Paper" and concluding, "I lost," which drew laughter from the audience. She continued playing rock-paper-scissors by herself afterwards.

highlights_en.title: Song Performance: "Dear My Fave,"
highlights_en.description: She performed her original song, "Dear My Fave," at the end of the birthday stream. Midway through, there was a minor mishap where she disappeared from the screen while adjusting the microphone position.

highlights_en.title: Closing Greetings and Thanks
highlights_en.description: After finishing "Dear My Fave," she once again thanked the fans who attended the birthday countdown stream and encouraged them to watch the cover song release and the 3D live event the next day.

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【PlateUp!】リオニコで仲良く共同作業♥、、、だよなぁ？　【虎金妃笑虎／響咲リオナ@IsakiRiona 】

overview.summary: VTuberの虎金妃笑虎さんと響咲リオナさんによる協力型レストラン経営ゲーム『PlateUp!』のコラボ配信。ステーキ専門店での失敗後、サラダ専門店に切り替えて再挑戦。高難易度の「アップルサラダ」挑戦で再度Day 7クリアに挑むも、調理の複雑さにより早期閉店。シンプルなサラダメニューで仕切り直し、自動オーダーパネルやリラックス効果のあるテーマを導入し効率化を図るが、最終的にDay 6で客の待ち時間が尽き、目標のDay 7クリアは果たせなかった。終始二人の軽快なトークと絶叫が飛び交う、賑やかな配信となった。
overview.mood: 終始賑やかで笑いが絶えない、時折緊迫した雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とオープニングアニメーションの振り返り
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、ゲストの響咲リオナさんと挨拶。猫が大量に出てくる可愛らしいオープニングアニメーションについて触れ、和やかな雰囲気でスタート。

highlights.title: コラボの趣旨説明と「社内恋愛禁止」のルール
highlights.description: 今回のコラボの趣旨であるPlateUp!の紹介と、店内のバイト間の恋愛は禁止であるというルールを冗談交じりに説明。

highlights.title: コラボタグ「リオニコ」を決定
highlights.description: コラボハッシュタグを決め忘れていたことに気づき、響咲リオナさんの提案で「リオニコ」に決定する。

highlights.title: PlateUp!のルール説明と7日目クリアの目標設定
highlights.description: ゲームのルールを改めて確認。虎金妃笑虎さんがソロでは達成できていない7日目クリアを今回のコラボでの目標に設定。

highlights.title: DAY 1 開始！ステーキ提供に挑戦
highlights.description: 初期のレイアウトで1日目がスタート。早速ステーキの注文が入り、二人が連携して調理を開始する。

highlights.title: 最初の注文を焦がし、早くも閉店危機！
highlights.description: 焼き加減を間違えてステーキを焦がし、すぐに提供できなかったため客の忍耐ゲージがゼロになり、初日から閉店の危機を迎える。

highlights.title: DAY 1 終了と売上確認
highlights.description: なんとか1日目を乗り切り閉店。売上は34Gで目標達成。

highlights.title: DAY 2 準備。レイアウト変更で効率化を目指す
highlights.description: 客の回転を上げるため、テーブルの配置を変更し、調理スペースと提供スペースの動線を改善する。

highlights.title: DAY 3 準備。客数が5人に増え、皿洗いが追いつかない
highlights.description: 客数が5人に増えたことで、皿洗いがネックになっていることが判明。調理自体は順調に進む。

highlights.title: DAY 4 準備。星一つを獲得しランクアップ！
highlights.description: 4日目終了時点で星一つを獲得しランクアップ。新しいテーマ選択カードとアップグレードカードが出現する。

highlights.title: 新メニュー「キノコ添え」を追加決定
highlights.description: ランクアップ特典として、難易度は上がるが利益も増える新メニュー「キノコ添え」を選択する。

highlights.title: DAY 5 開始。食器洗い機が活躍するもキッチンは散らかり放題
highlights.description: 食器洗い機を導入したことで皿洗いの手間が軽減されるが、キノコの調理過程で床が散らかり、移動しづらくなる。

highlights.title: DAY 6 準備開始。次のアップグレードを検討
highlights.description: 5日目を無事終了し、次のアップグレードを検討。キッチン内が汚れる問題に対して、床マットの購入を決める。

highlights.title: DAY 6 開始。客の忍耐度が低く、速い調理が求められる
highlights.description: 客の忍耐ゲージが減少するスピードが速くなり、より迅速な調理と提供が求められる状況で、二人は焦りながらも対応する。

highlights.title: 内装デコレーションの追加と店長（ニコタン）への業務指示
highlights.description: フォーマルテーマを選択したことで、内装のデコレーションが可能に。Rionaが店内の床や装飾を整えるが、店長役のNikotanが動線上にアイテムを置き、カオスな状況を楽しむ。

highlights.title: DAY 6 早期閉店（ステーキ専門店終了）
highlights.description: Day 6がスタートするが、準備不足と混乱によりすぐに閉店してしまう。これまでのステーキ専門店でのチャレンジが終了となる。

highlights.title: メニューをサラダに変更し、店名を「NIKORIO SALAD」に
highlights.description: Day 6失敗後、メインメニューをサラダ（レタスとトマト）に変更し、レイアウトを刷新。店名も「NIKORIO SALAD」として仕切り直す。

highlights.title: サラダ専門店 DAY 1 開始：「くさたま」ジョークと「もえもえきゅん」接客
highlights.description: サラダDay 1がスタート。トマトとレタスをカットして提供する簡単な作業に専念。「草とトマト」を意味する「くさたま」というスラングや、Rionaが「もえもえきゅん」接客をするなどの茶番が始まる。

highlights.title: DAY 3 完了で初の★一つを獲得
highlights.description: サラダ店は順調に進みDay 3をクリア。目標だった一つ目の星を獲得し、ランクアップする。

highlights.title: トッピング追加（オリーブ/玉ねぎ）とアップグレードの購入
highlights.description: ランクアップにより、オリーブとタマネギをサラダのトッピングとして追加し難易度を上げることを選択。さらに大皿ラックやシンクなど、作業効率を上げるアップグレードを購入する。

highlights.title: DAY 5 終了で星二つを獲得し、Day 7クリアが見える
highlights.description: Day 5を乗り切り、星二つを獲得。目標であるDay 7クリアが現実的になってくる。従業員数が増えて忙しくなりつつも、順調に利益を上げる。

highlights.title: DAY 7に向けて高難易度メニュー「アップルサラダ」に挑戦
highlights.description: Day 7のクリアを目指し、難易度が非常に高い「アップルサラダ」の追加を決定。リンゴ、ナッツ、オイルが必要となり、調理が大幅に複雑化する。

highlights.title: Day 7開始直前：最終準備と神アイテム「まな板付きカウンター」獲得
highlights.description: Day 7開始直前の準備時間。難易度の高いアップルサラダのために、まな板付きカウンターという超有用なアップグレードを獲得。最後の準備を整える。

highlights.title: DAY 1 開始。ステーキ提供に挑戦
highlights.description: 初期のレイアウトで1日目がスタート。早速ステーキの注文が入り、二人が連携して調理を開始する。

highlights.title: Day 7 挑戦開始。アップルサラダの難易度に大混乱
highlights.description: Day 7を開始。アップルサラダの調理に必要なナッツや卵の扱い方がわからず、キッチンは瞬時に大混乱に陥る。

highlights.title: Day 7 早期閉店と失敗原因の考察
highlights.description: アップルサラダの難易度に圧倒され、Day 7は早期閉店。ナッツの直置きや卵を炒めるべきだったなど、失敗の原因を分析する。

highlights.title: サラダ専門店で再々チャレンジ開始 (Day 1)
highlights.description: シンプルなサラダメニューに戻し、レイアウトを変更して再スタート。Day 1は順調に切り抜ける。

highlights.title: ランクアップ！効率化のためのアップグレードを選択
highlights.description: Day 2, 3を順調にクリアし、ランクアップ。より耐久性の高い食器や、調理効率を上げるアップグレードを選択する。

highlights.title: 神アイテム「オーダーパネル」導入でリモート注文が可能に (Day 5 準備)
highlights.description: 新たなアップグレードとして、客がリモートで注文し、待ち時間のゲージ減少が緩和される「オーダーパネル」を導入。客席にもダイニンテーブルを追加する。

highlights.title: テーマ「アットホーム」に変更し、リラックス効果で待ち時間緩和
highlights.description: Day 6に向けたアップグレードで、客のリラックス効果を狙った「アットホーム」テーマを選択。デコレーションも追加する。

highlights.title: Day 6 開始。客数増加と床の汚れで再び大混乱
highlights.description: Day 6を開始するが、客数が10人に増えたことで調理スペースが混乱。客の待ち時間が尽き、早期閉店となる。

highlights.title: Day 6 早期閉店。二度目のDay 7クリア失敗
highlights.description: Day 7クリアは達成できず、今回のチャレンジはDay 6で終了。新メニュー「ピザ」がアンロックされる。

highlights.title: 新メニュー「ピザ」登場とクロージング
highlights.description: 新たなメインメニューとしてピザが登場。コラボ配信の振り返りとクロージングトークを開始する。

highlights.title: 次回コラボ告知：見守りホラゲーに挑戦
highlights.description: 次回のコラボ配信として、響咲リオナさんのチャンネルにてホラーゲーム『DREAD FLATS』をプレイする企画を告知する。

overview_en.summary: A collaborative stream featuring VTubers Kogane Hikotora and Hibikisaki Riona playing the cooperative restaurant management game 'PlateUp!'. After failing at the steak specialized restaurant, they switched to a salad specialization for a renewed attempt. They challenged the high-difficulty 'Apple Salad' to try for a Day 7 clear again, but the complexity of preparation led to an early closure. They reset with a simpler salad menu, introducing efficiency measures like automatic order panels and relaxing themes, but ultimately, the customers' patience ran out on Day 6, preventing them from achieving the goal of clearing Day 7. The stream was lively throughout, filled with the duo's cheerful banter and occasional shouts.
overview_en.mood: Lively throughout, full of laughter, with occasional moments of tension

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Reflection on the Opening Animation
highlights_en.description: The stream begins with greetings to the guest, Hibikisaki Riona. They mention the cute opening animation featuring many cats, setting a peaceful mood.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of the Collaboration Purpose and the 'No Office Romance' Rule
highlights_en.description: They introduce PlateUp!, the purpose of the collaboration, and jokingly explain the rule prohibiting romance between employees (part-timers) in the restaurant.

highlights_en.title: Collaboration Tag 'Rioniko' Decided
highlights_en.description: Realizing they forgot to set a collaboration hashtag, they decide on 'Rioniko' as proposed by Hibikisaki Riona.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of PlateUp! Rules and Setting the Day 7 Clear Goal
highlights_en.description: They review the game rules. Kogane Hikotora sets the goal for this collaboration as clearing Day 7, a feat she hasn't achieved solo.

highlights_en.title: DAY 1 Start! Challenging Steak Service
highlights_en.description: Day 1 starts with the initial layout. Steak orders immediately come in, and the two begin cooking cooperatively.

highlights_en.title: First Order Burned, Crisis of Early Closure!
highlights_en.description: They mess up the cooking time and burn the steak. Since they couldn't serve it immediately, the customer patience gauge drops to zero, facing an early closure crisis on the very first day.

highlights_en.title: DAY 1 End and Sales Check
highlights_en.description: They somehow manage to survive Day 1 and close the shop. Sales reached 34G, achieving the goal.

highlights_en.title: DAY 2 Preparation. Aiming for Efficiency with Layout Changes
highlights_en.description: To increase customer turnover, they change the table arrangement, improving the flow between the cooking area and the serving area.

highlights_en.title: DAY 3 Preparation. Customer Count Increases to 5, Dishwashing Falls Behind
highlights_en.description: With the customer count increasing to five, dishwashing is identified as a bottleneck. The cooking process itself is proceeding smoothly.

highlights_en.title: DAY 4 Preparation. One Star Acquired and Rank Up!
highlights_en.description: They acquire one star and rank up upon finishing Day 4. New theme selection cards and upgrade cards appear.

highlights_en.title: Decision to Add New Menu Item 'Served with Mushrooms'
highlights_en.description: As a rank-up bonus, they choose the new menu item 'Served with Mushrooms,' which increases profit but also difficulty.

highlights_en.title: DAY 5 Start. Dishwasher Helps, but the Kitchen is a Mess
highlights_en.description: Introducing the dishwasher reduces the burden of cleaning, but the mushroom preparation process creates clutter on the floor, making movement difficult.

highlights_en.title: DAY 6 Preparation Begins. Considering the Next Upgrade
highlights_en.description: After safely finishing Day 5, they consider the next upgrade. They decide to purchase floor mats to address the kitchen dirtiness issue.

highlights_en.title: DAY 6 Start. Low Customer Patience Requires Fast Cooking
highlights_en.description: The speed at which the customer patience gauge decreases accelerates, demanding quicker cooking and serving. The duo responds while feeling rushed.

highlights_en.title: Adding Interior Decorations and Operational Instructions to the Manager (Nikotan)
highlights_en.description: Selecting the Formal theme allows for interior decoration. Riona organizes the floor and decorations, but Nikotan (the manager) enjoys the chaotic situation by placing items in the movement path.

highlights_en.title: DAY 6 Early Closure (Steak Specialty Shop Ends)
highlights_en.description: Day 6 starts, but due to lack of preparation and immediate confusion, they close quickly. The challenge with the steak specialty shop concludes.

highlights_en.title: Changing Menu to Salad and Renaming the Shop 'NIKORIO SALAD'
highlights_en.description: After the Day 6 failure, they change the main menu to salad (lettuce and tomato) and overhaul the layout. They reset the challenge, renaming the shop 'NIKORIO SALAD'.

highlights_en.title: Salad Specialty Shop DAY 1 Start: 'Kusatama' Joke and 'Moe Moe Kyun' Service
highlights_en.description: Salad Day 1 begins. They focus on the simple task of cutting and serving tomatoes and lettuce. Banter starts, including the slang 'Kusatama' (meaning 'grass and tomato') and Riona providing 'Moe Moe Kyun' (cute magical girl style) customer service.

highlights_en.title: First ★ Acquired After Completing DAY 3
highlights_en.description: The salad shop progresses smoothly, clearing Day 3. They achieve the first star goal and rank up.

highlights_en.title: Adding Toppings (Olive/Onion) and Purchasing Upgrades
highlights_en.description: Upon ranking up, they choose to increase the difficulty by adding olives and onions as salad toppings. They also purchase upgrades to boost efficiency, such as a large dish rack and a sink.

highlights_en.title: Two Stars Acquired After Finishing DAY 5, Day 7 Clear Appears Feasible
highlights_en.description: They successfully navigate Day 5 and acquire two stars. Clearing Day 7 seems realistic. Although the increased number of employees makes things busy, profits are rising steadily.

highlights_en.title: Challenging the High-Difficulty Menu 'Apple Salad' for DAY 7
highlights_en.description: Aiming to clear Day 7, they decide to add the highly difficult 'Apple Salad.' This requires apples, nuts, and oil, significantly complicating the preparation.

highlights_en.title: Just Before Day 7 Start: Final Preparations and Obtaining the Divine Item 'Counter with Cutting Board'
highlights_en.description: Preparation time just before the start of Day 7. They acquire the extremely useful upgrade, the 'Counter with Cutting Board,' for the difficult Apple Salad. They finalize the last preparations.

highlights_en.title: DAY 1 Start! Challenging Steak Service
highlights_en.description: Day 1 starts with the initial layout. Steak orders immediately come in, and the two begin cooking cooperatively.

highlights_en.title: Day 7 Challenge Begins. Mass Confusion Over Apple Salad Difficulty
highlights_en.description: Day 7 begins. The kitchen instantly falls into chaos as they don't know how to handle the nuts and eggs required for the Apple Salad preparation.

highlights_en.title: Day 7 Early Closure and Analysis of Failure Causes
highlights_en.description: Overwhelmed by the difficulty of the Apple Salad, Day 7 closes early. They analyze the causes of failure, such as needing to fry the eggs and not placing nuts directly.

highlights_en.title: Salad Specialty Shop Rere-Challenge Starts (Day 1)
highlights_en.description: They return to the simple salad menu, modify the layout, and restart. Day 1 is cleared successfully.

highlights_en.title: Rank Up! Selecting Upgrades for Efficiency
highlights_en.description: Days 2 and 3 are cleared smoothly, leading to a rank up. They choose upgrades for more durable dishes and improved preparation efficiency.

highlights_en.title: Introduction of the Divine Item 'Order Panel' Allowing Remote Ordering (Day 5 Preparation)
highlights_en.description: As a new upgrade, they introduce the 'Order Panel,' which allows customers to order remotely and mitigates the reduction of the waiting time gauge. They also add dining tables to the seating area.

highlights_en.title: Changing Theme to 'Homely' for Relaxation Effect and Waiting Time Mitigation
highlights_en.description: During the upgrade phase for Day 6, they select the 'Homely' theme, aiming for a relaxation effect on customers. Decorations are also added.

highlights_en.title: Day 6 Start. Increased Customer Count and Floor Mess Lead to Chaos Again
highlights_en.description: Day 6 begins, but the increased customer count (up to 10) causes confusion in the preparation area. Customers' waiting time runs out, resulting in an early closure.

highlights_en.title: Day 6 Early Closure. Second Failure to Clear Day 7
highlights_en.description: The goal of clearing Day 7 is not achieved; this challenge ends on Day 6. The new menu item 'Pizza' is unlocked.

highlights_en.title: New Menu 'Pizza' Appears and Closing
highlights_en.description: Pizza appears as a new main menu item. They begin the review and closing talk for the collaborative stream.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Next Collaboration: Challenging a Horror Game
highlights_en.description: They announce the next collaborative stream plan on Hibikisaki Riona's channel, where they will play the horror game 'DREAD FLATS'.

title: WOW Chill Malming Guys

overview.summary: ホロライブIDのリス・アユンダが、まったりとくつろぐ夜の雑談＆パズルゲーム配信を実施しました。前半はFishieのビーチキャビンの装飾を完了させ、「Master Organizer」の称号を獲得しました。中盤では、物語が進展し、祖父であるアインスマート博士が所有していた荒廃した家を訪れ、隠されたタイムポータルを発見。過去の散らかった家を整理するというミッションに取り組みました。終盤では、祖父の家の片付けを完了させて「Greek god of getting things done」の称号を獲得した後、タイムポータルで再度現在に戻り、祖父の家が過去の整理によって変化したことを確認しました。その後、街のバーでミニゲームに挑戦し、さらにSageからの新たな依頼（チャイナタウンのチェスルームの片付け）を受け取り、リスナーへ感謝を伝え配信を終えました。
overview.mood: リラックスして穏やか

highlights.title: 雑談：ソニックレーシング大会での2位入賞を報告
highlights.description: 配信直前に行われたソニックレーシングの大会で2位を獲得したことを報告。練習に時間をかけた甲斐があったと喜び、リスナーからの祝福のコメントに感謝を述べた。

highlights.title: ソニックレーシングへの熱中ぶりとリスナーとの絆
highlights.description: 大会での勝利のために、ゲームのビルドや設定を徹底的に研究・調整したことを語る。リスナーはリスが真剣にゲームに取り組んでいる姿勢を評価し、その"ゲーマースキル"が向上していることを称賛した。

highlights.title: 今後の配信方針：学業とゲーム実況の両立
highlights.description: 学業（宿題）があるため、しばらくは1日1回のチル配信（まったりとしたゲーム配信）を続ける予定だと説明。リスナーはリスの学業への努力を応援しつつ、ゲームの続きを期待した。

highlights.title: パズルゲーム『Whisper of the House』開始
highlights.description: 15分間の雑談パートを終え、チルゲームとしてドット絵のパズルゲーム『Whisper of the House』を開始。まずは最初の部屋を探索する。

highlights.title: 最初の部屋の探索：IH犬のギミック発見
highlights.description: リビングルームの探索を開始。部屋にはホロメンをモチーフにしたアイテムがいくつかあり、IH犬のぬいぐるみを使った隠しギミックを発見した。

highlights.title: パン屋の部屋でBGMに合わせて即興歌唱
highlights.description: マップを探索し、パン屋の部屋（Baking Room）へ。パンを焼くアクションを試しながら、BGMに合わせた即興の歌（替え歌）を披露し、リスナーを和ませた。

highlights.title: 魔女の部屋の謎解き（調合パート）開始
highlights.description: 謎のハーブ研究室（Herbs Lab）を発見。部屋には様々な材料とレシピが書かれたノートがあり、ポーション調合の謎解きを開始した。

highlights.title: 調合のレシピを解読し、花火を作成
highlights.description: ノートに書かれたレシピを確認し、調合の材料を特定。Moonflower, Mercury Thistle, Silverleaf Infusionをポーションに入れて花火(Firework)を完成させた。

highlights.title: 隠し部屋のワープゾーンを起動し、Ianを救出
highlights.description: 調合した花火を使い、鏡の隠し部屋「Subspace」のワープゾーンを起動。そこに閉じ込められていたIanを救出した。

highlights.title: 街中でのアイテム収集（ニューズスタンド）
highlights.description: Ianを救出した後、ゲーム内の街を探索。ニューズスタンドでアイテムボックスを購入し、ゲームコントローラーを獲得した。

highlights.title: アイテム収集：コンビニエンスストア
highlights.description: 次にコンビニエンスストアを探索。ここでもアイテムボックスを購入し、「Spider Web（クモの巣）」というアイテムを獲得した。

highlights.title: ビーチと灯台周辺の探索とNPCとの会話
highlights.description: ビーチと桟橋を探索し、釣り人のゴードンや、寂しい島にいる遭難者（？）と出会う。遭難者から「Voucher x 500」を受け取る。

highlights.title: 街中でのアイテム収集（ローズウッドの靴棚、サボテンなど）
highlights.description: メインタウンに戻り、警察署付近で「Rosewood Shoe Bench」、教会の墓地周辺で「Spider Web」「Spineless Cactus」、そして「Notebook」を発見し、アイテムをコレクションする。

highlights.title: コンビニエンスストアの在庫陳列を開始
highlights.description: コンビニエンスストア（No. 8 Convenience Store Pro）に入り、商品の陳列作業を開始。冷蔵ケース内のミルク、ヨーグルト、ソーダなどの飲料を棚に並べる。

highlights.title: 食品アイテムの陳列（おにぎり、サンドイッチなど）
highlights.description: おにぎり（Kitten Onigiri）、サンドイッチ、お弁当などの食品アイテムを陳列し、在庫の隙間を埋めていく。

highlights.title: アルコール飲料の補充と冗談
highlights.description: ウォッカなどのアルコール飲料を補充。リスナーはボトルが冷蔵庫に入っていないことに言及し、リスは「アルコールだからね！」と返す。

highlights.title: スナックやキャンディ、洗剤の陳列
highlights.description: その他の棚にキャンディ、ガム、海藻、洗剤、化粧品、生理用品など多岐にわたる商品を陳列。陳列中はリスナーと和やかに雑談を続ける。

highlights.title: コンビニエンスストアの拡張計画完了
highlights.description: 全ての棚に商品を陳列し終わり、「Expansion Plan」のタスクを完了。報酬としてVoucher x 150とEXP 50を獲得し、「Excellent!」の評価を得る。

highlights.title: Fishieの海辺のキャビンに移動
highlights.description: コンビニエンスストアのタスクを終え、再びFishieの海辺のキャビンに戻る。Fishieは過去を懐かしみ、少し落ち込んだ様子を見せる。

highlights.title: キャビンの秘密の地下室を発見
highlights.description: バスルームの浴槽から隠された「Secret Base」を発見。水中に入り、青いクラゲ（？）や巨大なタコの謎のオブジェと出会う。

highlights.title: 記憶を失った魚人Finlordとの会話
highlights.description: 水中の装置に閉じ込められた魚人のキャラクター「Finlord」と出会う。彼は過去の記憶を失っており、Risuは彼を助けるための次のタスク（Fishieの引越し手伝い）を受ける。

highlights.title: Fishieのキャビンの整理と装飾を開始
highlights.description: Fishieのキャビンに戻り、部屋の整理と装飾に取り掛かる。古びたノートや、おもちゃ、アルバムなどを見つけ、棚や家具に配置していく。

highlights.title: 落書きノートからT-Rexの絵を発見
highlights.description: Fishieの古いノートを開くと、彼が描いたと思われる雑多な落書きと、リアルなT-Rexの絵が描かれているのを発見する。

highlights.title: 海辺のキャビンをマリンテイストに装飾
highlights.description: 棚に海洋生物のアルバムや船舶の舵を模したダーツボード、貝殻のランプなどを飾り付け、部屋を海辺のキャビンらしいマリンテイストに整える。

highlights.title: 続けてシーサイドキャビンの装飾を進める
highlights.description: ゲームのカートリッジ、貝殻の椅子、ビーチパラソル、ビーチサンダルなどを配置し、リゾート感あふれる空間を作る。

highlights.title: ピクニックバスケットと釣具の配置
highlights.description: 外のデッキにピクニックバスケットや水筒、釣具の入ったタックルボックスを追加し、さらにくつろげる空間にカスタマイズする。

highlights.title: フィギュアとメモラビリアの配置
highlights.description: フィッシュの家のテーマに合わせて、カメのフィギュアやマンボウのフィギュア、そして彼が発明したと思われる機器などを棚に飾る。

highlights.title: Fishieの自宅装飾クエスト完了
highlights.description: 家具の配置、模様替えのタスクを完了させ、依頼人であるFishieから「Excellent!」の評価を獲得した。

highlights.title: 祖父アインスマートの荒廃した家を発見
highlights.description: 次は祖父であるアインスマートの自宅へ。家は荒れ果て、植物が生い茂っている状態になっていた。

highlights.title: タイムカプセルを発見し、過去へ飛ぶ
highlights.description: 庭に埋められていたタイムカプセルを発見。中にはアインスマートからの手紙と、過去の家へ移動できるタイムポータルのボタンが入っていた。

highlights.title: ロフトリビングルーム（クリーンアップ開始）
highlights.description: 過去の家に到着。ここはRisuが配信で使用していた自室のようなロフトリビングルームで、部屋はギフトボックスで埋め尽くされていた。

highlights.title: 大量の家具ガチャギフトボックスを開封
highlights.description: 「家具ガチャ」から送られてきた大量のギフトボックスを開封し、家具や雑貨（魚のオブジェ、ケーキなど）を次々と獲得する。

highlights.title: 使わないアイテムを地下のストレージへ移動
highlights.description: リビングルームの家具を配置し、使いきれない大量のギフトボックスや不要なアイテムを地下のストレージルームに移動させる。

highlights.title: フィッシュタンクとラウンジエリアの設置
highlights.description: リビングエリアに魚をモチーフにしたフィッシュタンク、レザーのラウンジチェアなどを配置し、モダンな空間を作る。

highlights.title: シーサイドキャビンの最終調整
highlights.description: 再びフィッシュのキャビンに戻り、ハンモックやテレビ、寝具の最終的な配置を調整し、完璧なリゾートキャビンを完成させた。

highlights.title: 街のメテオバーでタロット占いに挑戦
highlights.description: 街のバーに移動し、タロット占いができるNPCと会話。今月のフリータイムを楽しめるかという質問に、大アルカナ「愚者」「女帝」「悪魔」のカードが出た。

highlights.title: カクテル作りのミニゲームに挑戦
highlights.description: バーテンダーとしてカクテル作りミニゲームに挑戦。ライムジュースやジンジャービア、ブランデーなどを組み合わせてオリジナルカクテルを作る。

highlights.title: 祖父の家（過去）での片付けを完了
highlights.description: 過去の祖父の家に戻り、残りの散らかったアイテム（手の石鹸、ナッツ、牛乳カルシウム錠剤、洋服など）の片付けを完了させた。

highlights.title: 祖父の家の片付け完了と報酬獲得（Excellent!）
highlights.description: 全ての片付けタスクが完了し、「Excellent! You're basically the Greek god of getting things done」の称号とVoucher x 500、EXP 50を獲得。

highlights.title: タイムポータルを起動し、祖父のラボへ移動
highlights.description: タイムポータルを起動して、祖父アインスマートが働いていたサイバーパンク風のラボへ移動。そこにはギロチンや科学的な装置が置かれている。

highlights.title: ロボットMark V1.0と遭遇し、バスカードを獲得
highlights.description: ラボ内でロボットMark V1.0と遭遇。「バスカードを見つけたか？」と聞かれ、見つけるとバスの利用が可能になる「Bus Card」のアイテムを獲得した。

highlights.title: 現在に戻り、荒廃した家が変化していることを確認
highlights.description: タイムポータルで現在に戻ると、家は荒れ果てた状態ではあるが、祖父が元気な姿（車椅子）で座っており、過去の行動が現在に影響を与えたことが示唆された。

highlights.title: 過去に戻り、寝ている祖父とシェフMarkに遭遇
highlights.description: 再度タイムポータルで過去の祖父の家に戻る。祖父がソファで寝ており、シェフMark（ロボット）がスープの塩分濃度をチェックしているのを発見。

highlights.title: 街へ移動し、Sageからの次の依頼を確認
highlights.description: マップに戻り、ジャーナリストのSageからチャイナタウンにあるチェスルームの片付けを依頼する手紙を受け取る。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶と感謝
highlights.description: ゲームをセーブした後、リスナーに向けて感謝のメッセージを伝える。運動の話題や健康的なライフスタイルについての雑談を交わしつつ、配信を締めくくる。

ルームデコレーション

overview_en.summary: Hololive ID's Risu Ayunda conducted a relaxed, cozy evening stream featuring chatting and a puzzle game. In the first half, she completed the decoration of Fishie's beach cabin, earning the title "Master Organizer." In the middle, the story progressed, leading her to visit the dilapidated house owned by her grandfather, Dr. Einsmart, where she discovered a hidden time portal. She then tackled the mission of organizing the cluttered house in the past. In the final stage, after finishing the cleanup of her grandfather's house and receiving the title "Greek god of getting things done," she returned to the present via the time portal and confirmed that the house had changed due to her past efforts. She concluded the stream by attempting a mini-game at a city bar, receiving a new request from Sage (to clean up a chess room in Chinatown), and expressing gratitude to her viewers.
overview_en.mood: Relaxed and calm

highlights_en.title: Chat: Reporting 2nd Place in the Sonic Racing Tournament
highlights_en.description: She reported achieving 2nd place in the Sonic Racing tournament held just before the stream. She expressed joy that the time spent practicing was worth it and thanked viewers for their congratulatory comments.

highlights_en.title: Passion for Sonic Racing and Bond with Viewers
highlights_en.description: She talked about thoroughly researching and adjusting the game's builds and settings for the tournament win. Viewers praised Risu's serious commitment to the game and complimented her improving "gamer skills."

highlights_en.title: Future Streaming Policy: Balancing Academics and Gaming Streams
highlights_en.description: She explained that due to academic work (homework), she plans to continue with one chill stream (relaxed gaming stream) per day for a while. Viewers supported Risu's efforts in her studies while looking forward to the continuation of the game.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Puzzle Game 'Whisper of the House'
highlights_en.description: After finishing the 15-minute chat segment, she started the pixel art puzzle game 'Whisper of the House' as a chill game. She begins by exploring the first room.

highlights_en.title: Exploring the First Room: Discovering the IH Dog Gimmick
highlights_en.description: She started exploring the living room. The room contained several items modeled after Holomem, and she discovered a hidden gimmick involving an IH dog plushie.

highlights_en.title: Impromptu Singing to the BGM in the Bakery Room
highlights_en.description: Exploring the map, she entered the Baking Room. While trying out the bread-baking action, she performed an impromptu song (a parody song) along with the BGM, entertaining the viewers.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Witch's Room Puzzle (Alchemy Segment)
highlights_en.description: She discovered the mysterious Herbs Lab. The room contained various ingredients and a recipe notebook, leading her to begin the potion mixing puzzle.

highlights_en.title: Deciphering the Alchemy Recipe and Creating a Firework
highlights_en.description: She checked the recipe written in the notebook and identified the ingredients for the mixture. She completed a Firework by adding Moonflower, Mercury Thistle, and Silverleaf Infusion to the potion.

highlights_en.title: Activating the Hidden Room's Warp Zone and Rescuing Ian
highlights_en.description: Using the completed firework, she activated the warp zone in the mirrored hidden room "Subspace." She rescued Ian, who was trapped there.

highlights_en.title: Item Collection in Town (Newsstand)
highlights_en.description: After rescuing Ian, she explored the town in the game. She purchased an item box at the newsstand and obtained a game controller.

highlights_en.title: Item Collection: Convenience Store
highlights_en.description: Next, she explored the convenience store. Here too, she purchased an item box and acquired an item called "Spider Web."

highlights_en.title: Exploring the Beach and Lighthouse Area and Talking to NPCs
highlights_en.description: She explored the beach and pier, meeting the fisherman Gordon and a castaway (?) on a lonely island. She received "Voucher x 500" from the castaway.

highlights_en.title: Item Collection in Town (Rosewood Shoe Bench, Cactus, etc.)
highlights_en.description: Returning to the main town, she discovered a "Rosewood Shoe Bench" near the police station, "Spider Web," "Spineless Cactus," and a "Notebook" near the church cemetery, adding them to her collection.

highlights_en.title: Starting Stock Display at the Convenience Store
highlights_en.description: She entered the convenience store (No. 8 Convenience Store Pro) and began stocking the shelves. She arranged beverages like milk, yogurt, and soda from the refrigerated cases onto the shelves.

highlights_en.title: Arranging Food Items (Onigiri, Sandwiches, etc.)
highlights_en.description: She arranged food items such as Onigiri (Kitten Onigiri), sandwiches, and bento boxes, filling the gaps in the inventory.

highlights_en.title: Restocking Alcoholic Beverages and Making a Joke
highlights_en.description: She restocked alcoholic beverages like vodka. Viewers noted that the bottles weren't refrigerated, and Risu responded, "Because it's alcohol!"

highlights_en.title: Arranging Snacks, Candy, and Detergent
highlights_en.description: She arranged a wide variety of products on other shelves, including candy, gum, seaweed, detergent, cosmetics, and sanitary products. She continued chatting pleasantly with viewers while stocking.

highlights_en.title: Convenience Store Expansion Plan Completed
highlights_en.description: She finished stocking all the shelves and completed the "Expansion Plan" task. She received a reward of Voucher x 150 and EXP 50, earning an "Excellent!" rating.

highlights_en.title: Moving to Fishie's Seaside Cabin
highlights_en.description: Finishing the convenience store task, she returned to Fishie's seaside cabin. Fishie showed signs of nostalgia and slight sadness about the past.

highlights_en.title: Discovering the Cabin's Secret Basement
highlights_en.description: She discovered a hidden "Secret Base" via the bathroom bathtub. She entered the water and encountered mysterious objects like blue jellyfish (?) and a giant octopus.

highlights_en.title: Conversation with Finlord, the Merman Who Lost His Memory
highlights_en.description: She met the merman character "Finlord," trapped in an underwater device. He had lost his memories, and Risu accepted the next task (helping Fishie move) to assist him.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Organization and Decoration of Fishie's Cabin
highlights_en.description: Returning to Fishie's cabin, she began organizing and decorating the room. She found old notebooks, toys, and albums, placing them on shelves and furniture.

highlights_en.title: Discovering a T-Rex Drawing in the Doodle Notebook
highlights_en.description: Opening Fishie's old notebook, she found random doodles and a realistic drawing of a T-Rex, presumably drawn by him.

highlights_en.title: Decorating the Seaside Cabin in a Marine Style
highlights_en.description: She decorated the shelves with albums of marine life, a dartboard modeled after a ship's wheel, and seashell lamps, giving the room a marine aesthetic fitting a seaside cabin.

highlights_en.title: Continuing the Decoration of the Seaside Cabin
highlights_en.description: She arranged game cartridges, a seashell chair, a beach umbrella, and beach sandals to create a resort-like atmosphere.

highlights_en.title: Placing a Picnic Basket and Fishing Gear
highlights_en.description: She added a picnic basket, a canteen, and a tackle box containing fishing gear to the outside deck, further customizing the space for relaxation.

highlights_en.title: Arranging Figures and Memorabilia
highlights_en.description: Following the theme of Fishie's house, she displayed turtle figures, sunfish figures, and devices presumably invented by him on the shelves.

highlights_en.title: Fishie's Home Decoration Quest Completed
highlights_en.description: She completed the furniture arrangement and redecorating tasks, receiving an "Excellent!" rating from the client, Fishie.

highlights_en.title: Discovering Grandfather Einsmart's Dilapidated House
highlights_en.description: Next, she headed to the home of her grandfather, Einsmart. The house was desolate and overgrown with plants.

highlights_en.title: Discovering a Time Capsule and Jumping to the Past
highlights_en.description: She discovered a time capsule buried in the garden. Inside were a letter from Einsmart and a button for a time portal that could transport her to the house in the past.

highlights_en.title: Loft Living Room (Cleanup Starts)
highlights_en.description: She arrived at the house in the past. It was a loft living room, similar to Risu's room used for streaming, and the space was filled with gift boxes.

highlights_en.title: Unboxing Massive Amounts of Furniture Gacha Gift Boxes
highlights_en.description: She unboxed a large quantity of gift boxes sent from the "Furniture Gacha," acquiring furniture and various items (fish sculptures, cakes, etc.) one after another.

highlights_en.title: Moving Unused Items to the Underground Storage
highlights_en.description: She arranged the furniture in the living room and moved the vast number of excess gift boxes and unwanted items to the underground storage room.

highlights_en.title: Installing a Fish Tank and Lounge Area
highlights_en.description: She placed a fish-themed fish tank and leather lounge chairs in the living area, creating a modern space.

highlights_en.title: Final Adjustments to the Seaside Cabin
highlights_en.description: She returned to Fishie's cabin to make final adjustments to the placement of the hammock, TV, and bedding, completing the perfect resort cabin.

highlights_en.title: Trying Tarot Reading at the City's Meteor Bar
highlights_en.description: She moved to a bar in the city and spoke with an NPC who could do tarot readings. In response to the question of whether she would enjoy her free time this month, the Major Arcana cards 'The Fool,' 'The Empress,' and 'The Devil' appeared.

highlights_en.title: Trying the Cocktail Making Mini-Game
highlights_en.description: She attempted the cocktail-making mini-game as a bartender. She mixed lime juice, ginger beer, brandy, and other ingredients to create an original cocktail.

highlights_en.title: Cleanup Completed at Grandfather's House (Past)
highlights_en.description: Returning to her grandfather's house in the past, she completed the cleanup of the remaining cluttered items (hand soap, nuts, milk calcium tablets, clothes, etc.).

highlights_en.title: Grandfather's House Cleanup Completed and Reward Received (Excellent!)
