highlights_en.description: Deploys the RC-XD scorestreak, attempting to break the enemy's defense, but the effect is limited.

highlights_en.title: Domination Match Defeat and Re-evaluation of the AR
highlights_en.description: The match ends in a 161 to 200 defeat. She reconfirms the difficulty of using an SMG on this map and values the stability of the AR.

highlights_en.title: Kill Confirmed Start (Map: Forge/Office)
highlights_en.description: Starts Kill Confirmed again on the map "Forge," using the AR "M15 MOD 0."

highlights_en.title: Quad Kill on the Stairs
highlights_en.description: Achieves an impressive feat, taking down four enemies consecutively on the building staircase, but fails to collect the kill tags.

highlights_en.title: Mouse Escaping Issue Recurs
highlights_en.description: The issue of the mouse cursor escaping the screen recurs during intense combat. She mentions the possibility of using fullscreen settings.

highlights_en.title: Switching to SMG Loadout
highlights_en.description: To change the flow, she switches to an SMG loadout, strong in close quarters, attempting indoor combat.

highlights_en.title: Consecutive Kills with SMG in Indoor Combat
highlights_en.description: Utilizes the SMG's strength to achieve consecutive kills in indoor engagements. Struggles on despite the mouse issue.

highlights_en.title: Kill Confirmed Victory and Belly-Up Reload
highlights_en.description: Wins 75 to 59. The highlight reel shows an enemy player's unique "belly-up reload" animation.

highlights_en.title: Next Stream Schedule and Farewell
highlights_en.description: Concludes the current stream and announces the schedule for upcoming streams (Atelier Marie).

highlights_en.title: Handprints and Post-Moving Room Status
highlights_en.description: Mentions that the room shown on stream is clean and lacks the "Binda" (handprint/running gag) that was on the window in previous streams. Interacts with viewers who hope the Binda returns.

highlights_en.title: Mentioning the Timing of the SSRB General Meeting
highlights_en.description: In response to a viewer question, she states that the SSRB General Meeting (member-exclusive stream) is tentatively scheduled for mid-October or later, once more information is available, or perhaps starting next week.

highlights_en.title: Episode of Ookami Mio's Professional-Level Cooking
highlights_en.description: Shares a cooking episode with Holomembers, expressing surprise at Ookami Mio's naturally high cooking skills and her ability to quickly prepare even dessert.

highlights_en.title: Windows 11 Installation on New PC and Game Titles
highlights_en.description: Mentions that installing Windows 11 on her new PC was good timing, as it aligns with CoD's security requirements. She also expresses interest in Pokémon ZA.

highlights_en.title: Final Greetings and Next Stream Announcement
highlights_en.description: Once again thanks the viewers, announces the next stream (Atelier Marie), and concludes the broadcast.

title: 【世界のアソビ大全51】ハローボー！ようこそフレア邸へ！オフコラボで遊ぼう【不知火フレア/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 不知火フレアとロボ子さんのオフコラボ後半戦では、カードゲームと対戦ゲームに挑戦。ブラックジャックでは、ディーラーとCPU相手にロボ子さんが序盤好調を維持するも、終盤リスクを取りすぎてしまい大幅な借金を抱えてしまう展開に。その後、ビリヤード（9ボール）やエアホッケーといった対戦ゲームに移行。ビリヤードではルール確認に手間取りながらも、フレアが最終的な勝利を収め、続くエアホッケーでは互角の激しい戦いを制し、最終的にフレアが勝利を飾りました。ロボ子さんの圧倒的な頭脳と、フレアの粘り強さが光るゲーム対決となりました。
overview.mood: 楽しく、時に悲鳴が上がる、白熱の対決

highlights.title: オフコラボ開始！誰がポンコツかを賭ける？
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶。フレアとロボ子さんが今回のオフコラボについて語り合い、誰がポンコツになるかを冗談交じりに話し合う。

highlights.title: 【リバーシ】頭脳戦で圧倒されるフレア
highlights.description: 最初のゲームはリバーシ。Joy-Conを横持ちでプレイ。ロボ子さんが序盤から角を取り、優位に進める。フレアは「リバーシ嫌い！」と叫びながら、ロボ子さんの強さに驚きを見せる。

highlights.title: ロボ子、リバーシ勝利で早速パイナップルを要求
highlights.description: リバーシ対決終了。ロボ子さんが35対28で勝利し、フレアは「ポンコツは私だ」と認め、ロボ子さんにパイナップルを要求する。

highlights.title: 【五目ならべ】ロボ子さんの早すぎる勝利
highlights.description: 続いて五目並べを開始。フレアは得意だと意気込むが、開始直後ロボ子さんが斜めに五目並べを完成させ即勝利。

highlights.title: 【ヒット＆ブロー】色の特定に成功、3ターンで圧勝！
highlights.description: 推理ゲーム「ヒット＆ブロー」に挑戦。色の種類と順番を当てるゲーム。ロボ子さんはわずか3ターン目で正解を導き出し、フレアを驚かせる。

highlights.title: 【ヒット＆ブロー】2戦目もロボ子さんが勝利
highlights.description: ヒット＆ブロー2戦目。今度はフレアが回答者となるが、難解な推理に苦戦。対してロボ子さんは冷静に推理を進め、このゲームもロボ子さんが制する。

highlights.title: 【ヨット】高得点を目指すダイスゲーム
highlights.description: ダイスゲーム「ヨット」を開始。役を作って高得点を目指す。ロボ子さんは序盤から順調に点数を稼ぎ、上段ボーナスを狙う。

highlights.title: フレア、惜しくもボーナス点を逃す
highlights.description: フレアは上段ボーナス (63点) 獲得を目指すが、わずかに届かず (59点)。ロボ子さんはボーナスを獲得し、差が広がる。

highlights.title: 【ヨット】フレアがヨットを出すも、ロボ子が総合勝利
highlights.description: フレアが最後のターンで「ヨット」を出すも時すでに遅し。最終的にロボ子さんが246点対125点で勝利を収める。

highlights.title: 最終ゲームはコネクトフォー
highlights.description: 二人は敗北にめげず、さらにコネクトフォーをプレイすることに決定する。

highlights.title: 【ブラックジャック】ロボコの賭け金管理とフレアのミス
highlights.description: ブラックジャック開始。Robocoは堅実な賭け方で勝ちを重ねるが、フレアは大胆なプレイでコインを失う。

highlights.title: ロボコがバーストでフレアが初勝利！
highlights.description: フレアが17でスタンドしたのに対し、ロボコがバースト。フレアが初めてブラックジャックで勝利し、喜びの声を上げる。

highlights.title: ロボコ「僕の勝ち！」 vs ディーラーの安定感
highlights.description: ロボコは調子を取り戻すが、ディーラーも強く、互いにコインを削り合う展開に。

highlights.title: ロボコ、ダブルダウンで大量にバースト！
highlights.description: ロボコがリスクの高いダブルダウンを選んだ結果、カードを引きすぎてバースト。コインを大幅に失う。

highlights.title: ディーラーがブラックジャックでロボコ瀕死
highlights.description: ディーラーが21を出し、ロボコは持っていた全ての賭け金を失い、残りコインがわずかになる。

highlights.title: ディーラーバースト！フレアが大量コイン獲得で復活
highlights.description: ディーラーがバーストしたことで、フレアが賭け金を倍増させていたスポットで勝利し、一気にコインを回復させる。

highlights.title: ファイナルラウンド：ロボコ借金がマイナス494に到達
highlights.description: ロボコが意地で大金（持ちコイン以上）を賭け続けるが、連続でバースト。最終的に-494の借金でゲーム終了となる。

highlights.title: ブラックジャック最終結果発表：ロボコ借金確定
highlights.description: 最終リザルト画面。フレアは0コインで終了し、ロボコは-494コインで大敗を喫する。

highlights.title: 【ビリヤード】初の9ボールに挑戦
highlights.description: 次のゲームはビリヤード（9ボール）。ロボコは初めてプレイすると話し、ルールをざっくり確認しながらスタート。

highlights.title: ロボコ、白球を落としてしまいファールが続く
highlights.description: ルールを把握しきれず、ロボコが白球をポケットに入れてしまいファールを連発。フレアが運良く有利な配置を得る。

highlights.title: ロボコ、4番ボールをポケットイン！
highlights.description: 序盤から勢いに乗ったロボコが4番ボールを難なくポケットに入れ、調子を取り戻す。

highlights.title: ロボコ、意図せず8番ボールを角に寄せてしまう
highlights.description: 狙いすぎてしまった結果、8番ボールがポケット近くに張り付く配置にしてしまい、フレアに攻められやすくなる。

highlights.title: ロボコのミスを活かし、フレアが9ボールポケットで勝利！
highlights.description: ロボコが最後に9番ボールをポケットに入れ損ない、フレアがその隙を突いて9番ボールをポケットに入れ、ビリヤードに勝利。

highlights.title: 【エアホッケー】ポンコツ同士のガチバトル開始
highlights.description: 最後のゲームはエアホッケー。ロボコはエアホッケーでも実力を発揮し、フレアに対してリードを広げる。

highlights.title: 7-9でマッチポイント！ロボコが勝利目前
highlights.description: ロボコが安定して得点を重ね、7-9でマッチポイントを迎える。フレアは追い詰められる。

highlights.title: フレアが土壇場で追い上げ同点に！
highlights.description: フレアが粘りを見せ、9-9まで追いつき、試合は最高潮の盛り上がりを見せる。

highlights.title: フレアの逆転勝利でゲームセット！
highlights.description: 最終盤の攻防を制し、フレアが10-9で勝利。ロボコは「ズルい！」と叫び、笑いながら終了。

highlights.title: 全ゲームの勝敗を確認し、エンディングトークへ
highlights.description: 勝敗を振り返り、フレアが僅差で総合勝利を収めたことを確認。ロボコは「山登り」の企画への意気込みを見せる。

highlights.title: 次のコラボ企画への言及
highlights.description: ロボコが次回の山登りコラボについて触れる。視聴者への感謝を伝え、オフコラボは終了。

overview_en.summary: In the latter half of Shiranui Flare and Roboco-san's offline collaboration, they challenged card games and competitive games. In Blackjack, Roboco-san maintained good form early against the dealer and CPU, but took too much risk late in the game, ending up with significant debt. They then moved on to competitive games like Billiards (9-Ball) and Air Hockey. In Billiards, after struggling with rule confirmation, Flare ultimately secured the victory. In the subsequent Air Hockey match, Flare won a fierce, even battle, claiming the final victory. This game showdown highlighted Roboco-san's overwhelming intellect and Flare's tenacity.
overview_en.mood: Fun, sometimes screaming, heated showdown

highlights_en.title: Offline Collaboration Starts! Betting on who will be the clumsy one?
highlights_en.description: Opening greetings for the stream. Flare and Roboco-san discuss the collaboration, jokingly talking about who will end up being the clumsy one (ponkotsu).

highlights_en.title: [Reversi] Flare overwhelmed in a battle of wits
highlights_en.description: The first game is Reversi. Played using Joy-Cons held sideways. Roboco-san takes the corners early and gains an advantage. Flare shouts 'I hate Reversi!' and expresses surprise at Roboco-san's strength.

highlights_en.title: Roboco immediately demands a pineapple after winning Reversi
highlights_en.description: Reversi match ends. Roboco-san wins 35 to 28, and Flare admits 'I'm the clumsy one,' leading Roboco-san to request a pineapple.

highlights_en.title: [Gomoku] Roboco-san's too quick victory
highlights_en.description: Next, they start Gomoku (Five in a Row). Flare is enthusiastic, claiming it's her specialty, but immediately after starting, Roboco-san completes five in a diagonal line and wins instantly.

highlights_en.title: [Hit & Blow] Successfully identifying the colors, overwhelming victory in 3 turns!
highlights_en.description: They challenge the deduction game 'Hit & Blow.' A game of guessing the color types and order. Roboco-san finds the correct answer in just 3 turns, surprising Flare.

highlights_en.title: [Hit & Blow] Roboco-san wins the second match too
highlights_en.description: The second match of Hit & Blow. This time Flare is the guesser but struggles with the difficult deduction. In contrast, Roboco-san proceeds calmly with her deductions and wins this game as well.

highlights_en.title: [Yacht] Dice game aiming for a high score
highlights_en.description: They start the dice game 'Yacht.' The goal is to make combinations and aim for a high score. Roboco-san steadily accumulates points from the start, aiming for the upper section bonus.

highlights_en.title: Flare narrowly misses the bonus points
highlights_en.description: Flare aims to achieve the upper section bonus (63 points) but narrowly misses it (59 points). Roboco-san earns the bonus, widening the gap.

highlights_en.title: [Yacht] Flare rolls a Yacht, but Roboco takes the overall victory
highlights_en.description: Flare rolls a 'Yacht' on her final turn, but it's too late. Roboco-san ultimately wins the game 246 points to 125.

highlights_en.title: The final game is Connect Four
highlights_en.description: Despite the loss, the two decide to continue playing Connect Four.

highlights_en.title: [Blackjack] Roboco's wager management and Flare's mistakes
highlights_en.description: Blackjack begins. Roboco steadily wins by betting conservatively, while Flare loses coins due to aggressive play.

highlights_en.title: Roboco busts, and Flare secures her first win!
highlights_en.description: Flare stands on 17, while Roboco busts. Flare wins in Blackjack for the first time and shouts with joy.

highlights_en.title: Roboco 'My win!' vs The Dealer's stability
highlights_en.description: Roboco regains her momentum, but the dealer is strong, leading to a situation where they constantly chip away at each other's coins.

highlights_en.title: Roboco doubles down and busts significantly!
highlights_en.description: Roboco chooses a risky double down, resulting in drawing too many cards and busting. She loses a significant amount of coins.

highlights_en.title: Dealer gets Blackjack, crippling Roboco
highlights_en.description: The dealer hits 21, causing Roboco to lose all her current wagers, leaving her with only a few remaining coins.

highlights_en.title: Dealer busts! Flare revives by gaining a large amount of coins
highlights_en.description: Because the dealer busted, Flare wins at a spot where she had doubled her bet, rapidly recovering her coin total.

highlights_en.title: Final Round: Roboco's debt reaches -494
highlights_en.description: Roboco stubbornly continues to wager large amounts (more than her current coins) but busts repeatedly. The game ends with a final debt of -494.

highlights_en.title: Blackjack Final Results Announcement: Roboco's debt confirmed
highlights_en.description: The final results screen. Flare finishes with 0 coins, while Roboco suffers a devastating loss with -494 coins.

highlights_en.title: [Billiards] Challenging 9-Ball for the first time
highlights_en.description: The next game is Billiards (9-Ball). Roboco mentions she's playing for the first time, and they start after a rough check of the rules.

highlights_en.title: Roboco pockets the cue ball, leading to continuous fouls
highlights_en.description: Unable to grasp the rules fully, Roboco continuously commits fouls by pocketing the cue ball. Flare fortunately gains advantageous positions.

highlights_en.title: Roboco pockets the 4-ball!
highlights_en.description: Riding the early momentum, Roboco effortlessly pockets the 4-ball and regains her rhythm.

highlights_en.title: Roboco unintentionally leaves the 8-ball near the corner pocket
highlights_en.description: Aiming too aggressively results in leaving the 8-ball stuck near the pocket, making it easier for Flare to attack.

highlights_en.title: Capitalizing on Roboco's mistake, Flare pockets the 9-ball for the win!
highlights_en.description: Roboco fails to pocket the 9-ball at the end, and Flare takes advantage of the opportunity to pocket the 9-ball and win the game of billiards.

highlights_en.title: [Air Hockey] Serious battle between the clumsy ones begins
highlights_en.description: The final game is Air Hockey. Roboco demonstrates her skill even in Air Hockey, widening her lead against Flare.

highlights_en.title: Match point at 7-9! Roboco is close to victory
highlights_en.description: Roboco scores steadily, reaching match point at 7-9. Flare is cornered.

highlights_en.title: Flare rallies at the last minute to tie the score!
highlights_en.description: Flare shows tenacity, catching up to 9-9, bringing the excitement of the match to its peak.

highlights_en.title: Game set with Flare's comeback victory!
highlights_en.description: Controlling the final exchange, Flare wins 10-9. Roboco shouts 'That's unfair!' and the segment ends in laughter.

highlights_en.title: Checking the results of all games and moving to the ending talk
highlights_en.description: They review the match results, confirming that Flare won the overall victory by a narrow margin. Roboco shows enthusiasm for the upcoming 'mountain climbing' project.

highlights_en.title: Mention of the next collaboration project
highlights_en.description: Roboco mentions the next mountain climbing collaboration. Expressing gratitude to the viewers, the offline collaboration concludes.

title: 逢魔時の帰り方│黒上フブキfeat.白上フブキ(cover)

overview.summary: 白上フブキさんが柊キライさんの楽曲「逢魔時の帰り方」をカバーした歌ってみた動画です。二面性を表現する「黒上フブキ」と「白上フブキ」の掛け合いが特徴的。ダークで耽美な世界観の中、闇堕ちしたような黒上フブキが、孤独に苦しむ白上フブキを地獄へと誘うドラマチックな内容が、高品質なアニメーションPVで描かれています。熱量が高く、ロックな曲調と二人の対話形式の歌唱が魅力です。
overview.mood: ダークで情熱的、ドラマチック

highlights.title: 逢魔時の誘い
highlights.description: 黒上フブキが迷い子となった白上フブキを呼び止め、誘惑する歌い出し。赤黒い夕焼けの背景がダークな雰囲気を演出する。

highlights.title: タイトルとクレジット表示
highlights.description: 「逢魔時の帰り方」のタイトルと、歌唱者、クリエイター陣のクレジットが表示される。

highlights.title: 寒気の正体
highlights.description: 黒上フブキが白上フブキに対し「寒気の正体、俺の目を見な」と迫り、「ここから先は帰せないぞ」と宣言する。

highlights.title: この世から消えたいの
highlights.description: 白上フブキが苦悩する表情と共に「この世から消えたいの」と独白するソロパート。

highlights.title: 地獄へ歩いて行こう（サビ）
highlights.description: 「散々な人生を呪いながら、一つ地獄へ歩いて行こう」と、二人が手を繋ぎ、熱狂的な高揚感を持って歌うサビ。

highlights.title: お嬢さんいい加減
highlights.description: 落ち着いたトーンで、黒上フブキが白上フブキを挑発するパート。「もう帰れないのに随分だな」

highlights.title: 地獄の沙汰も二人次第
highlights.description: 白上フブキが明るい表情を見せ始め、黒上フブキと手を重ねるシーン。地獄を遊園地に見立てる。

highlights.title: 最悪な人生を嗤いながら
highlights.description: 「最悪な人生を嗤いながら」と、二人で地獄で肝試しをすることを歌い、喜びを爆発させるラスサビ前の盛り上がり。

highlights.title: 生まれ変われたら
highlights.description: モノクロのレトロな映像に変わり、白上フブキが「この手離して生まれ変われたら、次こそ幸せに」と願いを口にする。

highlights.title: もう人間になれなくても
highlights.description: 映像が一転、真っ赤な背景の中、黒上フブキが白上フブキを抱き寄せる。「もういいわ、人間になれなくても！」

highlights.title: そばにいてくれるのなら
highlights.description: 白上フブキが笑い、黒上フブキが「そうしたらきっともう、寂しくないなあ」と語りかけ、エンディングへ向かう。

tags: オリジナルアニメーション

overview_en.summary: This is a cover song video ("Utattemita") by Shirakami Fubuki of the song "Omagatoki no Kaerikata" by Hiiragi Kirai. It distinctively features the interplay between "Kurokami Fubuki" (Black Fubuki) and "Shirakami Fubuki" (White Fubuki), representing her duality. The high-quality animated PV depicts a dramatic scenario set in a dark and aesthetic world, where the seemingly fallen Kurokami Fubuki tempts the lonely and suffering Shirakami Fubuki into hell. The high energy, rock tune, and the conversational style of the duet are highly appealing.
overview_en.mood: Dark, passionate, dramatic

highlights_en.title: Temptation at Omagatoki (Dusk)
highlights_en.description: The song begins with Kurokami Fubuki calling out and tempting Shirakami Fubuki, who seems lost. The dark crimson sunset background creates a dark atmosphere.

highlights_en.title: Title and Credits Display
highlights_en.description: The title "Omagatoki no Kaerikata" and the credits for the vocalist and creators are displayed.

highlights_en.title: The Source of the Chill
highlights_en.description: Kurokami Fubuki presses Shirakami Fubuki, saying, "Look into my eyes, the source of this chill," and declares, "You cannot return from beyond this point."

highlights_en.title: I Want to Disappear from This World
highlights_en.description: Shirakami Fubuki's solo part, where she confides, "I want to disappear from this world," with a troubled expression.

highlights_en.title: Let's Walk to Hell (Chorus)
highlights_en.description: The passionate and exciting chorus where they join hands and sing, "While cursing this miserable life, let's walk together to a hell."

highlights_en.title: My Lady, Enough Already
highlights_en.description: A part where Kurokami Fubuki provokes Shirakami Fubuki in a calm tone. "It's quite a thing, even though you can't go back now."

highlights_en.title: Hell's Judgement is Up to the Two of Us
highlights_en.description: Shirakami Fubuki starts to show a brighter expression and overlaps hands with Kurokami Fubuki. They liken hell to an amusement park.

highlights_en.title: While Laughing at the Worst Life
highlights_en.description: The climax before the final chorus, where they sing, "While laughing at this worst life," exploding with joy as they plan a test of courage in hell.

highlights_en.title: If I Could Be Reborn
highlights_en.description: The video changes to monochromatic, retro footage. Shirakami Fubuki voices her wish, "If I could let go of this hand and be reborn, I hope I'll be happy next time."

highlights_en.title: Even If I Can't Be Human Anymore
highlights_en.description: The scene suddenly changes to a bright red background, and Kurokami Fubuki embraces Shirakami Fubuki. "It's fine now, even if I can't be human anymore!"

highlights_en.title: If You Stay By My Side
highlights_en.description: Shirakami Fubuki laughs, and Kurokami Fubuki murmurs, "If that happens, I definitely won't be lonely anymore," leading to the ending.

title: 【  恐怖の採点 -Score the Fear-  】自分、緊急で採点いいっすか？？？？？？【ホロライブ/さくらみこ】

overview.summary: さくらみこがフリーホラーゲーム「恐怖の採点 -Score the Fear-」に挑戦。終盤、みこちは意図的に高評価を与え続け、ユルいエンド（D）や、中途半端な評価を与えて記憶が再発するエンディング（E）を回収する。特にエンディングEでは、主人公（兄）が弟（ゆ〜君）の死の記憶を無意識に封印していたことが明らかになり、ホラーゲームから一転、非常に感動的で悲しい兄弟の物語として結末を迎える。みこちはその深いストーリーに感動しつつ、全エンディングを回収しクリアとした。
overview.mood: ユーモラスなゲームプレイから一転、深い感動と切なさに包まれる

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲーム紹介
highlights.description: 配信開始時の挨拶と、本日挑戦するフリーホラーゲーム「恐怖の採点」の紹介。急な出張で借りた部屋での奇妙な体験がテーマ。

highlights.title: 悪霊「ゆ〜君」初登場とルール説明
highlights.description: 部屋に現れた可愛らしい悪霊「ゆ〜君」が、立派な悪霊になるための修行に付き合ってほしいと懇願。採点ルールは、5回遭遇したらベルを鳴らし、怖かった度合いを星3段階で評価すること。

highlights.title: 1日目開始、悪霊の努力に全くビビらないみこち
highlights.description: 1日目の恐怖修行開始。ゆ〜君は玄関や風呂場、テレビから出現するが、みこちは全く動じず、可愛さを褒めたり冷静に状況を分析したりする。

highlights.title: 1日目終了、採点結果は星1つでゆ〜君が落ち込む
highlights.description: 5回遭遇しベルを鳴らし、採点。みこちが怖がらなかったため、星1つの評価。ゆ〜君は落ち込み、ジャンプスケアの導入を検討。

highlights.title: 2日目開始、ゆ〜君の「ジャンプスケア」を冷静に処理
highlights.description: 2日目開始。部屋が暗くなり、ゆ〜君はより視覚的なジャンプスケア（ドラ、電子レンジ、冷蔵庫からの出現）を試みるが、みこちは冷静に対処。

highlights.title: 2日目終了、採点結果は星1つでゆ〜君の姿が変化
highlights.description: 2日目の採点も星1つに終わり、ゆ〜君はガッカリ。もっと怖がらせるために、自分が怖かったことをすればいいと気づき、姿がよりホラーなものに変化する。

highlights.title: 3日目開始（エンディングA）、ホラー演出が本格化
highlights.description: 3日目開始。部屋は真っ暗になり、ゆ〜君の姿も黒く不気味なものに。懐中電灯を頼りに探索を開始し、ドアの隙間から手が出てくるなど、より怖い演出になる。

highlights.title: エンディングA回収、主人公が孤独になる結末
highlights.description: 3日目を満点クリアした結果、エンディングAに到達。主人公は出張を終えて帰宅するが、ゆ〜君との交流を思い出すことなく、孤独な生活に戻る結末が描かれる。

highlights.title: エンディングC回収、ゆ〜君が幽霊研究者としてテレビ出演
highlights.description: 2日目の点数を1点とすることでエンディングCを回収。ゆ〜君が恐怖の研究者として成功し、テレビでグラフを解説している姿が映し出される。

highlights.title: エンディングB回収、ゆ〜君が恐怖の修行の旅へ
highlights.description: 1日目星2、2日目星3とすることでエンディングBを回収。ゆ〜君はさらなる恐怖の修行のため、旅に出ることを決意する。

highlights.title: エンディングAの再確認
highlights.description: 点数を1日目星2、2日目星1とすることでエンディングAが再び発生。主人公の頭痛や妻の容体の急変など、重い過去が示唆される。

highlights.title: Day 3 スタート (楽しいエンドルート)
highlights.description: Day 1, Day 2の評価を3/3に調整して迎えた3日目。部屋が明るく、ゆ〜君の登場も和やかで、おにーさんと遊んでいる雰囲気に。

highlights.title: Jumpscareが「マツケンサンバ」に
highlights.description: 陽気なBGMが流れる中、ゆ〜君がドラやトイレから登場するが、一切怖くない。「マツケンサンバ」のBGMとコメントするみこち。

highlights.title: エンディングD：これから一緒に
highlights.description: 連続満点評価の結果、主人公がゆ〜君との修行を続けるために滞在期間を延長。携帯を壊して世間との繋がりを断ち、幸せに暮らすという、ゆ〜君に支配された結末。

highlights.title: エンディングEへ (スコア2/2設定)
highlights.description: エンディング回収のため、Day 1、Day 2の評価を2/2に設定してゲームを再開。3日目、主人公は頭痛に襲われ、光る点を探す異変が起こる。

highlights.title: 人間化した弟（ユウジ）の登場
highlights.description: 部屋の中で人間化した弟の姿の「ユウジ」が出現し、兄（主人公）を驚かす。兄は弟の記憶を封印していたことが明らかになる。

highlights.title: 衝撃的な真実、弟の死の記憶
highlights.description: フラッシュバックにより、弟（ユウジ）が自分のせいであやまってマンションのベランダから落ちて死んでしまったという、主人公が封印していた過去の真実が判明する。

highlights.title: エンディングE：恐怖の再現
highlights.description: ゆ〜君（ユウジ）が、兄に自分を思い出させ、一緒にいる時間を楽しむために怖がらせる修行をしていたことを明かす。ユウジは消滅し、感動的な兄弟の物語としてゲームが終了。

highlights.title: ゲームクリアと感想
highlights.description: 全エンディングを回収しゲームクリア。ホラーゲームと思いきや感動的な兄弟の物語だったことに、みこちは「うまい！」と絶賛し、視聴者へのお礼と告知を行って配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: Sakura Miko takes on the free horror game "Kyoufu no Saitan -Score the Fear-". Towards the end, Miko intentionally continues giving high scores to collect the lenient ending (D) and the ending (E) where mid-level scores trigger the recurrence of memory. Especially in Ending E, it is revealed that the protagonist (the older brother) unconsciously sealed away the memory of his younger brother's (Yuu-kun) death. The game shifts from a horror experience to a deeply moving and sad story of brotherhood. Miko, deeply touched by the profound story, successfully collected all endings and completed the game.
overview_en.mood: Shifts from humorous gameplay to deep emotion and poignancy

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Game Introduction
highlights_en.description: Greetings at the start of the stream and introduction of the free horror game "Score the Fear" to be played today. The theme is a strange experience in a room rented for a sudden business trip.

highlights_en.title: First Appearance of the Evil Spirit "Yuu-kun" and Rule Explanation
highlights_en.description: The cute evil spirit "Yuu-kun" who appeared in the room pleads for the protagonist to accompany him in his training to become a proper evil spirit. The scoring rule is to ring the bell after 5 encounters and rate the level of fear on a 3-star scale.

highlights_en.title: Day 1 Starts, Miko is Completely Unfazed by the Evil Spirit's Efforts
highlights_en.description: The horror training for Day 1 begins. Yuu-kun appears from the entrance, the bathroom, and the TV, but Miko remains unfazed, praising his cuteness and calmly analyzing the situation.

highlights_en.title: Day 1 Ends, Yuu-kun Gets 1 Star and Gets Depressed
highlights_en.description: After 5 encounters, the bell is rung and scored. Since Miko was not scared, the score is 1 star. Yuu-kun gets depressed and considers implementing jump scares.

highlights_en.title: Day 2 Starts, Miko Calmly Handles Yuu-kun's "Jumpscares"
highlights_en.description: Day 2 starts. The room darkens, and Yuu-kun attempts more visual jump scares (appearing from the gong, microwave, and refrigerator), but Miko deals with them calmly.

highlights_en.title: Day 2 Ends, Yuu-kun Gets 1 Star and His Appearance Changes
highlights_en.description: Day 2 scoring also ends with 1 star, disappointing Yuu-kun. He realizes that to scare the protagonist more, he should do things that scared him, and his appearance changes to a more horrific form.

highlights_en.title: Day 3 Starts (Ending A), Horror Production Intensifies
highlights_en.description: Day 3 starts. The room is pitch black, and Yuu-kun's appearance is dark and ominous. Exploration begins using a flashlight, and the scares become more intense, such as a hand reaching out from under the door.

highlights_en.title: Ending A Acquired, Protagonist Ends Up Lonely
highlights_en.description: Achieving a perfect score on Day 3 leads to Ending A. The protagonist returns home after the business trip, but the ending depicts him returning to a lonely life without remembering his interaction with Yuu-kun.

highlights_en.title: Ending C Acquired, Yuu-kun Appears on TV as a Ghost Researcher
highlights_en.description: Setting the Day 2 score to 1 point leads to Ending C. Yuu-kun succeeds as a fear researcher and is shown explaining graphs on television.

highlights_en.title: Ending B Acquired, Yuu-kun Embarks on a Journey of Fear Training
highlights_en.description: Setting the scores to 2 stars on Day 1 and 3 stars on Day 2 leads to Ending B. Yuu-kun decides to travel for further fear training.

highlights_en.title: Reconfirming Ending A
highlights_en.description: Setting the scores to 2 stars on Day 1 and 1 star on Day 2 triggers Ending A again. Heavy past events are hinted at, such as the protagonist's headaches and his wife's sudden change in condition.

highlights_en.title: Day 3 Start (Happy End Route)
highlights_en.description: Day 3, reached by adjusting the Day 1 and Day 2 scores to 3/3. The room is bright, Yuu-kun's appearances are peaceful, creating an atmosphere of playing with his older brother.

highlights_en.title: Jumpscare Turns into "Matsuken Samba"
highlights_en.description: While cheerful background music plays, Yuu-kun appears from the gong and the toilet, but it's not scary at all. Miko comments that the BGM sounds like "Matsuken Samba."

highlights_en.title: Ending D: Together from Now On
highlights_en.description: As a result of consecutive perfect scores, the protagonist extends his stay to continue training with Yuu-kun. This is an ending where the protagonist is dominated by Yuu-kun, breaking his phone to cut ties with the outside world and living happily (under Yuu-kun's control).

highlights_en.title: Towards Ending E (Score 2/2 Setting)
highlights_en.description: To collect the ending, the game is restarted with Day 1 and Day 2 scores set to 2/2. On Day 3, the protagonist is hit by a headache, and an abnormality occurs where he searches for a glowing spot.

highlights_en.title: Appearance of the Humanized Younger Brother (Yuji)
highlights_en.description: "Yuji," the humanized form of the younger brother, appears in the room, startling the older brother (protagonist). It is revealed that the older brother had sealed away the memory of his younger brother.

highlights_en.title: Shocking Truth, The Memory of the Younger Brother's Death
highlights_en.description: A flashback reveals the sealed truth of the past: the younger brother (Yuji) accidentally fell off the apartment balcony and died due to the protagonist's fault.

highlights_en.title: Ending E: Replication of Fear
highlights_en.description: Yuu-kun (Yuji) reveals that he was conducting the fear training to make his older brother remember him and enjoy spending time together. Yuji disappears, and the game concludes as a moving story of brotherhood.

highlights_en.title: Game Clear and Impressions
highlights_en.description: All endings collected and the game is cleared. Miko praises the game, exclaiming "Well done!" (Umai!), for being a moving story of brotherhood rather than just a horror game, and concludes the stream with thanks and announcements to the viewers.

title: 【#冥ハロ2025】白上フブキ生誕３DLIVE「冥界Halloween Night!」【白上フブキ/ホロライブ】

overview_en.summary: A summary of the entire Shirakami Fubuki Birthday 3D Live "Meikai Halloween Night!", including the latter half. This section featured a variety of unit songs with special guests like Nekomata Okayu, Takane Lui, Fuwawa Abyssgard, and Mococo Abyssgard, as well as an original song sharing the live's title. The event concluded with an ecstatic performance of "ANTHEM," featuring Hoshimachi Suisei and Sakura Miko. Following the live, announcements were made regarding birthday commemorative merchandise and the live Blu-ray release.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki 1st Song: "Isekai Kyousoukyoku" (Otherworld Concerto)
highlights_en.description: The live performance begins. Shirakami Fubuki appears in a king costume and performs the original song "Isekai Kyousoukyoku." A powerful performance on a magnificent stage set.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki & Omaru Polka: "CIRCUS PANIC!!!"
highlights_en.description: Omaru Polka appears in a circus outfit. They splendidly perform a fun, circus-themed song accompanied by dancers.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki & Sakura Miko: "Happy End Princess"
highlights_en.description: Sakura Miko appears in a cherry blossom pink dress. They perform a cute, idol-like song with adorable duo dancing.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki & Amane Kanata: "Meitantei Renzoku Satsujin Jiken" (Detective Serial Murder Case)
highlights_en.description: Amane Kanata appears dressed as a detective. They perform a mysterious song evoking the atmosphere of solving a case.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki & Ookami Mio 5th Song: "Kokoro Okashi"
highlights_en.description: Ookami Mio appears in a Japanese-style outfit. They perform a gentle, friendly song evoking a feeling of companionship.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki Solo Song: "Chakuen" (Ignition)
highlights_en.description: The atmosphere completely changes as Shirakami Fubuki performs the solo song "Chakuen" on a gothic stage. A powerful and passionate performance.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki (Solo): Continuation of "Chakuen"
highlights_en.description: The latter half of the song "Chakuen." Emotional singing and dance performance continue in the gothic costume.

highlights_en.title: Unit Song with Takane Lui and Nekomata Okayu: "Amazing Happy Halloween Night"
highlights_en.description: After a kamishibai-style animation, the melody changes, and Shirakami Fubuki, Takane Lui, and Nekomata Okayu perform a unit song. A colorful and cute dance segment.

highlights_en.title: Unit Song with Fuwawa Abyssgard and Mococo Abyssgard: "Kyoushou Tricksters" (Manic Laugh Tricksters)
highlights_en.description: After a kamishibai-style animation, they perform a lively and tricky song alongside Fuwawa Abyssgard and Mococo Abyssgard.

highlights_en.title: Shirakami Fubuki (Solo/Special Performance): "Necro no Hanayome" (Necro Bride)
highlights_en.description: After a kamishibai-style animation, Shirakami Fubuki performs a pair dance with a woman in a white dress. A sorrowful yet beautiful ballad.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to the Luxurious Birthday Commemorative Full Set 2025 Merchandise
highlights_en.description: Introduction of four merchandise items: the Underworld Halloween Wide Rubber Mat, the FBKINGDOM Passport-Style Sticker Book, the King Fubu-chan Plushie, and the Kingdom Ribbon Charm.

highlights_en.title: First Performance of the Live Title Song: "Meikai Halloween Night!"
highlights_en.description: The original song, which shares its name with the live title, is performed solo for the first time. Grand stage production.

highlights_en.title: Epilogue & Cast Credits
highlights_en.description: A kamishibai-style animation plays, displaying the epilogue and cast credits for the live concert.
highlights_en.type: アニメーション/エンディング

highlights_en.title: Trio Song by Shirakami Fubuki, Sakura Miko, and Hoshimachi Suisei: "ANTHEM"
highlights_en.description: The live finale. They perform "ANTHEM" in new outfits alongside Sakura Miko and Hoshimachi Suisei. The entire venue erupts in excitement.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of "FBKINGDOM ANTHEM" Live Blu-ray Release
highlights_en.description: A surprise announcement regarding the Blu-ray release of Shirakami Fubuki's first solo live concert, "FBKINGDOM ANTHEM."

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【凱旋門賞】2025年 凱旋門賞で大勝する！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！！こ！【ホロライブ/兎田ぺこら】

overview.summary: ホロライブの兎田ぺこらによる凱旋門賞の最終予想からレース観戦、結果発表までの配信。過去のデータや直前のオッズ変動を参考に、日本馬の応援馬券（アロヒアリー複勝3000円）と、勝ちを狙う海外馬の本命馬券（ソジー・ミニホーク複勝各10万円）を購入。レース中は絶叫しながら展開を見守り、最終的に本命とした海外馬2頭の複勝が的中。昨年凱旋門賞で大敗したマイナス分をほぼ回収する大勝利（203,000円の投資に対し510,000円の払い戻し）を収め、興奮と感謝の気持ちを伝える。配信の最後には、今回の勝利を起点に「プラスの人生」にしていくと宣言し、今後の競馬配信への意欲を語った。
overview.mood: 興奮と歓喜

highlights.title: 配信開始と凱旋門賞への意気込み
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、久しぶりの競馬配信、しかも凱旋門賞への挑戦に興奮を見せる。日本馬の凱旋門賞制覇という悲願について言及する。

highlights.title: 日本馬の状況確認と視聴者からの情報収集
highlights.description: 今回出走する日本馬3頭（ビザンチンドリーム、クロノデュノール、アロヒアリー）を確認。勝つための情報（パドックの様子など）を視聴者から求める。

highlights.title: アヴァンチュールが海外・日本で1番人気
highlights.description: 視聴者からの情報で、前年度2着だったアヴァンチュールが海外・日本共に1番人気であることを知る。今年は1着を狙いたいと期待を寄せる。

highlights.title: 海外の怪物馬「ミニホーク」の評価に注目
highlights.description: ミニホークが複数の国でオークスを制した今年の怪物馬だという情報に驚く。さらにオブライエン厩舎が追加登録料を払って出走させているため、勝ちに来ていると判断する。

highlights.title: クロノデュノールと日本馬への想い
highlights.description: クロノデュノールが日本で2番人気だが、外枠であることが不利ではないか懸念する。しかし日本馬への応援の気持ちは強いと語る。

highlights.title: ビザンチンドリームの詳細情報（海外無敗）
highlights.description: ビザンチンドリームが海外で無敗で、スタミナ豊富かつ舞台適性も高いという詳細情報を確認し、有力候補として再評価する。

highlights.title: 単勝を避け、複勝で堅実に勝利を狙う意向
highlights.description: 過去の経験から、単勝よりも複勝で確実に馬券を当てたいという方針を明かす。

highlights.title: 内枠有利のコース情報と穴馬カルパナの存在
highlights.description: 凱旋門賞のコース特性上、内枠が有利だという情報を得る。また、12戦中馬券内率100%のカルパナが複勝での穴馬候補として浮上する。

highlights.title: 馬場状態の変化への期待
highlights.description: 重馬場だが、強い日差しと風で馬場が乾く可能性が出てきたという情報に、特定の馬（重馬場不利な馬）への期待を高める。

highlights.title: ソジーが内枠で絶好調との情報
highlights.description: 昨年1番人気で敗れたソジーだが、今年は内枠で絶好調という情報が入り、ソジーを複勝候補として有力視する。

highlights.title: ミニホークを単勝で狙うか悩む
highlights.description: ミニホークの圧倒的な強さから、単勝での勝負もアリかと考え始めるが、日本馬への応援との間で葛藤する。

highlights.title: どの馬券を買うか最終検討（日本馬への応援と勝利への道）
highlights.description: 情報を整理し、日本馬を応援したい気持ちと、勝ち馬を選ぶという現実的な選択の間で悩みながら、馬券の組み合わせを絞り込もうとする。

highlights.title: 日本馬の複勝馬選びの方針決定
highlights.description: 日本馬3頭（ビザンチンドリーム、クロワデュノール、アロヒアリー）の中から1頭を選び、海外馬からも選んで購入する方針を固める。複勝で堅実に勝利を狙う意向を再確認。

highlights.title: 内枠有利を踏まえた日本馬の再評価
highlights.description: 内枠有利という情報から、日本馬の中で比較的内枠のアロヒアリーが有利ではないかと考察。しかし、他の2頭も捨てがたいと葛藤する。

highlights.title: 視聴者への日本馬選択の問いかけとクロワデュノールへの期待
highlights.description: 日本馬3頭の中でどれを選ぶべきか視聴者に問いかける。クロワデュノールは大外枠だが「夢がある」と評し、唯一の日本人ジョッキーである北村友一騎手への応援の気持ちも語る。

highlights.title: クロワデュノールの調教映像を確認
highlights.description: グリーンチャンネルでクロワデュノールの調教映像が映り、ペコラは前脚の筋肉がすごいと反応。馬場が重馬場であり、走りづらそうだと再認識する。
highlights.type: リアクション/情報収集

highlights.title: 海外有力馬の調教映像の確認と情報収集
highlights.description: 他の有力馬の調教映像も確認したいと述べる。ビザンチンドリームがレース前に日本に帰らず、フランスに長期滞在していることを知り、その馬の調整状況に注目する。
highlights.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights.title: マーフィ騎手の奮闘とビザンチンドリームへの期待
highlights.description: ビザンチンドリームに乗るマーフ騎手の「頑張ります」という言葉に感銘を受け、彼への信頼を強める。

highlights.title: クロワデュノールの枠順（15番）と陣営コメント
highlights.description: クロワデュノールの15番枠の不利を再度確認。陣営が「馬の様子次第でできることをやる」という控えめなコメントを出していることに、自信のなさが見えると不安がる。

highlights.title: ゲソラの過去実績とアヴァンチュールの購入拒否
highlights.description: 過去の凱旋門賞でアヴァンチュールに次ぐ2着だったゲソラが気になり情報を集める。ペコラは「アヴァンチュールは絶対買わない」と宣言するが、ゲソラもアヴァンチュールに負けているため混乱する。

highlights.title: ルメール騎手の弱気なコメントとゲソラの人気薄の理由
highlights.description: ルメール騎手の発言が弱気だと感じ、買いにくいとコメント。ゲソラが人気がない理由を考える。ゲソラは前回2着だが、今回人気薄なのは大外枠が理由かと推測。

highlights.title: ゲソラの騎手情報に関する訂正とカルパナの情報
highlights.description: ゲソラの騎手がスミヨンであることを確認し、情報を追う。また、カルパナがイギリスのレースで馬券内率100%だが、フランスは初出走であることに注目する。

highlights.title: 日本馬の夢と凱旋門賞の難しさ
highlights.description: 日本馬を応援したい気持ちと、勝つという現実的な目標の間で揺れる。リスナーからの「凱旋門賞はフランス馬が圧倒的に強く、日本馬が勝ったことがない」という情報を受け、レースの過酷さを再認識する。

highlights.title: 「うどんとラーメンくらい違う」凱旋門賞の環境と買い方への葛藤
highlights.description: 日本の競馬とロンシャンは「うどんとラーメンくらい違う」とされ、日本馬が勝てない理由を再確認。海外馬を買って日本馬が勝った場合「非国民」と言われることへの恐れと葛藤を語る。
highlights.type: 情報収集/トーク/リアクション

highlights.title: 複勝候補をソジーとミニホークに絞り込み
highlights.description: 複勝の候補をソジーとミニホークに絞り込む。ソジーのラッキーナンバー（3番ゲート）と実績から本命視する。

highlights.title: ゴドルフィンおじさんの情報（ソジーの得意舞台）
highlights.description: 視聴者からの「ソジーはロンシャンで2着以内を外していない得意舞台」という情報や、内枠で適性があるという意見から、ソジーへの評価が高まる。

highlights.title: ソジーの優位性とカルパナの経験不足
highlights.description: ソジーが昨年4着であり、得意舞台であること、内枠であることを考慮し、ソジーの複勝が非常に有力だと判断。カルパナは無敗だがフランス初出走のため、懸念が残る。

highlights.title: ミニホークの複勝購入を決定。日本馬はアロヒアリーを選出
highlights.description: 海外馬で堅い複勝候補としてミニホークを選び、日本馬ではアロヒアリーを応援馬として選出する方針を固める。

highlights.title: ミニホーク複勝、アロヒアリー枠連購入で葛藤
highlights.description: ミニホークの複勝（3連複）とアロヒアリーの枠連で勝負するか悩む。日本馬への応援と勝利の安定性を天秤にかける。

highlights.title: 複勝と枠連の組み合わせ購入へ
highlights.description: ミニホークの複勝と、日本馬であるアロヒアリーとビザンチンドリームの枠連の組み合わせで決着しようとする。

highlights.title: 直前のオッズ変動確認と最終調整
highlights.description: 直前のオッズが変動し、特にビザンチンドリームのオッズが下がったことで、最後の検討を行う。アロヒアリーへの複勝をガチの軸として選出。

highlights.title: 複勝の最終本命3頭決定
highlights.description: 最終的に複勝（3連複）で購入する3頭をミニホーク、ソジー、アロヒアリーに決定する。

highlights.title: 枠連購入の検討と勝負の行方
highlights.description: 複勝と枠連の組み合わせで再度買い方を検討。このレースで勝って200万円を取り戻したいという強い思いを語る。

highlights.title: 締め切り間近！最後の追い込み検討
highlights.description: 刻々と迫る締切時刻に焦りながら、ソジー、ミニホーク、アロヒアリーの3頭立て複勝を最終的に購入することを確認。

highlights.title: 締切迫る！勝つために真剣勝負
highlights.description: 締切まで残り12分となり、真剣に勝ちに来ていることを強調し、気合を入れ直す。

highlights.title: 日本馬の応援馬券と海外馬の選定
highlights.description: 日本馬の中ではアロヒアリーを応援馬として選定。海外の有力馬の情報を再度確認する。

highlights.title: 最終馬券購入（本命複勝2頭決定）
highlights.description: 複勝の本命をソジーとミニホークの2頭に絞り込み、それぞれ10万円ずつ購入する決意をする。

highlights.title: 20万円を超える本気の馬券購入
highlights.description: アロヒアリー複勝3000円、ソジー・ミニホーク複勝各10万円、合計203,000円の馬券を購入完了。

highlights.title: 日本馬へのエールと勝利への執念
highlights.description: ロマンではなく勝ちを重視しつつ、日本馬への応援を叫ぶ。

highlights.title: オッズ変動：知られざる人気馬「ダリス」の存在
highlights.description: オッズが変動し、ノーマークだったダリスが一番人気になっていることに動揺する。
highlights.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights.title: ミニホークが再び1番人気に
highlights.description: ミニホークが一番人気に再浮上したことに興奮し、ソジーとミニホークの複勝的中を願う。
highlights.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights.title: 締め切り直前！購入内容最終確認
highlights.description: 締切直前、購入内容を最終確認し、いざレースへ。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞レーススタート
highlights.description: 重馬場でのレースがスタート。クロワデュノールが好スタートを切る。

highlights.title: ソジーとミニホークの複勝的中！大勝利の雄叫び
highlights.description: ソジーとミニホークの複勝的中を確信し、大勝利に歓喜の雄叫びを上げる。

highlights.title: 払戻し金額確定と昨年のリベンジ達成
highlights.description: 払い戻し金額510,000円を確認し、前年のマイナスを解消しプラスに転じたことに大興奮する。「勝ちの波に乗る」と宣言。
highlights.type: 結果発表/リアクション

highlights.title: 感謝と今後の競馬への意欲
highlights.description: 複勝的中を改めて喜び、情報提供してくれたリスナーに感謝。今後も楽しく競馬を続けていく意欲を語る。

highlights.title: 活動6周年記念グッズの紹介
highlights.description: 活動6周年記念グッズの紹介に移る。ラバーマットやカードスリーブなど、ペコラ推しグッズの販売を告知。

highlights.title: プラスの人生への誓いと視聴者への感謝
highlights.description: G1レース予想の楽しさについて語り、今年はプラスの人生にしていきたいと意気込みを語る。今回の勝利を喜び、視聴者からの情報提供に感謝を述べる。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶とエンディングへ
highlights.description: 視聴者に対し感謝を伝え、次回の競馬配信やその他の配信での再会を約束し、配信を締めくくる。「おつぺこでした。バイバーイ」

overview_en.summary: A stream by Hololive's Usada Pekora, covering her final prediction for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, watching the race, and announcing the results. Based on past data and immediate odds changes, she purchased a cheering ticket for a Japanese horse (Alohealy, Place bet, ¥3,000) and main prediction tickets for international horses expected to win (Sojay and Mini Hawk, Place bets, ¥100,000 each). She watched the race unfolding while shouting, and ultimately, her Place bets on the two favorite international horses hit. She achieved a major victory (¥510,000 payout on a ¥203,000 investment), recovering nearly all of her losses from the previous year's disastrous Arc de Triomphe. She conveyed her excitement and gratitude. At the end of the stream, she declared that this win would be the starting point for a "positive life" and expressed enthusiasm for future horse racing streams.
overview_en.mood: Excitement and Joy

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Enthusiasm for the Arc de Triomphe
highlights_en.description: The stream begins, showing excitement for the return to horse racing streaming, especially the challenge of the Arc de Triomphe. She mentions the long-cherished wish for a Japanese horse to win the Arc.

highlights_en.title: Checking the Status of Japanese Horses and Gathering Viewer Information
highlights_en.description: She confirms the three Japanese horses participating (Byzantine Dream, Chrono Du Nord, Alohealy). She asks viewers for information needed to win (like paddock conditions).

highlights_en.title: Aventure is the Favorite in both Overseas and Japan
highlights_en.description: Based on viewer information, she learns that Aventure, who finished second last year, is the top favorite both internationally and in Japan. She expresses hope that the horse aims for first place this year.

highlights_en.title: Focusing Attention on the Evaluation of the International Monster Horse "Mini Hawk"
highlights_en.description: She is surprised by the information that Mini Hawk is this year's monster horse, having won the Oaks in multiple countries. She deduces that since O'Brien's stable paid an additional entry fee, they are aiming for a win.

highlights_en.title: Chrono Du Nord and Feelings towards Japanese Horses
highlights_en.description: Chrono Du Nord is the second favorite in Japan, but she worries that the outside draw might be a disadvantage. However, she states her strong desire to cheer for the Japanese horses.

highlights_en.title: Detailed Information on Byzantine Dream (Undefeated Overseas)
highlights_en.description: She confirms detailed information that Byzantine Dream is undefeated overseas, has abundant stamina, and high course suitability, leading her to re-evaluate it as a strong contender.

highlights_en.title: Intention to Avoid Win Bets and Secure Victory with Place Bets
highlights_en.description: Based on past experience, she states her strategy is to secure a betting win reliably using Place bets rather than Win bets.

highlights_en.title: Course Information Favoring Inside Draw and the Dark Horse Karupana
highlights_en.description: She receives information that the inside draw is advantageous due to the nature of the Arc de Triomphe course. Additionally, Karupana, who has hit the board 100% of the time in 12 races, emerges as a dark horse candidate for a Place bet.

highlights_en.title: Hopes for Track Condition Changes
highlights_en.description: She hears information that although the track is heavy, strong sunlight and wind might dry it out, raising her hopes for specific horses (those disadvantaged by heavy ground).

highlights_en.title: Information that Sojay is in Top Form with an Inside Draw
highlights_en.description: Sojay, who lost despite being the favorite last year, is reported to be in top form with an inside draw this year, making Sojay a strong candidate for a Place bet.

highlights_en.title: Debating whether to target Mini Hawk with a Win Bet
highlights_en.description: Given Mini Hawk's overwhelming strength, she starts considering a Win bet, but struggles with the conflict between winning and cheering for the Japanese horses.

highlights_en.title: Final Consideration on Which Tickets to Buy (Cheering for Japan vs. Path to Victory)
highlights_en.description: She organizes the information, struggling between the desire to cheer for Japanese horses and the realistic choice of selecting a winning horse, trying to narrow down the ticket combinations.

highlights_en.title: Policy Decision on Selecting a Japanese Horse for a Place Bet
highlights_en.description: She decides on a strategy to choose one Japanese horse (Byzantine Dream, Chrono Du Nord, or Alohealy) and purchase tickets along with selections from international horses. She reconfirms her intention to aim for a reliable victory using Place bets.

highlights_en.title: Re-evaluating Japanese Horses based on the Inside Draw Advantage
highlights_en.description: Based on the information that the inside draw is advantageous, she considers whether Alohealy, having a relatively inside draw among the Japanese horses, might be favorable. However, she struggles because the other two horses are also strong contenders.

highlights_en.title: Asking Viewers for Japanese Horse Selection and Expectations for Chrono Du Nord
highlights_en.description: She asks viewers which of the three Japanese horses she should choose. Although Chrono Du Nord has the outermost draw, she describes it as having "a dream," and expresses her support for Yuichi Kitamura, the only Japanese jockey.

highlights_en.title: Checking Chrono Du Nord's Training Footage
highlights_en.description: Chrono Du Nord's training footage appears on Green Channel, and Pekora reacts, noting the amazing muscles in its forelegs. She reaffirms that the track is heavy and seems difficult to run on.
highlights_en.type: リアクション/情報収集

highlights_en.title: Checking Training Footage of Strong International Horses and Information Gathering
highlights_en.description: She expresses a desire to check the training footage of other strong horses. She learns that Byzantine Dream did not return to Japan before the race but stayed in France long-term, and focuses on that horse's conditioning status.
highlights_en.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Jockey Murphy's Fight and Hopes for Byzantine Dream
highlights_en.description: She is impressed by the words "I will do my best" from Jockey Murphy, who is riding Byzantine Dream, and strengthens her trust in him.

highlights_en.title: Chrono Du Nord's Draw (Gate 15) and Stable Comment
highlights_en.description: She reconfirms the disadvantage of Chrono Du Nord's Gate 15 draw. She expresses anxiety that the stable's modest comment—"We will do what we can depending on the horse's condition"—suggests a lack of confidence.

highlights_en.title: Gesola's Past Performance and Refusal to Buy Aventure
highlights_en.description: She is interested in Gesola, who finished second to Aventure in a past Arc de Triomphe, and gathers information. Pekora declares, "I will definitely not buy Aventure," but becomes confused since Gesola also lost to Aventure.

highlights_en.title: Jockey Lemaire's Negative Comment and the Reason for Gesola's Low Popularity
highlights_en.description: She feels Jockey Lemaire's comment is negative and says it makes the horse hard to bet on. She contemplates why Gesola is unpopular. She hypothesizes that Gesola's low popularity, despite finishing second last time, might be due to the far outside draw.

highlights_en.title: Correction regarding Gesola's Jockey Information and Information on Karupana
highlights_en.description: She confirms that Gesola's jockey is Soumillon and follows up on the information. She also notes that while Karupana has a 100% hit rate in UK races, this is its first appearance in France.

highlights_en.title: The Dream of Japanese Horses and the Difficulty of the Arc de Triomphe
highlights_en.description: She wavers between wanting to cheer for Japanese horses and the realistic goal of winning. Upon receiving viewer information that "French horses are overwhelmingly strong in the Arc de Triomphe, and a Japanese horse has never won," she recognizes the severity of the race.

highlights_en.title: "As Different as Udon and Ramen": The Arc Environment and the Conflict over Betting Strategy
highlights_en.description: She reaffirms why Japanese horses struggle to win, noting that Japanese racing and Longchamp are "as different as Udon and Ramen." She talks about the conflict and fear of being called "unpatriotic" if she bets on international horses and a Japanese horse wins.
highlights_en.type: 情報収集/トーク/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Narrowing Down Place Bet Candidates to Sojay and Mini Hawk
highlights_en.description: She narrows the Place bet candidates down to Sojay and Mini Hawk. She makes Sojay her main prediction based on its lucky number (Gate 3) and track record.

highlights_en.title: Godolphin Oji-san's Information (Sojay's Favorite Stage)
highlights_en.description: Sojay's evaluation increases due to viewer information that "Sojay has never finished outside the top two at Longchamp, a favored stage," and the opinion that it is suitable for the inside draw.

highlights_en.title: Sojay's Advantage and Karupana's Lack of Experience
highlights_en.description: Considering that Sojay finished 4th last year, is on a favored stage, and has an inside draw, she concludes that a Place bet on Sojay is highly promising. Concerns remain about Karupana, who is undefeated but debuting in France.

highlights_en.title: Deciding to Buy Mini Hawk for Place Bet. Selecting Alohealy as the Japanese Horse
highlights_en.description: She decides on a policy: Mini Hawk as the reliable international Place bet candidate, and Alohealy as the Japanese cheering horse.

highlights_en.title: Conflict Over Buying Mini Hawk Place Bet vs. Alohealy Bracket Quinella
highlights_en.description: She struggles whether to bet on Mini Hawk's Place bet (Trio/Trifecta) versus Alohealy's Bracket Quinella. She weighs cheering for the Japanese horse against the stability of victory.

highlights_en.title: Moving Towards a Combination Purchase of Place and Bracket Quinella
highlights_en.description: She tries to settle on a combination of Mini Hawk's Place bet and a Bracket Quinella featuring the Japanese horses Alohealy and Byzantine Dream.

highlights_en.title: Checking Last-Minute Odds Changes and Final Adjustments
highlights_en.description: Last-minute odds fluctuate, particularly Byzantine Dream's odds dropped, prompting a final review. She selects Alohealy for a serious Place bet.

highlights_en.title: Final Decision on the Three Main Place Bet Horses
highlights_en.description: She finally decides on the three horses for the Place bet (Trio/Trifecta) purchase: Mini Hawk, Sojay, and Alohealy.

highlights_en.title: Considering Bracket Quinella Purchase and the Fate of the Bet
highlights_en.description: She reviews her betting strategy again, combining Place bets and Bracket Quinella. She expresses a strong desire to win this race and recover ¥2 million.

highlights_en.title: Deadline Approaching! Last-Minute Consideration
highlights_en.description: Rushing against the rapidly approaching deadline, she confirms the final purchase of a Place bet involving the three horses: Sojay, Mini Hawk, and Alohealy.

highlights_en.title: Deadline Approaching! A Serious Bet to Win
highlights_en.description: With 12 minutes left until the deadline, she emphasizes that she is seriously aiming to win and refocuses her determination.

highlights_en.title: Cheering Ticket for Japanese Horse and Selection of International Horse
highlights_en.description: She selects Alohealy as the cheering horse among the Japanese entrants. She reviews information on the strong international horses again.

highlights_en.title: Final Ticket Purchase (Decision on Two Main Place Bets)
highlights_en.description: She narrows down her main Place bets to Sojay and Mini Hawk, resolving to purchase ¥100,000 on each.

highlights_en.title: Serious Bet Purchase Exceeding ¥200,000
highlights_en.description: She completes the purchase of tickets totaling ¥203,000: Alohealy Place bet ¥3,000, Sojay Place bet ¥100,000, and Mini Hawk Place bet ¥100,000.

highlights_en.title: Cheers for Japanese Horses and Obsession with Victory
highlights_en.description: While prioritizing victory over romance, she shouts her support for the Japanese horses.

highlights_en.title: Odds Fluctuation: The Presence of the Unknown Favorite "Dalis"
highlights_en.description: She is agitated when the odds fluctuate and Dalis, a horse she hadn't considered, becomes the new favorite.
highlights_en.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Mini Hawk Becomes Favorite Again
highlights_en.description: She gets excited when Mini Hawk resurfaces as the favorite and wishes for her Place bets on Sojay and Mini Hawk to hit.
highlights_en.type: 情報収集/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Just Before Deadline! Final Confirmation of Purchase
highlights_en.description: Just before the deadline, she performs a final check of her bets and prepares for the race.

highlights_en.title: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Race Starts
highlights_en.description: The race starts on the heavy ground. Chrono Du Nord gets a good start.

highlights_en.title: Sojay and Mini Hawk Place Bets Hit! A Shout of Great Victory
highlights_en.description: Confident that her Place bets on Sojay and Mini Hawk have hit, she lets out a triumphant shout of joy for the major victory.

highlights_en.title: Payout Amount Confirmed and Last Year's Revenge Achieved
highlights_en.description: She confirms the payout of ¥510,000 and is highly excited that she has cleared last year's deficit and turned a profit. She declares, "I'm riding the wave of victory."
highlights_en.type: 結果発表/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Gratitude and Future Enthusiasm for Horse Racing
highlights_en.description: She rejoices again over the successful Place bets and thanks the viewers for providing information. She expresses her enthusiasm to continue enjoying horse racing in the future.

highlights_en.title: Introduction of 6th Anniversary Goods
highlights_en.description: She moves on to introducing her 6th Anniversary merchandise. She announces the sale of fan goods, such as rubber mats and card sleeves.

highlights_en.title: Vow for a Positive Life and Gratitude to Viewers
highlights_en.description: She talks about the fun of predicting G1 races and expresses her motivation to make this year a "positive life." She celebrates the victory and thanks the viewers for providing information.

highlights_en.title: Closing Greeting and Transition to Ending
highlights_en.description: She conveys her thanks to the viewers, promises to meet again in future horse racing streams or other broadcasts, and concludes the stream. "Otsu Peko deshita. Bye-bye."

title: 【Minecraft】釣り雑談【ホロライブ/ときのそら】

overview.summary: ときのそらさんがMinecraftのホロライブサーバーで、前回から引き続き、家の周りの環境整備（竹や木の伐採と植林）を行いながら雑談を繰り広げました。配信中に、慢性的な舌の不調や最近受けた全身麻酔での胃カメラ体験、そして今後のライブに向けた体力づくりの必要性など、健康に関する話題を深く共有。後半では、自宅の地下室を桜の木材やコンクリートで可愛らしく装飾する作業に取り組み、資材調達のために遠くの砂漠バイオームへ移動。最後はトロッコで自宅まで帰還し、今後の体調管理への意気込みを語りつつ、和やかに配信を終了しました。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気だが、健康や自己管理についての真面目な話題も含まれる。

highlights.title: Minecraft配信開始とサーバー接続
highlights.description: Minecraft hololive Server New Worldにログインし、配信を開始。画面外の告知映像について触れる。

highlights.title: 桜の木の下の釣り堀で釣り開始
highlights.description: 自宅近くの桜の木の周囲にある釣り堀で、ホロライブ楽曲をBGMにのんびり釣りを始める。フグを釣る。

highlights.title: 桜の木の伐採と近況雑談
highlights.description: 手持ちのシャベルで桜の木を伐採しながら、最近の活動（ライブリハなど）やプライベートでのリラックス方法について雑談する。

highlights.title: リリースイベでのファンとの交流に感動
highlights.description: 楽曲リリースイベントでのファンとの交流や熱い応援の様子について語り、ファンとの繋がりを感じて嬉しかったと話す。

highlights.title: 回線トラブルのファンへの対応エピソード
highlights.description: リリースイベで回線トラブルで声が出せなかったファンと、後日スタッフに連絡を取ってもらい会話できたという心温まるエピソードを共有。

highlights.title: 女性ファンや海外ファン増加の話題
highlights.description: リリースイベを通して女性ファンや海外からのファン（海外ニキ）が増えたことに言及し、喜びを語る。

highlights.title: ライブ演出の裏話と韓国語の綴りの間違い
highlights.description: ライブ演出で使った韓国語の感謝の言葉の綴りが間違っており、アーカイブで「監視（ハメニダ）」の言葉に差し替えられたという裏話を披露。

highlights.title: ライブグッズの全種通販購入を報告
highlights.description: 忙しくてポップアップショップに行けず、ライブグッズを通販で全て購入したことを報告。ファンがアイテムを求めてくれる気持ちに感謝する。

highlights.title: 推し声優の出演作を見逃していたエピソード
highlights.description: 自身の推し声優が出演していたアニメのシーンを、ファンからのコメントで気づいたというエピソードを語り、自身のオタ活について触れる。

highlights.title: 疲労回復のための点滴と食生活改善
highlights.description: 疲労回復のために点滴を打った話や、朝食をプロテインに置き換えるなどの食生活改善に取り組んでいると話す。

highlights.title: 最近お気に入りの美容家電について
highlights.description: リファのドライヤーとブラシを愛用している話。マイナスイオンチップの効果に触れ、髪のケアの重要性について語る。

highlights.title: 放置されていた竹の伐採作業
highlights.description: 畑の近くで竹が伸び放題になっているのを見つけ、シャベルで伐採して整理する作業を開始。

highlights.title: 放置されていた竹の伐採作業
highlights.description: 畑の近くで伸び放題になっていた竹を伐採。話の流れで、慢性的な舌の痛みやピリピリ感について触れる。

highlights.title: 舌の痛みが続く原因はストレスか？
highlights.description: 舌の痛みが数日単位で続くことについて、熱傷ではないかと疑問を呈しつつ、母親が経験したストレス起因の舌の過敏症の話題を共有。

highlights.title: シラカバの木を伐採して植林
highlights.description: 自宅近くに生えているシラカバの木を伐採し、苗木を植えて周りの景観を整える作業を行う。

highlights.title: 全身麻酔での胃カメラ体験談
highlights.description: 健康管理の一環として全身麻酔で胃カメラ検査を受けた経験について語る。寝ている間に終わり楽だったと報告。

highlights.title: 地下室をサクラの木材で装飾開始
highlights.description: 採集したサクラの木材を加工し、自宅地下の通路や倉庫をピンク色の壁で可愛らしく装飾し始める。

highlights.title: 来年のライブに向けた体力づくり宣言
highlights.description: 次の大きなライブに向けて、体力づくりや筋トレを真面目に頑張る必要があると決意を語る。

highlights.title: 白ブロックとサクラ板で通路を装飾
highlights.description: 地下の空間にサクラの原木や石などを整理しつつ、桜の板材とコンクリートブロックで壁と床の装飾を進める。

highlights.title: 彼女に振る舞う料理のアイデアについて雑談
highlights.description: オムライスやイタリアンなど、女の子が喜ぶ料理のアイデアについてリスナーと雑談する。

highlights.title: お気に入りの漫画アプリの紹介とプロモーションの線引き
highlights.description: 愛用している漫画アプリや、提携していない他社コンテンツについて言及する際の配慮や線引きについて語る。

highlights.title: マインカートに乗って雪山バイオームへ移動
highlights.description: 長大なトロッコのレールを走り、遠くの雪山バイオームへと移動開始。景色を楽しみつつ、乗り物酔いしそうだと話す。

highlights.title: 雪山近くの砂漠で砂集め
highlights.description: 雪山を通過後、目的地の砂漠バイオームに到着。自宅の内装用コンクリート資材を集めるために砂の採掘を開始。
highlights.type: ゲームプレイ/資材調達

highlights.title: トロッコで雪山エリアを通過し自宅へ帰還
highlights.description: 砂漠での資材調達を終え、長距離トロッコで自宅方面へと帰還する。トンネルを通過し、景色を眺める。

highlights.title: ホロライブの街並みが視界に現れ安心
highlights.description: 自宅の近くまでトロッコで戻り、ホロライブサーバーの賑やかな建築群が視界に現れる。「救われる」と喜びの声を上げる。
highlights.type: ゲームプレイ/リアクション

highlights.title: 自宅の地下室に帰宅
highlights.description: 自宅の入り口から地下の倉庫兼作業部屋（桜の装飾）へ移動。本日の作業を終える。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶と体調への決意
highlights.description: 舌の不調について触れつつ、今後も体調を整えてマイクラを楽しみたいと語り、視聴者へ感謝を伝え配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: Tokino Sora continued her previous efforts to improve the environment around her house (cutting down and planting bamboo and trees) in the Minecraft Hololive Server while chatting. During the stream, she deeply shared health-related topics, including her chronic tongue discomfort, her recent experience with a gastroscopy under general anesthesia, and the necessity of building up physical stamina for future live performances. In the latter half, she focused on adorning her home's basement cutely with cherry wood and concrete, traveling to a distant desert biome to gather materials. Finally, she returned home via minecart and concluded the stream peacefully, expressing her commitment to managing her health better in the future.
overview_en.mood: Generally peaceful atmosphere throughout, but also includes serious discussions about health and self-management.

highlights_en.title: Minecraft Stream Start and Server Connection
highlights_en.description: Logs into the Minecraft hololive Server New World and starts the stream. Mentions the announcement video outside the screen.

highlights_en.title: Starting Fishing in the Pond Under the Cherry Tree
highlights_en.description: Starts leisurely fishing in the pond near her house, surrounded by cherry trees, with Hololive music as background. Catches a pufferfish.

highlights_en.title: Cutting Down Cherry Trees and Chatting About Recent Events
highlights_en.description: Chats about her recent activities (like live rehearsals) and methods for relaxing in private while cutting down cherry trees with her shovel.

highlights_en.title: Moved by Interaction with Fans at the Release Event
highlights_en.description: Talks about the interaction and enthusiastic support from fans at the song release event, expressing happiness at feeling connected to them.

highlights_en.title: Episode of Handling a Fan with Connection Trouble
highlights_en.description: Shares a heartwarming story about a fan who couldn't speak due to connection issues at the release event, and how she managed to chat with them later by having staff contact them.

highlights_en.title: Topic of Increasing Female and Overseas Fans
highlights_en.description: Mentions the increase in female fans and international fans (kaigai niki) through the release event, expressing her joy.

highlights_en.title: Behind-the-Scenes Live Performance Story and Korean Spelling Error
highlights_en.description: Reveals a behind-the-scenes story that the Korean spelling for the word of gratitude used in the live performance was incorrect, and had to be replaced with the word for "monitoring/surveillance (hamenida)" in the archive.

highlights_en.title: Reporting the Purchase of All Live Goods via Mail Order
highlights_en.description: Reports that she was too busy to go to the pop-up shop and bought all the live merchandise via mail order. Expresses gratitude that fans desire the items.

highlights_en.title: Episode of Missing Her Favorite Voice Actor's Appearance
highlights_en.description: Shares an episode about realizing a scene featuring her favorite voice actor only after a comment from a fan, touching upon her own otaku activities.

highlights_en.title: IV Drip for Fatigue Recovery and Dietary Improvement
highlights_en.description: Talks about receiving an IV drip for fatigue recovery and working on dietary improvements, such as replacing breakfast with protein.

highlights_en.title: Favorite Recent Beauty Appliances
highlights_en.description: Discusses her fondness for ReFa's hairdryer and brush. Mentions the effect of negative ion chips and talks about the importance of hair care.

highlights_en.title: Clearing Neglected Bamboo Growth
highlights_en.description: Finds bamboo growing wild near the farm and begins clearing and tidying it up with a shovel.

highlights_en.title: Clearing Neglected Bamboo Growth
highlights_en.description: Clears the overgrown bamboo near the farm. The conversation shifts to her chronic tongue pain and tingling sensation.

highlights_en.title: Is Persistent Tongue Pain Caused by Stress?
highlights_en.description: Questions whether her persistent tongue pain (lasting several days) might be due to a burn, and shares a story about her mother experiencing stress-induced tongue hypersensitivity.

highlights_en.title: Cutting Down Birch Trees and Reforestation
highlights_en.description: Cuts down the birch trees growing near her home and plants saplings to tidy up the surrounding landscape.

highlights_en.title: Gastroscopy Experience Under General Anesthesia
highlights_en.description: Talks about her experience undergoing a gastroscopy under general anesthesia as part of her health management. Reports that it was easy because it finished while she was asleep.

highlights_en.title: Starting to Decorate the Basement with Cherry Wood
highlights_en.description: Processes the collected cherry wood and begins adorning the underground passages and storage room of her house cutely with pink walls.

highlights_en.title: Declaration of Building Stamina for Next Year's Live Performance
highlights_en.description: Expresses her determination that she needs to seriously focus on building stamina and strength training for the next major live performance.

highlights_en.title: Decorating the Passage with White Blocks and Cherry Planks
highlights_en.description: Organizes cherry logs and stone in the underground space and continues decorating the walls and floor using cherry planks and concrete blocks.

highlights_en.title: Chatting About Cooking Ideas for a Girlfriend
highlights_en.description: Chats with viewers about cooking ideas that girls would enjoy, such as omurice (omelet rice) and Italian food.

highlights_en.title: Introducing Favorite Manga Apps and Drawing the Line for Promotion
highlights_en.description: Discusses her favorite manga app and the consideration and boundaries she uses when mentioning non-affiliated content from other companies.

highlights_en.title: Moving to the Snow Mountain Biome by Minecart
highlights_en.description: Starts traveling along the long minecart rail towards the distant snow mountain biome. Enjoys the scenery but mentions feeling motion sickness.

highlights_en.title: Collecting Sand in the Desert Near the Snow Mountain
highlights_en.description: Arrives at the target desert biome after passing the snow mountain. Begins mining sand to gather concrete materials for her home's interior.
highlights_en.type: ゲームプレイ/資材調達

highlights_en.title: Returning Home via Minecart, Passing Through the Snow Mountain Area
highlights_en.description: Finishes gathering materials in the desert and returns towards home via the long-distance minecart. Passes through a tunnel and watches the scenery.

highlights_en.title: Relieved as the Hololive Townscape Appears in Sight
highlights_en.description: Returns close to home via minecart, and the bustling collection of buildings in the Hololive server appears in sight. Expresses relief, saying she feels "saved."
highlights_en.type: ゲームプレイ/リアクション

highlights_en.title: Returning Home to the Basement
highlights_en.description: Moves from the house entrance down to the underground storage/workroom (decorated with cherry blossoms). Concludes the day's tasks.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending Greeting and Health Resolution
highlights_en.description: Touches upon her tongue discomfort, expresses her desire to continue enjoying Minecraft while maintaining her health, thanks the viewers, and concludes the stream.

title: 【 凱旋門賞 】日本馬初勝利をみんなで見届けようぜ・・・！【鷹嶺ルイ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: 鷹嶺ルイさんが凱旋門賞の最終予想とレース実況を行った配信です。前半で各出走馬の詳細な分析を終えた後、ルイさんは本命のミニホークを中心とした最終馬券を購入。その後、突如ゲストとしてさくらみこさんが参加し、お互いの予想を共有しながらレース観戦の熱気が高まります。レース本番では、序盤からクロノテノールが先行する中、最終直線でさくらみこさんが本命に押していたダリズが優勝。ルイさんは馬券を外すも、みこさんの大勝利に歓喜し、大興奮のうちに配信を締めくくりました。
overview.mood: 期待と興奮に満ちた白熱の実況、終盤は歓喜の絶叫

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞スペシャル衣装で登場＆オープニングトーク
highlights.description: 鷹嶺ルイさんが凱旋門賞をテーマにした特殊な衣装（帽子付き）で登場。ウキウキでテンションが高く、視聴者と興奮を共有する。

highlights.title: 海外馬：ジァヴェロット、ホワイトバーチの紹介
highlights.description: レースボードを表示し、海外出走馬であるジァヴェロットとホワイトバーチのオッズや近走の成績について簡単に紹介する。

highlights.title: 鷹嶺ルイさんが気になる海外馬：ミニホーク（コンティニュアス）を猛プッシュ
highlights.description: 鷹嶺ルイさんが個人的に大注目の海外馬、ミニホーク（Continuous）を紹介。5連勝中、海外G1も勝っている実力馬であり、強い馬だと熱弁する。

highlights.title: 海外馬：ダリズ、ソジー、アロヒアリの紹介
highlights.description: 海外馬ダリズ（短距離実績）、ソジー（G2 2着実績）、オルフェーヴルの孫であるアロヒアリについて分析する。

highlights.title: 海外馬：ホタツェル、ジオゾラの紹介
highlights.description: ホタツェル（2400mは初挑戦だが力がある）とジオゾラ（近走成績が良い）について、印をつけるべきか悩む。

highlights.title: 日本馬分析開始：カラパナ（7番人気）
highlights.description: いよいよ日本馬の分析を開始。カラパナは12戦して馬券内を外したことがない安定感のある馬だと評価する。

highlights.title: 日本馬分析：クロノテノール（2番人気）
highlights.description: 日本馬で2番人気のクロノテノールを解説。前走のG1を勝利しており、斤量も軽めであることから期待を寄せる。

highlights.title: 日本馬分析：アヴァンチュール（4番人気）
highlights.description: アヴァンチュールの紹介。斤量が軽いため、ババ不良でも力を出せると分析する。

highlights.title: 日本馬分析：ロザンアンゼルス（13番人気）
highlights.description: ロザンアンゼルス（斤量55.5kg）を紹介。斤量が重めだが、過去に重い斤量で勝った経験があるため、どうなるか注目する。

highlights.title: 日本馬分析：アローイーグル（17番人気）
highlights.description: アローイーグルの紹介。過去に4連勝経験があるものの、今回の大外枠がどう響くか懸念する。

highlights.title: 勝ったらハッピー！日本の単勝馬券を買う理由
highlights.description: ルイルイが、単勝で日本馬が勝った時の喜びを語り、日本馬の単勝馬券を記念に買うことを決意する。

highlights.title: ルイの最終馬券の公開
highlights.description: 単勝、馬単、3連単フォーメーションを組み合わせた、本命ミニホーク軸の合計16,800円の馬券を公開する。

highlights.title: ゲスト：さくらみこ登場
highlights.description: さくらみこさんがサプライズで登場し、一緒に凱旋門賞のレースを観戦することになる。

highlights.title: みこちの馬券予想公開
highlights.description: みこちが予想したダリズ（単勝・複勝）とカルバナ（複勝）の馬券を公開する。

highlights.title: ゲート入り完了：レース直前
highlights.description: レース実況が始まり、出走馬がゲートイン。現地では雨が降っていることが伝えられ、緊張感が高まる。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞スタート！クロノテノールが先行
highlights.description: レースがスタート。スタート直後、日本馬のクロノテノールが先頭に出る。ルイとみこちは大興奮。

highlights.title: レース終盤：猛烈な叩き合いと結果
highlights.description: 最終直線。ミニホークが先頭に躍り出るが、ダリズが追い込み優勝。ミニホークは2着となる。

highlights.title: みこち大勝利！ルイ大敗北！
highlights.description: みこちの予想したダリズが優勝し、みこちは大興奮。ルイは本命のミニホークが2着で外れ、負けを認める。

highlights.title: エンディングトーク
highlights.description: レースの感想を語り合い、勝ったみこちを祝福しつつ、次回への期待を語り、配信を締めくくる。

highlights.title: みこちの強運を再評価し自虐するルイ
highlights.description: 凱旋門賞で本命ダリズを当てたさくらみこさんの予想センスと強運に驚きを表明。自身の敗北はウマ娘ガチャのために運を取っておいたせいだとポジティブに解釈する。

highlights.title: 鷹嶺ルイ 2ndアルバム『LAPISLAZULI』告知
highlights.description: 画面に表示されている2ndアルバム『LAPISLAZULI』の告知を改めて紹介する。特典内容についても説明。

highlights.title: 「運があったら今勝ってるだろうが！」ルイの熱い叫び
highlights.description: 視聴者からのコメントに反応し、自分の運の無さを主張。「運があったら今勝ってるだろうが！」と悔しさを爆発させ笑いを誘う。

highlights.title: コードギアス同時視聴の告知と注意点
highlights.description: 明後日に予定されている「コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ」の同時視聴企画について告知。アニメ映像は流せるが、劇場版は出せないという制約について言及する。過激なシーンの対応についても雑談。

highlights.title: 配信のエンディングと感謝
highlights.description: 凱旋門賞の観戦配信を締めくくり、視聴者に対して一緒に盛り上がってくれたことへの感謝を伝える。

overview_en.summary: This is a stream where Takane Lui provided her final prediction and live commentary for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. After detailed analysis of each participating horse in the first half, Lui purchased her final betting tickets, centered on her favorite, Mini Hawk. Subsequently, Sakura Miko suddenly joined as a guest, and the excitement grew as they shared their predictions while watching the race. During the actual race, Chronotenol led early on, but in the final straight, Dariz, whom Sakura Miko had favored, won. Although Lui lost her bet, she rejoiced in Miko's huge victory, concluding the stream in great excitement.
overview_en.mood: Intense live commentary filled with anticipation and excitement; ending with screams of joy

highlights_en.title: Appearance in Arc de Triomphe Special Outfit & Opening Talk
highlights_en.description: Takane Lui appears in a special costume (with a hat) themed after the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. She is very cheerful and excited, sharing the excitement with viewers.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Foreign Horses: Javerot and White Birch
highlights_en.description: Displays the race board and briefly introduces the odds and recent performance of the foreign participating horses, Javerot and White Birch.

highlights_en.title: Takane Lui Strongly Promotes the Foreign Horse She's Interested In: Mini Hawk (Continuous)
highlights_en.description: Takane Lui introduces Mini Hawk (Continuous), the foreign horse she personally has her eye on. She passionately argues that it is a strong and accomplished horse, having won 5 consecutive races, including an international G1.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Foreign Horses: Dariz, Sogy, and Alohari
highlights_en.description: Analysis of the foreign horses Dariz (short-distance performance), Sogy (G2 2nd place performance), and Alohari, the grandson of Orfevre.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Foreign Horses: Hotazell and Giozola
highlights_en.description: Pondering whether to mark Hotazell (first attempt at 2400m but strong) and Giozola (good recent performance) as potential picks.

highlights_en.title: Start of Japanese Horse Analysis: Kalapana (7th Favorite)
highlights_en.description: Finally starting the analysis of Japanese horses. Kalapana is evaluated as a stable horse, having never finished outside the placings in 12 races.

highlights_en.title: Japanese Horse Analysis: Chronotenol (2nd Favorite)
highlights_en.description: Commentary on Chronotenol, the second favorite Japanese horse. Expectations are high as it won the previous G1 race and has a light weight assignment.

highlights_en.title: Japanese Horse Analysis: Aventure (4th Favorite)
highlights_en.description: Introduction to Aventure. Analyzed as capable of performing well even in poor track conditions due to its light weight assignment.

highlights_en.title: Japanese Horse Analysis: Rosan Angels (13th Favorite)
highlights_en.description: Introduction to Rosan Angels (weight 55.5 kg). Noted that although the weight is heavy, the horse has a history of winning with heavy loads, making the race outcome noteworthy.

highlights_en.title: Japanese Horse Analysis: Arrow Eagle (17th Favorite)
highlights_en.description: Introduction to Arrow Eagle. Concern is raised regarding how the wide outside draw might affect the horse, despite its past experience of winning 4 consecutive races.

highlights_en.title: Happy If They Win! Reasons to Buy Japanese Win Bets
highlights_en.description: Lui-lui talks about the joy of a Japanese horse winning a win bet (Tansho) and decides to purchase a Japanese horse win bet ticket as a keepsake.

highlights_en.title: Lui's Final Betting Tickets Revealed
highlights_en.description: Reveals betting tickets totaling ¥16,800, combining Win, Exacta (Umabara), and Trifecta (Sanrentan) formations, centered on her favorite, Mini Hawk.

highlights_en.title: Guest: Sakura Miko Appears
highlights_en.description: Sakura Miko makes a surprise appearance and joins Lui to watch the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe race together.

highlights_en.title: Mikochi's Betting Predictions Revealed
highlights_en.description: Reveals Mikochi's betting tickets for Dariz (Win and Place) and Kalapana (Place).

highlights_en.title: Entering the Gate Completed: Just Before the Race
highlights_en.description: Live race commentary begins, and the horses enter the gate. It is reported that it is raining locally, heightening the tension.

highlights_en.title: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe Starts! Chronotenol Takes the Lead
highlights_en.description: The race begins. Immediately after the start, the Japanese horse Chronotenol takes the lead. Lui and Mikochi are highly excited.

highlights_en.title: Final Stage of the Race: Fierce Finish and Result
highlights_en.description: The final straight. Mini Hawk sprints into the lead, but Dariz closes rapidly and wins. Mini Hawk finishes in 2nd place.

highlights_en.title: Mikochi's Great Victory! Lui's Crushing Defeat!
highlights_en.description: Dariz, predicted by Mikochi, wins, causing Mikochi great excitement. Lui's favorite, Mini Hawk, finished 2nd, and she concedes defeat.

highlights_en.title: Ending Talk
highlights_en.description: Discussing thoughts on the race, congratulating the winner Mikochi, expressing anticipation for next time, and concluding the stream.

highlights_en.title: Lui Re-evaluates Mikochi's Good Fortune and Self-Deprecates
highlights_en.description: Expresses surprise at Sakura Miko's prediction sense and strong luck for picking the winner, Dariz, at the Arc de Triomphe. Lui positively interprets her own loss as saving her luck for the Uma Musume gacha.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of Takane Lui's 2nd Album 'LAPISLAZULI'
highlights_en.description: Re-introducing the announcement for the 2nd album 'LAPISLAZULI' displayed on the screen. Also explaining the bonus content.

highlights_en.title: "If I Had Any Luck, I'd Be Winning Right Now!" Lui's Passionate Shout
highlights_en.description: Reacts to viewer comments by asserting her lack of luck. She explodes in frustration, shouting, "If I had any luck, I'd be winning right now!" which prompts laughter.

highlights_en.title: Announcement and Precautions for Code Geass Watch Party
highlights_en.description: Announces the planned watch party for "Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion" scheduled for the day after tomorrow. Mentions the restriction that anime footage can be streamed, but movie versions cannot. Also discusses handling intense scenes.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending and Gratitude
highlights_en.description: Concluding the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe viewing stream, expressing gratitude to the viewers for the excitement they shared.

title: 【 凱旋門賞 】はじめての凱旋門賞２０２５！🏇🎯いくぞおおおおおお！！【ホロライブ/さくらみこ】

overview.summary: ホロライブのさくらみこさんが、海外G1レース「凱旋門賞2025」の予想と実況を行う配信。レース直前にはゲストの梅崎さんを迎え入れ、お互いの予想を確認し、最終的な馬券を購入。本命「アロヒアヒア」に加え、穴馬として購入した「ダリズ」が劇的な勝利を収め、単勝と複勝が見事に的中。的中後の興奮冷めやらぬまま、今回の情報収集の新鮮さや競馬の奥深さについて語り、喜びの中で配信を締めくくった。
overview.mood: 興奮と歓喜に包まれた競馬予想と実況

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞2025 予想配信開始
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、さくらみこさんが初めての海外競馬予想として凱旋門賞2025の予想を行うことを発表。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞は「重馬場」の可能性が高いことを確認
highlights.description: 凱旋門賞の開催地フランスは雨が降った後であり、馬場状態が重馬場となっており、日本馬にとっては厳しい条件であることを確認。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞の無料放送情報
highlights.description: レースがグリーンチャンネルやAbemaTVでも無料で放送されることを告知。

highlights.title: 日本馬3頭の人気オッズの現状
highlights.description: 日本馬（クロワデュノール、ビザンチンドリーム、アロヒアヒア）のオッズが、重馬場の影響で下がっていることに言及。

highlights.title: 現時点での人気順を発表
highlights.description: 現地の人気順として、アヴァンチュール、クロワデュノール、ミニーホークの順であることを確認。ミニーホークは重馬場で人気が落ちている。

highlights.title: 海外の専門家が注目する穴馬「ダリズ」
highlights.description: 海外の専門家筋が評価している穴馬として、10番人気の「ダリズ」をピックアップ。さくらみこ自身も穴馬として購入を検討。

highlights.title: 日本馬の本命予想は「アロヒアヒア」
highlights.description: 日本馬3頭の中から、C.ルメール騎手騎乗の「アロヒアヒア」を本命にすると発表。

highlights.title: 日本馬応援の複勝（3着以内）予想
highlights.description: 応援も兼ねて、複勝でアロヒアヒアを軸に、アヴァンチュール、ミニーホーク、カルバナ、ダリズを絡めた馬券を検討。

highlights.title: 最終的な本命予想を発表
highlights.description: 日本馬の本命は「アロヒアヒア」、対抗に「アヴァンチュール」「ミニーホーク」「カルバナ」「ダリズ」を選び、最終予想とする。

highlights.title: パドック映像を確認し、日本馬の様子をチェック
highlights.description: レース直前のパドック映像が公開され、日本馬の様子を確認し、「ビザンチンドリーム」や「クロワデュノール」に声援を送る。

highlights.title: 最終的な馬券購入内容を決定
highlights.description: 最終的な賭け方を検討し、穴馬「ダリズ」の単勝5,000円、複勝3,500円を含む計35,000円分の馬券を購入する。

highlights.title: 競馬好きのゲスト梅崎さん登場
highlights.description: レース直前、梅崎さん（和装の女性アバター）が画面に登場し、自身の予想（本命はミニーホーク）を語る。

highlights.title: ゲストの本命はミニーホーク
highlights.description: 梅崎さんはミニーホークに三連単で厚く張ったことを明かす。さくらみこは穴馬ダリズの現地評価について言及。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞2025 スタート！
highlights.description: レースがスタート。日本馬のクロワデュノールが好スタートを切る。

highlights.title: 最終直線でミニーホークが先頭に立つ
highlights.description: 最終直線に入り、梅崎さんの本命ミニーホークが先頭を走る展開に興奮が高まる。

highlights.title: 穴馬ダリズが差し切り劇的な勝利！
highlights.description: さくらみこが穴馬として選んだダリズが、最後の最後に先頭を差し切り、見事に勝利を収める。

highlights.title: ダリズの単勝・複勝的中確定！
highlights.description: ダリズの勝利により、さくらみこの単勝と複勝が的中。興奮のあまり叫び声を上げる。

highlights.title: 的中馬券の金額を確認し興奮
highlights.description: 的中した馬券の金額を確認。興奮冷めやらぬまま、勝利の喜びを分かち合う。

highlights.title: レースを振り返り、穴馬的中の喜び
highlights.description: レースを振り返り、国際的な情報収集の新鮮さと、穴馬ダリズの単勝を当てた喜びを語る。今後の競馬への意欲も語る。

highlights.title: 凱旋門賞の結果と競馬の面白さ
highlights.description: ダリズの勝利は現地人気ではそれほど荒れた結果ではなかったことに言及。重馬場で人気だったアヴァンチュールが崩れたことに触れ、競馬の奥深さと難しさを再認識する。

highlights.title: 配信の締めくくりと楽曲プロモーション
highlights.description: 視聴者に感謝を伝え、今後のパワプロへの影響を冗談交じりに心配しつつ、自身の楽曲「Dori Pop」が70万回再生に近づいていることを宣伝する。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: 視聴者に向けておつみこで終了の挨拶。今回の勝利を喜びつつ、今後の競馬も楽しむ意欲を表明する。

overview_en.summary: A stream where Hololive's Sakura Miko makes predictions and provides live commentary for the overseas G1 race, the "Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 2025." Just before the race, guest Umezaki-san joined to confirm their predictions before purchasing the final betting tickets. In addition to her favorite, "Alohi Ahia," the long shot "Daly's" she purchased achieved a dramatic victory, resulting in successful wins for the win (single) and place (show) bets. Still buzzing from the win, she discussed the novelty of the information gathering process and the depth of horse racing before concluding the stream in joy.
overview_en.mood: Horse racing prediction and commentary filled with excitement and delight

highlights_en.title: Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 2025 Prediction Stream Starts
highlights_en.description: The stream begins, and Sakura Miko announces she will be making predictions for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 2025, her first time predicting an overseas horse race.

highlights_en.title: Confirmation that the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is likely to be a "Heavy Track"
highlights_en.description: It is confirmed that the venue for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in France has seen rain, resulting in a heavy track condition, which poses difficult circumstances for Japanese horses.

highlights_en.title: Information on Free Broadcasts of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
highlights_en.description: Notification that the race will be broadcast for free on Green Channel and AbemaTV.

highlights_en.title: Current Popularity Odds for the Three Japanese Horses
highlights_en.description: Mention of the odds for the Japanese horses (Croix du Nord, Byzantine Dream, Alohi Ahia) dropping due to the heavy track conditions.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of the Current Popularity Ranking
highlights_en.description: Confirmation of the local popularity ranking: Aventure, Croix du Nord, and Minnie Hawk. Minnie Hawk's popularity has dropped due to the heavy track.

highlights_en.title: Long Shot "Daly's" Highlighted by Overseas Experts
highlights_en.description: Daly's, the 10th favorite, is picked up as a dark horse praised by overseas experts. Sakura Miko also considers betting on Daly's as a long shot.

highlights_en.title: Top Pick Among Japanese Horses is "Alohi Ahia"
highlights_en.description: Announcement that "Alohi Ahia," ridden by Christophe Lemaire, will be her top pick among the three Japanese horses.

highlights_en.title: Place Bet (Top 3 Finish) Prediction to Support Japanese Horses
highlights_en.description: Considering a place bet, centered on Alohi Ahia, and including Aventure, Minnie Hawk, Carbana, and Daly's, partly for support.

highlights_en.title: Announcing the Final Top Prediction
