highlights_en.description: Mio began the taste challenge, blindfolded and wearing nose plugs, attempting to identify the Matsusaka Beef Gourmet Hamburg steak from four different products.

highlights_en.title: Mio Correctly Identifies Matsusaka Beef Gourmet Hamburg
highlights_en.description: Based solely on the taste—specifically the unique flaky texture and juiciness of the Matsusaka Beef Hamburg—Mio successfully identified the correct product. A discount coupon was presented to viewers.

highlights_en.title: Challenge 2: Identify by Hearing Only! (Challenger: Shirakami Fubuki)
highlights_en.description: Fubuki, blindfolded and wearing nose plugs, started the hearing challenge, attempting to determine the order of the Coarsely Ground Negitoro (tuna scrapings) based on four cooking sounds (Changja, Salted Salmon, Scallops, Negitoro).

highlights_en.title: Fubuki Correctly Identifies Coarsely Ground Negitoro
highlights_en.description: Fubuki successfully differentiated the cooking sounds and correctly identified the Negitoro based on its sticky texture and difference in consistency. A Negitoro discount coupon was presented to viewers.

highlights_en.title: Challenge 3: Identify by Sight Only! (Challenger: Shirakami Fubuki)
highlights_en.description: Fubuki, while blindfolded, began the sight challenge where she had to view the pre- and post-cooking images of four products (Chicken Wing Gyoza, Coarsely Ground Sausage, Extra-Large Peeled Shrimp, Lightly Salted Silver Salmon) and determine the order of the Silver Salmon.

highlights_en.title: Fubuki Listens to the Cooking Sounds for the Sight Challenge Products
highlights_en.description: The sounds of the Chicken Wing Gyoza, Coarsely Ground Sausage, Extra-Large Peeled Shrimp, and Lightly Salted Silver Salmon being cooked played, giving Fubuki hints to deduce the products from the sounds. She focused particularly on the difference between frying and grilling sounds.

highlights_en.title: Challenge 3: Acoustic Deduction for the Sight Quiz (Continued)
highlights_en.description: Differentiating the cooking sounds of the subsequent products, she deepened her deduction, inferring that they were either Chicken Wing Gyoza, Salmon, Shrimp Chili, or Sausage.

highlights_en.title: Sight Quiz Answer Check and Incorrect Answer
highlights_en.description: Fubuki guessed that the salmon was the third item, but this was incorrect. The correct answer was the first item. Reflecting on the order, she regretted that differentiating the cooking sounds had been difficult.

highlights_en.title: Teetee Chance Activated!
highlights_en.description: Suddenly, a 'Teetee Chance!' (A term denoting heartwarming/close relationship moments) occurred. The rule was presented: if they made eye contact and expressed their daily gratitude to each other, they would be allowed to taste the salmon.

highlights_en.title: Fubuki Expresses Daily Gratitude to Mio
highlights_en.description: Fubuki told Mio how delicious her homemade apple jam was and thanked her, saying that spreading it on bread had become her daily routine.

highlights_en.title: Mio Expresses Daily Gratitude to Fubuki
highlights_en.description: Mio thanked Fubuki for sharing fun things and contacting her immediately, thus earning permission to taste the product.

highlights_en.title: Reward Tasting Time: Thick-Cut Salted Silver Salmon
highlights_en.description: They enjoyed the Thick-Cut Salted Silver Salmon, which they earned by avoiding the penalty game. They reported on the deliciousness of the thick and juicy salmon.

highlights_en.title: Challenge 4: Identify the Japanese Chestnut Mont Blanc by Smell Only!
highlights_en.description: They took on a quiz challenge, sniffing four desserts (Pudding, Uji Matcha Raw Cheesecake, Sky Cheesecake, Japanese Chestnut Mont Blanc) and guessing which number was the target 'Japanese Chestnut Mont Blanc'.

highlights_en.title: Confirmed the Mont Blanc Scent in the Smell Quiz
highlights_en.description: Fubuki smelled the third item and strongly sensed the unique flavor of chestnut, confirming it was the Mont Blanc.

highlights_en.title: Smell Quiz Correct Answer & Tasting the Japanese Chestnut Mont Blanc
highlights_en.description: Fubuki correctly identified the third item as Mont Blanc. They tasted the reward Japanese Chestnut Mont Blanc, praising its refined sweetness and richness.

highlights_en.title: Challenge 5: Convey the Taste to Listeners! (Kakuni Manju)
highlights_en.description: The final mission: Listeners, based on the food reports of four dishes (Beef Tendon Simmered in Soy Sauce, Extra-Large Domestic Eel, Salt-Grilled Chicken Wings, Nagasaki Kakuni Manju), had to guess the target Nagasaki Kakuni Manju. Success would also revive the salmon coupon.

highlights_en.title: Food Report for the Third Product (Salt-Grilled Chicken Wings)
highlights_en.description: They sampled the third item, chicken wings, and enthusiastically reported that they were fluffy, tender, and melted in the mouth.

highlights_en.title: Food Report for the Fourth Product (Kakuni Manju)
highlights_en.description: They tasted the fourth item, the Kakuni Manju, commenting that it was thick, soft, richly flavored, and delicious. They described it as melting away in the mouth.

highlights_en.title: Correct Answer via Listener Poll! Salmon Coupon also Revived
highlights_en.description: The listener vote correctly identified the fourth item. They received coupons for the Nagasaki Kakuni Manju and, via a bonus chance, the salmon coupon was also secured.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to Campaign Benefits and the Roulette
highlights_en.description: Introduction to the collaboration campaign benefits with Yahoo! Shopping and the luxury lottery collaboration roulette.

highlights_en.title: Coupon Information Released for All Introduced Gourmet Items
highlights_en.description: Discount coupon information for all gourmet products introduced during the challenges so far was released.

generation.ja: ホロライブゲーマーズ

title: 【 Keep Digging 】掘って掘って掘りまくれ！！【ホロライブ/夏色まつり】

overview.summary: ホロライブの夏色まつり、白上フブキ、鷹嶺ルイ、雪花ラミィの4名で、穴掘りゲーム『Keep Digging』を協力プレイし、地下1000mの最終目標を目指します。500m層以降は難易度の高い岩盤や特殊なエリアが出現し、壁掘りアップグレードやサーチ機能などを活用しながら、採掘を進めました。最終的には地下1000mの金庫室に到達し、見事ゲームをクリア。最後は掘り進めた軌跡が映し出され、夢オチのようなエンディングに盛り上がりました。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気で、トラブルも笑いに変える楽しい配信

highlights.title: ゲーム開始とゲームの説明
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、出演者の挨拶後、ゲームの説明がされます。土を掘って鉱石を採掘し、それを売って装備をアップグレードするシンプルなゲームであることが紹介されます。

highlights.title: 穴掘り開始とゲームシステムの把握
highlights.description: プレイヤー全員で地面の土を掘り始めます。掘り進めると石炭などのアイテムが見つかり、それをマップにいるスーツ姿のおじさんに売却することで資金を得られることが判明します。

highlights.title: 最初のワープゾーン発見とトラブル
highlights.description: 深く掘り進めたところ、洞窟のような空間に到達し、ワープゾーンを発見します。しかし、ワープゾーンがうまく起動せず、ラミィが穴から戻れなくなるなどのトラブルが発生します。

highlights.title: ゲーム再起動と装備アップグレード
highlights.description: ゲームの不調や操作方法が不明なため、一度ゲームを再起動します。再起動後、貯めたお金でバッテリーやシャベル、バックパックなどの装備をアップグレードします。

highlights.title: チ●パンジーに変身
highlights.description: 装備のアップグレード中に、まつりが作業員コスチュームの中からチンパンジーのコスチュームを選択し、全員がチンパンジーの姿になって掘り進めることになります。

highlights.title: 地下100mの採掘作業と新たなアイテム発見
highlights.description: 地下100mの地点まで掘り進め、コハクや金などの貴重な鉱石を発見し、売却で得た資金でさらに装備を強化します。

highlights.title: 恐竜の化石を発見し、大盛り上がり
highlights.description: さらに深く掘り進めていると、巨大な恐竜の化石（肋骨）のようなものを見つけ、出演者一同が興奮します。また、掘削を助けてくれる「労働者」を雇えることが判明します。

highlights.title: 地下200mに到達と遺跡の発見
highlights.description: 地下200mに到達し、アメジストなどの貴重な鉱石や、古代の遺跡のような空間を発見します。ワープストーンを見つけて地上に戻り、さらに装備をアップグレードします。

highlights.title: 地下500mを目指す過酷な採掘
highlights.description: 装備を強化し、より深く地下500mを目指して採掘を続けます。掘削が進むにつれて硬い鉱石が多くなり、ダイナマイトが必要になるなど、作業は困難になります。

highlights.title: 地下500mに到達し、大量のデカ鉱石を採掘
highlights.description: 苦労の末、地下500mのワープゾーンに到達します。そこには巨大なデカアメジストやデカサファイアなど、高値で売れる貴重な鉱石が大量に埋蔵されており、一気に大金を稼ぎます。

highlights.title: 400m層への道を探る
highlights.description: 300m層からさらに深く掘り進めるが、400m層へのワープゾーンを見逃していたことが判明。壁を掘り進めながら穴を探す。

highlights.title: 500m層の採掘と400m層へのワープゾーン確保
highlights.description: 500mの深度に到達し、ウランやダイヤモンドといった高価な鉱石を大量に発見する。その後、見逃していた400m層へのワープゾーンを見つけ、地上に戻り売却・アップグレードを目指す。

highlights.title: 地下400m層の古代遺跡エリアの探索
highlights.description: 装備をアップグレードした後、400m層にワープ。石造りの通路が広がる古代遺跡のようなエリアを発見する。進む際に誤って下に落ちてしまい、壁沿いの梯子を使って登り返すハプニングが発生。

highlights.title: 遺跡内でワープストーンや追加のバッテリーを発見
highlights.description: 遺跡内でワープストーンや予備バッテリーなどの重要アイテムを発見。さらに深く掘り進められることが示唆される。

highlights.title: 地下500m層への再突入と600m層への穴の発見
highlights.description: 500m層に戻り、壁に隠されたワープストーンを発見。さらに、600m層へ続く巨大な穴を見つけ、壁を破壊して先に進む。

highlights.title: 地下700m層に到達し、ゴールデンチンパンジーの神殿を発見
highlights.description: 600m層で大量の鉱石を採掘した後、700m層のワープゾーンを発見。ワープ先のエリアは、ステンドグラスや黄金のチンパンジー像がある豪華な神殿のような空間だった。

highlights.title: 700m層での高効率採掘と装備の継続的な強化
highlights.description: 700m層周辺の採掘作業に集中。特に高価なアダマンタイトやウラン、ダイヤモンドを大量に採掘し、手に入れた資金でツルハシやバックパック、バッテリーなどをアップグレードし、掘削能力を向上させる。

highlights.title: 800m層と900m層の危険なエリアの探索
highlights.description: 800m層で未来的な金属のトンネル、900m層で溶岩が流れる危険なエリアを発見。壁掘りアップグレードを活用し、熱に耐えながら全員で一気に999m層まで掘り進める。

highlights.title: 1000m層（最終層）に到達し、ゲームクリア
highlights.description: ついに1000mの最終層に到達。金庫室のような場所でボタンを押すと、全員が掘ってきた縦穴の経路が映し出され、見事にゲームクリア。

highlights.title: ゲームクリア後の感想と配信終了
highlights.description: ゲームクリア後の感想を語り合う。クリアすると世界がリセットされる機能があることが判明し、「夢落ち」だったと盛り上がりながら配信が終了する。

overview_en.summary: Four members of Hololive—Natsuiro Matsuri, Shirakami Fubuki, Takane Lui, and Yukihana Lamy—cooperatively played the digging game 'Keep Digging,' aiming for the final goal of 1000m underground. From the 500m layer onwards, high-difficulty bedrock and special areas appeared. They utilized wall-digging upgrades and search functions to advance their excavation. They finally reached the vault 1000m underground and successfully cleared the game. In the end, the trajectory they had dug was displayed, leading to excitement over a dream-like ending.
overview_en.mood: A cheerful stream with a consistently amicable atmosphere, turning even troubles into laughter.

highlights_en.title: Game Start and Explanation
highlights_en.description: The stream begins. After greetings from the cast, the game is explained. It is introduced as a simple game where players dig soil, mine ores, sell them, and use the proceeds to upgrade their equipment.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Digging and Understanding the Game System
highlights_en.description: All players begin digging the ground. As they dig deeper, they find items like coal, and it is discovered that they can earn money by selling these items to the suited man on the map.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of the First Warp Zone and Troubleshooting
highlights_en.description: After digging deep, they reach a cave-like space and discover a warp zone. However, the warp zone fails to activate properly, leading to troubles, such as Lamy getting stuck and unable to return from the hole.

highlights_en.title: Game Restart and Equipment Upgrade
highlights_en.description: Due to game glitches and uncertainty about controls, they restart the game once. After restarting, they use the money they saved to upgrade equipment such as batteries, shovels, and backpacks.

highlights_en.title: Transforming into Chimpanzees
highlights_en.description: While upgrading equipment, Matsuri selects a chimpanzee costume from the worker costume options, resulting in everyone digging while dressed as chimpanzees.

highlights_en.title: Digging at 100m Underground and Discovering New Items
highlights_en.description: They dig down to 100m underground, discover valuable ores like amber and gold, and use the funds gained from sales to further strengthen their equipment.

highlights_en.title: Discovering a Dinosaur Fossil, Leading to Excitement
highlights_en.description: As they dig even deeper, they find something resembling a gigantic dinosaur fossil (ribcage), exciting all the performers. It is also discovered that they can hire 'workers' to assist with the excavation.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 200m Underground and Discovering Ruins
highlights_en.description: They reach 200m underground, discovering valuable ores like amethyst and an area resembling ancient ruins. They find a warp stone, return to the surface, and upgrade their equipment further.

highlights_en.title: Harsh Excavation Aiming for 500m Underground
highlights_en.description: After strengthening their equipment, they continue digging deeper, aiming for 500m underground. As excavation progresses, harder ores become more frequent, requiring dynamite, making the work difficult.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 500m Underground and Mining Large Ores
highlights_en.description: After great effort, they reach the 500m underground warp zone. This layer contains a large amount of valuable, high-priced ores, such as giant Amethyst and giant Sapphire, allowing them to earn a large sum of money quickly.

highlights_en.title: Searching for the Path to the 400m Layer
highlights_en.description: They dig deeper from the 300m layer but realize they had missed the warp zone to the 400m layer. They search for the hole by digging through the walls.

highlights_en.title: Mining the 500m Layer and Securing the Warp Zone to the 400m Layer
highlights_en.description: They reach a depth of 500m, discovering large quantities of expensive ores like Uranium and Diamond. They then find the previously missed warp zone to the 400m layer, return to the surface, and aim for selling and upgrading.

highlights_en.title: Exploring the Ancient Ruins Area at 400m Underground
highlights_en.description: After upgrading equipment, they warp to the 400m layer. They discover an area resembling ancient ruins with stone-built passages. A mishap occurs when they accidentally fall down while progressing, requiring them to climb back up using a ladder along the wall.

highlights_en.title: Discovering Warp Stones and Extra Batteries within the Ruins
highlights_en.description: They discover crucial items like warp stones and spare batteries inside the ruins. This suggests that they can dig even deeper.

highlights_en.title: Re-entry into the 500m Underground Layer and Discovery of the Hole to the 600m Layer
highlights_en.description: Returning to the 500m layer, they find a hidden warp stone in the wall. Furthermore, they discover a huge hole leading to the 600m layer and break through the wall to proceed.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 700m Underground and Discovering the Golden Chimpanzee Temple
highlights_en.description: After mining a large amount of ore in the 600m layer, they discover the 700m warp zone. The warped destination was a luxurious, temple-like space featuring stained glass and a golden chimpanzee statue.

highlights_en.title: High-Efficiency Mining in the 700m Layer and Continuous Equipment Upgrades
highlights_en.description: They focus on mining operations around the 700m layer. They excavate large quantities of particularly expensive ores like Adamantite, Uranium, and Diamond, using the funds obtained to upgrade their pickaxes, backpacks, and batteries, thus improving their digging ability.

highlights_en.title: Exploring Dangerous Areas in the 800m and 900m Layers
highlights_en.description: They discover futuristic metal tunnels in the 800m layer and dangerous areas with flowing lava in the 900m layer. Utilizing wall-digging upgrades, they withstand the heat and quickly dig down together to the 999m layer.

highlights_en.title: Reaching the 1000m Layer (Final Layer) and Clearing the Game
highlights_en.description: They finally reach the final layer at 1000m. When they press a button in the vault-like area, the vertical path they all dug is displayed, successfully clearing the game.

highlights_en.title: Post-Game Clear Impressions and Stream End
highlights_en.description: They share their thoughts after clearing the game. It is revealed that the game features a world-reset function upon completion, concluding the stream with excitement over the realization that it was 'all a dream'.

title: 【Keep Digging】掘ります。【白上フブキ/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: ホロライブのメンバー4人（白上フブキ、夏色まつり、雪花ラミィ、風真いろは）が、協力プレイで穴を掘り進め、地下に埋まる鉱石や化石、お宝などを発掘していくシミュレーションゲーム「Keep Digging」をプレイ。序盤で猿化し、そのままの姿で地下深くを掘り進めた。地下600mの遺跡、700mの古代神殿、そして900mを越える溶岩地帯を突破し、最終的に1000mの地下バンカーに到達。最後のボタンを押すことで世界がリセットされるという衝撃的なエンディングを迎え、大盛り上がりのまま配信を終えた。
overview.mood: 終始ハイテンションで賑やかな雰囲気、驚きと感動のラスト

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲーム概要の説明
highlights.description: 配信が始まり、出演メンバーの紹介と、穴を掘って鉱石を売り、装備をアップグレードしてさらに深く掘り進めるというゲーム「Keep Digging」のシンプルな概要が説明される。

highlights.title: 地面を掘り始め、早速鉱石を売る
highlights.description: ゲームがスタートし、メンバー全員で土の地面を掘り始め、出てきた石ころや石炭を地面に立っているスーツ姿の男性NPCに売却し、初期資金を得る。

highlights.title: 地下の洞窟を発見し、転落
highlights.description: 地面を掘り進めるうちに穴が深くなり、地下の洞窟のような空間を発見。しかし、洞窟は深く降りる手段がないため、メンバーがそのまま落ちていく。体力ゲージのようなバッテリーがなくなると「死ぬ」ことが判明。

highlights.title: ホストが切断しゲーム再起動
highlights.description: 深く掘り進める最中、ホストであるフブキの回線が切断され、ゲームを一度再起動することになる。再接続後、ゲームの設定で装備のアップグレードを行い、掘り進める効率を上げる。

highlights.title: 洞窟内にお宝（恐竜の化石）を発見
highlights.description: 再開後、洞窟をさらに深く掘り進めると、恐竜の骨格（化石）や宝箱を発見する。化石は高い値がつき、宝箱からはアイテムや新しいエモートを獲得する。

highlights.title: コスチューム「チンパンジー」を獲得
highlights.description: 宝箱からチンパンジーのコスチュームとエモートを獲得し、メンバー全員で早速着替える。人間離れしたチンパンジーの姿になり、さらにコミカルな掘り進めが展開される。

highlights.title: 洞窟の最深部をめぐる競争
highlights.description: 地下を掘り進めていく中で、より深くにある鉱石を目指し、メンバー間で競争が激化する。特に風真いろはは「キャリーされたぜの力」で驚異的な掘り進めを見せる。

highlights.title: 500m付近で新たな化石や貴金属を発見
highlights.description: 地下500m付近まで到達し、新たな化石や巨大なルビー、サファイア、ダイヤモンドといった高価な鉱石を大量に発見する。メンバーのバックパックがパンクするほどの収穫となる。

highlights.title: 地下600m付近にある遺跡に到達
highlights.description: さらに掘り進め、地下600m付近で人工的な構造を持つ遺跡に到達する。遺跡内には様々な部屋があり、隠された宝箱やお宝を探すことになる。

highlights.title: 400mワープ地点を発見し、高価な宝石を掘りまくる
highlights.description: 地中を掘り進め、隠されていた400m地点のワープストーンを発見。付近にはデカランやアダムンタイトなど高価な宝石が集中しており、採掘に集中する。

highlights.title: 700m地点の古代神殿を発見
highlights.description: 地下をさらに深く掘り進め、700m地点で古代神殿のような美しい遺跡を発見。神殿の入り口にはワープストーンが設置されていた。

highlights.title: コスチューム「ゴールデンチンパンジー」をゲット
highlights.description: 古代神殿内部の宝箱から、新しいコスチューム「ゴールデンチンパンジー」と「チンパンジーの雄叫び」エモートを入手する。

highlights.title: アイテム探索機能（Q）を発見
highlights.description: キーボードのQキーを押すことで、近くにある鉱石や宝箱が光るアイテム探索機能があることを発見し、効率的に採掘を進める。

highlights.title: 地上に戻り、売却と大量アップグレード
highlights.description: 大量の鉱石を地上で売却し、約18万ドルの大金を得る。ピッケルやバックパック、バッテリーなど、採掘効率に関わる装備を一気にアップグレードする。

highlights.title: 溶岩地帯での採掘とオリハルコンの発見
highlights.description: 700mワープ地点からさらに深く掘り進め、地中が赤く染まる溶岩地帯に到達。ここで非常に高価な鉱石「オリハルコン」を発見する。

highlights.title: 1000mの地下バンカーに到達
highlights.description: 地下1000m付近まで掘り進め、巨大な金庫の扉が設置された地下バンカーに到達。内部には人間が生活していた痕跡が残されていた。

highlights.title: ティラノサウルスの頚椎を発掘
highlights.description: バンカー付近で、最後の化石パーツであるティラノサウルスの頚椎を発掘し、目標としていた全ての化石パーツの収集を完了する。

highlights.title: 赤いボタンを押して世界崩壊のエンディングへ
highlights.description: バンカーの最奥にあった大きな赤いボタンを押したところ、世界が崩壊し爆発音とともに強制的にゲームが終了。地中探索の軌跡が表示された後、「GAME OVER」となりタイトル画面に戻る。

highlights.title: 配信終了と感想
highlights.description: ゲームがタイトル画面に戻り、メンバー全員で早すぎるエンディングに驚きつつ、配信を締めくくる。あっという間の協力ディギング配信だったと感想を述べる。

overview_en.summary: Four Hololive members (Shirakami Fubuki, Natsuiro Matsuri, Yukihana Lamy, Kazama Iroha) played the co-op simulation game "Keep Digging," where they dig holes to unearth buried ores, fossils, and treasures. Early in the game, they turned into monkeys and continued digging deep underground in that form. They broke through the ruins at 600m underground, the ancient temple at 700m, and the lava zone past 900m, finally reaching the underground bunker at 1000m. The stream concluded with great excitement after a shocking ending where pressing the final button reset the world.
overview_en.mood: High-tension and lively atmosphere throughout, a surprising and emotional ending

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Game Outline Explanation
highlights_en.description: The stream begins with the introduction of the appearing members and a simple outline of the game 'Keep Digging,' which involves digging holes, selling ore, upgrading equipment, and digging deeper.

highlights_en.title: Starting to Dig and Immediately Selling Ore
highlights_en.description: The game starts, and all members begin digging into the soil. They sell the collected pebbles and coal to a suited male NPC standing on the surface to obtain initial funds.

highlights_en.title: Discovering and Falling into an Underground Cave
highlights_en.description: As they dig deeper, the hole widens, and they discover an underground cave-like space. Since there is no means to descend slowly, the members simply fall in. It is revealed that running out of the battery, which acts like a health bar, results in 'death.'

highlights_en.title: Host Disconnects and Game Restarts
highlights_en.description: While digging deep, Fubuki, the host, disconnects, requiring a game restart. After reconnecting, they upgrade their equipment in the game settings to increase digging efficiency.

highlights_en.title: Discovering Treasure (Dinosaur Fossil) in the Cave
highlights_en.description: After resuming, digging deeper into the cave reveals a dinosaur skeleton (fossil) and treasure chests. Fossils fetch a high price, and treasure chests yield items and new emotes.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the 'Chimpanzee' Costume
highlights_en.description: They obtain a chimpanzee costume and emote from a treasure chest, and all members immediately change into them. Transforming into exaggerated chimpanzees makes the digging process even more comical.

highlights_en.title: Race for the Deepest Part of the Cave
highlights_en.description: As they dig deeper underground, the competition among members intensifies, aiming for the ores located further down. Kazama Iroha, in particular, shows amazing digging prowess, attributing it to the 'power of being carried.'

highlights_en.title: Discovering New Fossils and Precious Metals Near 500m
highlights_en.description: They reach about 500m underground and discover a large quantity of expensive ores, including new fossils and giant rubies, sapphires, and diamonds. The haul is so large that the members' backpacks are bursting.

highlights_en.title: Reaching Ruins Located Near 600m Underground
highlights_en.description: Digging further, they reach ruins with artificial structures around 600m underground. The ruins contain various rooms where they search for hidden treasure chests and loot.

highlights_en.title: Discovering the 400m Warp Point and Mining Tons of Expensive Gems
highlights_en.description: Digging through the ground, they discover a hidden warp stone at the 400m mark. Expensive gems like Dekaran and Adamantite are concentrated nearby, and they focus on mining intensely.

highlights_en.title: Discovering the Ancient Temple at the 700m Mark
highlights_en.description: Digging even deeper underground, they discover a beautiful ruin resembling an ancient temple at 700m. A warp stone was installed at the entrance of the temple.

highlights_en.title: Getting the 'Golden Chimpanzee' Costume
highlights_en.description: They obtain a new costume, the 'Golden Chimpanzee,' and the 'Chimpanzee Roar' emote from a treasure chest inside the ancient temple.

highlights_en.title: Discovering the Item Search Function (Q)
highlights_en.description: They discover an item search function activated by pressing the Q key on the keyboard, which makes nearby ores and treasure chests glow, allowing for more efficient mining.

highlights_en.title: Returning to the Surface, Selling, and Mass Upgrade
highlights_en.description: They sell a large amount of ore on the surface, earning a huge sum of approximately $180,000. They immediately upgrade equipment related to mining efficiency, such as pickaxes, backpacks, and batteries.

highlights_en.title: Mining in the Lava Zone and Discovering Orichalcum
highlights_en.description: Digging deeper from the 700m warp point, they reach a lava zone where the ground is stained red. Here, they discover the extremely expensive ore 'Orichalcum.'

highlights_en.title: Reaching the 1000m Underground Bunker
highlights_en.description: They dig down to about 1000m underground and reach a subterranean bunker secured by a massive vault door. Inside, there were traces of human habitation.

highlights_en.title: Excavating the Tyrannosaurus Cervical Vertebra
highlights_en.description: Near the bunker, they excavate the final fossil piece—the cervical vertebra of a Tyrannosaurus—completing the collection of all target fossil parts.

highlights_en.title: Pressing the Red Button Leads to the World Destruction Ending
highlights_en.description: Upon pressing a large red button at the deepest part of the bunker, the world collapsed, and the game forcibly ended with an explosion. After displaying the trajectory of their underground exploration, the screen showed 'GAME OVER' and returned to the title screen.

highlights_en.title: Stream Conclusion and Reactions
highlights_en.description: The game returns to the title screen, and all members express surprise at the abrupt ending while concluding the stream. They remark on how quickly the co-op digging stream passed.

overview_en.summary: A collaborative stream of the cooperative game "Keep Digging" featuring Yukihana Lamy, Shirakami Fubuki, Momosuzu Nene, and Hoshimachi Suisei. Despite initial technical issues, the team efficiently advanced their excavation starting from the mid-game with powerful equipment. At ruins discovered at 400m and 700m underground, they acquired costumes like the "Miner Outfit" and the "Golden Chimpanzee," raising the members' spirits. Especially after 700m, they found large quantities of expensive ores like Uranium, Diamond, and the ultimate Orichalcum, significantly upgrading their gear. They finally reached 1,000m underground, and pressing a button inside the vault led to a shocking conclusion: a gigantic hole opened up on the surface accompanied by a huge explosion. The members burst into laughter at the abrupt ending and concluded the stream cheerfully.
overview_en.mood: Lively, High-energy, Joyful, Funny

highlights_en.title: Start of Keep Digging with a Rare Group of Four
highlights_en.description: The cooperative game begins with the four members: Yukihana Lamy, Shirakami Fubuki, Momosuzu Nene, and Hoshimachi Suisei.

highlights_en.title: The Rule is "Shinpo is Best" (Simple is Best)
highlights_en.description: The game is simple: dig the ground and sell the ore. The phrase "Simple is best" became a popular mishearing as "Shinpo is best."

highlights_en.title: Member Introductions
highlights_en.description: Before starting the game, members briefly introduce themselves in turn.

highlights_en.title: First Treasure Chest Found Immediately
highlights_en.description: Immediately after starting the game, they quickly find the first treasure chest and get an item that boosts "Climbing Power."

highlights_en.title: Host (Lamy) Experiences Game Disconnection Trouble
highlights_en.description: Lamy, the host, is disconnected from the network while exploring deep underground and is kicked out of the game.

highlights_en.title: Game Restart and Reconnection
highlights_en.description: Following advice from the members, they restart the game and begin multiplayer again.

highlights_en.title: Selling Excavated Materials and Equipment Upgrade
highlights_en.description: They sell the collected stones to an NPC and upgrade shovels, batteries, and other equipment.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/アップグレード

highlights_en.title: Reaching the 50m Underground Point
highlights_en.description: They activate the checkpoint (Warp Stone) at 50m and continue digging deeper.

highlights_en.title: Dinosaur Fossil (Head) Discovered
highlights_en.description: They discover and mine a large dinosaur skull fossil deep underground.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the Chimpanzee Costume from a Treasure Chest
highlights_en.description: They get the "Emote: Chimpanzee" motion from a treasure chest, and all members turn into chimpanzees.

highlights_en.title: Chimpanzee Discovers Extremely Expensive Ore
highlights_en.description: Kanade Chimpanzee discovers a large amount of Amethyst (expensive ore) and rejoices.

highlights_en.title: Dinosaur Fossil (Ribs) Discovered
highlights_en.description: They discover an even larger dinosaur rib cage fossil near the 100m mark.

highlights_en.title: All Members Gather in Chimpanzee Form
highlights_en.description: All members return to the surface as chimpanzees and run wild with emotes.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/ハイテンション

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the "Rampage" Emote from a Treasure Chest
highlights_en.description: They acquire the "Emote: Rampage" from a treasure chest through excavation.

highlights_en.title: Ruins Discovered at the 200m Mark
highlights_en.description: Continuing excavation, they reach a ruin-like space at 200m underground and discover a warp zone.

highlights_en.title: Significant Equipment Upgrade
highlights_en.description: Returning to the surface, they sell the large amount of mined ore and level up their equipment (pickaxes, batteries, backpacks).
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/アップグレード

highlights_en.title: Resuming by Warping from the 50m Mark
highlights_en.description: After gearing up, they move to the 50m warp zone and resume their exploration.

highlights_en.title: Ruins Discovered at the 300m Mark
highlights_en.description: They enter an area at the 300m mark that also contains ruin-like structures.

highlights_en.title: Huge Diamond ($51,000) Discovered
highlights_en.description: They discover a giant diamond ore at the 500m mark, aiming for a fortune.

highlights_en.title: Breaking 500m and Discovering Expensive Ores
highlights_en.description: They break 500m and enter an area densely packed with expensive ores like Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald. However, they struggle due to equipment limitations.

highlights_en.title: Final Equipment Upgrade
highlights_en.description: Using the accumulated funds, they upgrade their equipment close to the final level.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/アップグレード

highlights_en.title: 400m Warp Zone Discovered
highlights_en.description: Continuing excavation, they discover and activate the Warp Stone at 400m. They also mine dinosaur bones and emeralds.

highlights_en.title: 400m Ruins and Treasure Chest
highlights_en.description: They obtain the "Miner Green Costume" and "Miner Red Costume" in the 400m ruin area.

highlights_en.title: Giant Dinosaur Bone (Tail) Discovered
highlights_en.description: They discover and excavate a massive fossil resembling a dinosaur tail within the 400m ruin area.

highlights_en.title: Massive Discovery of Expensive Ores at 500m
highlights_en.description: They continue digging and discover large quantities of Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald past the 500m mark.

highlights_en.title: Mining Extremely Expensive Uranium and Diamond
highlights_en.description: They discover and excitedly mine extremely expensive ores (over $50,000) such as Uranium and Diamond.

highlights_en.title: Giant Chimpanzee Statue at 700m
highlights_en.description: Arriving at the ruins at 700m. They discover stained glass and a large chimpanzee statue, hailing it as "Our King."

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the "Golden Chimpanzee Costume"
highlights_en.description: They obtain the "Golden Chimpanzee Costume" and the "Emote: Chimpanzee Scream" from a treasure chest at the 700m mark.

highlights_en.title: Cashing in Mined Ore and Upgrading Equipment
highlights_en.description: Returning to the surface, they sell the massive haul of mined ore, significantly boosting their funds. They upgrade to a Gold Pickaxe and improve their backpacks, etc.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/アップグレード

highlights_en.title: Digging Past 700m with the Gold Pickaxe
highlights_en.description: With the upgraded Gold Pickaxe, their excavation speed increases, and they dig smoothly.

highlights_en.title: Orichalcum ($530,000) Discovered, Huge Excitement
highlights_en.description: At the 751m mark, they discover Orichalcum, the highest-grade material in the game. The members are highly excited and cheer.

highlights_en.title: Digging Further, Reaching an Area Dense with Orichalcum
highlights_en.description: Upgrading to the Uranium Pickaxe, they reach an area past 800m densely packed with ultra-expensive ores like Orichalcum and mine a large quantity.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 1,000m and Opening the Giant Vault Door
highlights_en.description: They finally reach the ultimate point of the game, 1,000m underground. A vault door lies beyond.

highlights_en.title: Pressing the Ending Trigger (Button)
highlights_en.description: Inside the vault's machine room, the members cooperate to press the activation button.

highlights_en.title: Epic Explosion and Display of the Excavation Route
highlights_en.description: When the activation button is pressed, an epic explosion occurs, and a visual display shows the path they dug extending straight up to the sky.

highlights_en.title: Did the Game End with a Dream Twist? And an Explosion Finale
highlights_en.description: The surface also explodes massively, leading to a Game Over screen. The host connection is cut, returning them to the title screen, and the members end the stream laughing hysterically.

highlights_en.title: Stream Ending Greetings
highlights_en.description: Expressing surprise at how quickly they cleared the game, all members thank the viewers and conclude the stream.

title: 【睡眠導入朗読】蜘蛛の糸/芥川龍之介【ホロライブ/夏色まつり】

overview.summary: ホロライブの夏色まつりによる、芥川龍之介の短編小説『蜘蛛の糸』の朗読配信です。初めての朗読配信として、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気の中、地獄に落ちた大泥棒カンダタが、過去の善行によりお釈迦様から与えられた蜘蛛の糸を登ろうとする物語を読み聞かせています。カンダタが他の罪人を排斥しようとした瞬間に糸が切れ、再び地獄へ落ちるという、人間のエゴと業を描いた物語を、優しく穏やかな声で綴っています。約13分と短時間で完結するため、寝る前の睡眠導入にも適した内容です。
overview.mood: 落ち着いた雰囲気、睡眠導入

highlights.title: 朗読配信の開始と挨拶
highlights.description: 初めての朗読配信であること、噛むかもしれないことを伝えつつ、リスナーに挨拶をする。

highlights.title: 朗読作品の紹介と配信時間の目安
highlights.description: 今回の作品が芥川龍之介の「蜘蛛の糸」であること、配信時間は約10分と想定していることを説明。

highlights.title: 朗読開始：極楽と地獄の描写
highlights.description: お釈迦様が極楽の蓮池の縁を歩き、池の下にある地獄の様子を覗く場面から朗読が始まる。

highlights.title: 罪人カンダタの過去の善行
highlights.description: 地獄の底にいる大泥棒カンダタの、過去の唯一の善行（小さな蜘蛛を助けたこと）がお釈迦様の記憶に蘇る。

highlights.title: 蜘蛛の糸が地獄へ垂らされる
highlights.description: お釈迦様はカンダタを救うため、極楽の銀色の蜘蛛の糸を地獄の底へまっすぐに下ろす。

highlights.title: カンダタ、蜘蛛の糸を発見し登り始める
highlights.description: 地獄で苦しんでいたカンダタが、空から垂れてきた蜘蛛の糸を見つけ、必死に登り始める。

highlights.title: 多数の罪人が糸を登り始める
highlights.description: 登る途中でカンダタが下を見下ろすと、数えきれないほどの罪人たちが蜘蛛の糸を追って登ってきているのを発見する。

highlights.title: カンダタの独占欲と糸の切断
highlights.description: カンダタが「この糸は俺のものだ」と叫んだ瞬間、糸は音を立てて切れ、カンダタは暗闇へ落下する。

highlights.title: 朗読終了：お釈迦様の心境
highlights.description: カンダタの無慈悲な心を見たお釈迦様は悲しそうな顔をされ、再び歩き始める。極楽の蓮池には平和な朝の様子が戻る。

highlights.title: 朗読後の感想とまとめ
highlights.description: 朗読を終え、リスナーへ挨拶し、たまに朗読配信をしたいという意欲を語る。

overview_en.summary: This is a reading stream by Hololive's Natsuiro Matsuri of Ryūnosuke Akutagawa's short story, "The Spider's Thread" (Kumo no Ito). As her first reading stream, she narrates the story in a quiet and calming atmosphere. It tells the tale of Kandata, a great thief who fell into Hell, attempting to climb the spider's thread offered by Buddha due to one good deed in his past. The story, which depicts human ego and karma, is told in a gentle and soothing voice. The thread snaps the moment Kandata tries to exclude the other sinners, sending him back to Hell. Since it is short (about 13 minutes), it is suitable for winding down or as a sleep aid before bed.
overview_en.mood: Calm atmosphere, Sleep aid

highlights_en.title: Start of the Reading Stream and Greeting
highlights_en.description: Greeting the listeners, while mentioning that this is her first reading stream and she might stumble over her words.

highlights_en.title: Introduction of the Reading Material and Estimated Stream Length
highlights_en.description: Explaining that the work is Ryūnosuke Akutagawa's "The Spider's Thread" and that the stream is expected to last about 10 minutes.

highlights_en.title: Reading Starts: Description of Paradise and Hell
highlights_en.description: The reading begins with the scene where Buddha walks along the edge of the Lotus Pond in Paradise and peers down into the state of Hell below the pond.

highlights_en.title: The Sinner Kandata's Past Good Deed
highlights_en.description: Buddha recalls the only good deed performed by Kandata, the great thief at the bottom of Hell (saving a small spider).

highlights_en.title: The Spider's Thread is Lowered into Hell
highlights_en.description: To save Kandata, Buddha lowers a silver spider's thread straight down from Paradise to the bottom of Hell.

highlights_en.title: Kandata Discovers the Spider's Thread and Begins to Climb
highlights_en.description: Kandata, suffering in Hell, finds the spider's thread dangling from the sky and frantically begins to climb.

highlights_en.title: Numerous Sinners Begin to Climb the Thread
highlights_en.description: While climbing, Kandata looks down and discovers countless sinners following him up the spider's thread.

highlights_en.title: Kandata's Selfishness and the Snapping of the Thread
highlights_en.description: The moment Kandata shouts, "This thread is mine!", the thread snaps with a sound, and Kandata falls into the darkness.

highlights_en.title: End of Reading: Buddha's Feelings
highlights_en.description: Seeing Kandata's merciless heart, Buddha looks sad and begins walking again. The peaceful morning scene returns to the Lotus Pond in Paradise.

highlights_en.title: Post-Reading Impressions and Conclusion
highlights_en.description: Finishing the reading, she greets the listeners and expresses her desire to do more reading streams occasionally.

title: 【 Keep Digging 】このゲームで屁をこけることぐらいしか覚えてません【音乃瀬奏】#hololiveDEV_IS #ReGLOSS

overview.summary: 音乃瀬奏、白上フブキ、夏色まつり、雪花ラミィ、星街すいせいの5名による協力型採掘シミュレーションゲーム『Keep Digging』のコラボ配信。序盤のアップグレードを経て、地下深く（400m, 700m）にあるチェックポイントや古代遺跡を進みます。途中、金色のチンパンジー像（オサ）や地下採掘施設の発見などもありつつ、大量のデカ鉱石やアダマンタイトなどの高額な鉱物を採掘。最終的に地下1000mにある巨大な機械を起動させ、見事にゲームクリアを達成しました。
overview.mood: 終始、賑やかで愉快な雰囲気

highlights.title: ゲーム概要紹介と採掘開始
highlights.description: シンプルなルール（石を掘って売る）の説明と、メンバー紹介。各自がピッケルを持ち、地上の公園で最初の採掘を始める。

highlights.title: 最初の洞窟とアイテム発見
highlights.description: 掘り進めた先に広い洞窟が広がり、ワープストーンやバッテリーなどのアイテムを発見。アイテムを売却し、装備のアップグレードを行う。

highlights.title: ゲーム切断と再接続
highlights.description: ネットワークの問題によりゲームが切断され、ホストの奏がゲームの再構築を試みる。

highlights.title: 地下50m地点のチェックポイント到達
highlights.description: ゲームを再開し、地下50m地点に到達。ファストトラベルができるチェックポイントを発見する。

highlights.title: チンパンジーコスチュームの発見とエモート遊び
highlights.description: 宝箱からチンパンジーのコスチューム（レッド、グリーン、ブルー）とゴリラのコスチュームを発見。メンバーがチンパンジーの格好でエモート（おなら、土下座、大暴れなど）を試す。

highlights.title: 地下200mに到達し、古代遺跡を発見
highlights.description: 掘削を続け、地下200m地点で古代の遺跡のような構造物に到達。遺跡内には様々なアイテムが配置されている。

highlights.title: 貴重な鉱石の大量発見
highlights.description: 遺跡内でデカアメジストやデカエメラルド、デカルビーなど、高額な貴重な鉱石を大量に発見する。

highlights.title: 中間地点の売却とアップグレード
highlights.description: 一度地上に戻り、集めた鉱石を売却して約14万ドルを獲得。ピッケルやバッテリーなどを大幅にアップグレードする。

highlights.title: 400mチェックポイントの発見と起動
highlights.description: 地下400m地点のチェックポイントを苦労して発見し起動。次の目標を目指す。

highlights.title: 巨大な古代遺跡の罠
highlights.description: 地下に広がる古代遺跡の内部を進む途中で、床が抜け落ちるトラップに遭遇。一時的にパニックになるメンバーたち。

highlights.title: 地下500m地点で大量の貴重な鉱石を発見
highlights.description: 地下深くの広い洞窟内で、高額な「デカ」鉱石（デカサファイア、デカルビー、デカウランなど）の巨大な鉱脈を発見し、集中して採掘する。

highlights.title: 700mチェックポイントに到達
highlights.description: さらに掘り進め、地下700m地点に到達。次のファストトラベルポイントを確保する。

highlights.title: ゴールデンチンパンジーの像（オサ）の登場
highlights.description: 700m地点の奥にある広間にて、神々しい光を浴びる巨大なゴールデンチンパンジーの像を発見。メンバーは「オサ」と呼んで崇める。

highlights.title: アイテム「サーチ」機能の発見
highlights.description: アイテムボックスから「サーチ」機能を習得。発動すると周りのアイテムの位置を把握でき、効率が大幅に向上する。

highlights.title: 大量売却と装備強化 (2回目)
highlights.description: 700mで大量に採掘した鉱石を売却し、約11.9万ドルを獲得。再び装備を強化する。

highlights.title: 装備強化後の700m地点での採掘
highlights.description: 強化されたピッケルで700m地点の鉱物を高速で採掘。効率が上がり、ダイアモンドやアダマンタイトを次々と掘り出す。

highlights.title: 巨大な恐竜の骨格を発見 (750m)
highlights.description: 地下750m付近の洞窟で、巨大な恐竜の骨格（化石）を発見。骨格の一部も採掘できる。

highlights.title: 800m地点、マグマ帯での採掘とシャイニングスター
highlights.description: 地下800mに到達すると、周囲が赤く輝くマグマ帯に突入。新たな貴重な鉱石「オリハルコン」を発見し、夢中で掘り進める。

highlights.title: 1000m地点に到達し、地下施設を発見
highlights.description: マグマ帯を抜け、地下1000mの地点に到達。そこには鉄の扉と近代的な地下施設が広がっていた。

highlights.title: エンディングトリガー起動とゲームクリア
highlights.description: 1000mの奥深くにある中央のボタンを押すと画面が赤く染まり、ゲームクリア（地形リセット）のムービーが流れ、配信が終了する。

overview_en.summary: A collaboration stream of the cooperative mining simulation game 'Keep Digging' featuring 5 members: Otonose Kanade, Shirakami Fubuki, Natsuiro Matsuri, Yukihana Lamy, and Hoshimachi Suisei. After initial upgrades, they advanced through checkpoints and ancient ruins deep underground (400m, 700m). Along the way, they discovered a golden chimpanzee statue (Osa) and underground mining facilities, while mining large quantities of high-value minerals like huge ores (Deca ores) and Adamantite. They successfully activated a giant machine located 1000m underground, achieving game completion.
overview_en.mood: Lively and cheerful atmosphere throughout

highlights_en.title: Game Overview Introduction and Start of Mining
highlights_en.description: Explanation of the simple rules (digging stones and selling them) and member introductions. Each member takes a pickaxe and begins the initial excavation in a park above ground.

highlights_en.title: First Cave and Item Discovery
highlights_en.description: A wide cave opens up after digging deeper, where warp stones and batteries are discovered. They sell the items and upgrade their equipment.

highlights_en.title: Game Disconnection and Reconnection
highlights_en.description: The game disconnects due to network issues, and Kanade (the host) attempts to rebuild the game session.

highlights_en.title: Reaching the Checkpoint at 50m Underground
highlights_en.description: Resuming the game, they reach the 50m underground mark and discover a checkpoint that allows for fast travel.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Chimpanzee Costumes and Emote Play
highlights_en.description: Chimpanzee costumes (red, green, blue) and a gorilla costume are discovered from a treasure chest. Members try out emotes (farting, dogeza, rampage, etc.) while dressed as chimpanzees.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 200m Underground and Discovering Ancient Ruins
highlights_en.description: Continuing excavation, they reach a structure resembling ancient ruins at the 200m underground mark. Various items are placed within the ruins.

highlights_en.title: Massive Discovery of Valuable Ores
highlights_en.description: They discover large quantities of high-value precious ores within the ruins, such as Huge Amethyst (Deca Amethyst), Huge Emerald (Deca Emerald), and Huge Ruby (Deca Ruby).

highlights_en.title: Mid-point Selling and Upgrades
highlights_en.description: Returning to the surface, they sell the collected ores and earn approximately $140,000. They significantly upgrade their pickaxes and batteries.

highlights_en.title: Discovery and Activation of the 400m Checkpoint
highlights_en.description: After considerable effort, they discover and activate the checkpoint at 400m underground. They aim for the next goal.

highlights_en.title: Trap in the Massive Ancient Ruins
highlights_en.description: While progressing through the massive ancient ruins underground, they encounter a trap where the floor collapses. The members temporarily panic.

highlights_en.title: Massive Discovery of Valuable Ores at 500m Underground
highlights_en.description: They discover a giant vein of high-value 'Huge' ores (Huge Sapphire, Huge Ruby, Huge Uran, etc.) in a wide cave deep underground, and focus on mining them.

highlights_en.title: Reaching the 700m Checkpoint
highlights_en.description: Digging further, they reach the 700m underground mark, securing the next fast travel point.

highlights_en.title: Appearance of the Golden Chimpanzee Statue (Osa)
highlights_en.description: In a large chamber deep beyond the 700m point, they discover a giant golden chimpanzee statue bathed in divine light. The members refer to it as 'Osa' and worship it.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of the 'Search' Item Function
highlights_en.description: They acquire the 'Search' function from an item box. When activated, it allows them to locate nearby items, significantly increasing efficiency.

highlights_en.title: Mass Selling and Equipment Enhancement (2nd Time)
highlights_en.description: They sell the massive amount of ore mined at 700m, earning approximately $119,000. They enhance their equipment again.

highlights_en.title: Mining at 700m Underground After Equipment Enhancement
highlights_en.description: Using the enhanced pickaxes, they rapidly mine minerals at the 700m point. Efficiency increases, and they quickly dig up diamond and adamantite.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of Giant Dinosaur Skeleton (750m)
highlights_en.description: They discover a giant dinosaur skeleton (fossil) in a cave around 750m underground. Parts of the skeleton can also be mined.

highlights_en.title: Mining in the Magma Zone at 800m and Shining Star
highlights_en.description: Upon reaching 800m underground, they enter a magma zone glowing red. They discover a new valuable ore, 'Orichalcum,' and furiously dig deeper.

highlights_en.title: Reaching 1000m Underground and Discovering an Underground Facility
highlights_en.description: Exiting the magma zone, they reach the 1000m underground mark. There, they find iron doors and a modern underground facility.

highlights_en.title: Activating the Ending Trigger and Game Clear
highlights_en.description: Pressing the central button deep within the 1000m mark, the screen turns red, followed by a game clear (terrain reset) movie, and the stream concludes.

title: 【歌枠】ピアノのオケでしっとり歌枠でちゅよ～【虎金妃笑虎】

overview.summary: 虎金妃笑虎による、ピアノ伴奏のみでしっとりと歌い上げる歌枠配信。ダンスレッスン帰りで疲労がある中、序盤から「Pretender」「マリーゴールド」など人気曲を披露。中盤以降も「蝶々結び」「プラネタリウム」などバラードを中心に熱唱したが、途中で「コネクト」の歌詞を飛ばすハプニングも発生。アンコールでは「ふたりごと」（RADWIMPS）や「星屑ヴィーナス」（Aiko）を披露し、優しく歌うことで声を抑えていると明かした。最後は熱いリクエストに応えて「残酷な天使のテーゼ」を力強く歌い上げ、次回配信の予告をして締めくくった。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気、リラックス、しっとり

highlights.title: 配信開始と挨拶
highlights.description: ダンスレッスン後で疲労困憊だが、歌枠の前に鼻うがいを済ませてきたことを報告。配信中に喉に痰が絡むようになり、配信者自身が笑ってしまう。

highlights.title: ダンスレッスンで疲労と鼻うがい報告
highlights.description: ダンスレッスン後で疲労困憊だが、歌枠の前に鼻うがいを済ませてきたことを報告。配信中に喉に痰が絡むようになり、配信者自身が笑ってしまう。

highlights.title: 【歌】Pretender / Official髭男dism
highlights.description: ピアノ伴奏のみで力強く感情的に歌い上げる。歌い終わった後、音を外してしまったが「ジョークです」と弁解。

highlights.title: 歌って泣くことが増えた？
highlights.description: ホロライブに入ってから大笑いする機会が増え、痰が絡むことが多くなったと話す。また、感情を込めて歌い上げると本当に泣いてしまうことがあると告白。

highlights.title: ダンスレッスン中、先輩の「イチャイチャ」に焼きもちを焼く
highlights.description: ダンスレッスンの休憩中に、ビビと千早が仲良くしているのを見て焼きもちを焼き、勇気を出して間に入ったというエピソードを披露。

highlights.title: 喉の調子が悪く、環境音を調整
highlights.description: 咳が続くため、環境音のカエルの鳴き声が大きくなっていたことを確認し、音量を調整する。

highlights.title: 【歌】マリーゴールド / あいみょん
highlights.description: ピアノ伴奏でしっとりとした雰囲気で「マリーゴールド」を歌唱。切ない歌詞を切なく歌い上げる。

highlights.title: 次の曲はBack Numberの「水平線」
highlights.description: 弾き語り音源をピアノ伴奏に変えて歌うことを予告し、曲の歌詞について話す。

highlights.title: 今後の企画と喉の調子について
highlights.description: 近日中に重大な告知があることを予告。喉の調子が悪化しているため、配信中にミュートを活用したいと語る。

highlights.title: 【歌】水平線 / back number
highlights.description: 3曲目となる「水平線」をピアノ伴奏で披露。非常に感情豊かな歌い方で視聴者からのコメントも盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 「なんでもないや」のピアノ伴奏を準備
highlights.description: 4曲目としてRADWIMPSの「なんでもないや」（映画『君の名は。』より）を選曲し、ピアノ伴奏の準備に入る。

highlights.title: 【歌】なんでもないや / RADWIMPS
highlights.description: 「なんでもないや」を歌唱開始。感情のこもったエモーショナルな歌い出し。

highlights.title: 「なんでもないや」歌唱終了
highlights.description: RADWIMPSの「なんでもないや」の歌唱を締めくくる。アプテンポの曲で力強く歌い上げた。

highlights.title: 海外コメントに感謝と照れ隠し
highlights.description: 海外リスナーからの英語のコメントに感謝を伝えつつ、「美人だね」といった褒め言葉に照れを隠す。

highlights.title: 歌枠でのトークが苦手な理由を説明
highlights.description: 歌に集中すると脳がぼーっとする（お酒を飲んだ状態のようになる）ため、トークがうまくいかないと弁解する。

highlights.title: 【歌】蝶々結び / Aimer
highlights.description: アコースティックピアノによるしっとりとしたアレンジで、Aimerの「蝶々結び」を歌唱。切ない感情を込めて歌い上げる。

highlights.title: 【歌】プラネタリウム / 大塚愛
highlights.description: リクエストに応え、夜の雰囲気にぴったりな大塚愛の「プラネタリウム」を披露。切なくも前向きな歌声で歌い上げる。

highlights.title: 【歌】コネクト / ClariS (歌唱ミス)
highlights.description: ピアノアレンジされた「コネクト」に挑戦するが、途中で歌詞を忘れてしまい、悔しさを滲ませる。

highlights.title: 自称「ブラックタイガー」のエピソード
highlights.description: 以前、全身黒い衣装だったため、コラボ相手のVTuberに「ブラックタイガーだね」と言われたエピソードを思い出す。

highlights.title: 【歌】三日月 / 絢香
highlights.description: リベンジマッチとして絢香の「三日月」を選曲。伸びやかで情感豊かな歌声を響かせる。

highlights.title: 【歌】君の知らない物語 / supercell
highlights.description: 夏のアニメソングの定番「君の知らない物語」をしっとりとしたピアノアレンジで歌い上げる。

highlights.title: 配信終了間近の挨拶と次回予告
highlights.description: 配信終了を告げ、リスナーに感謝を伝える。今後もコラボやゲーム配信の予定があると予告。

highlights.title: 【歌】コネクト / ClariS (歌唱ミス)
highlights.description: ピアノアレンジされた「コネクト」に挑戦するが、途中で歌詞を忘れてしまい、悔しさを滲ませる。

highlights.title: ポストソングトークと楽器の話題
highlights.description: 歌唱後の拍手に感謝を述べつつ、ピアノ伴奏はオケであり、自身はピアノやヴァイオリンを弾いていないと釈明。ヴァイオリンを習っていた過去を明かす。

highlights.title: 【歌】怪獣の歌 / Vaundy (アンコール1)
highlights.description: アンコールとして「怪獣の歌」を披露。サビのファルセットを多用した情感的な歌唱。

highlights.title: 【歌】ふたりごと / RADWIMPS (アンコール2)
highlights.description: 早口な歌詞に苦戦しつつも、RADWIMPSの「ふたりごと」を熱唱。歌い終わった後、歌詞を間違えたことを悔やむ。

highlights.title: 【歌】星屑ヴィーナス / Aiko (アンコール3)
highlights.description: 「優しい声で歌って欲しい」というコメントに対し、普段の力強い歌い方を抑えて優しいトーンで歌唱。

highlights.title: 次回配信予告（ジブリ縛り歌枠）
highlights.description: 歌枠が続きになったことを謝罪しつつ、翌日（日付上）にジブリ縛り歌枠をやることを予告。海外リスナーからの「ちびボイス」コメントに笑う。

highlights.title: 【歌】残酷な天使のテーゼ / 高橋洋子 (アンコール4)
highlights.description: 最後のアンコールとしてエヴァのテーマ曲「残酷な天使のテーゼ」を力強く披露。優しく歌う縛りを解いて熱唱した。

highlights.title: 「残酷な天使のテーゼ」歌唱終了と感謝
highlights.description: 最後のアンコール曲「残酷な天使のテーゼ」を歌い上げ、リスナーに深く感謝を伝える。明日18時からのジブリ縛り歌枠を改めて予告。

highlights.title: エンディングトーク：「ブラックタイガー」再び
highlights.description: リスナーからのコメントで「ブラックタイガー」の愛称が再浮上し、夜に舞い降りる天使、ブラックタイガーだと名乗る。

highlights.title: エンディングトーク：ピアノアレンジの感想と別れ
highlights.description: ピアノ伴奏によるしっとり歌枠の感想を話し、「残酷な天使のテーゼ」がジャズっぽく聞こえたことに触れる。明日18時に再会することを約束し、配信を終える。

overview_en.summary: A singing stream by Kokon Kinmito, featuring heartfelt vocals accompanied only by piano. Despite being tired after dance lessons, she performed popular songs like "Pretender" and "Marigold" early on. In the middle section and beyond, she passionately sang ballads such as "Chocho Musubi" and "Planetarium," though an incident occurred where she skipped lyrics for "Connect." During the encore, she performed "Futari Goto" (RADWIMPS) and "Hoshikuzu Venus" (Aiko), revealing that she was intentionally restraining her voice by singing softly. Finally, responding to fervent requests, she powerfully sang "A Cruel Angel's Thesis" and concluded the stream with an announcement for the next broadcast.
overview_en.mood: Calm atmosphere throughout, relaxed, soothing/heartfelt

highlights_en.title: Stream start and greeting
highlights_en.description: Exhausted after dance lessons, but reports having finished nasal rinsing before the singing stream. During the stream, her throat started filling with phlegm, which made the streamer laugh.

highlights_en.title: Reporting fatigue from dance lessons and nasal rinsing
highlights_en.description: Exhausted after dance lessons, but reports having finished nasal rinsing before the singing stream. During the stream, her throat started filling with phlegm, which made the streamer laugh.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Pretender / Official Hige Dandism
highlights_en.description: Sings powerfully and emotionally, accompanied only by piano. After finishing, she missed a note but explained, "It was a joke."

highlights_en.title: Does she cry more often while singing?
highlights_en.description: She talks about how she laughs more often since joining Hololive, leading to more phlegm build-up. She also confessed that she sometimes truly cries when singing with deep emotion.

highlights_en.title: Getting jealous of seniors' "flirting" during dance lessons
highlights_en.description: Shares an episode where she got jealous seeing Bibi and Chihaya getting along during a dance break, and bravely stepped between them.

highlights_en.title: Sore throat, adjusting ambient sounds
highlights_en.description: Because of continuous coughing, she checked that the ambient frog noises were too loud and adjusted the volume.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Marigold / Aimyon
highlights_en.description: Sings "Marigold" in a mellow atmosphere with piano accompaniment. She delivers the sad lyrics emotionally.

highlights_en.title: Next song is "Suiheisen" (Horizon) by Back Number
highlights_en.description: Announces that she will sing the track, changing the self-accompanied arrangement to piano accompaniment, and discusses the lyrics.

highlights_en.title: Future projects and throat condition
highlights_en.description: Hints at a major announcement coming soon. Due to her worsening throat condition, she mentions wanting to use mute more often during the stream.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Suiheisen (Horizon) / back number
highlights_en.description: Performs "Suiheisen," the third song, with piano accompaniment. The audience comments are excited by her highly emotional singing style.

highlights_en.title: Preparing the piano accompaniment for "Nandemonaiya"
highlights_en.description: Selects RADWIMPS' "Nandemonaiya" (from the movie 'Your Name.') as the fourth song and begins preparing the piano accompaniment.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Nandemonaiya / RADWIMPS
highlights_en.description: Begins singing "Nandemonaiya." An emotional start filled with feeling.

highlights_en.title: "Nandemonaiya" performance ends
highlights_en.description: Concludes the performance of RADWIMPS' "Nandemonaiya." She sang the upbeat song powerfully.

highlights_en.title: Thanks and shy reaction to foreign comments
highlights_en.description: Expresses gratitude for English comments from foreign listeners, while hiding her shyness when complimented with phrases like "You're beautiful."

highlights_en.title: Explaining why she struggles with talking during singing streams
highlights_en.description: Explains that when she concentrates on singing, her brain gets hazy (like being drunk), which makes it difficult to talk effectively.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Chocho Musubi (Bowknot) / Aimer
highlights_en.description: Sings Aimer's "Chocho Musubi" with a mellow acoustic piano arrangement, injecting sad emotions into the performance.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Planetarium / Ai Otsuka
highlights_en.description: Responding to a request, she performs Ai Otsuka's "Planetarium," perfect for the nighttime atmosphere. She sings with a voice that is both sad and hopeful.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Connect / ClariS (Singing error)
highlights_en.description: Attempts the piano-arranged "Connect," but forgets the lyrics midway, showing her frustration.

highlights_en.title: Anecdote about calling herself "Black Tiger"
highlights_en.description: Recalls an episode where a VTuber collaborator called her "Black Tiger" because she was previously wearing an all-black outfit.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Mikazuki (Crescent Moon) / Ayaka
highlights_en.description: Selects Ayaka's "Mikazuki" as a revenge performance. She projects a clear and deeply emotional singing voice.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Kimi no Shiranai Monogatari (The Story You Don't Know) / supercell
highlights_en.description: Sings the classic summer anime song "Kimi no Shiranai Monogatari" with a mellow piano arrangement.

highlights_en.title: Near-end stream greeting and next time announcement
highlights_en.description: Announces the end of the stream and thanks the listeners. She hints at future collaborations and gaming streams.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Connect / ClariS (Singing error)
highlights_en.description: Attempts the piano-arranged "Connect," but forgets the lyrics midway, showing her frustration.

highlights_en.title: Post-song talk and topic of instruments
highlights_en.description: Thanks the audience for the applause after the song, explaining that the piano accompaniment was an instrumental track and that she does not play the piano or violin. She reveals she used to take violin lessons.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Kaiju no Uta (Monster Song) / Vaundy (Encore 1)
highlights_en.description: Performs "Kaiju no Uta" as an encore. An emotional performance utilizing falsetto frequently in the chorus.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Futari Goto (About Us) / RADWIMPS (Encore 2)
highlights_en.description: Sings RADWIMPS' "Futari Goto" passionately, despite struggling with the fast-paced lyrics. After finishing, she regrets having missed lyrics.

highlights_en.title: [Song] Hoshikuzu Venus (Stardust Venus) / Aiko (Encore 3)
highlights_en.description: Responds to a comment requesting her to "sing with a gentle voice" by restraining her usual powerful singing style and performing in a soft tone.

highlights_en.title: Next stream announcement (Ghibli-only singing stream)
highlights_en.description: Apologizes for the long duration of the singing stream, while announcing a Ghibli-only singing stream for the following day (calendar wise). She laughs at a foreign listener's comment about her "chibi voice."

highlights_en.title: [Song] Zankoku na Tenshi no Thesis (A Cruel Angel's Thesis) / Yoko Takahashi (Encore 4)
highlights_en.description: Powerfully performs the Evangelion theme song "A Cruel Angel's Thesis" as the final encore. She sang passionately, breaking the restriction of singing softly.

highlights_en.title: "A Cruel Angel's Thesis" performance ends and gratitude
highlights_en.description: Finishes singing the final encore song "A Cruel Angel's Thesis" and expresses deep gratitude to the listeners. She reiterates the announcement for the Ghibli-only singing stream starting tomorrow at 6 PM.

highlights_en.title: Ending Talk: "Black Tiger" again
highlights_en.description: The nickname "Black Tiger" resurfaces due to listener comments, and she declares herself to be the Black Tiger, an angel descending at night.

highlights_en.title: Ending Talk: Impressions of the piano arrangement and farewell
highlights_en.description: Discusses her impressions of the mellow singing stream accompanied by piano, noting that "A Cruel Angel's Thesis" sounded somewhat jazzy. She promises to meet again tomorrow at 6 PM and ends the stream.

title: STREAMING before collab

overview.summary: ホロライブIDのRisuが、ピクセルアートのシミュレーションゲーム『Whisper of the House』をプレイする配信の後半。前半で着手したカフェのデザインを完成させ、高い評価を得ました。その後、マップ移動中に雨が降る演出を楽しみつつ、新しいミッションである病院での私物回収タスクに取り掛かります。病室に散乱したアイテムを分別・整理する作業を行い、故人からの遺書や、謎の空き家の鍵、そして可愛らしい猫を発見し、次のミッションへと繋がる展開で配信を終えました。
overview.mood: 達成感と和やかな雰囲気、後半に軽いミステリー要素が加わる

highlights.title: 配信開始とリスナーへの挨拶
highlights.description: Risuのアイドルのようなオープニングアニメーションの後、リスナーへ挨拶し、インドネシア語と日本語でコメントを読み上げる。

highlights.title: サムネイルのスパイク付きバットについて
highlights.description: サムネイルで持っている武器（スパイク付きバット）について、特に意味はないがカッコいいから持っていると説明。

highlights.title: ホロIDコラボ（Mage Arena）の告知
highlights.description: 今夜行われるホロIDコラボ配信の告知と、コラボゲーム『Mage Arena』の呪文の練習が必要だと話す。

highlights.title: ゲーム実況「Whisper of the House」開始
highlights.description: 家具や装飾を配置して部屋をデザインする、ピクセルアートのシミュレーションゲームを開始。最初の舞台は花屋。

highlights.title: 花屋の装飾：階段上の棚に挑戦
highlights.description: 花屋の部屋を装飾するタスクを開始。特に階段上の棚への配置に苦戦しながらも、アイテムを適切に配置していく。

highlights.title: 花屋の装飾完了とAnnaからの評価
highlights.description: 花屋の最初のデコレーションタスクを完了し、NPCのAnnaから「Excellent!」の評価を得て報酬を獲得する。

highlights.title: 「Whisper Daily」の新聞を読む
highlights.description: ゲーム内で新聞を入手し、新しいミッション（病院でターゲットの私物を回収）を確認する。

highlights.title: 地下のラボへテレポート移動
highlights.description: タウンマップを探索し、地下にある研究所のような場所へテレポートして移動する。

highlights.title: 花屋のデコレーション再開
highlights.description: テレポートで花屋のマップに戻り、装飾の続きを開始。アイテムの配置方法や種類を工夫して部屋をより華やかにする。

highlights.title: 花屋の装飾：2つ目のExcellent評価
highlights.description: 花屋のデコレーションの2つ目のフェーズを完了し、再びAnnaから高評価を得る。

highlights.title: カフェのタスクを開始し、マップを探索
highlights.description: 新しいクエストボードから「Dreaming of a Coffee Shop」のタスクを選択。テレポート装置で街を探索し、アイテム収集を行う。

highlights.title: 地下ラボとグランパの部屋の探索
highlights.description: テレポート装置を使ってマップを移動し、Underground LabやGrandpa's Roomなど、タスクに必要な場所を探索する。

highlights.title: 特殊な種（Giant Cactus）の栽培レシピを特定
highlights.description: Annaから依頼された特別な種の栽培を開始。必要な3つの要素（土、ポーション、種）を試行錯誤し、Giant Cactusのレシピを完成させる。

highlights.title: Alien Flowerの栽培に挑戦
highlights.description: Alien Flowerの種と栄養液を使って栽培を開始。レシピを確認しながら試行錯誤し、Alien SoilとAlien Nutrient Solutionが必要だと気づく。

highlights.title: Alien Flowerの栽培成功と報酬
highlights.description: Alien Flowerの栽培に成功し、報酬としてVoucher x 200とRamos Flower Seedsを獲得。新しい花の種も手に入れる。

highlights.title: 新しい植物のレシピ確認
highlights.description: レシピ帳でRed Eye Plant、Ramos Flower、Purple Mignonette Seedなど、新しい植物のレシピを確認する。

highlights.title: African Violetの栽培成功
highlights.description: African Violet SeedとMagic Soil、Crimson Nutrient Solutionの組み合わせで栽培に成功し、Voucher x 100を獲得。

highlights.title: 花屋の全タスク完了とカフェへの移動
highlights.description: 花屋での全ての栽培タスクを完了し、マップ画面に戻る。カフェのデザインミッションに取り掛かるため、ショールームへ移動する。

highlights.title: カフェの内装デザイン開始（1階）
highlights.description: カフェのデザインルームに到着。まずは1階にコーヒーカウンターと階段周りにキャビネットを配置する。

highlights.title: カフェの2階部分のデザイン
highlights.description: 2階の客席エリアに丸テーブルと椅子を配置。顧客がコーヒーメーカーまでたどり着くために階段を登る必要があるというコメントでRisuは爆笑。

highlights.title: カフェの装飾：談話スペースと壁の装飾
highlights.description: 1階の窓側にソファとコーヒーテーブルを配置し、アートポスターや植物で壁を装飾。カフェらしい雰囲気に仕上げる。

highlights.title: カフェのデザインタスク完了と高評価
highlights.description: カフェのインテリアデザインを完了し、「Excellent!」の評価とVoucher 140を獲得。

highlights.title: タウンマップ探索中に雨の演出
highlights.description: 次のミッションへ向かうためマップに戻ると、ゲーム内で雨が降り始める演出が発生する。傘がスパイク付きバットに変わりRisuは喜ぶ。

highlights.title: 新しいミッション：病院への潜入
highlights.description: ミッションボードを確認し、病院にある「重要なアイテム」の回収ミッションを受注し、聖ウラジミール病院へ向かう。

highlights.title: 汚い病室の整理と遺書の発掘
highlights.description: 病室（Room 205）に入り、散乱したアイテムを分別・整理する作業を開始。故人の「Bai」が残した遺書を発見する。遺書には猫とサングラスについての指示が書かれていた。

highlights.title: アイテム探索と猫の発見
highlights.description: 部屋の中の貴重品や手掛かり（レーザーピストル、ぬいぐるみ、日記など）を回収する。その後、隠れていた猫（Kuroi）を発見し、猫用の食料を用意するヒントを得る。

highlights.title: 空き家の鍵の入手と配信終了
highlights.description: 猫に餌をやり、隠された空き家の鍵を入手。次のミッションの準備ができたため、配信をセーブして終了する。

overview_en.summary: The latter half of Hololive ID's Risu streaming a playthrough of the pixel art simulation game, "Whisper of the House." She successfully completed the café design started in the first half, receiving high praise. Afterward, she enjoyed the in-game rain animation while traveling the map and began a new mission: retrieving personal belongings from a hospital. She sorted and organized scattered items in the hospital room, discovering a will from the deceased, a key to a mysterious abandoned house, and a cute cat, leading to a cliffhanger that sets up the next mission before ending the stream.
overview_en.mood: Feeling of accomplishment and calm atmosphere, with light mystery elements added in the second half.

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Greeting to Viewers
highlights_en.description: After Risu's idol-like opening animation, she greets the viewers and reads comments in Indonesian and Japanese.

highlights_en.title: About the Spiked Bat in the Thumbnail
highlights_en.description: Explaining that the weapon (spiked bat) held in the thumbnail has no specific meaning, she just has it because it looks cool.

highlights_en.title: Announcement of HoloID Collab (Mage Arena)
highlights_en.description: Announcing tonight's HoloID collaboration stream and mentioning the need to practice spells for the collaboration game, "Mage Arena."

highlights_en.title: Game Play "Whisper of the House" Begins
highlights_en.description: Starts the pixel art simulation game where she designs rooms by placing furniture and decorations. The first setting is a flower shop.

highlights_en.title: Flower Shop Decoration: Tackling the Shelf Above the Stairs
highlights_en.description: Starts the task of decorating the flower shop room. She struggles slightly with placing items on the shelf above the stairs but manages to arrange the items appropriately.

highlights_en.title: Flower Shop Decoration Complete and Evaluation from Anna
highlights_en.description: Completes the first flower shop decoration task, receives an "Excellent!" evaluation from the NPC Anna, and earns a reward.

highlights_en.title: Reading the "Whisper Daily" Newspaper
highlights_en.description: Obtains a newspaper in the game and confirms a new mission (retrieving the target's personal belongings at the hospital).

highlights_en.title: Teleporting to the Underground Lab
highlights_en.description: Explores the town map and teleports to an underground, laboratory-like location.

highlights_en.title: Resuming Flower Shop Decoration
highlights_en.description: Returns to the flower shop map via teleportation and continues decorating. She experiments with item placement and types to make the room more vibrant.

highlights_en.title: Flower Shop Decoration: Second Excellent Evaluation
highlights_en.description: Completes the second phase of flower shop decoration and receives high praise from Anna again.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Cafe Task and Exploring the Map
highlights_en.description: Selects the "Dreaming of a Coffee Shop" task from the new quest board. She uses the teleporter to explore the city and collect items.

highlights_en.title: Exploring the Underground Lab and Grandpa's Room
highlights_en.description: Moves across the map using the teleporter, exploring necessary locations for the task, such as the Underground Lab and Grandpa's Room.

highlights_en.title: Identifying the Cultivation Recipe for a Special Seed (Giant Cactus)
highlights_en.description: Begins cultivating the special seed requested by Anna. After trial and error with the three necessary elements (soil, potion, seed), she completes the recipe for the Giant Cactus.

highlights_en.title: Attempting to Cultivate the Alien Flower
highlights_en.description: Starts cultivation using the Alien Flower seed and nutrient solution. After checking the recipe and trial and error, she realizes Alien Soil and Alien Nutrient Solution are required.

highlights_en.title: Successful Cultivation of Alien Flower and Rewards
highlights_en.description: Successfully cultivates the Alien Flower, earning Voucher x 200 and Ramos Flower Seeds as a reward. She also acquires new flower seeds.

highlights_en.title: Checking New Plant Recipes
highlights_en.description: Checks the recipe book for new plant recipes, including Red Eye Plant, Ramos Flower, and Purple Mignonette Seed.

highlights_en.title: Successful Cultivation of African Violet
highlights_en.description: Successfully cultivates the African Violet using African Violet Seed, Magic Soil, and Crimson Nutrient Solution, earning Voucher x 100.

highlights_en.title: All Flower Shop Tasks Complete and Moving to the Cafe
highlights_en.description: Completes all cultivation tasks at the flower shop and returns to the map screen. She moves to the showroom to begin the cafe design mission.

highlights_en.title: Starting the Cafe Interior Design (1st Floor)
highlights_en.description: Arrives at the cafe design room. First, she places the coffee counter and cabinets around the stairs on the first floor.

highlights_en.title: Designing the Cafe's Second Floor
highlights_en.description: Places round tables and chairs in the 2nd-floor seating area. Risu laughs heartily at the comment that customers would have to climb the stairs to reach the coffee maker.

highlights_en.title: Cafe Decoration: Conversation Space and Wall Decor
highlights_en.description: Places sofas and coffee tables by the windows on the first floor, and decorates the walls with art posters and plants, creating a cafe-like ambiance.

highlights_en.title: Cafe Design Task Complete and High Evaluation
highlights_en.description: Completes the cafe interior design and receives an "Excellent!" evaluation, earning 140 Vouchers.

highlights_en.title: Rain Animation During Town Map Exploration
highlights_en.description: When returning to the map to head to the next mission, an in-game rain animation begins. Risu is delighted when her umbrella transforms into a spiked bat.

highlights_en.title: New Mission: Infiltrating the Hospital
highlights_en.description: Checks the mission board, accepts the mission to retrieve "important items" at the hospital, and heads to St. Vladimir's Hospital.

highlights_en.title: Organizing a Messy Hospital Room and Unearthing a Will
highlights_en.description: Enters the hospital room (Room 205) and begins sorting and organizing the scattered items. She discovers a will left by the deceased person, "Bai." The will contained instructions regarding a cat and sunglasses.

highlights_en.title: Item Search and Discovery of a Cat
highlights_en.description: Recovers valuables and clues (laser pistol, plushie, diary, etc.) inside the room. She then discovers a hidden cat (Kuroi) and receives a hint to prepare cat food.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the Abandoned House Key and Stream End
highlights_en.description: Feeds the cat and obtains the hidden key to an abandoned house. Since preparations for the next mission are complete, she saves the stream and ends the broadcast.

title: 【MAGE ARENA】FIRE BALL !!! *misses* *aura-1* 【Zeta POV】

overview.summary: ホロライブIDのメンバー7名によるキャプチャー・ザ・フラッグ形式の魔術師ゲーム『MAGE ARENA』の終盤戦。Warlocksチーム（Zeta、Kaela、Yopi、Anya）は、拠点でのクラフティングと戦闘を繰り返します。Zetaはカエルを使ったスープやジャンプ力強化アイテムを作成し戦力を補強しますが、Sorcerersチーム（Ollie、Moona、Risu）の猛攻とゴーレムの出現により苦戦。Zetaは計2回デスし、最終的にWarlocksチームは拠点を奪還される形で敗北しました。終始ハイテンションでカオスな魔法バトルを繰り広げました。
overview.mood: 終始ハイテンションでカオス、爆笑の連続

highlights.title: Hololive ID Gen 1-3 7名によるコラボ開始
highlights.description: ムーナ、オーリー、リスー、アニャ、ヨピピ、カエラ、ゼータの7名での大人数コラボがスタート。ゲーム開始前の賑やかな挨拶が交わされます。

highlights.title: チーム分けと旗のデザイン決定
highlights.description: チームはSorcerers（Moona, Ollie, Risu）とWarlocks（Kaela, Yopi, Anya, Zeta）に決定。各チームのフラッグをペイント機能で作成しますが、デザインはカオスな仕上がりに。

highlights.title: 『MAGE ARENA』ゲームスタート
highlights.description: 「3, 2, 1」のカウントダウンと共にゲームが開始。プレイヤーは広大なマップに放り出され、アイテムやスペルを習得しながら進みます。

highlights.title: ゼータが初めてのデス
highlights.description: ゲーム開始直後の混乱の中、ゼータは敵の魔法に被弾し、早々に最初のデスを喫します。死因は不明で、スペルの理解に苦労します。

highlights.title: 敵陣地が見えてきた
highlights.description: マップを彷徨う中、遠くに敵の城郭らしきものが見えてきます。マップが暗い上、仲間と敵の区別もつきにくく、混乱は続きます。

highlights.title: フレンドリーファイアの洗礼
highlights.description: 近くのプレイヤーにFireballを放ちますが、それが味方だったことが判明し、ゼータは再びデス。誤射と混乱の中でマップをさまよいます。

highlights.title: カエラを撃破しレベルアップ
highlights.description: 炎のエリアでカエラと遭遇し、Fireballで撃破に成功。ゼータはスペルレベルが2に上がり、新しい魔法を習得します。

highlights.title: ワームホールを連発するもディスペルされる
highlights.description: ワームホールで移動を試みますが、敵の強力な魔法によって打ち消されてしまいます。敵陣地への到達は困難を極めます。

highlights.title: 敵のキャッスル内で戦闘
highlights.description: 敵の城郭内部に侵入しますが、味方と合流できずに孤立。Magic Missileの応酬となり、敵チームにキルされてしまいます。

highlights.title: 拠点でクラフティングとアイテム作成
highlights.description: 拠点に戻り、クラフティングマニュアルを確認。カエル（Toad）やキノコ（Mushroom）を使って、ジャンプ力が増すアイテム「Jump Bounce Mush」や「Frog Soup」を作成します。

highlights.title: 敵のキャプチャ通知と戦闘開始
highlights.description: 敵チーム（Sorcerers）がクリスタルキャバーンを占拠したというアナウンスが流れ、Warlocksチームは再び拠点防衛/奪還のために戦闘態勢に入ります。

highlights.title: Zeta、敵との交戦で再びデス
highlights.description: Fireballを放つも敵に防がれ、逆に自陣営のメンバー（Yopi）によって倒されてしまいます（Friendly Fireではない）。Zetaは自動リスポーンではないことに気づき、リスポーンを待ちます。

highlights.title: 味方が旗を取り返しZetaがリスポーン
highlights.description: 敵チームに旗をキャプチャされた後、味方Yopiが旗を奪還。Zetaは拠点からリスポーンし、チームメンバーと合流します。

highlights.title: Ollieのゴーレムに捕まりデス
highlights.description: Ollie（敵チーム）と遭遇。Fireballを放つが、Ollieが召喚したGolemに捕まり2度目のデス。敵チームがGolemを複数使用している様子に驚きます。

highlights.title: Warlocksチーム敗北（DEFEAT）
highlights.description: 敵チームの猛攻によりWarlocksチームは拠点を奪われ、Defeatが確定します。リザルト画面が表示され、メンバーは健闘を称え合います。

highlights.title: ゲームの振り返りと配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: リザルト画面でスコアとアイテムを確認。楽しかったゲームを振り返り、メンバーやリスナーに感謝を伝え、配信を終了します。

overview_en.summary: The final battle of the Capture-the-Flag wizard game, 'MAGE ARENA', featuring 7 members of Hololive ID. The Warlocks team (Zeta, Kaela, Yopi, Anya) repeatedly engaged in crafting and combat at their base. Zeta bolstered the team's strength by creating jump-enhancing items like Frog Soup using toads, but they struggled against the fierce assault from the Sorcerers team (Ollie, Moona, Risu) and the appearance of Golems. Zeta died a total of two times, and the Warlocks team ultimately lost after their base was recaptured. A high-tension, chaotic magic battle unfolded from start to finish.
overview_en.mood: High tension and chaotic throughout, continuous laughter

highlights_en.title: Collaboration start with 7 members of Hololive ID Gen 1-3
highlights_en.description: A large-group collaboration featuring 7 members: Moona, Ollie, Risu, Anya, Yopipi, Kaela, and Zeta, begins. Lively greetings are exchanged before the game starts.

highlights_en.title: Team split and flag design finalized
highlights_en.description: The teams are decided: Sorcerers (Moona, Ollie, Risu) and Warlocks (Kaela, Yopi, Anya, Zeta). They use the paint function to create their respective team flags, resulting in chaotic designs.

highlights_en.title: 'MAGE ARENA' Game Start
highlights_en.description: The game begins with the countdown "3, 2, 1". Players are thrown onto a massive map and proceed while learning items and spells.

highlights_en.title: Zeta's First Death
highlights_en.description: In the confusion immediately following the game start, Zeta is hit by an enemy spell and suffers her first death early on. The cause of death is unclear, and she struggles to understand the spells.

highlights_en.title: The enemy base comes into view
highlights_en.description: While wandering the map, what appears to be the enemy castle comes into view in the distance. The confusion continues as the map is dark and it's difficult to distinguish between allies and enemies.

highlights_en.title: Baptism by Friendly Fire
highlights_en.description: Zeta shoots a Fireball at a nearby player, only to realize it was an ally, resulting in another death. She wanders the map amidst misfires and confusion.

highlights_en.title: Defeating Kaela and leveling up
highlights_en.description: Zeta encounters Kaela in the fiery area and successfully defeats her with a Fireball. Zeta's spell level increases to 2, and she learns a new magic.

highlights_en.title: Repeatedly using Wormhole only to be dispelled
highlights_en.description: She attempts to travel using Wormhole, but it is countered by a powerful enemy spell. Reaching the enemy base proves extremely difficult.

highlights_en.title: Combat inside the enemy castle
highlights_en.description: Zeta infiltrates the enemy castle but becomes isolated, failing to link up with allies. After an exchange of Magic Missiles, she is killed by the enemy team.

highlights_en.title: Crafting and Item Creation at the Base
highlights_en.description: Returning to the base, Zeta checks the crafting manual. She uses toads and mushrooms to create "Jump Bounce Mush" and "Frog Soup," items that increase jump power.

highlights_en.title: Enemy Capture Notification and Combat Start
highlights_en.description: An announcement states that the enemy team (Sorcerers) has captured the Crystal Cavern, and the Warlocks team enters combat readiness again to defend/recapture the base.

highlights_en.title: Zeta dies again in engagement with the enemy
highlights_en.description: She shoots a Fireball, but it is blocked by the enemy, and she is subsequently defeated by a member of her own team (Yopi) (though not Friendly Fire). Zeta realizes that respawn is not automatic and waits for the respawn.

highlights_en.title: Ally retrieves the flag and Zeta respawns
highlights_en.description: After the flag was captured by the enemy team, Ally Yopi recaptures the flag. Zeta respawns from the base and rejoins her team members.

highlights_en.title: Captured by Ollie's Golem and dies
highlights_en.description: Encounters Ollie (enemy team). She shoots a Fireball, but is captured by a Golem summoned by Ollie, marking her second death. She is surprised that the enemy team is using multiple Golems.

highlights_en.title: Warlocks Team Defeated (DEFEAT)
highlights_en.description: Due to the fierce assault from the enemy team, the Warlocks team loses their base, and the defeat is finalized. The results screen is displayed, and members praise each other for their effort.

highlights_en.title: Game reflection and stream ending greetings
highlights_en.description: They check scores and items on the results screen. They reflect on the enjoyable game, express gratitude to the members and viewers, and end the stream.

title: 【Mage Arena】You are a Mage, Moona.【hololiveID】

overview.summary: ホロライブIDのVTuber7名による『Mage Arena』のコラボ配信の後半です。Moonaチームは旗を巡る攻防戦を制し、最初のCTF（Capture the Flag）で勝利を収めます。勝利後、メンバーは個人戦のDeathmatchに移行。新しい魔法「Wisp」を駆使しつつも、戦闘では大混乱が生じます。特にMoonaがDiscordのミュートを外し忘れていたことが判明し、笑いに包まれます。最終的に2試合で勝敗がつかず、和やかに配信を終了しました。
overview.mood: 賑やか、楽しい、カオス

highlights.title: ホロライブIDコラボ開始の挨拶
highlights.description: ホロライブIDの1期生、2期生、3期生が集合し、初の合同コラボレーションを祝う挨拶を行います。全員が興奮気味で賑やかなスタート。

highlights.title: 『Mage Arena』ゲーム紹介とチーム分け
highlights.description: 今回のコラボでプレイする『Mage Arena』を紹介。魔法使いのPvPゲームで、2チームに分かれて対戦します。チーム分けはランダムで、ムーナ、オーリー、リス、アニャと、レイネ、イオフィ、ゼータのチームになりました。

highlights.title: チームフラッグのお絵描きタイム
highlights.description: ゲーム開始前の準備として、各チームのフラッグをデザイン。ムーナは「Moon」をテーマに、ハートマークと紫を基調とした旗を描きますが、他のメンバーが勝手に書き足し始め、カオスな状態に。

highlights.title: ゲーム開始と魔法のクラフト
highlights.description: ゲームがスタートし、プレイヤーはマップの探索を開始。様々な素材を集めて魔法をクラフトできる仕様を理解し、まずは強力なアイテムを作るための素材集めに奔走します。

highlights.title: 山の拠点を発見し、最初の旗をゲット
highlights.description: マップの中央にある山の上に到達し、相手チームの旗（フラッグ）を発見。空中戦やレヴィテーションの魔法を駆使して山を登り、無事旗を奪うことに成功します。

highlights.title: ゴレーム（Golen）を召喚
highlights.description: 素材を集めてゴーレムを召喚。チームの防御と攻撃に役立つ強力な味方を手に入れ、戦力を強化します。

highlights.title: メンバーが次々とダウンする混戦
highlights.description: 敵陣近くで激しい戦闘が勃発。お互いに魔法を打ち合い、次々とメンバーがダウン。魔法のスキルアップが勝利への鍵を握ります。

highlights.title: 味方のゴーレムが倒されたことに気づく
highlights.description: Moonaがベースに戻ったところ、先ほど召喚したはずのゴーレムが既に倒されていたことに気づく。

highlights.title: マップの奥地でワームホールを発見
highlights.description: 敵陣から遠い、誰も訪れていなかった沼地の奥でワープポータル（ワームホール）を発見し、瞬間移動を試みる。

highlights.title: ワームホールを使った瞬間移動を試す
highlights.description: ワームホールを起動し、勢いよく突入。一瞬で溶岩地帯が広がる敵の拠点近くにワープする。

highlights.title: 敵の拠点へ侵入し、激しい攻防戦に
highlights.description: 敵陣の炎の塔に侵入し、Fireballを連射。敵プレイヤーを次々と凍らせるが、反撃を受けMoonaもダウンする。

highlights.title: 敵の大群がMoonaチームのフラッグを奪いに来る
highlights.description: Moonaがデスして復活した直後、相手チームのプレイヤーが大群で押し寄せ、自チームのフラッグが奪われたことが表示される。

highlights.title: 新しい魔法「Wisp（ウィスプ）」を獲得
highlights.description: 新たな魔法Wispの呪文書を入手。Wispは敵の動きを遅くし、ダメージを与える効果がある。

highlights.title: Moona、敵の旗を奪取し冷気魔法で妨害
highlights.description: 敵陣に忍び込み、フラッグを奪取。帰路の道中、追ってきた敵チームのプレイヤーを冷気魔法で凍らせて逃げ切ることに成功する。

highlights.title: 敵陣深部へ侵入し、再度フラッグを奪取
highlights.description: 味方が囮になっている間に、ワームホールを使って敵陣のDoomエリアにワープ。見事、フラッグ奪取に成功する。

highlights.title: チームバトル（CTF）でMoonaチームが勝利！
highlights.description: CTFモードが終了。Moonaチームがフラッグを奪取し、勝利を収める。スコアボードが表示され、勝敗が確定する。

highlights.title: ゲームモードをDeathmatch（個人戦）に変更
highlights.description: CTFモードの勝利後、メンバーは次のゲームモードについて相談し、全員が敵となるDeathmatch（個人戦）を試すことを決定。

highlights.title: Discordのミュートをし忘れていたMoonaにメンバー爆笑
highlights.description: 個人戦のプレイ中、MoonaがDiscordのミュートを外したままゲームをプレイしていたことが判明し、他のメンバーからツッコミが入る。

highlights.title: Deathmatch 2戦目、再び混沌とした戦場へ
highlights.description: Deathmatchの2戦目がスタート。狭いマップ内で魔法の打ち合いが繰り広げられ、カオスな状況となる。

highlights.title: Deathmatch 2戦目終了、Moonaが敗北
highlights.description: Deathmatchの2戦目が終了。Moonaは敗北するが、楽しかったと感想を述べる。

highlights.title: メンバーシップ告知と配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: ゲームが終了し、ホロIDメンバーからの告知や、視聴者への感謝を述べ、配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: This is the latter half of the collaboration stream of 'Mage Arena' featuring seven Hololive ID VTubers. Moona's team won the first CTF (Capture the Flag) after dominating the battle over the flag. Following the victory, the members transitioned to a private Deathmatch game. Utilizing the new 'Wisp' spell, the combat quickly devolved into chaos. Laughter erupted when it was discovered that Moona had forgotten to unmute her Discord. Ultimately, after two Deathmatch games resulted in no clear winner, the stream concluded peacefully.
overview_en.mood: Lively, Fun, Chaotic

highlights_en.title: Greetings for the Start of the Hololive ID Collaboration
highlights_en.description: The 1st, 2nd, and 3rd generations of Hololive ID gather to give greetings, celebrating their first joint collaboration. A lively and excited start for everyone.

highlights_en.title: 'Mage Arena' Game Introduction and Team Assignment
highlights_en.description: Introduction to 'Mage Arena', the PvP wizard game played in this collaboration. The participants are divided into two teams for the match. Teams were randomly assigned: Moona, Ollie, Risu, and Anya versus Reine, Iofi, and Zeta.

highlights_en.title: Team Flag Drawing Time
highlights_en.description: As preparation before the game starts, each team designs its flag. Moona draws a purple-themed flag with a heart, based on "Moon," but other members start drawing over it haphazardly, leading to chaos.
