In the middle section, she tackled a school bus conversion request (into an office specification) and the cleaning and furnishing of a heavily dilapidated RV. After completing the final RV conversion in this part, she began working on the next job: renovating a school bus (complete destruction and cleaning of the interior, and surface finishing). She also searched extensively for collectible items and attempted the now-traditional dangerous mountain road drive. Towards the end of the stream, an unexpected "DOOM"-style mini-game appeared. Battling motion sickness, she completed the cleaning and interior custom work on a new RV, achieved an S rank, and concluded the broadcast.
overview_en.mood: Relaxed atmosphere throughout

highlights_en.title: Starting 'Bus Flipper Simulator'! Setting controls to House Flipper style
highlights_en.description: Greeting at the start of the stream and game introduction. Playing 'Bus Flipper Simulator,' which resembles the system of the popular game 'House Flipper.' Realizes there is a "House Flipper Style" control setting and selects it.

highlights_en.title: Negotiating and acquiring the first purchased bus
highlights_en.description: Purchases an old 1977 Citrovan introduced by Bobby. Despite noting it was dirtier than in the photos, she successfully negotiates the price and acquires the bus at a discount.

highlights_en.title: Bus cleaning and customization tutorial
highlights_en.description: Since the interior of the purchased bus is extremely dirty, she follows the tutorial to pick up trash, clean up stains, and destroy (demolish) objects. She earns points and bonuses through cleaning.

highlights_en.title: Selling the cleaned bus
highlights_en.description: Sells the bus after completing cleaning and basic renovations (such as installing furniture). She successfully accepts the buyer's offer and completes the sale at a high price. A new job request then arrives.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking "No Selling Penalty" in the perk shop
highlights_en.description: Uses earned funds to open the perk shop and unlocks "No Selling Penalty," allowing items mistakenly purchased or placed to be sold without penalty.

highlights_en.title: New Bus Purchase Request (Old RV): SOS from Johnny
highlights_en.description: Receives a request from Johnny to clean an "old RV" in terrible condition. He mentions it looks like someone conducted a chemical experiment inside.

highlights_en.title: Driving the bus and the grueling journey
highlights_en.description: Gets into the pre-renovated RV and drives to the next site. Footage shows her driving on an unpaved mountain road, and Flare feels fear due to the extremely narrow path. The drive becomes nerve-wracking combined with the background music.

highlights_en.title: Starting the requested RV cleaning work
highlights_en.description: Arrives at the site and begins cleaning the RV. The interior is scattered with trash, dirt, and destroyed furniture, with noticeable stains resembling chemical spills. She proceeds smoothly with the cleaning work.

highlights_en.title: New Request: I want to install furniture!
highlights_en.description: After cleaning is complete, she checks the email from Lindsay. She accepts the request to sell the old fixtures and install new furniture to create a space for relaxing alone.

highlights_en.title: Enjoying layout and customization (Part 1)
highlights_en.description: Installs and customizes furniture according to the client's specified design in the cleaned bus. She installs a kitchen, sofa, desk, etc., paying close attention to the details of furniture colors and materials.

highlights_en.title: Enjoying layout and customization (Part 2)
highlights_en.description: Completes the installation of furniture in the requested RV. Chats about the color and material of the desk chair and how resistant it is to visible dirt.

highlights_en.title: Before and after: The finished RV interior
highlights_en.description: Reviews the before-and-after transformation: the filthy interior has been converted into an office space and a relaxing diner-style area.

highlights_en.title: Requested RV renovation complete! S Rank achieved
highlights_en.description: Completes the renovation tasks for the requested RV and achieves S Rank, earning a reward.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking "Powerful Flashlight" in the perk shop
highlights_en.description: Uses earned points to unlock the "Powerful Flashlight," which improves efficiency when working in dark areas.

highlights_en.title: Moving to the bus market, but giving up due to budget shortage
highlights_en.description: Heads to the bus market to buy a new bus, but cannot afford the desired buses (Japanese bus, motorhome) as they are over budget, so she returns home temporarily.

highlights_en.title: Next Request: Plumbing and surface finishing for Johnny's relocation bus
highlights_en.description: Receives a request from Johnny regarding the installation of plumbing, kitchen, and electrical equipment for an RV he intends to live in.

highlights_en.title: Driving Segment: Danger of falling off a steep mountain road!
highlights_en.description: Drives to the next site but nearly falls off a narrow, dangerous mountain road, letting out a scream.

highlights_en.title: Starting work in plumbing connection mode
highlights_en.description: Begins the plumbing work connecting the fresh water tank and the grey water tank to the kitchen sink.

highlights_en.title: Surface finishing work (tiling the kitchen backsplash)
highlights_en.description: Tiles the kitchen wall surface. Reacts to the sound effects when placing the tiles.

highlights_en.title: Plumbing and surface finishing complete! S Rank achieved
highlights_en.description: Completes the requested plumbing connection and surface finishing tasks, achieving S Rank.

highlights_en.title: Challenge Mode: Taking on the Bus Cleaning Contest
highlights_en.description: Receives an email from Bobby and attempts the "Bus Cleaning Contest," which involves cleaning a bus within a time limit.

highlights_en.title: Removing trash and dirt at high speed
highlights_en.description: Because of the time bonus in Challenge Mode, she uses destruction tools and trash bags to quickly remove interior debris.

highlights_en.title: Contest completion (B Rank achieved)
highlights_en.description: Completes the cleaning contest, but fails to reach S Rank, ending up with B Rank. She expresses frustration, noting she had been achieving S Ranks until now.

highlights_en.title: Next Request: School Bus Renovation "Electrician Wanted!"
highlights_en.description: Starts a request to convert a school bus into an office. The interior is mostly finished, requiring only object placement and electrical connections.

highlights_en.title: Achieving a new record for trash bag throwing!
highlights_en.description: Attempts to throw a trash bag found along the road far away and achieves a new record of 12.2 meters.

highlights_en.title: Installing the power panel in the bus office
highlights_en.description: Installs the power panel on the wall of the school bus converted into an office. Places it accurately by checking the installation location against photos.

highlights_en.title: Installing lighting in the school bus
highlights_en.description: Following the request, she installs the wall lamp "MARTAJ" between the windows.

highlights_en.title: Electrical Connection Mode: Starting wiring work
highlights_en.description: Begins the wiring process, connecting the lights and the main power panel via switches.

highlights_en.title: School bus renovation complete! S Rank achieved
highlights_en.description: Completes object placement and electrical connection work, achieving S Rank.

highlights_en.title: Next Request: RV Cleaning and Renovation "Break it and Build it!"
highlights_en.description: Receives a cleaning and renovation request from Lindsay for a dilapidated RV. This time, the entire interior needs to be rebuilt.

highlights_en.title: Starting cleaning: Picking up large amounts of trash and removing dirt
highlights_en.description: The interior of the requested RV is scattered with trash and broken wood, which she collects using cleaning tools.

highlights_en.title: Starting RV interior installation
highlights_en.description: Begins placing furniture (kitchen supplies, bed, toilet, shower room, etc.) into the requested RV.

highlights_en.title: Bed customization: Confusion over mysterious color scheme
highlights_en.description: While customizing the bed blanket, she is confused by the difficult patterns and color schemes provided for the textures, noting they "look tacky."

highlights_en.title: Furniture assembly work: Installing drawer slide rails
highlights_en.description: Assembles parts for various furniture items. A timing game occurs when installing the drawer slide rails.

highlights_en.title: Final plumbing connection work: Toilet and shower room
highlights_en.description: Performs the task of connecting the installed toilet and shower room to the fresh water and grey water tanks.

highlights_en.title: RV renovation (final finish) complete, S Rank achieved
highlights_en.description: Completes the plumbing connections for the toilet and shower, finishing all RV renovation tasks and achieving S Rank.

highlights_en.title: Discovering a collectible item outside the renovated RV: "Creepy Parasite Toy"
highlights_en.description: Discovers a collectible item (a creepy parasite toy) hidden outside the requested RV. She then collects the remaining trash bags.

highlights_en.title: Unlocking the "Fast Trash Collection" perk
highlights_en.description: Uses earned points to unlock the "Fast Trash Collection" perk, allowing trash to be collected faster by holding down the button on the trash bag.

highlights_en.title: Driving the dangerous mountain road again (coastal cliff)
highlights_en.description: Drives the RV towards the next job site (a school bus). This time, it’s a rugged, unpaved mountain road facing a coastal cliff, and she frequently screams due to the dangerous driving conditions.

highlights_en.title: Arriving at the new requested school bus. Starting complete interior destruction
highlights_en.description: Arrives at the renovation site for the school bus (a blue bus). Begins smashing installed objects like seats and handrails inside the interior using a hammer.

highlights_en.title: School bus cleaning complete, reaches Level 5 and unlocks the "Trash Collection Area" perk
highlights_en.description: Completes trash collection and dirt removal inside the bus. Reaches Level 5 with cleaning bonuses and unlocks the "Trash Collection Area" perk, allowing large areas to be cleaned in a single action.

highlights_en.title: Surface finishing of the bus interior floor and walls (tiling, panel installation)
highlights_en.description: Starts surface finishing the bus interior. Tiles part of the floor and installs wood-grain panels on the partition walls.

highlights_en.title: Sudden 'DOOM' Homage Mini-Game
highlights_en.description: A 'DOOM'-style mini-game starts on the arcade cabinet in the in-game office. She struggles with the FPS controls, fighting enemies while complaining of motion sickness. The game does not end in game over; it force-quits back to the main game midway.

highlights_en.title: Next Request: Van renovation preparing for a Euro tour
highlights_en.description: The next request arrives. Mr. Rudolf asks for a vintage van (Citrovan) acquired at auction to be converted into a camper. The land belongs to the client, but there is a warning: "Watch out for the old toilet."

highlights_en.title: Mountain road drive again
highlights_en.description: Drives the bus to the next destination. Once again forced to drive on a steep, sight-restricted mountain road, she struggles with the poor handling to the point of feeling sick.

highlights_en.title: Cleaning and interior destruction of the Citrovan
highlights_en.description: Arrives at the requested vintage van. Begins cleaning the interior and demolishing objects. The vehicle is scattered with large amounts of trash, dirty fabric, and wood.

highlights_en.title: Citrovan surface finishing and interior installation
highlights_en.description: After cleaning, she performs interior surface finishing (floor, walls) and furniture installation. She installs a small dining space, kitchen, refrigerator, TV, and fire extinguisher.

highlights_en.title: Struggling with high-difficulty furniture assembly
highlights_en.description: Struggles due to repeatedly making mistakes in the assembly timing game and installing multiple hinges, failing to benefit from the fast assembly perk.

highlights_en.title: Citrovan renovation task complete! S Rank achieved
highlights_en.description: Completes the remaining installation work (window blinds, etc.) and performs the final check. All items are completed, and she achieves S Rank, reaching Level 7 with bonus points.

highlights_en.title: Stream ending greetings and next announcement
highlights_en.description: The stream ends with the completion of the Citrovan renovation. She concludes here because the unexpected 'DOOM' mini-game caused motion sickness. She expresses thanks to the viewers and closes the stream, mentioning she wants to play other games or continue House Flipper next time.

title: 【日本画聖地巡礼2025展】この秋は日本画を楽しもう！推し日本画から和菓子、聖地巡礼まで！？【山種美術館×儒烏風亭らでん #ReGLOSS 】

overview.summary: 儒烏風亭らでんによる山種美術館とのコラボ配信。東山魁夷の「京洛四季シリーズ」完結作品の深掘りから始まり、山口晃による過去と現在が混在する巨大な「東京圖」、さらに速水御舟のイタリア写生、奥田元宋の鮮烈な紅葉、横山大観の墨の濃淡で表現された滝、竹内栖鳳、川端龍子の力強い作品まで、多様な日本画を紹介。終盤では展示会と連携した和菓子の詳細な食レポや、館内に設置された「ぬい撮りスポット」を紹介し、最後に日本画鑑賞における照明へのこだわりや「余白」の美といった、現地でしか味わえない魅力を熱く語り、展覧会への来場を促しつつ配信を締めくくった。
overview.mood: 終始和やかな雰囲気で、美術に関する知識が深まる

highlights.title: 配信開始と山種美術館コラボ告知
highlights.description: 配信がスタートし、儒烏風亭らでんが視聴者に挨拶。山種美術館とのコラボレーション企画「日本画 聖地巡礼2025展」を紹介する。

highlights.title: 展示会に合わせた特製和菓子の試食
highlights.description: コラボ企画の一環として山種美術館のカフェで提供される、展示作品をモチーフにした和菓子「紅葉（もみじ）」を紹介し、実食する。

highlights.title: 山種美術館の紹介と設立秘話
highlights.description: 1966年に山崎種二が創設した日本初の日本画専門美術館である山種美術館について紹介。山崎と横山大観の交流にまつわるエピソードも語られる。

highlights.title: 日本画の定義と描画材料の解説
highlights.description: 西洋画との比較を通じて、日本画が岩絵具と膠（にかわ）を主に使用する伝統的な絵画の総称であることを解説する。

highlights.title: 展覧会テーマ「聖地巡礼」について
highlights.description: 「聖地巡礼」という言葉の現代的な意味合いと、本展示の趣旨である「名画のモデルとなった場所」を巡るテーマについて解説する。

highlights.title: 作品①：速水御舟「名樹散椿」の紹介
highlights.description: 速水御舟の重要文化財「名樹散椿」を紹介。金地に椿が力強く描かれたデザイン性の高い作品を鑑賞する。

highlights.title: 金地の技法「蒔きつぶし」の解説
highlights.description: 「名樹散椿」の金地には、金箔ではなく金砂子（砂金）を細かく撒きつけ、磨きつぶすことでマットな質感を表現する「蒔きつぶし」の技法が使われていることを解説。

highlights.title: 「名樹散椿」のモデル地を巡る聖地巡礼
highlights.description: 「名樹散椿」のモデルとなった、京都・金剛山地蔵院にある五色八重散椿（2代目）の現在の写真と作品を比較する。

highlights.title: 作品②：東山魁夷「京洛四季シリーズ」より「年暮る」
highlights.description: 東山魁夷の「京洛四季シリーズ」から、冬の作品「年暮る」を紹介。雪化粧の京都の街並みを独特の青色「東山ブルー」で表現している。

highlights.title: 「年暮る」のモデル地（現在の姿）との比較
highlights.description: 作品のモデルとなった京都の風景の現在の写真（ホテルオークラ京都からの眺め）と比較し、時代による街並みの変化を見る。

highlights.title: 「京洛四季シリーズ」より「春静」
highlights.description: 同じく東山魁夷の「京洛四季シリーズ」より春の作品「春静」を紹介。満開の桜と山肌を対比させた構図が特徴。

highlights.title: 東山魁夷「緑潤う」の色彩考察
highlights.description: 東山魁夷の「緑潤う」について、水面の描写や静寂な空気感を解説。特に画家が青色に込めた「感覚と精神の世界を繋ぐ色」という哲学に触れる。

highlights.title: 「京洛四季シリーズ」完結作「秋彩」の紹介
highlights.description: 東山魁夷の「京洛四季シリーズ」より秋の作品「秋彩」を紹介。鮮やかな紅葉と深い青色のコントラストの魅力を解説し、四季シリーズが山種美術館の記念展に合わせて描かれた背景を説明する。

highlights.title: 山口晃「東京圖 1・0・4 輪之段」鑑賞
highlights.description: 山口晃による巨大な「東京圖 五輪之段」を紹介。過去の建造物と現在の景観が混在する超細密な鳥瞰図の魅力と、タイトルに込められた東京五輪（1940年と1964年）を合わせた数字の謎を解き明かす。

highlights.title: 速水御舟のイタリア写生「フィレンツェ」
highlights.description: 速水御舟がイタリア旅行中に描いたスケッチ作品「フィレンツェ、アルノの河岸の家並（写生）」を紹介。写真と比較し、画家が正確に対象を捉える描写力の高さについて語る。

highlights.title: 奥田元宋「奥入瀬（秋）」の鮮烈な赤
highlights.description: 奥田元宋の「奥入瀬（秋）」を鑑賞。奥田の代名詞である鮮やかな赤色を惜しみなく使った紅葉と、激しく流れる水が対比する大作の迫力を解説する。

highlights.title: 横山大観「飛瀑軽蹇」と墨の表現
highlights.description: 横山大観の「飛瀑軽蹇（ひばくけいけん）」を紹介。色彩を用いず墨の濃淡のみで、滝の迫力や遠近感、岩の様子を表現する技法を鑑賞する。

highlights.title: 竹内栖鳳「城外風景」の湿潤な空気感
highlights.description: 竹内栖鳳の「城外風景（じょうがいふうくん）」を紹介。にじみやかすれといった技法を用いて、中国の城外にある湿潤で柔らかな空気感と人々の営みを表現した作品を鑑賞する。

highlights.title: 川端龍子「月光」のモダンな視点
highlights.description: 川端龍子による建物の組み物を大胆なアングルで描いた「月光」を鑑賞。日光の輪王寺大猷院をモデルにした作品で、大胆な構図と月のコントラストの魅力を解説する。

highlights.title: カフェ椿の和菓子メニュー紹介
highlights.description: 山種美術館内のカフェ「椿」で提供される、展示作品をモチーフにしたオリジナル和菓子のメニューを詳しく紹介。

highlights.title: 「秋の渓流」の食レポと柚子餡の感想
highlights.description: 「秋の渓流」の和菓子を実食した際の写真を紹介しつつ、柚子餡の柑橘系の香りとあんこの甘さが抹茶と調和する絶妙な味わいをレポートする。

highlights.title: ぬい撮りOK！「名樹散椿」背景の撮影スポット紹介
highlights.description: 館内のカフェの対面にある、速水御舟の「名樹散椿」を背景にした「ぬい撮り（ぬいぐるみ撮影）スポット」を紹介。らでんのぬいぐるみと共に展示されている様子を見せる。

highlights.title: 配信終了と日本画の「余白」の魅力
highlights.description: 本日の配信内容を振り返りつつ、山種美術館が作品ごとに照明を調整していることや、日本画における「余白」の美しさが現地で鑑賞する醍醐味であることを熱く語り、展覧会（11月30日まで開催）への来場を呼びかけて配信を締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: A collaboration stream between Juufuutei Raden and the Yametane Museum of Art. It started with a deep dive into Higashiyama Kaii's concluding work of the "Kyōraku Shiki Series," followed by the introduction of various Japanese paintings, including Yamaguchi Akira's massive "Tokyo Zu" (Tokyo Map) mixing past and present, Hayami Gyoshū's Italian sketches, Okuda Gensō's vivid autumn leaves, Yokoyama Taikan's waterfall expressed through ink shades, and powerful works by Takeuchi Seihō and Kawabata Ryūshi. In the final stage, she provided a detailed food review of Japanese confectionery linked to the exhibition and introduced a "nuigurumi photo spot" (stuffed toy photo spot) within the museum. The stream concluded with a passionate discussion about the unique appeal of viewing Nihonga (Japanese painting) firsthand, such as the dedicated lighting and the beauty of "negative space" (yohaku), urging viewers to visit the exhibition.
overview_en.mood: A consistently peaceful atmosphere, deepening knowledge of art

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Yametane Museum Collaboration Announcement
highlights_en.description: The stream starts, and Juufuutei Raden greets the viewers. She introduces the collaboration project with the Yametane Museum of Art, "Nihonga (Japanese Painting) Sacred Pilgrimage 2025 Exhibition."

highlights_en.title: Tasting Special Japanese Confectionery Designed for the Exhibition
highlights_en.description: As part of the collaboration project, she introduces and tastes the Japanese confectionery "Momiji" (Autumn Leaves), which is modeled after an exhibited artwork and served at the Yametane Museum cafe.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to the Yametane Museum of Art and the Secret Story of its Founding
highlights_en.description: She introduces the Yametane Museum of Art, the first museum in Japan specializing in Nihonga, founded by Yamazaki Taneji in 1966. She also shares episodes related to the friendship between Yamazaki and Yokoyama Taikan.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of Nihonga Definition and Painting Materials
highlights_en.description: Through comparison with Western painting, she explains that Nihonga is a general term for traditional paintings primarily using mineral pigments (iwa-enogu) and animal glue (nikawa).

highlights_en.title: Regarding the Exhibition Theme "Sacred Pilgrimage"
highlights_en.description: She explains the contemporary meaning of the term "sacred pilgrimage" (seichi junrei) and the exhibition's theme, which revolves around visiting the real-life locations that served as models for famous paintings.

highlights_en.title: Artwork ①: Introduction to Hayami Gyoshū's "Meiju Chiritsubaki" (Fallen Camellias)
highlights_en.description: She introduces Hayami Gyoshū's Important Cultural Property, "Meiju Chiritsubaki." Viewers appreciate this highly artistic work featuring camellias powerfully depicted on a gold background.

highlights_en.title: Explanation of the Gold Ground Technique "Makitsubushi"
highlights_en.description: She explains that the gold ground of "Meiju Chiritsubaki" uses the "Makitsubushi" technique, where fine gold dust (kin-sunago) is scattered and polished, rather than gold leaf, to create a matte texture.

highlights_en.title: Sacred Pilgrimage to the Location Model for "Meiju Chiritsubaki"
highlights_en.description: She compares the artwork with a current photograph of the second-generation Goshiki Yaechiri Tsubaki (Five-Color Double Fallen Camellia) located at Kongozan Jizoin Temple in Kyoto, which served as the model for the painting.

highlights_en.title: Artwork ②: Higashiyama Kaii's "Toshi Kuru" (Year's End) from the "Kyōraku Shiki Series"
highlights_en.description: She introduces "Toshi Kuru," the winter piece from Higashiyama Kaii's "Kyōraku Shiki Series." The snow-covered streets of Kyoto are depicted using his unique blue color, known as "Higashiyama Blue."

highlights_en.title: Comparison with the Model Location of "Toshi Kuru" (Present Day)
highlights_en.description: She compares the artwork with a current photograph of the Kyoto scenery that served as the model (view from Hotel Okura Kyoto), observing the changes in the cityscape over time.

highlights_en.title: "Haru Shizuka" (Spring Silence) from the "Kyōraku Shiki Series"
highlights_en.description: She introduces "Haru Shizuka," the spring piece also from Higashiyama Kaii's "Kyōraku Shiki Series." It is characterized by a composition that contrasts full-blooming cherry blossoms with the mountain surface.

highlights_en.title: Analysis of Color in Higashiyama Kaii's "Midori Uruou" (Lush Green)
highlights_en.description: She discusses "Midori Uruou" by Higashiyama Kaii, explaining the depiction of the water surface and the sense of silence. She specifically touches upon the artist's philosophy that blue is "the color that connects the worlds of sensation and spirit."

highlights_en.title: Introduction to "Shūsai" (Autumn Colors), the Concluding Work of the "Kyōraku Shiki Series"
highlights_en.description: She introduces "Shūsai," the autumn piece from Higashiyama Kaii's "Kyōraku Shiki Series." She explains the charm of the contrast between vivid autumn foliage and deep blue, and provides the background that the Four Seasons series was painted for the Yametane Museum's commemorative exhibition.

highlights_en.title: Appreciation of Yamaguchi Akira's "Tokyo Zu 1・0・4 Rin no Dan"
highlights_en.description: She introduces Yamaguchi Akira's massive "Tokyo Zu Gorin no Dan." She unravels the charm of this ultra-detailed bird's-eye view, which mixes past buildings and current scenery, and explains the mystery of the numbers in the title, which combine the Tokyo Olympics (1940 and 1964).

highlights_en.title: Hayami Gyoshū's Italian Sketch "Florence"
highlights_en.description: She introduces "Florence, Houses on the Arno Riverbank (Sketch)," a drawing Gyoshū created during his trip to Italy. Comparing it with a photograph, she discusses the high level of descriptive accuracy the painter achieved.

highlights_en.title: Okuda Gensō's Vivid Red in "Oirase (Autumn)"
highlights_en.description: She appreciates Okuda Gensō's "Oirase (Autumn)." She explains the power of this grand work, contrasting the wildly flowing water with the autumn leaves painted lavishly in Okuda's signature vivid red.

highlights_en.title: Yokoyama Taikan's "Hibaku Keiken" and Ink Expression
highlights_en.description: She introduces Yokoyama Taikan's "Hibaku Keiken." Viewers examine the technique where the power of the waterfall, perspective, and rock texture are expressed using only the shading of ink, without color.

highlights_en.title: The Moist Atmosphere in Takeuchi Seihō's "Jōgai Fūkei" (View Outside the Castle)
highlights_en.description: She introduces Takeuchi Seihō's "Jōgai Fūkei." Viewers appreciate the work, which uses techniques like blurring (nijimi) and fading (kasure) to express the moist and soft atmosphere outside a Chinese castle town, along with the activities of the people.

highlights_en.title: Kawabata Ryūshi's Modern Perspective in "Gekkō" (Moonlight)
highlights_en.description: She appreciates Kawabata Ryūshi's "Gekkō," which depicts architectural bracing from a daring angle. She explains the charm of the bold composition and the contrast with the moon in this work, modeled after Nikkō Rinnō-ji Taiyū-in.

highlights_en.title: Introduction to the Café Tsubaki Japanese Confectionery Menu
highlights_en.description: She provides a detailed introduction to the original Japanese confectionery menu served at Café Tsubaki inside the Yametane Museum of Art, which is themed after the exhibited artworks.

highlights_en.title: Food Review of "Autumn Mountain Stream" and Impressions of Yuzu Bean Paste
highlights_en.description: While showing photos from when she tasted the "Autumn Mountain Stream" confectionery, she reports on the exquisite flavor where the citrus aroma of the yuzu bean paste and the sweetness of the regular bean paste harmonize perfectly with the matcha green tea.

highlights_en.title: Nuigurumi Photos OK! Introduction to the "Meiju Chiritsubaki" Backdrop Photo Spot
highlights_en.description: She introduces the "Nuigurumi Photo Spot" (stuffed toy photography spot) located opposite the museum café, which features Hayami Gyoshū's "Meiju Chiritsubaki" as the background. She shows her own plushie displayed there.

highlights_en.title: Stream Conclusion and the Charm of Nihonga's "Negative Space"
highlights_en.description: Reviewing the stream content, she passionately discusses how the Yametane Museum adjusts the lighting for each piece and how the beauty of "negative space" (yohaku) in Nihonga is a unique pleasure experienced only at the venue. She concludes the stream by urging viewers to attend the exhibition (running until November 30th).

title: 【Goblin Cleanup】次の冒険者が来る前にダンジョン掃除しなきゃぁ！ #つぼはち【轟はじめ/ReGLOSS】

overview.summary: ReGLOSSメンバー4人によるダンジョン掃除ゲーム『Goblin Cleanup』の続き。新エリア「OCCULT STUDIO」の図書館エリアの清掃に挑戦。即死トラップや複雑なギミックに苦戦しつつも、アイテム収集と協力プレイで清掃率100%を達成します。拠点に戻った後は、チケットで獲得した猫のしっぽや紙袋などのコスメアイテムを全員で試着して大盛り上がり。終始賑やかな雰囲気の中、次ステージへの期待や、居酒屋ノリの挨拶で配信を締めくくります。
overview.mood: 終始賑やかで楽しい雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とオープニングトーク
highlights.description: 轟はじめが配信を開始し、ゲストメンバーと共にオープニングトークと挨拶を行う。居酒屋のようなノリで盛り上がる。

highlights.title: ゲーム概要紹介：ダンジョン掃除メイド
highlights.description: ゲーム『Goblin Cleanup』の概要を説明。冒険者が荒らしたダンジョンをゴブリンメイドとして掃除するという、本作のユニークな設定を紹介。

highlights.title: メンバー紹介とおふざけで血まみれに
highlights.description: メンバー紹介中、冗談で槍（ゲーム内のツール）を突きつけ合い、血のエフェクトが飛び散るおふざけで笑いが起こる。

highlights.title: チュートリアルステージ開始「OLD SCHOOLYARD」
highlights.description: 最初のチュートリアルステージに移動し、本日の掃除マップ（手書き風の地図）を確認する。

highlights.title: スライムモップを使った血の掃除方法
highlights.description: チュートリアルに従い、スライムをモップ代わりに使って血の汚れを掃除する方法を学ぶ。

highlights.title: マナの充填とバランス調整のミニゲーム
highlights.description: 魔法のエネルギー（マナ）をトーチに充填し、火力を適正なバランス（赤と緑のゲージの間）に保つミニゲームに挑戦。

highlights.title: 残骸の処理：ミミックに肉を与える
highlights.description: 冒険者の残骸（肉）を処理するために、生きたミミックに餌として与える方法をチュートリアルで確認。

highlights.title: ミミックにおふざけで仲間を突っ込む
highlights.description: ミミックに肉を与える際、冗談で仲間（獅白ぼたん）の体をミミックに突っ込み、メンバーが騒ぎ立てる。

highlights.title: チュートリアルクリアと拠点帰還
highlights.description: 全ての掃除とタスクを完了し、ワープポータルを使って作業拠点に戻る。チュートリアルのクリア報告画面を確認。

highlights.title: ショップでアイテム交換とコスチュームチェンジ
highlights.description: 獲得したチケットを使って、ショップでアフロヘアー（ドレッド）を購入し、装着する。他のメンバーも仮の髪型に変更する。

highlights.title: お揃いの紙袋で「ダブルミミック」
highlights.description: メンバー全員がお揃いの紙袋を装着し、おふざけモードで『ダブルミミック』のコスプレをして盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 本番ステージ「THE MAIN HALL」へ突入
highlights.description: 準備を整え、いよいよ本番のダンジョン掃除ステージ「THE MAIN HALL」へ突入する。

highlights.title: マナのバランス調整失敗で炎上
highlights.description: 本番ステージでマナの充填に失敗し、炎が上がり自キャラがダメージを受けてしまう。

highlights.title: ネコハウスの修理とネコの救出
highlights.description: 壊れたネコハウスを発見し、オブジェクトを復元してネコを無事小屋に戻す作業を行う。

highlights.title: ミミックへの給餌と骨の処理
highlights.description: ダンジョン内の残骸を処理するため、ミミックに肉を与えて掃除を進める。肉を投げた際にチキンレースのようなやり取りが発生。

highlights.title: Forlorn Crypt再開とミミックへの給餌
highlights.description: 散乱した肉片の処理のため、ダンジョン内にいるミミック（宝箱の姿をしたモンスター）に肉を与えて掃除を進める。おふざけでミミックに仲間を押し付けそうになる。

highlights.title: 血の供給源：呪われた木への奉納
highlights.description: 清掃エリア「FORLORN CRYPT」の外れで、巨大な呪いの木（ボス）を発見。肉を与えると喜んで肉片を食べ、一時的に血の汚染を収める。

highlights.title: 木の口が閉じるハプニング
highlights.description: 肉を与えようとした瞬間、木の口が閉じてしまう。諦めずに再度投げ入れると、機嫌が直ったように木が動き出す。

highlights.title: エリアの謎解きとクリア：床の修復
highlights.description: 水溜まりのような場所に壊れた床オブジェクトを発見し、修復することで移動経路を確保。エリア内の全てのタスクを完了し、「AREA COMPLETED」を達成する。

highlights.title: 拠点帰還とレベルアップ
highlights.description: ワープポータルを使って拠点（オフィス）に戻り、清掃報酬としてコインと経験値を獲得。今回のリザルト画面を確認する。

highlights.title: メインホールへ突入とレーザートラップ起動
highlights.description: 次のエリア「THE MAIN HALL」へ突入。廊下を進むと、床から緑色の植物状のトラップが飛び出し、体力が削られる。

highlights.title: マナを充填して進路確保
highlights.description: 緑色の植物トラップを無力化するため、対応するマナオブジェクトにエネルギーを注入し、道を開ける。

highlights.title: 死亡者続出！肉片だらけのトラップ地帯
highlights.description: 東の通路に入るとトラップが発動し、メンバーが次々と死亡。大量の肉片が廊下に散らばり、大惨事となる。

highlights.title: ネコハウスの祭壇で残骸を処理
highlights.description: 廊下の奥にあるネコの祭壇（ネコハウス）に肉片を供える。祭壇周辺の清掃タスクを完了する。

highlights.title: エリアコンプリート＆クリア報酬獲得
highlights.description: メインホール全体の清掃を完了し、拠点で報酬（チケットと経験値）を回収。少ない報酬に不満を漏らす。

highlights.title: スライムヘルメットを購入
highlights.description: 集めたチケットで、全員がお揃いの新しいコスメアイテム「スライムの兜」を購入し、装着して騒ぎ立てる。

highlights.title: 次のステージ「OCCULT STUDIO」へ
highlights.description: 新たなエリア「OCCULT STUDIO (図書館)」へ向かうが、扉が施錠されているため、鍵を探すことになる。

highlights.title: レーザー射出トラップに大苦戦
highlights.description: 新ステージに入ると、レーザーが飛び交う激しいトラップに遭遇。複数のメンバーが連続でデスする。

highlights.title: 鍵を見つけてSilence Roomへ
highlights.description: トラップ地帯の奥で鍵を発見し、鍵を使って新たな部屋「SILENCE ROOM」の扉を開ける。

highlights.title: 高速回転する斧のトラップ
highlights.description: SILENCE ROOMの先で、壁から飛び出す巨大な回転斧のトラップに遭遇。タイミングを見て回避を試みるが、失敗して大爆笑となる。

highlights.title: 矢のトラップを回避しながらアイテム収集
highlights.description: 廊下を縦横無尽に飛び交う矢のトラップ地帯で、モップの柄や肉片を回収。誤ってトラップに接触し、血まみれになりながらも作業を進める。

highlights.title: トラップの作動原理と安全確保
highlights.description: トラップのトリガーとなる床のスイッチを踏まないように慎重に移動。動いているトラップの間にモップの柄を挟み込み、動きを止めることで安全を確保する。

highlights.title: ミミックへの給餌と黄金のアイテムの回収
highlights.description: ミミック（宝箱のモンスター）に肉片を投げ込み、内部に隠された黄金のアイテムを回収する。その後、エリアの奥にある棚や机の上でアイテムを探索。

highlights.title: 走ると作動する秘密の通路
highlights.description: 図書館のような部屋で、本に書かれたルール（走ると作動）を確認。実際に走った際に、床のトラップが発動する仕組みを確認する。

highlights.title: 散乱したオブジェクトの復元
highlights.description: 散らばった椅子や机などのオブジェクトを魔法で修復し、部屋を整理する。

highlights.title: 隠された鍵と鍵穴の発見
highlights.description: 本棚の間に隠された鍵を発見。この鍵を使って閉ざされた扉を開けようとするが、鍵穴が見つからず一旦別のタスクへ移行する。

highlights.title: 回転斧のギミック攻略と金のアイテムの設置
highlights.description: 回転斧のトラップが設置された部屋で、黄金のアイテムを3つ設置することでトラップを停止させ、奥の部屋へと進む。

highlights.title: トラップを解除するための連携
highlights.description: レーザーが飛び交う通路で、レバー操作と床のスイッチのタイミングを合わせることで通路を確保する連携プレイを行う。

highlights.title: トラップでの連続デスと肉片の増加
highlights.description: レーザートラップの起動と同時に、プレイヤーが連続で死亡。肉片が通路を埋め尽くし、清掃対象が増えるというカオスな状況になる。

highlights.title: 掃除完了とエリアコンプリート
highlights.description: 残っていた有機物の残骸の清掃を完了させ、「SILENCE ROOM」の清掃率100%を達成し、エリアコンプリートとなる。

highlights.title: 拠点帰還とレベルアップボーナス
highlights.description: ポータルを使ってオフィスに戻り、清掃報酬としてチケットと経験値を獲得。今回のリザルト画面を確認する。

highlights.title: カスタマイズショップで猫のしっぽを購入
highlights.description: 貯まったチケットを使って、コスメティックショップで新しいアイテム（猫のしっぽ）を購入し、装着して盛り上がる。

highlights.title: カスタマイズアイテム試着と紙袋のネタ
highlights.description: メンバーが猫のしっぽや紫色のスライム頭、紙袋などを試着し、紙袋姿のキャラクターが「アバターみたい」「強盗っぽい」と突っ込まれる。

highlights.title: 今後のステージへの期待と感想
highlights.description: ダンジョン掃除の感想を述べ、次のステージがさらに難しそうだと予想する。PVでドラゴン的なものを見たという話も出る。

highlights.title: 居酒屋ノリのクロージング挨拶
highlights.description: 配信終了の挨拶について議論。「ご来店ありがとうございました」や「おつぼ八」、「閉店ガラガラ、どっしゃん」といった居酒屋風の挨拶で盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶とエンディングへ
highlights.description: メンバー全員で最後の挨拶「ご来店ありがとうございました！」を交わし、配信が終了する。

overview_en.summary: Continuation of the dungeon cleaning game "Goblin Cleanup" featuring 4 ReGLOSS members. They tackle cleaning the library area of the new "OCCULT STUDIO" zone. Despite struggling with instant-death traps and complex gimmicks, they achieve 100% cleanup completion through item collection and teamwork. After returning to base, they try on cosmetic items earned with tickets, such as cat tails and paper bags, resulting in great excitement. The stream concludes in a lively atmosphere, expressing anticipation for the next stage and closing with an Izakaya-style greeting.
overview_en.mood: Lively and fun atmosphere throughout

highlights_en.title: Stream Start and Opening Talk
highlights_en.description: Todoroki Hajime starts the stream and holds an opening talk and greetings with the guest members. The atmosphere is lively, like being at an Izakaya (Japanese pub).

highlights_en.title: Game Overview Introduction: Dungeon Cleaning Maid
highlights_en.description: Explaining the overview of the game "Goblin Cleanup." Introducing the unique premise where the players clean up dungeons ruined by adventurers as goblin maids.

highlights_en.title: Member Introduction and Getting Bloody in Jest
highlights_en.description: During member introductions, they jokingly poke each other with spears (in-game tools), causing blood effects to splatter, leading to laughter.

highlights_en.title: Tutorial Stage Start: "OLD SCHOOLYARD"
highlights_en.description: Moving to the first tutorial stage and checking today's cleaning map (hand-drawn style).

highlights_en.title: How to Clean Blood Using a Slime Mop
highlights_en.description: Following the tutorial, they learn how to clean up blood stains using slime as a mop.

highlights_en.title: Mana Refill and Balance Adjustment Minigame
highlights_en.description: Attempting a minigame where they fill a torch with magical energy (Mana) and maintain the firepower at the appropriate balance (between the red and green gauges).

highlights_en.title: Debris Disposal: Feeding Meat to the Mimic
highlights_en.description: Confirming via tutorial how to dispose of adventurer remnants (meat) by feeding them to a live Mimic.

highlights_en.title: Joking Around by Pushing a Teammate into the Mimic
highlights_en.description: While feeding the Mimic meat, they jokingly push a teammate (Shishiro Botan) toward the Mimic, causing the members to make a ruckus.

highlights_en.title: Tutorial Clear and Return to Base
highlights_en.description: Completing all cleaning and tasks and returning to the operational base using the warp portal. Checking the tutorial clear results screen.

highlights_en.title: Item Exchange and Costume Change at the Shop
highlights_en.description: Using earned tickets to purchase and equip afro hair (dreads) at the shop. Other members also change to temporary hairstyles.

highlights_en.title: "Double Mimic" with Matching Paper Bags
highlights_en.description: All members put on matching paper bags and get excited playing dress-up as "Double Mimics" in jest.

highlights_en.title: Entering the Main Stage "THE MAIN HALL"
highlights_en.description: Preparing and finally entering the actual dungeon cleaning stage, "THE MAIN HALL."

highlights_en.title: Bursting into Flames After Failing Mana Balance Adjustment
highlights_en.description: Failing to refill the mana on the main stage, causing flames to rise and the character to take damage.

highlights_en.title: Repairing the Cat House and Rescuing the Cat
highlights_en.description: Discovering a broken cat house, restoring the object, and safely returning the cat to the shelter.

highlights_en.title: Feeding the Mimic and Disposing of Bones
highlights_en.description: To dispose of remnants in the dungeon, they feed meat to the Mimic to proceed with cleaning. An interaction similar to a game of chicken occurs when throwing the meat.

highlights_en.title: Resuming Forlorn Crypt and Feeding the Mimic
highlights_en.description: To dispose of scattered meat pieces, they feed meat to the Mimic (a monster disguised as a treasure chest) in the dungeon. They jokingly try to push a teammate toward the Mimic.

highlights_en.title: Source of Blood: Offering to the Cursed Tree
highlights_en.description: Discovering a giant cursed tree (boss) on the edge of the cleaning area "FORLORN CRYPT." When fed, it happily eats the meat pieces, temporarily stopping the blood contamination.

highlights_en.title: The Tree's Mouth Closes Unexpectedly
highlights_en.description: Just as they tried to feed the meat, the tree's mouth closed. They throw it in again without giving up, and the tree moves as if it's back in a good mood.

highlights_en.title: Area Puzzle Solving and Clearance: Floor Repair
highlights_en.description: Discovering a broken floor object in a puddle-like area and repairing it to secure a path. Completing all tasks in the area and achieving "AREA COMPLETED."

highlights_en.title: Return to Base and Level Up
highlights_en.description: Returning to the base (office) using the warp portal and earning coins and experience points as cleaning rewards. Checking the results screen for this run.

highlights_en.title: Entering the Main Hall and Activating Laser Trap
highlights_en.description: Entering the next area, "THE MAIN HALL." As they proceed down the corridor, green, plant-like traps spring out from the floor, draining health.

highlights_en.title: Securing a Path by Refilling Mana
highlights_en.description: Injecting energy into the corresponding Mana object to neutralize the green plant traps and open the path.

highlights_en.title: Mass Casualties! Trap Zone Full of Meat Chunks
highlights_en.description: Entering the eastern corridor triggers traps, causing members to die one after another. Large amounts of meat chunks litter the hallway, resulting in a disaster.

highlights_en.title: Disposing of Remains at the Cat House Altar
highlights_en.description: Offering meat pieces to the Cat Altar (Cat House) located at the back of the corridor. Completing the cleaning tasks around the altar.

highlights_en.title: Area Complete & Clearing Reward Acquired
highlights_en.description: Completing the cleaning of the entire Main Hall and collecting rewards (tickets and experience) at the base. Complaining about the small reward.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing the Slime Helmet
highlights_en.description: Using the accumulated tickets, everyone purchases matching new cosmetic items, "Slime Helmets," and excitedly puts them on.

highlights_en.title: Heading to the Next Stage "OCCULT STUDIO"
highlights_en.description: Heading towards the new area, "OCCULT STUDIO (Library)," but finding the door locked, necessitating a search for the key.

highlights_en.title: Great Struggle Against Laser Firing Traps
highlights_en.description: Upon entering the new stage, they encounter fierce traps with lasers flying everywhere. Multiple members die consecutively.

highlights_en.title: Finding the Key and Proceeding to the Silence Room
highlights_en.description: Discovering a key deep within the trap zone and using it to open the door to the new room, "SILENCE ROOM."

highlights_en.title: High-Speed Rotating Axe Trap
highlights_en.description: Beyond the SILENCE ROOM, they encounter a huge rotating axe trap springing from the wall. They attempt to dodge by timing, but fail, leading to massive laughter.

highlights_en.title: Collecting Items While Dodging Arrow Traps
highlights_en.description: Collecting mop handles and meat pieces in a zone where arrows fly haphazardly across the corridor. They accidentally touch the traps and continue working covered in blood.

highlights_en.title: Trap Activation Mechanism and Securing Safety
highlights_en.description: Moving carefully to avoid stepping on floor switches that trigger traps. Securing safety by wedging a mop handle between the moving traps to halt their movement.

highlights_en.title: Feeding the Mimic and Recovering Golden Items
highlights_en.description: Throwing meat pieces into the Mimic (treasure chest monster) to retrieve the golden item hidden inside. Afterwards, searching for items on shelves and desks deeper in the area.

highlights_en.title: Secret Passage Activated by Running
highlights_en.description: In the library-like room, confirming the rule written in a book (activates upon running). Verifying that running actually triggers the floor trap mechanism.

highlights_en.title: Restoring Scattered Objects
highlights_en.description: Restoring scattered objects like chairs and desks using magic to tidy up the room.

highlights_en.title: Discovery of a Hidden Key and Keyhole
highlights_en.description: Discovering a key hidden between bookshelves. Attempting to use this key to open a locked door, but switching to another task temporarily as the keyhole cannot be found.

highlights_en.title: Solving the Rotating Axe Gimmick and Placing Golden Items
highlights_en.description: In the room with the rotating axe trap, they disable the trap by placing 3 golden items, allowing them to proceed to the inner room.

highlights_en.title: Coordination to Disable Traps
highlights_en.description: Performing coordinated play to secure a path in the laser-filled corridor by timing lever operation and floor switches.

highlights_en.title: Consecutive Deaths and Increase in Meat Chunks Due to Traps
highlights_en.description: Players die consecutively immediately after the laser trap is activated. The path becomes covered in meat chunks, resulting in a chaotic situation where the cleaning targets increase.

highlights_en.title: Cleaning Complete and Area Complete
highlights_en.description: Completing the cleaning of the remaining organic remnants, achieving 100% completion rate for the "SILENCE ROOM," and marking the area complete.

highlights_en.title: Return to Base and Level Up Bonus
highlights_en.description: Returning to the office via the portal and earning tickets and experience points as cleaning rewards. Checking the results screen for this run.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing Cat Tails at the Customization Shop
highlights_en.description: Using accumulated tickets to purchase a new cosmetic item (cat tail) at the shop, equipping it, and getting excited.

highlights_en.title: Trying on Custom Items and the Paper Bag Gag
highlights_en.description: Members try on cat tails, purple slime heads, and paper bags. The characters wearing paper bags are joked about as looking "like avatars" or "like robbers."

highlights_en.title: Anticipation for Future Stages and Impressions
highlights_en.description: Sharing impressions of the dungeon cleaning and predicting the next stages will be even more difficult. Discussion about seeing something dragon-like in the PV.

highlights_en.title: Izakaya-Style Closing Greetings
highlights_en.description: Discussing closing greetings. Getting excited over Izakaya-style greetings like "Thank you for coming," "Otsubo Hachi (equivalent to Otsukare)," and "Shutter down, bang!"

highlights_en.title: Stream End Greetings and Transition to Ending
highlights_en.description: All members exchange their final greeting, "Thank you for visiting!" and the stream concludes.

title: 【Goblin Cleanup】#つぼはち でダンジョンのお掃除！？準備！？#つぼはち【#輪堂千速 / #hololivedev_is  #FLOWGLOW 】

overview.summary: ホロライブの輪堂千速、獅白ぼたん、尾丸ポルカ、角巻わためら4人が、ゴブリンメイドとなってダンジョンを掃除するマルチプレイヤーゲーム『Goblin Cleanup』をプレイ。レベル2、レベル3のダンジョンを清掃し、度重なる死亡やトラップを乗り越えて、協力してタスクをクリアした。終盤では、獲得したチケットで新しいメイド服や紙袋、スライムヘッドなどのコミカルなアクセサリーを購入し、お互いの姿を楽しみながらコラボを振り返った。最後まで「居酒屋のバイト」という設定を貫き、「ご来店ありがとうございました」という挨拶で締めくくられた、終始賑やかで笑いの絶えない清掃アルバイトとなった。
overview.mood: 終始賑やかで笑いの絶えない、ハイテンションな雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とゴブリンメイドのメンバー紹介
highlights.description: 輪堂千速、獅白ぼたん、尾丸ポルカ、角巻わための4人がゴブリンメイドの姿で集合し、配信が始まる。「#つぼはち」コラボであることを確認しつつ、ゲームコンセプトを「居酒屋のバイト」だと話す。

highlights.title: 魔改造されたアイテムでの内輪揉めと死亡
highlights.description: メンバーが持つアイテム（フォークや槍）でふざけてお互いを刺し合う流れになり、誤って尾丸ポルカが死亡してしまうカオスな状況に。アイテムの破壊力が高いことが判明。

highlights.title: ゲーム内アイコンでいじられるメンバーたち
highlights.description: ゲーム内の設定画面にあるメンバーのアイコンが、わためはアイドル写真、ぼたんはラーメン画像、ちゅらいむはエラー画像になっていて笑いが起こる。

highlights.title: チュートリアル開始と清掃マップの確認
highlights.description: チュートリアルステージ「OLD SCHOOLYARD」へ向かう。清掃すべきダンジョンのマップを確認し、本日のお掃除タスクを確認。

highlights.title: 血液の清掃方法（スライムモップ）
highlights.description: 血液の清掃方法のチュートリアル。槍にスライムを付けてモップのように使い、血痕を吸い取る。
highlights.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights.title: オブジェクトの修復とマナの取り扱い
highlights.description: 散乱したオブジェクト（テーブルなど）を元の位置に戻して修復する方法や、マナ（エネルギー）を使い、トーチに火を灯す方法を学ぶ。マナを注入しすぎると爆発の危険がある。
highlights.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights.title: ミミックの処理方法と誤って死亡
highlights.description: ミミック（ゴミ箱）に冒険者の残骸（肉片）や汚れたスライムを与えるタスク。ミミックの正面から肉片を与えようとしたところ、輪堂千速が食べられて死亡し、再開地点に戻される。

highlights.title: チュートリアルクリアと拠点帰還
highlights.description: 清掃タスクを完了させ、ワープポータルを使って拠点に戻る。報酬として経験値と「チケット」を獲得し、レベルアップ。

highlights.title: 輪堂千速のキーボードが暴走
highlights.description: 拠点に戻った直後、輪堂千速のキーボードが勝手に動き出すハプニングが発生。ゲーム内のキャラが走り続ける。
highlights.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights.title: チュートリアル：強制移動からのスライムの汚染
highlights.description: チュートリアル内でメンバーがお互いの血を処理したり、スライムが汚染されて使えなくなったりするカオスな展開が続く。

highlights.title: カスタムアイテム購入と紙袋姿に
highlights.description: 獲得したチケットを使ってショップでアイテムを購入。全員お揃いの紙袋の頭装備や靴下を購入し、奇妙な格好で次のステージへ向かう。

highlights.title: レベル2「THE MAIN HALL」へ突入
highlights.description: 全員が紙袋を装備した状態でレベル2「THE MAIN HALL」へ。広大で暗いダンジョンでの本格的な清掃がスタート。

highlights.title: 再びミミックに食べられる
highlights.description: ダンジョン内でミミックに肉片を与えようとしたところ、再び輪堂千速が食べられて死亡。ミミックの恐ろしさを再認識する。

highlights.title: 猫を家に帰すタスクに挑戦
highlights.description: 拾った黒猫（実体化）を特定の場所にある猫の家に誘導するタスクに挑戦。猫はマナを吸い取る性質を持つ。

highlights.title: 魔力バランスの調整ミスで爆発
highlights.description: 破壊されたオブジェクトをマナで修復する際にミスし、魔力の注入/放出のバランスを取るのが難しいことが判明。

highlights.title: ミミックの血痕掃除と肉を与えるシステム理解
highlights.description: ミミックの血を清掃する際、肉片をぶつけることで血が飛び散り、清掃が進むことを確認。
highlights.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights.title: 死亡者を復活させる祭壇（REVIVE HERE）が起動
highlights.description: 祭壇で誰かが魔法を使うと、その場にいる仲間が復活することを確認。ただし、誰かが犠牲になる必要あり。

highlights.title: 暴走するワタメ/紙袋姿での階段登りが話題に
highlights.description: ワタメが興奮して走り回り、階段を登る姿がコミカルに描かれ、メンバー間で笑いが起こる。

highlights.title: 不気味な木（TREES）に肉を捧げるミッション判明
highlights.description: 壁のメモから、墓地エリアにいる不気味な木に肉片を捧げることがミッションの一部であると判明。

highlights.title: 巨大な回転斧のトラップ通路を通過
highlights.description: 血まみれの巨大な回転斧が行き来する通路を慎重に通過。誰かが当たると即死する。

highlights.title: 謎の木に肉をあげすぎた？肉不足で誰かが肉になる必要性を話す
highlights.description: 不気味な木に肉片を与えすぎた結果、マップに肉片が不足。冗談で誰かがミミックの餌（肉）にならなきゃいけないという会話で盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 輪堂千速、斧トラップでまたもや死亡
highlights.description: 回転斧のトラップを避けきれず、輪堂千速が死亡。死亡回数が増えることで、次の清掃箇所が増えるという悪循環に。

highlights.title: ぼたんの投擲によりワタメが死亡するハプニング
highlights.description: ミミックに肉を投げようとした獅白ぼたんの攻撃が、角巻わためを直撃し、ワタメが死亡するハプニングが発生。

highlights.title: 墓場エリア「FORLORN CRYPT」探索開始、不気味な木に肉を献上
highlights.description: 墓場のような屋外エリアへ。不気味な木（TREES）に肉を捧げることで、木の表情が変わり、清掃が進む。

highlights.title: FORLORN CRYPTエリア清掃完了、次のワープゲートへ
highlights.description: FORLORN CRYPTエリアの清掃が完了。皆で協力して次のエリアへ向かうワープゲートを起動。

highlights.title: マナ充填ギミック起動で木のつるが伸びる
highlights.description: マナを充填するギミックが作動し、巨大な木のつるが勢いよく伸びていく様子に驚く。

highlights.title: 汚染されたスライムをモップがわりに利用
highlights.description: 赤い液体に汚染されたスライムを意図的に使って、清掃を進める。スライムが勝手に血を吸い上げる。

highlights.title: 汚れたスライムが徘徊する中、清掃を続ける
highlights.description: 汚染されたスライムがマップ内を動き回り、さらに周囲を汚染するカオスな状況で清掃を続行。

highlights.title: レベル2クリア報酬獲得（チケット165枚）
highlights.description: メインエリアの清掃を完了し、拠点に戻る。達成度が100%になり、報酬としてチケット165枚を獲得。

highlights.title: 死亡による給料天引きの懸念で盛り上がる
highlights.description: 度重なる死亡が原因で、クリア報酬のチケットが他のメンバーより少ないのではないかという話題で盛り上がる。

highlights.title: 新しいエリア「OCCULT STUDIO (THE LIBRARY)」へ
highlights.description: 獲得したチケットを使い、次のステージ「OCCULT STUDIO」へ。図書室のようなエリアを進む。

highlights.title: レーザー光線トラップを回避しながら進む
highlights.description: 移動するレーザー光線トラップを回避しながら、清掃対象の血痕やオブジェクトを探す。

highlights.title: 落下する足場に乗ろうとして死亡
highlights.description: 高い場所へのショートカットを試みたが、足場となるオブジェクトが突然崩壊し、輪堂千速が死亡。
highlights.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights.title: 毒沼エリアで、木型のミミックに肉片を投げる
highlights.description: 墓場のような屋外エリアの奥、毒沼の中にあるミミックのような木に肉を投げ込む。

highlights.title: サイレンスルームのレーザートラップに触れて死亡
highlights.description: SILENCE ROOMのレーザートラップを避けようとしたが、レーザーに当たって爆発炎上し死亡。レーザーアイが発動。

highlights.title: 炎のギミックを利用してマナを充填
highlights.description: 炎のギミックの真上にある台座にマナを注入し、炎で満たすことでオブジェクトを修復する。

highlights.title: 溶岩に落ちて死亡し、連帯責任を負う
highlights.description: 溶岩のエリアで清掃中に足を踏み外し、輪堂千速が死亡。他のメンバーに血痕掃除という追加の連帯責任を負わせる。
highlights.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights.title: 金のアイテムを3つ集めるゴールデンチェストに遭遇
highlights.description: 金のアイテムを3つ捧げると開くゴールデンチェストを発見。メンバーで手分けして金のアイテムを探す。

highlights.title: 金のアイテムを回収し、宝箱を閉じる
highlights.description: 金のアイテムを無事3つ回収し、宝箱を閉じてミッション完了。次のステージへのワープゲートが出現。

highlights.title: 飛び道具（槍）を拾う際の誤爆事故
highlights.description: 槍を拾おうとしたところ、触れた瞬間に槍が飛んでいき、輪堂千速が巻き込まれそうになる。

highlights.title: スライムモップをミミックに食べさせて復活
highlights.description: 瀕死の状態のミミックにスライムモップを与え、ミミックを正常な状態に復元させる。

highlights.title: 飛び交う本で死亡するメンバー
highlights.description: 本のオブジェクトを修復する際、本が飛び回り、メンバーに直撃して死亡する。

highlights.title: ダッシュ禁止の謎解きメモを発見
highlights.description: 髭の生えたボスらしき絵とともに、「ダッシュとジャンプが禁止」されていることが描かれたメモを発見。

highlights.title: ダッシュでトラップ発動、肉片化するメンバー
highlights.description: ダッシュしてしまったことで、床のトラップが発動し、輪堂千速が肉片となり死亡。

highlights.title: 壊れた椅子を直すタスクと、床のトラップを避ける苦労
highlights.description: 床のトラップを避けながら、壊れた椅子を直すタスクをこなす。椅子は「図工室の椅子」とネタにされる。

highlights.title: ワープゲート起動と『FORBIDDEN SECTION』へ
highlights.description: マップ内にあった仕掛けを起動し、新たなエリア『FORBIDDEN SECTION』のワープゲートを出現させる。

highlights.title: 秘密の部屋の謎解き（本・肉・バルブ）
highlights.description: ワープゲートから移動したエリアにて、飛び交う本や、肉を捧げる祭壇、バルブの設置など、多数の謎解きに挑戦。

highlights.title: 謎解きをクリアし「SILENCE ROOM」へ
highlights.description: 各種オブジェクトを修復・起動し、新たなエリア「SILENCE ROOM」へ進む。ここではモンスター退治がタスクとなる。

highlights.title: 回転斧のトラップで大量死発生
highlights.description: SILENCE ROOMの通路を移動中、床のトラップを踏んだことで回転斧の罠が起動し、メンバーが次々と死亡するカオスな状況に。

highlights.title: トラップの犠牲になった仲間たち
highlights.description: メンバーがトラップにより死亡したことで、血痕や肉片が大量に発生し、清掃箇所が激増する。

highlights.title: ゴールデンチェストに鍵をセットしクリア
highlights.description: ゴールデンチェストに必要な最後の金色のアイテム（鍵）をセットし、チェストをクローズ。エリアをコンプリート。

highlights.title: ゴールデンチェストクリアで報酬ゲット
highlights.description: ゴールデンチェストのクリアにより、大量のコインとチケットを獲得。

highlights.title: 最終エリア『OCCULT STUDIO』完全クリア
highlights.description: 全てのエリアを清掃し終え、ポータルで拠点に帰還。「OCULT STUDIO」を完全クリアした結果画面が表示される。

highlights.title: 全裸になって着せ替えを楽しむメンバーたち
highlights.description: 獲得したチケットでショップにて新しいメイド服などを購入。全員で装備を脱ぎ、裸（肌着姿）でフィッティングを楽しむ。

highlights.title: 新しい衣装で記念撮影
highlights.description: 輪堂千速が新しい衣装（メイド服、青い肌、青いスライムの帽子）に着替える。他のメンバーも新パーツを装着し、可愛らしい姿で記念撮影を試みる。

highlights.title: スライムヘッドが青く変色した輪堂千速
highlights.description: 新しいアクセサリーのスライムヘッドの色が青く変色したことが話題になる。わためるが青くなったスライムを触ったり、ポルカが紙袋のまま変色したりして遊ぶ。

highlights.title: 次のステージの話題とドラゴン型トラップの存在
highlights.description: レベル3をクリアし、次のステージLvl 4の難しさについて話す。PVでドラゴン型のトラップがいることが示唆され、メンバーはさらに難しくなる清掃に怯える。

highlights.title: 居酒屋設定を貫く締め挨拶の決定
highlights.description: 配信の締めくくりについて話し合い、居酒屋アルバイト設定に合わせて「ご来店ありがとうございました」で締めくくることを決定。居酒屋感が強まり爆笑となる。

highlights.title: コラボ配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: 4人揃って「せーの、ご来店ありがとうございました！」と挨拶し、和やかにコラボ配信を終了した。

tags: 清掃シミュレーション

overview_en.summary: Hololive members Rindo Chihaya, Shishiro Botan, Omaru Polka, and Tsunomaki Watame played the multiplayer game "Goblin Cleanup," where four goblin maids clean up dungeons. They successfully cleaned Level 2 and Level 3 dungeons, overcoming numerous deaths and traps through cooperation. Towards the end, they used acquired tickets to buy comical accessories like new maid outfits, paper bags, and slime heads, enjoying each other's custom looks while reflecting on the collaboration. They maintained the theme of "Izakaya part-time job" until the very end, concluding with the greeting, "Thank you for visiting our establishment," resulting in a consistently lively and hilarious cleaning shift.
overview_en.mood: Consistently lively, non-stop laughter, high-tension atmosphere

highlights_en.title: Stream Starts and Introduction of Goblin Maid Members
highlights_en.description: Rindo Chihaya, Shishiro Botan, Omaru Polka, and Tsunomaki Watame gather in their goblin maid outfits and start the stream. They confirm it's a "#Tsubohachi" collaboration and set the game concept as an "Izakaya part-time job."

highlights_en.title: In-fighting and Death with Heavily Customized Items
highlights_en.description: The members start playing around, stabbing each other with their items (forks and spears), leading to a chaotic situation where Omaru Polka accidentally dies. The destructive power of the items is revealed.

highlights_en.title: Members Teased Over In-Game Icons
highlights_en.description: Laughter ensues when checking the in-game settings: Watame's icon is an idol photo, Botan's is a ramen picture, and Churaime's (Chihaya's) is an error image.

highlights_en.title: Tutorial Start and Cleanup Map Check
highlights_en.description: They head to the tutorial stage "OLD SCHOOLYARD." They check the dungeon cleanup map and confirm today's cleaning tasks.

highlights_en.title: How to Clean Blood (Slime Mop)
highlights_en.description: Tutorial on how to clean blood. They attach a slime to a spear and use it like a mop to absorb blood stains.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights_en.title: Object Restoration and Mana Handling
highlights_en.description: They learn how to restore scattered objects (like tables) back to their original positions and how to use Mana (energy) to light torches. Injecting too much Mana risks explosion.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights_en.title: Mimic Disposal Method and Accidental Death
highlights_en.description: Task: Feed the mimic (trash can) adventurer remains (meat pieces) and dirty slime. Rindo Chihaya tries to feed the mimic from the front and is eaten and killed, returning her to the respawn point.

highlights_en.title: Tutorial Cleared and Return to Base
highlights_en.description: They complete the cleaning task and use the warp portal to return to base. They gain EXP and "Tickets" as a reward and level up.

highlights_en.title: Rindo Chihaya's Keyboard Goes Rogue
highlights_en.description: Immediately upon returning to base, Rindo Chihaya's keyboard starts acting on its own, causing her in-game character to run uncontrollably.
highlights_en.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights_en.title: Tutorial: Forced Movement and Slime Contamination
highlights_en.description: A chaotic sequence continues in the tutorial where members clean up each other's blood and slimes become contaminated and unusable.

highlights_en.title: Purchasing Custom Items and Appearance in Paper Bags
highlights_en.description: They use the earned tickets to buy items at the shop. Everyone buys matching paper bag headgear and socks, heading to the next stage in peculiar outfits.

highlights_en.title: Entering Level 2 "THE MAIN HALL"
highlights_en.description: All equipped with paper bags, they enter Level 2 "THE MAIN HALL." Serious cleaning begins in the vast, dark dungeon.

highlights_en.title: Eaten by the Mimic Again
highlights_en.description: While attempting to feed meat pieces to a mimic in the dungeon, Rindo Chihaya is eaten and dies once more, reaffirming the mimic's danger.

highlights_en.title: Attempting the Task of Returning a Cat Home
highlights_en.description: They attempt the task of leading a picked-up black cat (now materialized) to a specific cat house. The cat has the property of draining Mana.

highlights_en.title: Explosion Due to Mana Balance Adjustment Failure
highlights_en.description: They make a mistake while restoring a destroyed object with Mana, revealing the difficulty in balancing Mana injection/release.

highlights_en.title: Cleaning Mimic Blood and Understanding the Meat Feeding System
highlights_en.description: They confirm that throwing meat pieces at the mimic's blood splatters the blood, which helps with cleaning.
highlights_en.type: ゲーム/チュートリアル

highlights_en.title: Altar to Revive the Dead (REVIVE HERE) Activated
highlights_en.description: They confirm that when someone uses magic at the altar, nearby allies are revived, although someone usually needs to be sacrificed.

highlights_en.title: Rampaging Watame / Climbing Stairs in Paper Bag Outfit Becomes a Topic
highlights_en.description: Watame runs around excitedly, and her comical appearance climbing stairs sparks laughter among the members.

highlights_en.title: Mission Revealed: Offering Meat to Eerie Trees
highlights_en.description: A note on the wall indicates that part of the mission is to offer meat pieces to the spooky trees located in the graveyard area.

highlights_en.title: Passing Through a Passage with a Giant Spinning Axe Trap
highlights_en.description: They carefully pass through a passage where a giant, bloody spinning axe moves back and forth. Getting hit means instant death.

highlights_en.title: Fed the Mysterious Tree Too Much Meat? Discussing the Need for Someone to Become Meat Due to Shortage
highlights_en.description: As a result of feeding too many meat pieces to the spooky trees, the map runs low on meat. They joke about the necessity of someone becoming bait (meat) for the mimic.

highlights_en.title: Rindo Chihaya Dies Again to the Axe Trap
highlights_en.description: Rindo Chihaya fails to avoid the spinning axe trap and dies. Her increasing death count exacerbates the problem by creating more areas needing cleanup.

highlights_en.title: Accident: Watame Dies Due to Botan's Throw
highlights_en.description: Shishiro Botan attempts to throw meat at the mimic, but the throw hits Tsunomaki Watame directly, causing Watame to die.

highlights_en.title: Starting Exploration of Graveyard Area "FORLORN CRYPT," Offering Meat to Eerie Trees
highlights_en.description: They enter the outdoor graveyard area. Offering meat to the eerie trees (TREES) changes their expression and advances the cleanup.

highlights_en.title: FORLORN CRYPT Area Cleanup Complete, Moving to the Next Warp Gate
highlights_en.description: The cleanup of the FORLORN CRYPT area is finished. They cooperate to activate the warp gate leading to the next area.

highlights_en.title: Tree Vines Grow Rapidly Upon Mana Charging Activation
highlights_en.description: A Mana charging mechanism is activated, and they are surprised by how quickly huge tree vines extend.

highlights_en.title: Utilizing Contaminated Slime as a Mop
highlights_en.description: They intentionally use slime contaminated with red liquid to advance the cleanup. The slime automatically absorbs the blood.

highlights_en.title: Continuing Cleanup While Dirty Slime Roams
highlights_en.description: They continue cleaning in a chaotic situation where contaminated slime moves around the map, further polluting the surroundings.

highlights_en.title: Level 2 Clear Reward Acquired (165 Tickets)
highlights_en.description: They complete the cleanup of the main area and return to base. The achievement rate reaches 100%, and they receive 165 tickets as a reward.

highlights_en.title: Excitement Over Concerns About Wage Deduction Due to Deaths
highlights_en.description: They joke about the possibility that repeated deaths might result in fewer reward tickets than other members.

highlights_en.title: To the New Area "OCCULT STUDIO (THE LIBRARY)"
highlights_en.description: They use the acquired tickets and head to the next stage, "OCCULT STUDIO," proceeding through a library-like area.

highlights_en.title: Advancing While Avoiding Laser Beam Traps
highlights_en.description: They look for bloodstains and objects to clean while dodging moving laser beam traps.

highlights_en.title: Death Attempting to Step on a Falling Platform
highlights_en.description: Rindo Chihaya attempts a shortcut to a high place, but the platform object suddenly collapses, causing her death.
highlights_en.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights_en.title: Throwing Meat Pieces at a Tree-Shaped Mimic in the Poison Swamp Area
highlights_en.description: In the depths of the outdoor graveyard area, they throw meat into a mimic-like tree located in a poison swamp.

highlights_en.title: Death Touching the Laser Trap in the Silence Room
highlights_en.description: While trying to avoid the laser trap in the SILENCE ROOM, she hits the laser, exploding and dying. The Laser Eye is activated.

highlights_en.title: Charging Mana Using the Flame Gimmick
highlights_en.description: They inject Mana into the pedestal directly above the flame gimmick, filling it with fire to restore the object.

highlights_en.title: Falling into Lava and Dying, Incurring Collective Responsibility
highlights_en.description: While cleaning in the lava area, Rindo Chihaya misses her step and dies, imposing additional collective responsibility (cleaning bloodstains) on the other members.
highlights_en.type: リアクション/ハプニング

highlights_en.title: Encountering a Golden Chest Requiring 3 Gold Items
highlights_en.description: They find a Golden Chest that opens when three gold items are offered. The members split up to look for the items.

highlights_en.title: Recovering Gold Items and Closing the Chest
highlights_en.description: They successfully recover all three gold items and close the treasure chest, completing the mission. A warp gate to the next stage appears.

highlights_en.title: Accidental Explosion While Picking Up a Projectile (Spear)
highlights_en.description: While attempting to pick up a spear, it instantly flies off upon contact, nearly hitting Rindo Chihaya.

highlights_en.title: Reviving the Mimic by Feeding it a Slime Mop
highlights_en.description: They feed a slime mop to a nearly dead mimic, restoring it to a normal state.

highlights_en.title: Members Dying Due to Flying Books
highlights_en.description: When restoring a book object, the books fly around and hit members, causing them to die.

highlights_en.title: Discovering a Puzzle Note Prohibiting Dashing
highlights_en.description: They find a note depicting a bearded boss-like figure, indicating that "Dashing and Jumping are prohibited."

highlights_en.title: Trap Activation by Dashing, Member Turns into Meat Chunks
highlights_en.description: By dashing, a floor trap is activated, killing Rindo Chihaya and turning her into meat pieces.

highlights_en.title: Task to Fix Broken Chairs and Struggle to Avoid Floor Traps
highlights_en.description: They complete the task of fixing broken chairs while avoiding floor traps. The chairs are joked about as being "shop class chairs."

highlights_en.title: Activating the Warp Gate and Heading to 'FORBIDDEN SECTION'
highlights_en.description: They activate a mechanism found within the map, making the warp gate to the new area, 'FORBIDDEN SECTION,' appear.

highlights_en.title: Secret Room Puzzle (Books, Meat, Valve)
highlights_en.description: In the area accessed through the warp gate, they tackle multiple puzzles, including flying books, an altar for offering meat, and valve installations.

highlights_en.title: Clearing the Puzzle and Proceeding to "SILENCE ROOM"
highlights_en.description: They restore and activate various objects, advancing to the new area "SILENCE ROOM," where the task is to defeat monsters.

highlights_en.title: Mass Death Caused by Spinning Axe Trap
highlights_en.description: While moving through the SILENCE ROOM passage, stepping on a floor trap activates the spinning axe trap, leading to a chaotic situation where members die one after another.

highlights_en.title: Allies Sacrificed to Traps
highlights_en.description: Members dying to traps causes a massive increase in bloodstains and meat pieces, drastically increasing the required cleanup.

highlights_en.title: Clearing by Setting the Key in the Golden Chest
highlights_en.description: They set the final required gold item (a key) into the Golden Chest and close it, completing the area.

highlights_en.title: Receiving Reward for Clearing the Golden Chest
highlights_en.description: They receive a large amount of coins and tickets upon clearing the Golden Chest.

highlights_en.title: Full Clearance of the Final Area 'OCCULT STUDIO'
highlights_en.description: They finish cleaning all areas and return to base via the portal. The completion screen for "OCCULT STUDIO" is displayed.

highlights_en.title: Members Enjoying Dress-Up While Naked
highlights_en.description: They use the earned tickets to buy new maid outfits at the shop. Everyone strips down (to their underwear) and enjoys fitting the new items.

highlights_en.title: Commemorative Photo in New Outfits
highlights_en.description: Rindo Chihaya changes into a new outfit (maid uniform, blue skin, blue slime hat). Other members also equip new parts and attempt to take a cute commemorative photo.

highlights_en.title: Rindo Chihaya’s Slime Head Turns Blue
highlights_en.description: The change in color of Rindo Chihaya's new slime head accessory (turning blue) becomes a topic. Watame touches the blue slime, and Polka plays around, having her paper bag change color.

highlights_en.title: Discussion of the Next Stage and the Existence of a Dragon Trap
highlights_en.description: After clearing Level 3, they discuss the difficulty of the next stage, Lvl 4. A PV hints at a dragon-shaped trap, making the members anxious about the increasingly difficult cleanup.

highlights_en.title: Deciding on a Closing Greeting that Maintains the Izakaya Theme
highlights_en.description: They discuss how to conclude the stream and decide to use "Thank you for visiting our establishment," consistent with the izakaya part-time job theme, which leads to laughter.

highlights_en.title: Collaboration Stream Ending Greeting
highlights_en.description: The four members collectively say, "Ready, set, thank you for visiting our establishment!" and conclude the collaboration stream amicably.

title: 【ニコニコさん】ルイねえ、本当に怖くないんだろうな？【風真いろは/ホロライブ】

overview.summary: ホラーゲーム「ニコニコさん」実況配信の後半。序盤で手に入れたアイテムを使いながら、追跡者から隠れ、時には激しい追いかけっこを繰り広げる。無事にグッドエンディングを迎えた後、視聴者からのコメントやスーパーチャットを読み上げながら、ルイ姉（鷹嶺ルイ）の「怖くない」発言の真意について考察する。また、自身の新しい衣装の進捗や、最近ハマっている電子レンジで作る簡単クレープについて語り、ホラーゲームはしばらくお休みすると宣言しつつも、フブキ先輩とのホラーコラボへの覚悟を語って配信を終えた。
overview.mood: 恐怖と安堵が入り混じるジェットコースターのような展開のホラーゲーム実況から、落ち着いた雑談へ

highlights.title: 配信開始とエコーのトラブル
highlights.description: 配信開始の挨拶とともに、マイクのエコーがひどい状態に。風真いろはは「怪奇にやられている」と冗談交じりに挨拶。

highlights.title: ゲーム開始前の爆音の怯え
highlights.description: ゲーム「ニコニコさん」を起動。開始時に大音量の警告音が出ることに怯え、画面を真っ黒にして対応する。

highlights.title: ルイ姉は怖くないと言ったのに…
highlights.description: タイトル画面でゲームの不気味な雰囲気に改めて怯え、「ルイねえ、本当に怖くないんだろうな？」と不安を訴える。（タイトル回収）

highlights.title: 最初の追跡者と驚きの初死亡
highlights.description: ゲーム開始直後の路地で、最初の追跡者（女子高生のような姿）が出現。逃げ惑うも追いつかれてしまい、最初の死亡。

highlights.title: ゴミ箱に隠れる生存術とエナジードリンク
highlights.description: 再開後、倉庫のドアが鍵で閉ざされていることを確認。探索を始め、ゴミ箱を発見。「エナジードリンク」を入手し、走るためのブーストを獲得する。

highlights.title: 追跡者（ニコニコさん）の出現と再度の死亡
highlights.description: 路地で追跡者「ニコニコさん」が出現。逃げようとするも捕まり、ゴミ箱のクールタイムを待てずに死亡してしまう。

highlights.title: 公園でクッキーを入手し、即死亡
highlights.description: 探索を進め、公園で「クッキー」のアイテムを入手。直後、追跡者に捕まり死亡。

highlights.title: メモから犬の情報を得る
highlights.description: 公園のベンチでメモを発見。追跡者を撃退するためのヒント「犬」について知る。

highlights.title: ハンマーを入手し、フェンスを破壊
highlights.description: 探索中にハンマーを入手。これを使って、立ち入り禁止のフェンスを破壊し、次のエリアへ進む。

highlights.title: 選挙ポスターと狐の面
highlights.description: 道端で選挙ポスターを見つける。直後、狐の面をつけた追跡者が出現するが、ゴミ箱に隠れてやり過ごす。

highlights.title: チェーンカッターを入手
highlights.description: 自転車置き場で「チェーンカッター」を入手。アイテム収集を進める。

highlights.title: 犬にクッキーをあげて鍵を入手
highlights.description: 公園の犬にクッキーを使い、犬が消える。直後に追跡者が出現するが、女子トイレから倉庫の鍵を入手。

highlights.title: 倉庫の鍵の入手
highlights.description: 女子トイレの便器内に隠されていた「倉庫の鍵」を入手。物語の核心に迫るための準備が整う。

highlights.title: 「倉庫の鍵」の用途再確認
highlights.description: インベントリにある鍵とマップ上の施錠された扉を照合。「倉庫の鍵」はゲームスタート時の倉庫用で、「廃墟の鍵」が別に必要だと推測。

highlights.title: 追跡者の接近とゴミ箱での隠密行動
highlights.description: 追跡者が近くをうろつき、悲鳴を上げながらゴミ箱に隠れてやり過ごす。

highlights.title: 施錠された廃墟の扉を発見
highlights.description: 探索を進め、チェーンと南京錠で固く施錠された廃墟の扉を発見。「廃墟の鍵」が必要であることを確認。

highlights.title: 廃墟の鍵を入手し、建物内部へ
highlights.description: 別の隠し場所でテレビから「廃墟の鍵」を入手。扉を開け、内部へ侵入するが、空間が赤く染まり不穏な雰囲気となる。

highlights.title: 建物内部で追跡者と遭遇し、エナドリで逃走
highlights.description: 建物内部で追跡者と遭遇し、絶叫。エナジードリンクのブーストを使い逃走。その後「パールのようなもの」を入手する。

highlights.title: 倉庫付近での遭遇と回避行動
highlights.description: 再び初期エリアの倉庫付近に戻るが、追跡者と遭遇し、ゴミ箱に逃げ込む。追跡者の動きに怯える。

highlights.title: ゴミ箱クールタイム中の絶体絶命の危機
highlights.description: ゴミ箱のクールタイム中にもかかわらず、追跡者が目の前を通過する。恐怖に耐えながら、クールタイム終了後に逃走。

highlights.title: 出口を目指してダッシュ！赤い世界への突入
highlights.description: エナジードリンクを飲み、出口（トンネル）を目指して走り出す。景色が歪み、赤い世界へ突入する。

highlights.title: 追跡者に捕まり死亡（You are dead）
highlights.description: 赤い世界で追跡者に捕まり死亡。絶叫とともに「You are dead」が表示される。その後も連続で死亡する。

highlights.title: Eキー連打ミニゲームで扉を破る
highlights.description: 赤い世界での逃走中に、閉じ込められた部屋でEキー連打のミニゲームが発生。連打で扉をこじ開ける。

highlights.title: 大量の追跡者の中を走り抜け、光の出口へ
highlights.description: 扉の先には大量の追跡者が待ち構える異空間。絶叫しながら光の出口を目指して走り抜け、脱出に成功する。

highlights.title: エンディングテキストとゲームクリアの瞬間
highlights.description: 暗転後、脱出成功を告げるテキストが流れ、エンドロールに突入。犬（ワンちゃん）との再会が示唆され、エンド2「一人と一匹」に到達。

highlights.title: グッドエンド達成に歓喜と安堵
highlights.description: グッドエンドクリアに歓喜し、安堵の声を上げる。ルイ姉の言葉の真意（心臓に悪いのは間違いない）について考察。

highlights.title: 雑談（スパチャ読み）と今後の配信告知
highlights.description: ゲームの感想を話しつつ、スパチャ読みを開始。喉の不調に言及しつつ、次回以降の配信予定（土曜日のゆるいゲーム枠）について告知。

highlights.title: ルイ姉のコメントの真意
highlights.description: ルイ姉がホラーゲームを怖くないと言っていたが、実際はいろはと同じくらいビビっていたことを知り、ルイ姉の「怖くない」は「心臓に悪い」という意味だと再考察する。

highlights.title: 100%クリアへの言及
highlights.description: 視聴者から寄せられたコメントに対し、全エンディングやコンプリート要素を集める100%クリアに言及するが、やるかは未定。

highlights.title: ルイ姉のホラゲ適性考察
highlights.description: ルイ姉がホラゲーウィークなどホラー企画を次々実施していることに触れ、実はルイ姉がホラゲー耐性が高いのではないかと考察する。

highlights.title: 新しい衣装の進捗報告
highlights.description: 新しい衣装のお披露目について、視聴者から質問があり、現在は最終確認中であり、今月中にはお届けできると報告。

highlights.title: ホットケーキミックスで簡単クレープ
highlights.description: 最近の趣味として、ホットケーキミックスと豆乳を使い、電子レンジで簡単にクレープを作ることにハマっていると語る。

highlights.title: リスナーの誕生日祝いと感謝
highlights.description: スーパーチャットで明日誕生日を迎えるファンからのメッセージを読み上げ、お菓子作りにハマったという報告に喜ぶ。

highlights.title: ホラゲーは当分お休み
highlights.description: ニコニココメントの話題で盛り上がった後、体力的に疲れたため、ホラゲーはしばらくお休みすると宣言。

highlights.title: フブキ先輩のホラゲ企画への覚悟
highlights.description: 視聴者からフブキ先輩とのホラーコラボを提案され、自分が先輩の「おもちゃ」になる覚悟でコラボに臨むとユーモアを交えて語った。

highlights.title: 配信終了の挨拶
highlights.description: 最後のスーパーチャットを読み終え、視聴者へ向けて配信終了の挨拶を行い、次の配信予定を告げて締めくくる。

overview_en.summary: The latter half of the live stream playing the horror game "Nikoniko-san." While using items acquired early on, she hides from the pursuers and sometimes engages in intense chase sequences. After successfully achieving the Good Ending, she reads viewer comments and Super Chats, contemplating the true meaning behind Lui-nee (Takane Lui)'s statement that the game "isn't scary." She also talks about the progress of her new outfit and her recent hobby of making easy crepes in the microwave. She declares a temporary break from horror games but wraps up the stream by discussing her readiness for a horror collaboration with Fubuki-senpai.
overview_en.mood: Transitioning from a roller-coaster horror game stream filled with fear and relief to a calm chat session

highlights_en.title: Stream start and echo trouble
highlights_en.description: Along with the opening greeting, the microphone had severe echo issues. Kazama Iroha joked, greeting the viewers by saying she was being "attacked by a haunting."

highlights_en.title: Terrified by the loud boom before starting the game
highlights_en.description: Launched the game "Nikoniko-san." Terrified by the loud warning sound that appears upon starting, she reacted by blacking out the screen.

highlights_en.title: Lui-nee said it wasn't scary, but...
highlights_en.description: She was newly terrified by the eerie atmosphere on the title screen, expressing anxiety: "Lui-nee, are you sure this isn't scary?" (Referencing the title).

highlights_en.title: First pursuer and a shocking first death
highlights_en.description: In the alley right after the game started, the first pursuer (looking like a high school girl) appeared. Though she tried to run, she was caught, resulting in the first death.

highlights_en.title: Survival tactic of hiding in a trash can and the energy drink
highlights_en.description: After restarting, she confirmed the warehouse door was locked. She began exploring, found a trash can, obtained an "Energy Drink," and gained a running boost.

highlights_en.title: Appearance of the pursuer (Nikoniko-san) and a subsequent death
highlights_en.description: The pursuer "Nikoniko-san" appeared in the alley. She tried to escape but was caught and died before the trash can cooldown finished.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining a cookie in the park, followed by instant death
highlights_en.description: Proceeding with the exploration, she obtained a "Cookie" item in the park. Immediately afterward, she was caught by the pursuer and died.

highlights_en.title: Getting information about the dog from a memo
highlights_en.description: Discovered a memo on a park bench. Learned the hint "dog" for repelling the pursuer.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining a hammer and destroying the fence
highlights_en.description: Obtained a hammer during exploration. Used it to destroy a restricted fence and proceed to the next area.

highlights_en.title: Election poster and the fox mask
highlights_en.description: Found an election poster by the roadside. Immediately after, a pursuer wearing a fox mask appeared, but she hid in a trash can to wait it out.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the chain cutter
highlights_en.description: Obtained a "Chain Cutter" at the bike parking area. Continued item collection.

highlights_en.title: Giving the dog a cookie and obtaining a key
highlights_en.description: Used the cookie on the dog in the park, making the dog disappear. Immediately afterward, a pursuer appeared, but she managed to obtain the warehouse key from the women's restroom.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the warehouse key
highlights_en.description: Obtained the "Warehouse Key," which was hidden inside a toilet bowl in the women's restroom. Preparation for approaching the core of the story is complete.

highlights_en.title: Reconfirming the purpose of the "Warehouse Key"
highlights_en.description: Compared the key in the inventory with the locked door on the map. She speculated that the "Warehouse Key" was for the starting warehouse, and a separate "Abandoned Building Key" was needed.

highlights_en.title: Pursuer approaching and stealth action in the trash can
highlights_en.description: The pursuer wandered nearby; she screamed while hiding in the trash can to wait it out.

highlights_en.title: Discovering the locked door of the abandoned building
highlights_en.description: Proceeding with the exploration, she discovered the heavily chained and padlocked door of the abandoned building. She confirmed that the "Abandoned Building Key" was necessary.

highlights_en.title: Obtaining the abandoned building key and going inside
highlights_en.description: Obtained the "Abandoned Building Key" from a TV in another hiding spot. She opened the door and entered the interior, where the space turned red, creating an ominous atmosphere.

highlights_en.title: Encountering the pursuer inside the building and fleeing with an energy drink
highlights_en.description: Encountered the pursuer inside the building and screamed. She used the energy drink boost to escape. Afterward, she obtained a "pearl-like object."

highlights_en.title: Encounter near the warehouse and evasion
highlights_en.description: She returned to the initial warehouse area, encountered the pursuer, and escaped into the trash can. She was terrified by the pursuer's movements.

highlights_en.title: Desperate danger during the trash can cooldown
highlights_en.description: Despite the trash can being on cooldown, the pursuer passed right in front of her. She endured the terror and escaped after the cooldown ended.

highlights_en.title: Dash toward the exit! Entry into the red world
highlights_en.description: She drank an energy drink and started running toward the exit (tunnel). The scenery warped, and she entered a red world.

highlights_en.title: Caught by the pursuer and dying (You are dead)
highlights_en.description: Caught by the pursuer and died in the red world. "You are dead" displayed along with her scream. She continued to die repeatedly afterward.

highlights_en.title: Breaking the door with the E-key mashing mini-game
highlights_en.description: During her escape in the red world, an E-key mashing mini-game occurred in a trapped room. She mashed the key to force the door open.

highlights_en.title: Running through a horde of pursuers towards the light exit
highlights_en.description: Beyond the door was an alien space filled with a large number of pursuers. Screaming, she ran through towards the light exit and successfully escaped.

highlights_en.title: Ending text and the moment of game clear
highlights_en.description: After the screen faded to black, text announcing her successful escape appeared, and the end credits rolled. The reunion with the dog was hinted at, reaching End 2: "One Person and One Dog."

highlights_en.title: Joy and relief upon achieving the Good Ending
highlights_en.description: She rejoiced and expressed relief upon clearing the Good Ending. She speculated on the true meaning of Lui-nee's words (that it definitely gives you heart palpitations).

highlights_en.title: Chat (reading Super Chats) and future stream announcements
highlights_en.description: Discussing her thoughts on the game, she started reading Super Chats. Mentioning her sore throat, she announced future stream plans (a relaxed gaming stream on Saturday).

highlights_en.title: The true meaning of Lui-nee's comment
highlights_en.description: Knowing that Lui-nee said the horror game wasn't scary but was actually as startled as Iroha, she re-speculated that Lui-nee meant "it gives you heart palpitations" when she said "it's not scary."

highlights_en.title: Mentioning 100% completion
highlights_en.description: Responding to viewer comments, she mentioned 100% completion (collecting all endings and completion elements), but whether she will do it is undecided.

highlights_en.title: Speculation on Lui-nee's horror game aptitude
highlights_en.description: Touching upon Lui-nee continuously organizing horror projects like "Horror Game Week," she speculated that Lui-nee might actually have a high tolerance for horror games.

highlights_en.title: Progress report on the new outfit
highlights_en.description: In response to viewer questions about the new outfit reveal, she reported that it is currently undergoing final checks and should be delivered this month.

highlights_en.title: Easy crepes with pancake mix
highlights_en.description: She talked about her recent hobby of making easy crepes in the microwave using pancake mix and soy milk.

highlights_en.title: Birthday wishes and thanks for a listener
highlights_en.description: She read a Super Chat message from a fan whose birthday was tomorrow and was delighted by the report that they got into baking.

highlights_en.title: Horror games are on hold for now
highlights_en.description: After getting excited about the topic of Nikoniko comments, she declared a temporary break from horror games due to physical exhaustion.

highlights_en.title: Resolve for Fubuki-senpai's horror game collaboration
highlights_en.description: When a viewer suggested a horror collaboration with Fubuki-senpai, she humorously stated her resolve to approach the collaboration ready to be the senior's "toy."

highlights_en.title: Stream ending greeting
highlights_en.description: Finishing reading the last Super Chat, she gave her stream ending greeting to the viewers, concluded by announcing the next stream schedule.

title: New Order / 常闇トワ (official)

overview.summary: 常闇トワのオリジナル楽曲「New Order」のミュージックビデオ（MV）。学校生活の中で、夢や目標に向かって葛藤しながらも、自分らしさを見つけ、前向きに進む若者たちの姿を、常闇トワの力強い歌声と共に描いている。実写とアニメーションを融合させた映像表現が特徴的で、バンド活動、イラスト、e-Sportsなど、様々な「好き」を追求する青春群像劇となっている。
overview.mood: エネルギッシュで前向き、青春の輝きを感じる

highlights.title: MV開始とオープニングバンド演奏
highlights.description: タイトル表示と共に、学校の校庭で紫の紙吹雪が舞う。屋上で高校生たちがバンド演奏の準備をし、演奏を開始する。

highlights.title: 個々の「好き」を追求する生徒たち
highlights.description: 教室でイラストを描く女子生徒や、PC室でゲームに熱中する男子生徒など、他者に囚われず自分の世界に没頭する生徒たちの日常が描かれる。

highlights.title: トワとの出会いと「自分らしく」
highlights.description: イラストを描く女子生徒の前に、アニメーション姿の常闇トワ（制服）が光の体で出現。彼女のイラスト（常闇トワ）が描かれるクローズアップも。

highlights.title: 屋上バンドによる情熱的なパフォーマンス
highlights.description: アニメーションのトワがバンドの中心で、高校生たちと共に屋上で歌い上げる。自分らしさを肯定する力強いサビが展開される。

highlights.title: ゲームに挑戦するもう一人の生徒
highlights.description: PC室でゲームに没頭していた男子生徒が、e-Sports会場のような場所で真剣にプレイ。モニターに映るトワに鼓舞され、拳を握る。

highlights.title: ライブハウスでの熱狂的な演奏
highlights.description: 場面がライブハウスに移り、実写のバンドとアニメーションのトワ（ロックな衣装）が観客の前でエネルギッシュなライブを繰り広げる。

highlights.title: 挑戦の結果と喜びの瞬間
highlights.description: e-Sportsの勝利（BLUE WIN）に男子生徒が歓喜し、イラストを描いていた女子生徒たちも喜びを分かち合い、手を取り合って屋上へ向かう。

highlights.title: 新しい時代と世界の広がり
highlights.description: 映像制作の女子生徒のスマホ画面に屋上バンドのトワが映る。紫の紙吹雪が街中に舞い、学校全体が映し出されてMVが締めくくられる。

overview_en.summary: Music video (MV) for Tokoyami Towa's original song "New Order."
