highlights.description: 姫様であることに囚われず、ありのままの自分を貫くことを肯定する歌詞。

highlights.title: 「なりたい私でいたい」2番サビ
highlights.description: 「どこへだって向かってゆけるのら！」と、決意を新たにするサビ。

highlights.title: 帰る理由はない！
highlights.description: 「どこになければねのら！」と、迷いなく前に進む強い姿勢を示すシーン。

highlights.title: リピートで「んなっしょい！」
highlights.description: 砂浜に建てられた砂の城の上で、ファンと共に「んなっしょい！」と何度も叫び、一体感を高める。

highlights.title: 夜空と花火の中でのクライマックス
highlights.description: 夜のステージで歌い上げる姫森ルーナ。「許される合言葉」を交わすロマンチックなシーン。

highlights.title: 永遠の約束
highlights.description: 「この先もみんなおるからへいき」と、ファンへの感謝とこれからの旅路への決意を表明し、MVが締めくくられる。

tags: んなっしょいぱっしょん

overview_en.summary: This is the music video (MV) for Himemori Luna's original song, "Nnashoi Passion." It is a summery, pop, and energetic track infused with the wish and determination to break free from the shell of being a princess, live authentically, and shine brightly alongside her fans (Lunanights). The animated MV expresses Himemori Luna's multifaceted appeal and positive message through various costumes and situations.
overview_en.mood: Pop, bright, energetic, and positive atmosphere throughout

highlights_en.title: “There's no particular punchline, nora!”
highlights_en.description: Starting from the intro, a phrase affirming her unadorned self appears as the song's first message.

highlights_en.title: Himemori Luna chasing the self she wants to be
highlights_en.description: Scenes showing her eyes sparkling while looking at a magazine, and the armored knight (Lunanight) watching over her from behind.

highlights_en.title: Jump out of bed and head to the sea!
highlights_en.description: Depicting her liberation from the constraints of reality and her push toward her aspirations.

highlights_en.title: Summer Fashion Magazine Style Theme
highlights_en.description: Himemori Luna showcases various summer outfits like a model. The theme at this moment is “Even God can make mistakes.”

highlights_en.title: Dialogue with the self in a blue dress
highlights_en.description: A dialogue with her other self (past self or ideal) dreaming in the dark. She solidifies her resolve with, “I want to live in love with love, that’s why.”

highlights_en.title: First Chorus: “I want to laugh because I want to cry”
highlights_en.description: Singing her determination to accept her weaknesses and change positively, proclaiming that even her heart can change with an “Urya!”

highlights_en.title: The Promised Password
highlights_en.description: Expressing the bond with fans as a “promised password,” imbued with the wish to “see you.”

highlights_en.title: Escaping the castle in the dark night
highlights_en.description: Scenes showing her removing her tiara in a dark room at night, escaping the castle, and heading toward the sea.

highlights_en.title: “Let's talk about being spoiled and innocent.”
highlights_en.description: Lyrics affirming the resolve to live as her true self, without being confined by the identity of a princess.

highlights_en.title: Second Chorus: “I want to be the me I want to be”
highlights_en.description: The chorus where she renews her resolve, declaring, “I can head anywhere, nora!”

highlights_en.title: No reason to go back!
highlights_en.description: A scene showing a strong stance of moving forward without hesitation, saying, “I don't have to be anywhere, nora!”

highlights_en.title: Repeating “Nnashoi!”
highlights_en.description: Repeatedly shouting “Nnashoi!” atop a sandcastle built on the beach alongside her fans, increasing the sense of unity.

highlights_en.title: Climax amidst the night sky and fireworks
highlights_en.description: Himemori Luna singing on a night stage. A romantic scene where they exchange the “allowed password.”

highlights_en.title: Eternal Promise
highlights_en.description: The MV concludes with an expression of gratitude to her fans and a determination for the journey ahead, stating, “I'm okay because everyone will be here from now on too.”

title: Lane Swap Detected #holoEN3DRepeat

overview.summary: ホロライブENのVTuberが、運転中に遭遇する「追い越し車線を低速で走り続ける車」に対する日常的な怒りを、コミカルでオーバーなリアクションで表現するショートクリップ。毎回運転するたびに発生するこのイライラを、激情的な叫びと、直後の明るい笑顔で締めくくるギャグとして描いている。視聴者に対し、追い越し車線の正しい使い方についてユーモラスに訴えかける内容となっている。
overview.mood: 激情、コミカル、ユーモラス

highlights.title: 運転中の日常的な思考
highlights.description: 運転中のVTuberが、ドライブ中にいつも同じことを考えていると語り始める。

highlights.title: 追い越し車線への激しい怒り
highlights.description: 追い越し速度で走らない車が追い越し車線にいることに激怒し、「追い越し車線から出て行け！」と怒鳴り散らす。

highlights.title: 怒りの後で笑顔に戻る
highlights.description: 怒りを爆発させた直後、すぐに明るい笑顔に戻り、今日は腹が立ったと認めて笑う。

highlights.title: 翌日も続く交通イライラ
highlights.description: 次の日も運転中、再び追い越し車線にいる遅い車に遭遇し、「道から出て行け！」と叫びながら怒りが爆発する。

overview_en.summary: A short clip featuring a Hololive EN VTuber expressing her daily frustration with "cars that continuously drive slowly in the passing lane" through comical and exaggerated reactions while driving. The recurring irritation, which happens every time she drives, is depicted as a gag culminating in a passionate scream followed immediately by a cheerful smile. The content humorously appeals to viewers regarding the correct usage of the passing lane.
overview_en.mood: Passionate, Comical, Humorous

highlights_en.title: Daily Thoughts While Driving
highlights_en.description: The VTuber starts talking about how she always thinks the same thing while on a drive.

highlights_en.title: Intense Anger Towards the Passing Lane
highlights_en.description: She explodes in anger at cars driving below passing speed in the passing lane, yelling, "Get out of the passing lane!"

highlights_en.title: Returning to a Smile After the Anger
highlights_en.description: Immediately after the outburst, she returns to a bright smile, admitting that she was frustrated today and laughing.

highlights_en.title: Traffic Frustration Continues the Next Day
highlights_en.description: While driving the next day, she encounters a slow car in the passing lane again, leading to an angry outburst while yelling, "Get off the road!"

title: 【#らでんのラジオ 】知新の秋特別編第一弾！宝石研磨編　ゲスト：ごもも【儒烏風亭らでん #ReGLOSS 】

overview.summary: 儒烏風亭らでんのラジオ企画「知新の秋特別編第一弾」として、宝石研磨を趣味とするゲストのごももさんを招いた対談配信。ごももさんが宝石研磨に興味を持ったきっかけから、原石を美しい宝石へと変えるための具体的な道具、手順、技術的な難しさについて、専門的な知識を交えて深く掘り下げていく。研磨師としての視点や、趣味としての研磨の魅力、そして初心者へのアドバイスまで、宝石の世界の奥深さを学べる密度の高いトークが展開された。
overview.mood: 終始知的好奇心を刺激する和やかな雰囲気

highlights.title: 配信開始とゲスト紹介
highlights.description: オープニングトークの後、ゲストのごももさんを紹介。今回のテーマである「宝石研磨」について、ごももさんがなぜこの趣味に辿り着いたのか、導入部分を語る。

highlights.title: 宝石研磨を始めたきっかけ
highlights.description: ごももさんが宝石研磨に興味を持った経緯や、実際に活動を始めた場所（公民館の教室など）について詳しく語る。

highlights.title: 研磨に必要な道具と初期の失敗談
highlights.description: 宝石研磨に使用する機械や砥石などの専門的な道具の説明。ごももさんが初期に研磨で石を割ってしまった失敗談を披露する。

highlights.title: 研磨する石の選び方と美の追求
highlights.description: 研磨に適した石の硬度や、内包物（インクルージョン）をどのように扱うかについて解説。ごももさんが研磨を通して追求したい美しさの定義を語る。

highlights.title: 具体的な研磨のステップ
highlights.description: 原石を宝石に仕上げるまでの具体的な工程（プレフォーム、ファセットカットなど）について、図解を想像しながら分かりやすく説明する。

highlights.title: 研磨時間の目安とコミュニティの存在
highlights.description: 石の種類やカットによって大きく異なる研磨にかかる時間について説明。また、研磨師同士の交流やコミュニティの存在についても触れる。

highlights.title: 研磨における色の重要性
highlights.description: 研磨によって石の色を最大限に引き出すための技術的なポイントについて解説。カット面の調整が光の反射に与える影響を語る。

highlights.title: 左右対称に仕上げる難しさ
highlights.description: 宝石を完璧に左右対称に仕上げるための技術的な難しさ、特に集中力が必要な理由について語り合う。

highlights.title: 機材の価格帯と研磨した石の活用法
highlights.description: 宝石研磨の機材の価格帯や、趣味として始める際の初期投資について。研磨後の石をコレクションやアクセサリーとして活用する方法を紹介。

highlights.title: 挑戦したいカットと初心者へのアドバイス
highlights.description: ごももさんが今後挑戦してみたい複雑なカットや石について語る。また、これから研磨を始める人へ、まずは簡単な石から始めるべきというアドバイスを送る。

highlights.title: 宝石の「カケラ」が持つ魅力
highlights.description: 研磨されずに残された石の破片（カケラ）にも魅力があるという話題。石の歴史や物語についての考察が交わされる。

highlights.title: モース硬度と硬い石の研磨
highlights.description: 宝石の硬さを示すモース硬度について解説。特に硬度の高い石を研磨する際の難しさや注意点について議論する。

highlights.title: 靭性（タフネス）とトルマリンの難しさ
highlights.description: 石の「硬さ（モース硬度）」と「割れにくさ（靭性/タフネス）」の違いを解説。靭性が低く研磨が難しいトルマリンを例に、具体的な苦労話が語られる。

highlights.title: 研磨の最大の魅力：美の発見
highlights.description: ごももさんが感じる宝石研磨の最大の魅力について。原石の中に隠された内側の輝きや、石の美しさを最大限に引き出すことに喜びを見出していると語る。

highlights.title: 石の産地がもたらすストーリーと個性
highlights.description: 同じ種類の石でも産地によって色味や特性が大きく異なるという話。石一つ一つが持つ「ストーリー」や、その原産地への思い入れを語り合う。

highlights.title: 研磨後の宝石の保管と活用法
highlights.description: 研磨を終えた石の具体的な保管方法（ルースケース）や、ごももさんがどのように作品をコレクションしているかを紹介。

highlights.title: 研磨に必要な集中力とストイックさ
highlights.description: 高い精度が求められる研磨作業における集中力の重要性。厳密な計算と、それをやり切るストイックさが不可欠であると熱く語る。

highlights.title: 理想のカットを追求する職人哲学
highlights.description: 石ごとに異なる最適な角度や、光の屈折率を最大限に活かすための技術的な追求について。角度がわずかにズレるだけで宝石の輝きが失われる恐ろしさを語る。

highlights.title: 研磨を始める人への最終アドバイス
highlights.description: ごももさんが、これから宝石研磨を始めたい人に向けて、先生を見つけることや、コミュニティに参加することの重要性を改めてアドバイスする。らでんがゲストへ感謝を伝える。

highlights.title: エンディングトークと次回予告
highlights.description: ゲストのごももさんをお見送りし、儒烏風亭らでんが今回の配信の感想を述べる。今後の「知新の秋特別編」の予告が行われる。

overview_en.summary: A talk show, the first installment of Juufuutei Raden's radio project "Chishin no Aki Special Edition," featuring guest Gomomo, who has a hobby of gem cutting (lapidary). The discussion delves deeply into the world of lapidary, covering Gomomo's initial interest, the specific tools, procedures, and technical difficulties involved in transforming rough stones into beautiful gems, all accompanied by expert knowledge. The conversation was dense and educational, exploring the depth of the gem world, from the perspective of a lapidary artist and the charm of the hobby, to advice for beginners.
overview_en.mood: A pleasant atmosphere that constantly stimulates intellectual curiosity

highlights_en.title: Broadcast Start and Guest Introduction
highlights_en.description: After the opening talk, the guest Gomomo is introduced. The introduction covers why Gomomo became involved in the theme of the day, "lapidary."

highlights_en.title: How They Started Lapidary
highlights_en.description: Gomomo talks in detail about how they became interested in lapidary and where they started their activities (such as community center classes).

highlights_en.title: Necessary Tools for Polishing and Early Mistakes
highlights_en.description: Explanation of specialized tools used in gem cutting, such as machines and whetstones. Gomomo shares an early mistake of cracking a stone while polishing it.

highlights_en.title: Choosing Stones for Cutting and the Pursuit of Beauty
highlights_en.description: Explanation of the hardness of stones suitable for polishing and how to handle inclusions. Gomomo describes their definition of beauty pursued through lapidary.

highlights_en.title: Specific Steps of Polishing
highlights_en.description: A clear explanation of the specific processes required to turn a rough stone into a gem (preforming, faceting, etc.), encouraging listeners to imagine diagrams.

highlights_en.title: Estimated Polishing Time and the Existence of a Community
highlights_en.description: Explanation of how polishing time varies greatly depending on the type of stone and cut. Also touches upon the existence of interaction and communities among lapidary artists.

highlights_en.title: Importance of Color in Lapidary
highlights_en.description: Explanation of technical points for maximizing the stone's color through polishing. Discusses the impact of adjusting the cut surface on light reflection.

highlights_en.title: Difficulty of Achieving Symmetry
highlights_en.description: Discussing the technical difficulty of finishing a gem perfectly symmetrically, especially why intense concentration is necessary.

highlights_en.title: Price Range of Equipment and Utilization of Polished Stones
highlights_en.description: Discussing the price range of gem cutting equipment and the initial investment required to start it as a hobby. Introducing ways to use polished stones as collections or accessories.

highlights_en.title: Cuts They Want to Try and Advice for Beginners
highlights_en.description: Gomomo talks about complex cuts and stones they want to attempt in the future. They also advise beginners starting lapidary to begin with simpler stones.

highlights_en.title: The Appeal of Gem "Fragments"
highlights_en.description: The topic shifts to the appeal of unpolished stone fragments. Reflections on the history and stories embedded in the stones are exchanged.

highlights_en.title: Mohs Hardness and Polishing Hard Stones
highlights_en.description: Explanation of Mohs hardness, which indicates the hardness of a gem. Discussion focuses on the difficulties and precautions when polishing particularly hard stones.

highlights_en.title: Toughness and the Difficulty of Tourmaline
highlights_en.description: Explaining the difference between a stone's "hardness (Mohs hardness)" and its "resistance to breaking (toughness)." Specific struggles are shared, using low-toughness, difficult-to-polish tourmaline as an example.

highlights_en.title: The Greatest Appeal of Lapidary: Discovery of Beauty
highlights_en.description: Gomomo discusses what they feel is the greatest appeal of lapidary. They express joy in uncovering the inner brilliance hidden within the rough stone and maximizing its beauty.

highlights_en.title: The Story and Individuality Provided by the Stone's Origin
highlights_en.description: Discussion about how the color and characteristics of stones of the same type vary greatly depending on their origin. They talk about the "story" each stone holds and their sentiment toward its place of origin.

highlights_en.title: Storage and Utilization of Polished Gems
highlights_en.description: Introducing specific ways to store finished stones (in loose cases) and how Gomomo collects their creations.

highlights_en.title: Concentration and Stoicism Required for Lapidary
highlights_en.description: The importance of concentration in polishing work, which demands high precision. They passionately discuss how strict calculation and the stoicism to see it through are essential.

highlights_en.title: Artisan Philosophy: The Pursuit of the Ideal Cut
highlights_en.description: Technical pursuit to find the optimal angle for each stone and maximize its light refraction. They talk about the frightening possibility of losing a gem's brilliance if the angle is slightly off.

highlights_en.title: Final Advice for Those Starting Lapidary
highlights_en.description: Gomomo reiterates the importance of finding a teacher and joining a community for those who want to start lapidary. Raden expresses gratitude to the guest.

highlights_en.title: Ending Talk and Next Broadcast Announcement
highlights_en.description: Juufuutei Raden bids farewell to the guest Gomomo, shares their thoughts on the broadcast, and announces future "Chishin no Aki Special Edition" plans.
